line-and-fold-lavash-accordion-pie.title: Line form and fold lavash
line-and-fold-lavash-accordion-pie.description: Line the baking dish with parchment. Take each lavash sheet and fold it like an accordion, placing them tightly in the dish from edge to edge.

slice-sausage-insert-accordion-pie.title: Slice sausage and insert into folds
slice-sausage-insert-accordion-pie.description: Slice the sausage into rounds. Insert the slices into the lavash folds in random order.

prepare-egg-mixture-accordion-pie.title: Prepare egg mixture
prepare-egg-mixture-accordion-pie.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the milk. Grate the cheese and add it along with dried dill and salt. Whisk with a fork or whisk until combined.

pour-mixture-accordion-pie.title: Pour mixture over lavash
pour-mixture-accordion-pie.description: Pour the egg and cheese mixture evenly over the lavash and sausage in the dish.

bake-accordion-pie.title: Bake the pie
bake-accordion-pie.description: Place the dish in an oven preheated to 180°C. Bake for 25–30 minutes until the cheese is melted and the top is golden brown.

mash-banana-air-fryer-banana-donuts.title: Mash the banana
mash-banana-air-fryer-banana-donuts.description: Take a ripe banana and mash it thoroughly with a fork until smooth puree.

combine-dry-ingredients-air-fryer-banana.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-ingredients-air-fryer-banana.description: In a small bowl, mix the rice flour and baking powder together.

mix-dough-air-fryer-banana-donuts.title: Mix dough
mix-dough-air-fryer-banana-donuts.description: Add the combined dry ingredients to the banana puree and stir until the dough comes together.

rest-dough-air-fryer-banana-donuts.title: Rest the dough
rest-dough-air-fryer-banana-donuts.description: Cover the dough and let it rest for 10 minutes to allow the rice flour to hydrate.

shape-dough-balls-air-fryer-banana-donut.title: Shape dough balls
shape-dough-balls-air-fryer-banana-donut.description: Divide the rested dough into 8 equal portions and roll each into a ball.

bake-donuts-air-fryer-banana-donuts.title: Bake in air fryer
bake-donuts-air-fryer-banana-donuts.description: Place the dough balls on the air fryer rack. Set the temperature to 180°C and bake for 10 minutes.

brush-oil-air-fryer-banana-donuts.title: Brush with oil
brush-oil-air-fryer-banana-donuts.description: Using a pastry brush, lightly coat the baked donuts with vegetable oil.

coat-donuts-air-fryer-banana-donuts.title: Coat with sugar mixture
coat-donuts-air-fryer-banana-donuts.description: Mix together the brown sugar, cinnamon, vanilla, and salt. Roll the oiled donuts in the mixture until evenly coated.

grind-oats-air-fryer-pizza.title: Grind oats into flour
grind-oats-air-fryer-pizza.description: Pour the rolled oats into a blender and grind until they become a fine flour.

blend-dough-air-fryer-pizza.title: Blend dough until smooth
blend-dough-air-fryer-pizza.description: Add the tvorog, egg, and salt to the oat flour. Blend again until the mixture is smooth and sticky, similar to pancake batter.

cut-chicken-air-fryer-pizza.title: Cut and season the chicken
cut-chicken-air-fryer-pizza.description: Dice the chicken breast into small cubes. Season with salt and pepper, then mix well.

slice-vegetables-air-fryer-pizza.title: Slice the vegetables
slice-vegetables-air-fryer-pizza.description: Cut the bell pepper into thin strips, the red onion into half-rings, and slice the mushrooms thinly.

spread-dough-air-fryer-pizza.title: Spread the dough on parchment
spread-dough-air-fryer-pizza.description: Place the sticky dough on a sheet of parchment paper and spread it into a thin, even circle.

add-toppings-air-fryer-pizza.title: Add ketchup and toppings
add-toppings-air-fryer-pizza.description: Spread a layer of ketchup over the dough. Arrange the chicken, mushrooms, bell pepper, onion, and whole cherry tomatoes on top.

add-mozzarella-air-fryer-pizza.title: Add mozzarella slices
add-mozzarella-air-fryer-pizza.description: Slice the mozzarella and distribute the slices evenly over the toppings.

bake-air-fryer-pizza.title: Bake in the air fryer
bake-air-fryer-pizza.description: Place the parchment with the pizza into the air fryer basket. Bake at 150°C for 20 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted.

add-tea-mint-apple-banana-green-tea-smoo.title: Add tea and mint to teapot
add-tea-mint-apple-banana-green-tea-smoo.description: Place the green tea leaves and fresh mint sprig into a teapot.

pour-water-steep-apple-banana-green-tea-.title: Pour boiling water and steep
pour-water-steep-apple-banana-green-tea-.description: Pour boiling water into the teapot, cover, and let steep for 10 minutes.

pour-tea-glass-apple-banana-green-tea-sm.title: Pour tea into glass
pour-tea-glass-apple-banana-green-tea-sm.description: Strain the tea into a tall glass and allow it to cool completely.

cool-tea-apple-banana-green-tea-smoothie.title: Cool the tea completely
cool-tea-apple-banana-green-tea-smoothie.description: Let the tea sit until it reaches room temperature, about 20 minutes.

prepare-fruit-apple-banana-green-tea-smo.title: Prepare the fruit
prepare-fruit-apple-banana-green-tea-smo.description: Peel the banana and remove the apple core. Cut both into arbitrary pieces.

blend-smoothie-apple-banana-green-tea-sm.title: Blend the smoothie
blend-smoothie-apple-banana-green-tea-sm.description: Transfer the cooled tea to a blender. Add the chopped apple, banana, and topinambur syrup. Blend until smooth.

slice-and-core-apples-apple-horseshoes.title: Slice and core the apples
slice-and-core-apples-apple-horseshoes.description: Slice the apples into circles about 1 cm thick. Remove the cores from each slice, then cut them in half to create small horseshoe shapes.

roll-and-cut-dough-apple-horseshoes.title: Roll and cut the dough
roll-and-cut-dough-apple-horseshoes.description: Dust your work surface with flour. Roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of 5 mm. Then cut the dough into strips about 1 cm wide.

wrap-apple-slices-apple-horseshoes.title: Wrap the apple slices with dough
wrap-apple-slices-apple-horseshoes.description: Take each apple half and wrap it with a strip of dough, overlapping the turns slightly so that each turn partially covers the previous one.

apply-egg-wash-and-cinnamon-sugar-apple-.title: Apply egg wash and cinnamon sugar
apply-egg-wash-and-cinnamon-sugar-apple-.description: Crack an egg into a clean bowl and beat lightly with a fork. In another bowl, mix the sugar and cinnamon. Brush the wrapped apple pastries with the egg mixture and sprinkle them with the cinnamon sugar.

transfer-to-baking-sheet-apple-horseshoe.title: Transfer to baking sheet
transfer-to-baking-sheet-apple-horseshoe.description: Place the prepared pastries onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper if desired.

bake-pastries-apple-horseshoes.title: Bake the pastries
bake-pastries-apple-horseshoes.description: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for 15-20 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

cool-pastries-apple-horseshoes.title: Cool the pastries
cool-pastries-apple-horseshoes.description: Remove the pastries from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

sift-dry-apple-pancakes.title: Sift dry ingredients
sift-dry-apple-pancakes.description: Sift the flour into a deep bowl. Add a pinch of salt and vanilla sugar.

mix-eggs-milk-apple-pancakes.title: Mix eggs and milk
mix-eggs-milk-apple-pancakes.description: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the milk until combined.

combine-batter-apple-pancakes.title: Combine wet and dry ingredients
combine-batter-apple-pancakes.description: Slowly pour the egg-milk mixture into the flour while whisking. Add the rum and mix until the batter is smooth and free of lumps.

rest-batter-apple-pancakes.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-apple-pancakes.description: Cover the bowl and let the batter rest at room temperature for 1 hour. This allows the gluten to relax and gives a tender texture.

slice-apples-apple-pancakes.title: Slice the apples
slice-apples-apple-pancakes.description: Core the apples and cut them into thin slices, about 3 mm thick.

heat-pan-apple-pancakes.title: Heat the pan with oil
heat-pan-apple-pancakes.description: Place a frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with sunflower oil.

dip-apples-apple-pancakes.title: Dip apple slices in batter and arrange in pan
dip-apples-apple-pancakes.description: Quickly dip each apple slice into the batter, then place them overlapping in a circular pattern in the hot pan. Spoon a little extra batter over the top.

fry-first-side-apple-pancakes.title: Fry the first side
fry-first-side-apple-pancakes.description: Cook the pancakes on one side for 3 to 5 minutes, until golden brown and set. Be careful not to rush, as they need to hold their shape.

flip-fry-second-side-apple-pancakes.title: Flip and fry the second side
flip-fry-second-side-apple-pancakes.description: Using a spatula, carefully flip the pancakes. Fry for another 3 to 5 minutes until cooked through and golden on both sides.

cut-chicken-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Cut the chicken
cut-chicken-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: Cut the chicken into small, bite-sized pieces.

fry-chicken-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: Heat oil in a skillet over high heat. Fry the chicken pieces for 10 minutes until golden brown and crispy on all sides.

remove-chicken-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Remove the chicken
remove-chicken-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: Transfer the fried chicken to a plate and set aside.

fry-onion-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Fry the onion
fry-onion-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: In the same skillet, fry the onion over medium heat until golden and translucent, about 5 minutes.

blanch-tomatoes-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Blanch the tomatoes
blanch-tomatoes-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: Make shallow cuts at the bottom of each tomato, then pour boiling water over them. Let sit for 2 minutes, then drain.

peel-and-dice-tomatoes-authentic-chakhok.title: Peel and dice the tomatoes
peel-and-dice-tomatoes-authentic-chakhok.description: Once cool enough to handle, peel off the skins and chop the tomatoes into small cubes.

simmer-tomato-sauce-authentic-chakhokhbi.title: Simmer the tomato sauce
simmer-tomato-sauce-authentic-chakhokhbi.description: Add the fresh diced tomatoes and canned tomatoes to the skillet with the onion. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

add-spices-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Add the spices
add-spices-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: Stir in the khmeli-suneli, utskho-suneli, savory, salt, and sugar. Mix well.

return-chicken-and-chili-authentic-chakh.title: Return the chicken and chili
return-chicken-and-chili-authentic-chakh.description: Place the fried chicken back into the skillet. Add the chili pepper. Stir to combine.

stew-chakhokhbili-authentic-chakhokhbili.title: Stew the chakhokhbili
stew-chakhokhbili-authentic-chakhokhbili.description: Cover the skillet with a lid and cook over medium-low heat for 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender and the flavors meld.

add-cilantro-and-garlic-authentic-chakho.title: Add cilantro and garlic
add-cilantro-and-garlic-authentic-chakho.description: Finely chop the cilantro and garlic. Stir them into the stew just before serving.

boil-egg-avocado-sandwiches-breakfast.title: Boil the egg
boil-egg-avocado-sandwiches-breakfast.description: Place the egg in a small saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Boil for exactly 10 minutes from the moment the water starts boiling.

cool-peel-egg-avocado-sandwiches-breakfa.title: Cool and peel the egg
cool-peel-egg-avocado-sandwiches-breakfa.description: Transfer the boiled egg to a bowl of ice water and let it cool completely. Once cool, peel off the shell and set aside.

toast-bread-avocado-sandwiches-breakfast.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-avocado-sandwiches-breakfast.description: Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Toast the bread slices on both sides until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Alternatively, you can use a toaster.

chop-prepare-ingredients-avocado-sandwic.title: Chop and prepare the filling ingredients
chop-prepare-ingredients-avocado-sandwic.description: Finely chop the crab sticks. Cut the cherry tomatoes into quarters. Mash the boiled egg with a fork until crumbly.

mix-filling-avocado-sandwiches-breakfast.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-avocado-sandwiches-breakfast.description: In a bowl, combine the chopped crab sticks, cherry tomatoes, and mashed egg. Add the cream cheese and stir until well combined.

mash-avocado-spread-avocado-sandwiches-b.title: Mash avocado and spread on toast
mash-avocado-spread-avocado-sandwiches-b.description: Scoop the avocado flesh into a bowl and mash it with a fork until smooth. Spread the mashed avocado evenly over each toasted bread slice.

assemble-sandwiches-avocado-sandwiches-b.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-avocado-sandwiches-b.description: Spoon the egg and crab mixture onto the avocado-covered toasts. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper to taste.

make-well-and-mix-ayran-pancakes.title: Make a well and mix
make-well-and-mix-ayran-pancakes.description: Sift the flour into a bowl and make a well in the center. Pour in the ayran at room temperature and stir gently to combine.

add-soda-salt-and-beat-ayran-pancakes.title: Add soda and salt and beat
add-soda-salt-and-beat-ayran-pancakes.description: Add the baking soda and salt to the batter. Beat with a mixer on medium speed for 2–3 minutes until smooth and homogeneous.

rest-batter-ayran-pancakes.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-ayran-pancakes.description: Cover the bowl with a clean cloth and let the batter rest in a warm place for 30 minutes. This allows the gluten to relax and the bubbles to form.

heat-pan-and-grease-ayran-pancakes.title: Heat and grease the pan
heat-pan-and-grease-ayran-pancakes.description: Place a frying pan over medium heat. Add a small amount of butter and let it melt, coating the pan evenly.

cook-pancakes-ayran-pancakes.title: Cook the pancakes
cook-pancakes-ayran-pancakes.description: Pour about half a ladle of batter into the pan, spreading it into a thin layer. Cook for 1–2 minutes until the surface is set and bubbly. Flip and cook the other side for another 1–2 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the pan with butter as needed.

separate-eggs-bagels-air-fryer.title: Separate the eggs
separate-eggs-bagels-air-fryer.description: Separate the white from the yolk of one egg. Add the white to the tvorog and crack the second whole egg into the same bowl.

grate-cheese-bagels-air-fryer.title: Grate the cheese
grate-cheese-bagels-air-fryer.description: Grate the hard cheese on a fine grater.

mix-dough-bagels-air-fryer.title: Mix the dough
mix-dough-bagels-air-fryer.description: Add the grated cheese, rice flour, and salt to the tvorog mixture. Stir well until evenly combined.

divide-dough-bagels-air-fryer.title: Divide the dough
divide-dough-bagels-air-fryer.description: Split the tvorog dough into two equal portions.

shape-bagels-bagels-air-fryer.title: Shape the bagels
shape-bagels-bagels-air-fryer.description: Roll each portion into a thick sausage. Join the ends to form a ring, pinching firmly to seal. Repeat with the second piece.

transfer-to-air-fryer-bagels-air-fryer.title: Transfer to air fryer
transfer-to-air-fryer-bagels-air-fryer.description: Place the shaped bagels onto a parchment-lined air fryer basket.

brush-with-yolk-bagels-air-fryer.title: Brush with yolk
brush-with-yolk-bagels-air-fryer.description: Brush the tops of the bagels with the reserved egg yolk for a golden finish.

sprinkle-sesame-bagels-air-fryer.title: Sprinkle sesame seeds
sprinkle-sesame-bagels-air-fryer.description: Sprinkle sesame seeds (and black sesame if desired) over the bagels.

bake-bagels-air-fryer.title: Bake the bagels
bake-bagels-air-fryer.description: Bake in the air fryer for 15–20 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.

prepare-filling-bagels-air-fryer.title: Prepare the filling
prepare-filling-bagels-air-fryer.description: Slice the tomato and ham, and wash the spinach leaves.

assemble-bagels-bagels-air-fryer.title: Assemble the bagels
assemble-bagels-bagels-air-fryer.description: Once baked, cut each bagel in half horizontally. Spread cream cheese on the cut sides, then layer spinach leaves, ham, and tomato slices on the bottom half. Close with the top half.

peel-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-c.title: Peel the apples
peel-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-c.description: Peel the apples using a vegetable peeler or a small knife.

core-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-c.title: Core the apples
core-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-c.description: Remove the cores from the apples, keeping them whole.

place-apples-in-pot-baked-apples-with-me.title: Place apples in a pot
place-apples-in-pot-baked-apples-with-me.description: Put the cored apples into a saucepan and cover with water.

add-water-and-sugar-baked-apples-with-me.title: Add water and sugar
add-water-and-sugar-baked-apples-with-me.description: Pour in enough water to cover the apples and add 1 tablespoon of sugar.

boil-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-c.title: Boil the apples
boil-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-c.description: Bring the water to a boil, then simmer for 6–7 minutes. Do not overcook.

drain-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-.title: Drain the apples
drain-apples-baked-apples-with-meringue-.description: Drain the apples in a colander and let all the moisture drip off.

transfer-to-baking-sheet-baked-apples-wi.title: Transfer to a baking sheet
transfer-to-baking-sheet-baked-apples-wi.description: Place the drained apples on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

sprinkle-half-sugar-and-cinnamon-baked-a.title: Sprinkle half of the sugar and cinnamon
sprinkle-half-sugar-and-cinnamon-baked-a.description: Measure half of the remaining sugar and sprinkle it over the apples. Dust with half of the cinnamon.

beat-egg-whites-baked-apples-with-mering.title: Beat the egg whites
beat-egg-whites-baked-apples-with-mering.description: Beat the egg whites with 1 tablespoon of sugar until stiff peaks form.

top-apples-with-meringue-baked-apples-wi.title: Top apples with meringue
top-apples-with-meringue-baked-apples-wi.description: Spoon the whipped egg whites over each apple, creating a fluffy 'hat'.

sprinkle-remaining-sugar-and-cinnamon-ba.title: Sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon
sprinkle-remaining-sugar-and-cinnamon-ba.description: Sprinkle the remaining sugar and cinnamon over the meringue tops.

bake-baked-apples-with-meringue-coat.title: Bake the apples
bake-baked-apples-with-meringue-coat.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Bake the apples for 5–7 minutes, until the meringue is lightly browned.

cut-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.title: Cut the chicken
cut-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.description: Cut the whole chicken into serving pieces. Use a sharp knife to separate the breasts, thighs, drumsticks, and wings as desired.

season-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.title: Season the chicken
season-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.description: Combine salt, white pepper, and curry powder. Rub the spice mixture thoroughly all over each piece of chicken.

preheat-oven-baked-chicken-in-cream.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-baked-chicken-in-cream.description: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Make sure it is fully heated before baking.

arrange-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.title: Arrange chicken in dish
arrange-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.description: Place the seasoned chicken pieces in a baking dish. Pour heavy cream over the chicken and mix gently to coat all pieces.

bake-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.title: Bake the chicken
bake-chicken-baked-chicken-in-cream.description: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for about 55 minutes, until the chicken is tender and cooked through. The cream will reduce and form a creamy sauce.

mix-marinade-baked-chicken-kefir-marinad.title: Mix the marinade
mix-marinade-baked-chicken-kefir-marinad.description: In a separate bowl, combine kefir, minced garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.

coat-chicken-baked-chicken-kefir-marinad.title: Coat the chicken and marinate
coat-chicken-baked-chicken-kefir-marinad.description: Place the chicken in a baking dish. Pour the marinade over it, making sure all parts are covered. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.

bake-chicken-baked-chicken-kefir-marinad.title: Bake the chicken
bake-chicken-baked-chicken-kefir-marinad.description: Bake the marinated chicken in the preheated oven for 45 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.

combine-brine-ingredients-baked-chicken-.title: Combine brine ingredients
combine-brine-ingredients-baked-chicken-.description: Pour 2 liters of water and 4 cups of apple cider into a large pot. Add salt (reserving ½ tsp), brown sugar, and black peppercorns. Tie 2-3 sprigs of thyme with kitchen twine and add to the pot.

heat-brine-baked-chicken-with-apples.title: Heat the brine
heat-brine-baked-chicken-with-apples.description: Place the pot over medium heat and stir until the salt and sugar are fully dissolved, about 3-4 minutes. Do not let it boil.

cool-brine-and-submerge-chicken-baked-ch.title: Cool brine and submerge chicken
cool-brine-and-submerge-chicken-baked-ch.description: Pour 1 liter of cold water into a deep bowl, then pour the hot brine into it. Stir to cool to room temperature. Place the chicken breast-side down into the brine, pressing to fully submerge.

refrigerate-chicken-in-brine-baked-chick.title: Refrigerate chicken in brine
refrigerate-chicken-in-brine-baked-chick.description: Cover the bowl and transfer to the refrigerator. Let the chicken marinate for 12 to 16 hours.

remove-and-pat-dry-chicken-baked-chicken.title: Remove and pat dry chicken
remove-and-pat-dry-chicken-baked-chicken.description: Remove the chicken from the brine. Pat it dry thoroughly with paper towels. This helps the skin crisp later.

dry-chicken-at-room-temperature-baked-ch.title: Dry chicken at room temperature
dry-chicken-at-room-temperature-baked-ch.description: Place the chicken on a wire rack breast-side up and let it dry at room temperature for 1 hour. This allows the skin to dry out, ensuring a crispy roast.

soften-butter-baked-chicken-with-apples.title: Let butter soften
soften-butter-baked-chicken-with-apples.description: Take the butter out of the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 20-30 minutes until softened.

make-herb-butter-baked-chicken-with-appl.title: Make herb butter
make-herb-butter-baked-chicken-with-appl.description: In a small bowl, combine 3 tablespoons of the softened butter with finely chopped thyme and sage. Grate the zest of half an orange over the bowl. Add ½ teaspoon of salt and ground black pepper. Mix well. Set aside 1 tablespoon of this mixture for the glaze.

preheat-oven-baked-chicken-with-apples.title: Preheat oven to 180°C
preheat-oven-baked-chicken-with-apples.description: Turn on the oven and preheat it to 180°C (350°F). This usually takes about 15 minutes.

prepare-aromatics-baked-chicken-with-app.title: Prepare aromatics
prepare-aromatics-baked-chicken-with-app.description: Slice the onion into thick rings. Cut the orange in half; reserve one half and cut the other half into quarters. Tie 2-3 sprigs of thyme and 1 sprig of sage together with kitchen twine.

arrange-aromatics-in-tray-baked-chicken-.title: Arrange aromatics in baking tray
arrange-aromatics-in-tray-baked-chicken-.description: Pour olive oil and 1 cup of apple cider into a deep baking tray. Add the sliced onion, orange quarters, whole garlic cloves, and the tied herb bundle.

prepare-chicken-for-roasting-baked-chick.title: Prepare chicken for roasting
prepare-chicken-for-roasting-baked-chick.description: Place the wire rack with the dried chicken on top of the tray. Stuff the cavity with the reserved orange half and remaining thyme. Brush the chicken all over with the herb butter. Tuck the wing tips under the back and tie the legs together with kitchen twine.

first-roast-chicken-baked-chicken-with-a.title: Roast chicken for 1 hour
first-roast-chicken-baked-chicken-with-a.description: Place the tray in the preheated oven and roast the chicken for 1 hour. The herbs and aromatics will infuse the meat with flavor.

prepare-apples-and-melt-butter-baked-chi.title: Prepare apples and melt butter
prepare-apples-and-melt-butter-baked-chi.description: Halve the apples without removing the cores. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a microwave or small saucepan until melted.

arrange-apples-on-tray-baked-chicken-wit.title: Arrange apples around chicken
arrange-apples-on-tray-baked-chicken-wit.description: Remove the chicken from the oven. Arrange the apple halves cut-side up around the chicken on the rack. Brush the apples with the melted butter.

second-roast-with-apples-baked-chicken-w.title: Roast chicken with apples
second-roast-with-apples-baked-chicken-w.description: Return the tray to the oven and roast for another 30-40 minutes, until the apples are tender and the chicken is golden.

make-glaze-baked-chicken-with-apples.title: Make maple-cider glaze
make-glaze-baked-chicken-with-apples.description: In a small saucepan, bring 1½ cups of apple cider to a boil over medium heat. Cook until reduced by half. Whisk in maple syrup and the reserved herb butter. Boil for 1-2 minutes until thickened, then remove from heat.

first-glaze-and-roast-baked-chicken-with.title: First glaze and roast
first-glaze-and-roast-baked-chicken-with.description: Brush half of the glaze over the chicken. Return to the oven and roast for 10 minutes.

second-glaze-and-final-roast-baked-chick.title: Second glaze and final roast
second-glaze-and-final-roast-baked-chick.description: Brush the remaining glaze over the chicken. Roast for another 10-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is caramelized.

plate-chicken-and-apples-baked-chicken-w.title: Plate chicken and apples
plate-chicken-and-apples-baked-chicken-w.description: Transfer the roasted chicken and apples to a serving platter. Let rest for a few minutes before carving.

make-gravy-baked-chicken-with-apples.title: Make gravy from pan drippings
make-gravy-baked-chicken-with-apples.description: Collect the drippings and fat from the baking tray into a skillet. Heat over medium heat and whisk in flour until smooth. Gradually pour in 1 cup of water, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and cook 1-2 minutes until thickened. Serve in a sauceboat.

grate-cheese-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.title: Grate the mozzarella
grate-cheese-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.description: Take the mozzarella and grate it on a coarse grater. Set the cheese aside.

grease-dish-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.title: Grease the baking dish
grease-dish-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.description: Lightly grease a baking dish with vegetable oil. You can use a brush or a paper towel to spread the oil evenly.

place-bread-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.title: Place the bread slices
place-bread-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.description: Arrange the bread slices in the bottom of the greased dish. If they are too large, trim them to fit snugly.

sprinkle-half-cheese-baked-eggs-bread-ch.title: Sprinkle half the cheese
sprinkle-half-cheese-baked-eggs-bread-ch.description: Sprinkle half of the grated mozzarella evenly over the bread slices.

crack-eggs-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.title: Crack the eggs on top
crack-eggs-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.description: Carefully crack the eggs directly onto the cheese layer, trying not to break the yolks. Spread them so they cover the bread.

season-eggs-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.title: Season the eggs
season-eggs-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.description: Sprinkle salt and freshly ground black pepper over the eggs to taste.

sprinkle-remaining-cheese-baked-eggs-bre.title: Top with remaining cheese
sprinkle-remaining-cheese-baked-eggs-bre.description: Sprinkle the rest of the grated mozzarella over the eggs.

bake-casserole-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.title: Bake the casserole
bake-casserole-baked-eggs-bread-cheese.description: Place the dish in an oven preheated to 180°C (350°F). Bake for 15–20 minutes, until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and lightly golden.

line-baking-tray-baked-granola.title: Line the baking tray
line-baking-tray-baked-granola.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.

spread-oats-baked-granola.title: Spread oats on the tray
spread-oats-baked-granola.description: Spread the rolled oats evenly on the prepared baking tray.

bake-oats-10min-baked-granola.title: Bake oats for 10 minutes
bake-oats-10min-baked-granola.description: Place the tray in the preheated oven and bake the oats for 10 minutes.

stir-oats-baked-granola.title: Stir the oats
stir-oats-baked-granola.description: Remove the tray from the oven and stir the oats gently.

bake-oats-15min-baked-granola.title: Bake oats for another 15 minutes
bake-oats-15min-baked-granola.description: Return the tray to the oven and bake for 15 more minutes at 150°C.

remove-and-increase-temp-baked-granola.title: Remove and increase oven temperature
remove-and-increase-temp-baked-granola.description: Take the tray out of the oven and increase the oven temperature to 170°C (340°F).

add-dry-ingredients-baked-granola.title: Add dried fruit and seeds
add-dry-ingredients-baked-granola.description: Add the dried fruit mix, sunflower seeds, pumpkin seeds, and flax seeds to the oats. Stir to combine.

bake-5min-baked-granola.title: Bake for 5 minutes
bake-5min-baked-granola.description: Return the tray to the oven and bake for 5 minutes at 170°C.

mix-honey-oil-pour-baked-granola.title: Mix honey and oil and pour over granola
mix-honey-oil-pour-baked-granola.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the honey and vegetable oil. Pour the mixture over the granola and stir to coat evenly.

bake-20min-stirring-baked-granola.title: Bake for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally
bake-20min-stirring-baked-granola.description: Bake the granola for 20 minutes at 170°C, stirring every 5–7 minutes to ensure even browning.

cool-granola-baked-granola.title: Cool the granola
cool-granola-baked-granola.description: Turn off the oven and let the granola cool completely on the tray. It will become crisp as it cools.

melt-butter-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and melt it in short bursts until fully melted. Set aside to cool.

cool-butter-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Cool the butter
cool-butter-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Let the melted butter cool to room temperature so it doesn't cook the eggs.

heat-milk-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Warm the baked milk
heat-milk-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Gently warm the baked milk in a microwave or on the stove until it is warm to the touch but not boiling.

separate-eggs-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Separate egg yolks and whites
separate-eggs-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Carefully separate the egg whites from the yolks, ensuring no yolk gets into the whites.

whisk-yolks-with-sugar-baked-milk-pancak.title: Whisk yolks with sugar
whisk-yolks-with-sugar-baked-milk-pancak.description: Combine the egg yolks with 2 tablespoons of sugar and whisk vigorously until the mixture becomes pale and fluffy, about 3-4 minutes.

combine-yolks-butter-milk-baked-milk-pan.title: Combine yolk mixture with butter and milk
combine-yolks-butter-milk-baked-milk-pan.description: Pour the cooled butter and warmed milk into the yolk mixture. Mix with a blender on low speed until well combined.

mix-flour-baking-powder-baked-milk-panca.title: Mix flour and baking powder
mix-flour-baking-powder-baked-milk-panca.description: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and baking powder to ensure even distribution.

add-dry-to-wet-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Add dry ingredients to wet
add-dry-to-wet-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture, stirring gently until just combined. Do not overmix.

whip-egg-whites-sugar-baked-milk-pancake.title: Whip egg whites with sugar
whip-egg-whites-sugar-baked-milk-pancake.description: Place the egg whites in a clean, dry blender bowl. Add the remaining sugar and whip on low speed, gradually increasing, until stiff peaks form. The whites should hold their shape.

fold-egg-whites-into-batter-baked-milk-p.title: Fold egg whites into batter
fold-egg-whites-into-batter-baked-milk-p.description: Gently fold the whipped egg whites into the batter using a spatula. Use an up-and-down motion to keep the batter airy. The batter should be slightly thicker than regular pancake batter.

heat-pan-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Heat a non-stick pan
heat-pan-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Place a non-stick frying pan over low heat and let it warm up for about 2 minutes.

cook-first-side-baked-milk-pancakes.title: Cook the first side of the pancake
cook-first-side-baked-milk-pancakes.description: Pour about half a ladleful of batter into the pan to form a round pancake. Cook on low heat until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges look set, about 2-4 minutes.

flip-and-cook-second-side-baked-milk-pan.title: Flip and cook the second side
flip-and-cook-second-side-baked-milk-pan.description: Carefully flip the pancake with a spatula and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown. Transfer to a plate.

cook-remaining-pancakes-baked-milk-panca.title: Cook the remaining pancakes
cook-remaining-pancakes-baked-milk-panca.description: Repeat the process with the remaining batter, cooking each pancake for 2-4 minutes on the first side and 1-2 minutes on the second side. Stack them as you go.

heat-milk-and-sugar-baked-millet-porridg.title: Heat milk and vanilla sugar
heat-milk-and-sugar-baked-millet-porridg.description: Combine almond milk and vanilla sugar in a saucepan. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil.

cook-millet-porridge-baked-millet-porrid.title: Cook millet porridge
cook-millet-porridge-baked-millet-porrid.description: Stir in millet once the milk boils, then reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the millet is tender and the porridge thickens.

cool-porridge-baked-millet-porridge-with.title: Cool porridge slightly
cool-porridge-baked-millet-porridge-with.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the porridge cool for about 10 minutes, so it's warm but not steaming.

prepare-banana-baked-millet-porridge-wit.title: Prepare banana
prepare-banana-baked-millet-porridge-wit.description: Peel the banana and slice it into rounds. Sprinkle with lemon juice to prevent browning and set aside.

mix-porridge-mixture-baked-millet-porrid.title: Mix porridge mixture
mix-porridge-mixture-baked-millet-porrid.description: In a deep bowl, whisk together the egg and heavy cream. Add the cooled millet porridge and stir until well combined and smooth. Gently fold in the banana slices.

fill-ramekins-baked-millet-porridge-with.title: Fill ramekins
fill-ramekins-baked-millet-porridge-with.description: Grease ceramic ramekins with butter. Fill each ramekin two-thirds full with the millet mixture.

bake-millet-porridge-baked-millet-porrid.title: Bake millet porridge
bake-millet-porridge-baked-millet-porrid.description: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Place the filled ramekins on a baking sheet or wire rack. Bake for 20 minutes, until the top is golden and the edges are set.

cool-baked-porridge-baked-millet-porridg.title: Cool baked porridge
cool-baked-porridge-baked-millet-porridg.description: Remove the ramekins from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.

preheat-oven-baked-omelet-with-cod.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-baked-omelet-with-cod.description: Set your oven to 180°C (350°F) and allow it to preheat fully before baking.

grate-and-cut-baked-omelet-with-cod.title: Grate cheese and carrot, slice onion and fish
grate-and-cut-baked-omelet-with-cod.description: Grate the cheese and carrot on a coarse grater. Slice the onion into quarter rings. Cut the cod fillet into pieces 2–2.5 cm wide.

beat-egg-mixture-baked-omelet-with-cod.title: Beat eggs with milk and salt
beat-egg-mixture-baked-omelet-with-cod.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the milk and salt. Beat with a mixer on medium speed for 2–3 minutes until the mixture is fluffy and smooth.

grease-baking-dish-baked-omelet-with-cod.title: Grease the baking dish
grease-baking-dish-baked-omelet-with-cod.description: Use 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil to lightly grease the baking dish.

heat-oil-in-skillet-baked-omelet-with-co.title: Heat oil in a skillet
heat-oil-in-skillet-baked-omelet-with-co.description: Pour the remaining sunflower oil into a skillet and heat over medium heat.

saute-onion-baked-omelet-with-cod.title: Sauté the onion
saute-onion-baked-omelet-with-cod.description: Add the sliced onion to the hot skillet and sauté, stirring occasionally, for 1–2 minutes until it turns light golden.

add-carrot-and-saute-baked-omelet-with-c.title: Add carrot and continue sautéing
add-carrot-and-saute-baked-omelet-with-c.description: Add the grated carrot to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, for another 2–3 minutes until the carrot is lightly browned. Remove the skillet from the heat.

assemble-baked-omelet-with-cod.title: Layer the ingredients in the dish
assemble-baked-omelet-with-cod.description: Spread the sautéed vegetables evenly in the greased baking dish. Arrange the cod pieces on top. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the fish, then sprinkle with the grated cheese.

bake-omelet-with-cod.title: Bake the omelet with cod
bake-omelet-with-cod.description: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 20–25 minutes until the omelet is set and golden brown on top.

heat-milk-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.title: Heat the milk
heat-milk-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.description: Pour the milk into a saucepan and place over medium heat. Wait for the first signs of boiling.

cook-semolina-baked-semolina-porridge-pe.title: Cook the semolina
cook-semolina-baked-semolina-porridge-pe.description: While stirring continuously, add the semolina in a thin stream. Cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring vigorously. Then remove from heat and allow to cool.

cool-semolina-baked-semolina-porridge-pe.title: Cool the semolina
cool-semolina-baked-semolina-porridge-pe.description: Let the cooked semolina porridge cool to room temperature. This will prepare it for mixing with eggs.

cut-pear-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.title: Cut the pear
cut-pear-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.description: Slice the pear lengthwise into two halves. Remove the core and seeds.

beat-eggs-sugar-baked-semolina-porridge-.title: Beat eggs with sugar
beat-eggs-sugar-baked-semolina-porridge-.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the regular sugar and vanilla sugar. Beat until the mixture becomes light and fluffy.

preheat-oven-baked-semolina-porridge-pea.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-baked-semolina-porridge-pea.description: Set your oven to 200°C (400°F) and allow it to fully preheat before baking.

grease-dish-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.title: Grease the baking dish
grease-dish-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.description: Butter the inside of your baking dish to prevent sticking.

mix-eggs-semolina-baked-semolina-porridg.title: Combine eggs with semolina
mix-eggs-semolina-baked-semolina-porridg.description: Pour the beaten egg mixture into the cooled semolina. Add ground cinnamon and cardamom. Stir everything together thoroughly.

spread-mixture-baked-semolina-porridge-p.title: Spread the mixture
spread-mixture-baked-semolina-porridge-p.description: Transfer the semolina mixture into the prepared baking dish. Spread it out evenly.

bake-initial-baked-semolina-porridge-pea.title: Bake for 5 minutes
bake-initial-baked-semolina-porridge-pea.description: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 5 minutes. The surface will start to set.

add-pears-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.title: Add pear halves
add-pears-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.description: Remove the dish from the oven. Carefully place the pear halves on top, cut side up.

bake-final-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.title: Bake for another 20 minutes
bake-final-baked-semolina-porridge-pear.description: Return the dish to the oven and continue baking for 20 minutes at the same temperature (200°C). The porridge will become golden and puffy.

marinate-onion-bean-and-egg-breakfast.title: Marinate the onion in lime juice
marinate-onion-bean-and-egg-breakfast.description: Squeeze the lime juice and slice half of the red onion into half rings. Place the onion in a bowl and pour the lime juice over it. Let it marinate for 10–15 minutes.

saute-onion-garlic-bean-and-egg-breakfas.title: Sauté onion and garlic
saute-onion-garlic-bean-and-egg-breakfas.description: Finely dice the remaining onion and the garlic. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until golden, about 5–7 minutes.

add-tomato-paste-barbecue-bean-and-egg-b.title: Add tomato paste and barbecue sauce
add-tomato-paste-barbecue-bean-and-egg-b.description: Stir in the tomato paste and barbecue sauce, and cook for 2 minutes while stirring.

add-sugar-bean-and-egg-breakfast.title: Add sugar
add-sugar-bean-and-egg-breakfast.description: Sprinkle in the sugar and cook for 1 more minute, stirring to combine.

cook-beans-bean-and-egg-breakfast.title: Cook the beans
cook-beans-bean-and-egg-breakfast.description: Add the canned white beans along with their liquid. Stir, bring to a boil, then cook over medium heat for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens to a consistency similar to Bolognese sauce.

cook-eggs-bean-and-egg-breakfast.title: Cook the eggs in the beans
cook-eggs-bean-and-egg-breakfast.description: Crack the eggs directly into the bean mixture. Cover the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until the eggs are set to your liking.

prep-vegetables-bean-pate.title: Prepare the vegetables
prep-vegetables-bean-pate.description: Dice the onion into 3-4 mm cubes. Coarsely grate the carrot. Finely chop the garlic. Separate the parsley leaves from the stems.

saute-onion-carrot-bean-pate.title: Sauté onion and carrot
saute-onion-carrot-bean-pate.description: Heat the sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the onion, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until lightly golden. Add the carrot and fry, stirring frequently, for another 3-4 minutes.

add-garlic-paprika-cool-bean-pate.title: Add garlic and paprika, then cool
add-garlic-paprika-cool-bean-pate.description: Add the garlic and paprika to the pan. Cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and let the vegetables cool slightly.

blend-bean-pate.title: Blend the pâté
blend-bean-pate.description: Place the canned red beans and parsley leaves into a blender. Add the sautéed vegetables and salt. Blend on medium speed for 2-3 minutes until smooth or to your desired texture.

grate-beet-and-garlic-beet-ricotta-sandw.title: Grate the beet and garlic into a bowl.
grate-beet-and-garlic-beet-ricotta-sandw.description: Coarsely grate the beet using a box grater. Press the garlic through a press. Place both into a mixing bowl.

blend-ingredients-beet-ricotta-sandwich.title: Blend the spread until smooth.
blend-ingredients-beet-ricotta-sandwich.description: Add the ricotta, water, olive oil, and salt to the bowl with the beet and garlic. Using an immersion blender, blend until the mixture is smooth and creamy.

spread-mixture-on-bread-beet-ricotta-san.title: Spread the mixture on bread and top with arugula.
spread-mixture-on-bread-beet-ricotta-san.description: Take two slices of bread and generously spread the beet-ricotta mixture on each. Sprinkle arugula over the spread.

cover-and-cut-sandwich-beet-ricotta-sand.title: Cover and cut the sandwich.
cover-and-cut-sandwich-beet-ricotta-sand.description: Top each sandwich with the remaining slices of bread. Cut the sandwiches diagonally and serve.

mash-banana-belgian-waffles-banana.title: Mash banana and mix with egg
mash-banana-belgian-waffles-banana.description: Mash the banana with a fork until smooth. Add the egg and mix well.

mix-dough-belgian-waffles-banana.title: Add dry ingredients and mix dough
mix-dough-belgian-waffles-banana.description: Sift in the flour and baking powder. Stir until a smooth batter forms.

bake-waffles-belgian-waffles-banana.title: Bake waffles
bake-waffles-belgian-waffles-banana.description: Preheat the waffle iron. Lightly grease the surface with oil. Pour the batter onto the hot iron, close the lid, and bake for 4–5 minutes until golden brown.

beat-butter-sugar-belgian-waffles-with-p.title: Beat butter and sugar
beat-butter-sugar-belgian-waffles-with-p.description: Take the butter and sugar in a bowl. Beat them together until the mixture is creamy and homogeneous.

mix-peanut-butter-belgian-waffles-with-p.title: Mix in peanut butter
mix-peanut-butter-belgian-waffles-with-p.description: Add the peanut butter to the butter-sugar mixture and stir until well combined.

add-eggs-belgian-waffles-with-peanut-but.title: Add eggs
add-eggs-belgian-waffles-with-peanut-but.description: Crack the eggs into the mixture and mix thoroughly.

add-milk-belgian-waffles-with-peanut-but.title: Add milk
add-milk-belgian-waffles-with-peanut-but.description: Pour in the milk and stir until the batter is smooth.

add-cornstarch-belgian-waffles-with-pean.title: Add cornstarch
add-cornstarch-belgian-waffles-with-pean.description: Sprinkle the cornstarch over the batter and mix until fully incorporated.

add-flour-mixture-belgian-waffles-with-p.title: Add flour mixture gradually
add-flour-mixture-belgian-waffles-with-p.description: In a separate bowl, combine the flour and baking powder. Gradually add this dry mixture to the wet batter in small portions, stirring well after each addition to avoid lumps.

cook-waffles-belgian-waffles-with-peanut.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-belgian-waffles-with-peanut.description: Preheat your waffle iron and lightly grease its surface with vegetable oil. Pour the batter onto the iron, close the lid, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the waffles are golden brown.

combine-batter-ingredients-big-banana-pa.title: Combine batter ingredients
combine-batter-ingredients-big-banana-pa.description: Pour the pancake flour into a deep bowl. Add the vegetable oil and warm milk. Mix thoroughly until no lumps remain.

rest-batter-big-banana-pancake.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-big-banana-pancake.description: Set the batter aside and let it rest for 10 minutes. This helps the flour hydrate and results in a tender pancake.

slice-bananas-big-banana-pancake.title: Slice the bananas
slice-bananas-big-banana-pancake.description: Cut the bananas into rounds about 1 cm thick.

grease-pan-and-add-sugar-big-banana-panc.title: Grease pan and add sugar
grease-pan-and-add-sugar-big-banana-panc.description: Butter the frying pan and sprinkle sugar over the butter.

arrange-bananas-big-banana-pancake.title: Arrange bananas in pan
arrange-bananas-big-banana-pancake.description: Place the banana slices tightly together in the pan.

cook-bananas-big-banana-pancake.title: Cook bananas until sugar dissolves
cook-bananas-big-banana-pancake.description: Set the pan over medium heat and cook the bananas for 1-2 minutes, until the sugar dissolves and begins to caramelize.

pour-batter-over-bananas-big-banana-panc.title: Pour batter over bananas
pour-batter-over-bananas-big-banana-panc.description: Gently pour the batter into the pan, making sure it completely covers the bananas.

cover-and-cook-pancake-big-banana-pancak.title: Cover and cook pancake
cover-and-cook-pancake-big-banana-pancak.description: Cover the pan with a lid and cook the pancake over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is set.

flip-pancake-big-banana-pancake.title: Flip the pancake
flip-pancake-big-banana-pancake.description: Carefully lift the pancake with a spatula and flip it to cook the other side.

cook-other-side-big-banana-pancake.title: Cook the other side
cook-other-side-big-banana-pancake.description: Cook the pancake for another 2 minutes, until golden and cooked through.

transfer-and-cool-big-banana-pancake.title: Transfer and cool
transfer-and-cool-big-banana-pancake.description: Slide the pancake onto a flat plate and let it cool slightly before serving.

mix-dry-ingredients-bird-cherry-pancakes.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-bird-cherry-pancakes.description: In a bowl, combine the wheat flour, bird cherry flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder. Stir until evenly mixed.

whisk-eggs-bird-cherry-pancakes.title: Whisk eggs
whisk-eggs-bird-cherry-pancakes.description: Crack the eggs into a separate bowl and whisk them with a fork or mixer until smooth.

add-milk-and-butter-to-eggs-bird-cherry-.title: Add milk and melted butter
add-milk-and-butter-to-eggs-bird-cherry-.description: Add half of the milk and the melted butter to the whisked eggs. Mix until uniform.

add-dry-to-wet-bird-cherry-pancakes.title: Add dry ingredients to wet
add-dry-to-wet-bird-cherry-pancakes.description: Pour the dry mixture into the egg-milk mixture and stir until combined.

add-remaining-milk-bird-cherry-pancakes.title: Add remaining milk
add-remaining-milk-bird-cherry-pancakes.description: Add the remaining milk and stir until the batter is smooth and thin.

heat-pan-and-grease-bird-cherry-pancakes.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-and-grease-bird-cherry-pancakes.description: Place a non-stick frying pan over high heat. Once hot, reduce to medium heat and lightly grease the pan with a little vegetable oil using a brush.

fry-pancakes-bird-cherry-pancakes.title: Fry pancakes
fry-pancakes-bird-cherry-pancakes.description: Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan, tilting to spread. Cook until the bottom is golden brown, then flip and cook the other side. Repeat with remaining batter.

brush-pancakes-with-butter-bird-cherry-p.title: Brush with butter
brush-pancakes-with-butter-bird-cherry-p.description: As you transfer each pancake to a plate, brush it with melted butter.

whisk-eggs-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and-.title: Whisk eggs with sugar and salt
whisk-eggs-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and-.description: Whisk together eggs, sugar, and salt until the sugar and salt are dissolved and the mixture is homogeneous. Do not whip to foam; just combine until smooth.

add-half-milk-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-a.title: Add half the milk
add-half-milk-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-a.description: Pour half of the milk into the egg mixture and whisk until combined.

add-flour-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and-e.title: Add flour gradually
add-flour-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and-e.description: Sift the flour into the mixture in small portions, stirring vigorously to avoid lumps. Continue until all flour is incorporated.

rest-batter-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and.title: Add remaining milk and oil, rest batter
rest-batter-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and.description: Gradually add the remaining milk and then the vegetable oil. Mix until you have a thin batter resembling heavy cream. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes to allow the gluten to relax.

cook-crepe-first-side-blinchiki-with-mus.title: Cook first side of crepes
cook-crepe-first-side-blinchiki-with-mus.description: Heat a non-stick pan over high heat. Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and swirl to spread it thinly across the bottom. Cook until the top is set and no longer sticky, about 1 minute per crepe. Repeat for the remaining batter.

cook-crepe-second-side-blinchiki-with-mu.title: Flip and cook second side
cook-crepe-second-side-blinchiki-with-mu.description: Carefully flip the crepe and cook the other side until golden brown. Remove to a plate. Repeat for all crepes.

boil-eggs-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and-e.title: Boil eggs
boil-eggs-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-and-e.description: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Transfer to cold water, cool, then peel.

chop-mushrooms-onion-blinchiki-with-mush.title: Chop mushrooms and onion
chop-mushrooms-onion-blinchiki-with-mush.description: Finely dice the mushrooms and onion into small cubes.

saute-mushrooms-onion-blinchiki-with-mus.title: Sauté mushrooms and onion
saute-mushrooms-onion-blinchiki-with-mus.description: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and onion and sauté, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6-8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

add-green-onion-blinchiki-with-mushrooms.title: Add green onion and finish
add-green-onion-blinchiki-with-mushrooms.description: Add the chopped green onion to the skillet and cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

chop-eggs-mix-filling-blinchiki-with-mus.title: Chop eggs and combine with filling
chop-eggs-mix-filling-blinchiki-with-mus.description: Chop the peeled hard-boiled eggs into small pieces. Mix them into the cooled mushroom mixture.

fill-roll-crepes-blinchiki-with-mushroom.title: Fill and roll crepes
fill-roll-crepes-blinchiki-with-mushroom.description: Place 1-2 tablespoons of filling along the edge of each crepe. Fold the sides over the filling, then roll the crepe into a tight roll.

reheat-crepes-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-a.title: Reheat crepes in dry pan
reheat-crepes-blinchiki-with-mushrooms-a.description: Heat a dry non-stick pan over medium heat. Place the rolled crepes seam-side down and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until heated through and lightly crispy. Serve warm.

beat-eggs-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Beat eggs with sugar and salt
beat-eggs-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Crack the eggs into a deep bowl, add sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk until homogeneous and the sugar is completely dissolved.

heat-milk-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Heat milk in microwave
heat-milk-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Warm the milk in the microwave for 15-20 seconds until it is warm but not hot.

add-milk-oil-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Add milk and oil to egg mixture
add-milk-oil-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Add the warm milk and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the eggs and mix again.

add-flour-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Gradually add flour
add-flour-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Sift in the flour in small portions, mixing well after each addition until the batter resembles heavy cream.

rest-batter-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Let batter rest
rest-batter-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Leave the batter to rest at room temperature for 20-30 minutes.

heat-pan-pour-batter-blini-rolls-with-pa.title: Heat pan and pour batter
heat-pan-pour-batter-blini-rolls-with-pa.description: Heat a crepe pan over medium heat, grease it with the remaining oil. Pour about half a ladle of batter and quickly tilt the pan to spread it evenly.

fry-pancakes-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Fry pancakes
fry-pancakes-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Cook each pancake for about 1 minute until the edges start to brown, then flip and cook the other side for another minute until golden. Repeat for all batter.

assemble-rolls-blini-rolls-with-pate.title: Assemble and roll
assemble-rolls-blini-rolls-with-pate.description: Spread each pancake with a thin layer of pâté and roll tightly. Slice into bite-sized pieces and secure with skewers.

sieve-dry-ingredients-blood-pancakes-wit.title: Sieve and mix dry ingredients
sieve-dry-ingredients-blood-pancakes-wit.description: Sift the rye flour, salt, baking soda, and oregano together in a separate bowl. Stir to combine.

beat-eggs-blood-pancakes-with-black-curr.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-blood-pancakes-with-black-curr.description: Beat 3 eggs with a whisk or mixer until homogeneous.

add-blood-and-milk-blood-pancakes-with-b.title: Add blood and some milk
add-blood-and-milk-blood-pancakes-with-b.description: Add 150 ml of pork blood and 100 ml of milk to the beaten eggs. Mix until combined.

add-butter-and-honey-blood-pancakes-with.title: Add butter and honey
add-butter-and-honey-blood-pancakes-with.description: Add the softened butter and honey to the liquid mixture. Stir well.

add-dry-ingredients-blood-pancakes-with-.title: Add dry ingredients
add-dry-ingredients-blood-pancakes-with-.description: Pour the sifted dry ingredients (including the finely chopped onion) into the liquid mixture. Mix until smooth.

add-remaining-milk-blood-pancakes-with-b.title: Add remaining milk
add-remaining-milk-blood-pancakes-with-b.description: Add the remaining 150 ml of milk and stir again until you have a thin, smooth batter.

heat-pan-blood-pancakes-with-black-curra.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-blood-pancakes-with-black-curra.description: Place a frying pan over high heat, then reduce to medium. Lightly grease the pan with vegetable oil using a brush.

fry-pancakes-blood-pancakes-with-black-c.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-blood-pancakes-with-black-c.description: Pour a ladle of batter into the pan and cook until the bottom is golden brown. Flip and cook the other side until browned. Repeat with remaining batter.

mix-currants-and-sugar-blood-pancakes-wi.title: Mix currants and sugar
mix-currants-and-sugar-blood-pancakes-wi.description: In a saucepan, combine the black currants and sugar for the jam.

heat-jam-blood-pancakes-with-black-curra.title: Heat the jam mixture
heat-jam-blood-pancakes-with-black-curra.description: Place the saucepan over heat and bring the currant and sugar mixture to a boil.

boil-jam-and-cool-blood-pancakes-with-bl.title: Boil and cool the jam
boil-jam-and-cool-blood-pancakes-with-bl.description: Boil the jam for 2–3 minutes, then remove from heat and let it cool completely.

mix-egg-milk-bread-pudding-with-cheese-a.title: Mix eggs and milk
mix-egg-milk-bread-pudding-with-cheese-a.description: Crack the eggs into a deep bowl and pour in the milk. Add salt and pepper to taste. Whisk until smooth and homogeneous.

soak-bread-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and.title: Soak the bread
soak-bread-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and.description: Cut the loaf into large cubes. Grease a baking dish with olive oil, arrange the bread, and pour the egg-milk mixture over it. Let it sit for 10 minutes so the bread absorbs the liquid.

prep-cheese-bacon-onion-bread-pudding-wi.title: Prep cheese, bacon, and onion
prep-cheese-bacon-onion-bread-pudding-wi.description: Grate the cheese coarsely. Cut the bacon and red onion into small cubes.

fry-bacon-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and-.title: Fry the bacon
fry-bacon-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and-.description: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add the bacon and fry until golden brown, about 2–3 minutes. Transfer the bacon to a plate.

fry-onion-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and-.title: Fry the onion
fry-onion-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and-.description: In the same pan with the remaining bacon fat, fry the onion until soft, about 2–3 minutes.

assemble-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and-b.title: Assemble the pudding
assemble-bread-pudding-with-cheese-and-b.description: Transfer the fried onion and half of the bacon to the baking dish with the bread. Gently mix. Sprinkle the grated cheese on top.

bake-pudding-bread-pudding-with-cheese-a.title: Bake the pudding
bake-pudding-bread-pudding-with-cheese-a.description: Place the dish in an oven preheated to 180°C. Bake for 20–25 minutes until the top is golden brown and the custard is fully set.

rest-pudding-bread-pudding-with-cheese-a.title: Rest the pudding
rest-pudding-bread-pudding-with-cheese-a.description: Remove the pudding from the oven and let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.

mash-cottage-cheese-breakfast-casserole-.title: Mash the cottage cheese
mash-cottage-cheese-breakfast-casserole-.description: Mash the cottage cheese with a fork until smooth.

peel-bananas-breakfast-casserole-air-fry.title: Peel and add bananas
peel-bananas-breakfast-casserole-air-fry.description: Peel the bananas and add them to the mashed cottage cheese.

add-egg-and-dry-ingredients-breakfast-ca.title: Add egg and dry ingredients
add-egg-and-dry-ingredients-breakfast-ca.description: Crack the egg into the mixture, then add cornstarch, cocoa powder, vanilla, sugar, and baking powder.

blend-mixture-breakfast-casserole-air-fr.title: Blend until smooth
blend-mixture-breakfast-casserole-air-fr.description: Use an immersion blender to process the mixture until it becomes a smooth, liquid batter.

pour-into-dish-breakfast-casserole-air-f.title: Pour into baking dish
pour-into-dish-breakfast-casserole-air-f.description: Grease a baking dish with oil, pour the batter in, and gently shake to evenly distribute.

bake-in-air-fryer-breakfast-casserole-ai.title: Bake in air fryer
bake-in-air-fryer-breakfast-casserole-ai.description: Place the dish in the air fryer. Set the temperature to 160°C and bake for 25 minutes.

cool-casserole-breakfast-casserole-air-f.title: Cool the casserole
cool-casserole-breakfast-casserole-air-f.description: Let the baked casserole cool completely before proceeding.

melt-chocolate-breakfast-casserole-air-f.title: Melt the chocolate
melt-chocolate-breakfast-casserole-air-f.description: Break the dark chocolate into pieces and microwave in short 10-15 second bursts, stirring in between, until completely melted.

mix-chocolate-with-yogurt-breakfast-cass.title: Mix chocolate with yogurt
mix-chocolate-with-yogurt-breakfast-cass.description: Allow the melted chocolate to cool a bit, then stir in the Greek yogurt until the cream is smooth and well combined.

spread-cream-on-casserole-breakfast-cass.title: Spread cream over casserole
spread-cream-on-casserole-breakfast-cass.description: Generously spread the chocolate-yogurt cream over the top and sides of the cooled casserole.

chill-overnight-breakfast-casserole-air-.title: Chill overnight
chill-overnight-breakfast-casserole-air-.description: Place the casserole in the refrigerator and let it set for several hours, preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to meld.

add-coffee-water-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Add coffee and water to turk
add-coffee-water-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Place the ground coffee into a turk or small saucepan. Pour in 100 ml of water and stir briefly.

heat-coffee-foam-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Heat over medium until foam forms
heat-coffee-foam-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Set the turk over medium heat and watch closely. When a light foam rises to the surface, immediately remove it from the heat.

settle-foam-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Let the foam settle
settle-foam-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Remove the turk from the burner and wait about 30 seconds for the foam to subside.

boil-coffee-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Bring to the first boil
boil-coffee-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Return the turk to low heat and heat until you see the first signs of boiling. Remove promptly to avoid over-extraction.

cool-coffee-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Allow the coffee to cool
cool-coffee-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Set the coffee aside to cool completely to room temperature.

separate-yolk-sugar-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Separate egg yolk and add sugar
separate-yolk-sugar-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Crack an egg and separate the yolk into a mixing bowl. Add 1 teaspoon of sugar.

beat-yolk-sugar-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Beat until fluffy
beat-yolk-sugar-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Using a mixer on medium speed, beat the yolk and sugar for 2–3 minutes until the mixture becomes light and pale.

mix-cream-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Add mascarpone and cream and mix
mix-cream-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Add the mascarpone and heavy cream to the beaten yolk. Mix on medium speed until smooth and fully combined.

add-liqueur-coffee-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Add liqueur to coffee
add-liqueur-coffee-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Stir the coffee liqueur into the cooled coffee mixture.

dip-ladyfingers-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Dip ladyfingers and arrange in dish
dip-ladyfingers-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Quickly dip each ladyfinger into the coffee mixture, then arrange them in a single layer at the bottom of a serving dish.

spread-cream-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Spread mascarpone cream on top
spread-cream-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Evenly spread the prepared mascarpone cream over the layer of ladyfingers.

chill-tiramisu-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Refrigerate for 2–3 hours
chill-tiramisu-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Place the dish in the refrigerator and let it chill for at least 2 hours, or up to 3, to allow the flavors to meld and the cream to set.

boil-buckwheat-water-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Add buckwheat and water, bring to a boil
boil-buckwheat-water-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Place the buckwheat groats in a pot and pour in the water. Add a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil over high heat.

cook-buckwheat-partial-buckwheat-tiramis.title: Cook buckwheat partially
cook-buckwheat-partial-buckwheat-tiramis.description: Reduce the heat to medium and let the buckwheat simmer for 5–7 minutes, until it is half-cooked and has absorbed some water.

cook-buckwheat-milk-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Add milk and sugar, cook until done
cook-buckwheat-milk-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Pour in the milk and add 0.5 teaspoon of sugar. Stir gently and continue cooking for another 7–10 minutes, until the buckwheat is soft and most of the liquid is absorbed.

dust-cocoa-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Dust tiramisu with cocoa
dust-cocoa-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Take the chilled tiramisu out of the fridge and dust the top generously with cocoa powder.

serve-dish-buckwheat-tiramisu.title: Plate buckwheat porridge and top with tiramisu
serve-dish-buckwheat-tiramisu.description: Divide the cooked buckwheat porridge among serving plates. Place a portion of the tiramisu on top of each plate.

bring-water-to-boil-buns-with-salmon-and.title: Bring water to a boil
bring-water-to-boil-buns-with-salmon-and.description: Place the eggs in a small pot and cover with water. Set over high heat and bring to a rolling boil.

boil-eggs-buns-with-salmon-and-egg.title: Boil the eggs
boil-eggs-buns-with-salmon-and-egg.description: Reduce the heat to medium and let the eggs boil for 7-8 minutes to hard-cook them.

cool-and-peel-eggs-buns-with-salmon-and-.title: Cool and peel the eggs
cool-and-peel-eggs-buns-with-salmon-and-.description: Transfer the boiled eggs to a bowl of cold water. Once cool, peel off the shells.

slice-ingredients-buns-with-salmon-and-e.title: Slice the ingredients
slice-ingredients-buns-with-salmon-and-e.description: Cut the eggs lengthwise into 2-3 mm slices. Dice the shallot into small cubes, chop the capers finely, and slice the trout fillet into 3-4 mm pieces.

heat-oil-in-pan-buns-with-salmon-and-egg.title: Heat oil in a pan
heat-oil-in-pan-buns-with-salmon-and-egg.description: Pour the olive oil into a frying pan and warm it over medium heat.

toast-buns-buns-with-salmon-and-egg.title: Toast the buns
toast-buns-buns-with-salmon-and-egg.description: Slice the burger buns in half. Place them cut-side down in the hot pan and toast for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crispy. Transfer to a serving plate, cut-side up.

spread-cream-cheese-and-assemble-trout-b.title: Spread cream cheese and add trout
spread-cream-cheese-and-assemble-trout-b.description: Spread cream cheese evenly over the toasted bun halves. Sprinkle with diced shallot, then arrange the trout slices on top, folding them slightly. Drizzle with lemon juice.

add-egg-and-capers-buns-with-salmon-and-.title: Add egg and capers
add-egg-and-capers-buns-with-salmon-and-.description: Place the egg slices over the trout. Lightly season with salt and sprinkle with chopped capers.

grate-carrot-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Grate the carrot
grate-carrot-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Finely grate the carrot on a box grater or with a food processor. Set aside.

chop-apricots-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Chop the dried apricots
chop-apricots-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Cut the dried apricots into small pieces, about the size of raisins.

melt-butter-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Place a saucepan or pot over medium heat and add the butter. Let it melt completely.

saute-carrot-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Sauté the carrot
saute-carrot-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Add the grated carrot to the melted butter. Cook over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the carrot softens slightly.

add-water-apricots-spices-carrot-cake-oa.title: Add water, apricots, and spices
add-water-apricots-spices-carrot-cake-oa.description: Pour the water into the saucepan. Add the chopped dried apricots, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg. Stir to combine.

simmer-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Simmer the mixture
simmer-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Keep the heat at medium and let the mixture simmer gently for 5 minutes. The aromas will meld together.

add-milk-boil-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Add milk and bring to a boil
add-milk-boil-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Pour the milk into the pot. Increase the heat to high and bring the liquid to a boil, stirring occasionally to prevent scorching.

add-oats-sugar-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Add oats and sugar
add-oats-sugar-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Once the liquid is boiling, add the rolled oats and brown sugar. Stir to incorporate.

cook-oatmeal-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Cook the oatmeal
cook-oatmeal-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Reduce the heat to low and cook the oatmeal, stirring gently from time to time, for 10–15 minutes until it thickens. About 5 minutes before it's done, add salt and stir.

remove-rest-carrot-cake-oatmeal.title: Remove from heat and rest
remove-rest-carrot-cake-oatmeal.description: Take the pot off the stove. Cover with a lid and let the oatmeal rest for 3–5 minutes. It will continue to thicken. Serve warm.

cut-carrots-carrot-casserole-with-cottag.title: Cut the carrots
cut-carrots-carrot-casserole-with-cottag.description: Peel the carrots and cut them into 2 cm cubes.

boil-carrots-carrot-casserole-with-cotta.title: Boil the carrots
boil-carrots-carrot-casserole-with-cotta.description: Place the carrot cubes in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and simmer for 10 minutes.

drain-mince-carrots-carrot-casserole-wit.title: Drain and mince the carrots
drain-mince-carrots-carrot-casserole-wit.description: Drain the carrots in a colander. Allow the water to drip off, then pass the carrots through a meat grinder or food processor.

heat-carrot-puree-carrot-casserole-with-.title: Heat the carrot puree to remove moisture
heat-carrot-puree-carrot-casserole-with-.description: Transfer the carrot puree back to the pot. Place over high heat, stir constantly, and heat briefly to evaporate excess moisture. Do not fry. Remove from heat.

add-semolina-carrot-casserole-with-cotta.title: Add the semolina
add-semolina-carrot-casserole-with-cotta.description: Sprinkle the semolina into the hot carrot puree in a thin stream while stirring continuously.

add-tvorog-carrot-casserole-with-cottage.title: Add the processed cottage cheese
add-tvorog-carrot-casserole-with-cottage.description: Press the tvorog through a sieve or pass it through a meat grinder. Add it to the carrot and semolina mixture and stir to combine.

mix-eggs-sugar-salt-carrot-casserole-wit.title: Mix in eggs, sugar, and salt
mix-eggs-sugar-salt-carrot-casserole-wit.description: Add the eggs, sugar, and a pinch of salt to the carrot mixture. Stir until evenly incorporated.

preheat-oven-carrot-casserole-with-cotta.title: Preheat the oven to 180°C
preheat-oven-carrot-casserole-with-cotta.description: Turn on the oven and set it to 180°C. Allow it to preheat fully before baking.

assemble-casserole-carrot-casserole-with.title: Assemble the casserole
assemble-casserole-carrot-casserole-with.description: Grease a baking dish with 5 g of butter and sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Spread the carrot mixture evenly in the dish. Dot the top with the remaining butter pieces.

bake-casserole-carrot-casserole-with-cot.title: Bake the casserole
bake-casserole-carrot-casserole-with-cot.description: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes, until golden and set. If using a deep dish, bake for 40 minutes.

boil-water-carrot-chebureki.title: Boil water
boil-water-carrot-chebureki.description: Bring a kettle of water to a rolling boil. This will be used to make the dough.

mix-dough-carrot-chebureki.title: Mix dough liquid and combine with flour
mix-dough-carrot-chebureki.description: In a small bowl, combine the boiled water with 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil. Make a well in the flour, pour in the liquid mixture, and stir until a shaggy dough forms.

knead-dough-carrot-chebureki.title: Knead dough
knead-dough-carrot-chebureki.description: Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. The dough should be soft and pliable.

rest-dough-carrot-chebureki.title: Let dough rest
rest-dough-carrot-chebureki.description: Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. This allows the gluten to relax, making it easier to roll out.

grind-spices-carrot-chebureki.title: Grind spices
grind-spices-carrot-chebureki.description: Using a mortar and pestle or a spice grinder, grind the coriander seeds and mustard seeds until they become a coarse powder. This releases their aroma.

prepare-filling-carrot-chebureki.title: Grate carrots and mix with spices and garlic
prepare-filling-carrot-chebureki.description: Peel and grate the carrots. Place them in a bowl, add the ground spices, and press the garlic cloves through a press into the mixture. Stir well to combine.

add-herbs-and-soy-carrot-chebureki.title: Add remaining soy sauce and fresh herbs
add-herbs-and-soy-carrot-chebureki.description: Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of soy sauce to the carrot mixture. Finely chop the fresh cilantro (or other fresh herbs) and stir it in. Mix until evenly distributed.

heat-sesame-oil-carrot-chebureki.title: Heat sesame oil until smoking
heat-sesame-oil-carrot-chebureki.description: Pour the sesame oil into a small pan and heat over high heat until it starts to shimmer and just begins to smoke. Be careful not to burn it.

divide-and-roll-carrot-chebureki.title: Divide dough and roll into circles
divide-and-roll-carrot-chebureki.description: Divide the rested dough into equal portions (about 4-6 pieces, depending on desired size). Also divide the filling into the same number of portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll each dough piece into a thin round disc, about 2-3 mm thick.

assemble-chebureki-carrot-chebureki.title: Fill and seal chebureki
assemble-chebureki-carrot-chebureki.description: Place a portion of filling on one half of each dough circle, leaving a 1 cm border. Moisten the edges with water, then fold the other half over the filling. Press the edges firmly to seal. Trim any uneven edges with a knife or pastry wheel for a neat shape.

heat-frying-oil-carrot-chebureki.title: Heat oil for frying
heat-frying-oil-carrot-chebureki.description: Pour enough vegetable oil into a deep skillet to reach about 1 cm depth. Heat over medium-high heat until the oil is hot and shimmering (about 170-180°C).

fry-chebureki-carrot-chebureki.title: Fry chebureki until golden
fry-chebureki-carrot-chebureki.description: Carefully place the chebureki into the hot oil, working in batches if needed. Fry for 2-3 minutes per side, until deep golden brown and crispy. Use a slotted spoon to turn them.

drain-carrot-chebureki.title: Drain on paper towels
drain-carrot-chebureki.description: Transfer the fried chebureki to a plate lined with paper towels. Let them sit for a minute to absorb excess oil before serving.

beat-egg-mixture-carrot-pancakes.title: Beat egg with honey and salt
beat-egg-mixture-carrot-pancakes.description: Break the egg into a bowl. Add honey and salt. Beat with a mixer until smooth and homogeneous.

add-kefir-oil-carrot-pancakes.title: Add kefir and oil
add-kefir-oil-carrot-pancakes.description: Pour in the kefir and vegetable oil. Mix again until combined.

combine-flour-soda-batter-carrot-pancake.title: Combine flour and soda with wet mixture
combine-flour-soda-batter-carrot-pancake.description: Mix the flour with baking soda. Gradually add it to the wet ingredients, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. The batter should become smooth and thick like sour cream.

grate-carrot-mix-batter-carrot-pancakes.title: Grate carrot and fold into batter
grate-carrot-mix-batter-carrot-pancakes.description: Finely grate the carrot and stir it into the batter until evenly distributed.

heat-pan-carrot-pancakes.title: Heat the frying pan
heat-pan-carrot-pancakes.description: Place a dry frying pan over medium heat and let it get hot.

fry-pancakes-carrot-pancakes.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-carrot-pancakes.description: Pour a ladle of batter onto the hot pan. Cook for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden brown. Repeat with the remaining batter.

grate-carrot-cheese-carrot-tortillas-wit.title: Grate carrot and cheese
grate-carrot-cheese-carrot-tortillas-wit.description: Finely grate the carrot and the cheese. Use a fine grater for best texture.

mix-batter-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken.description: Combine the grated carrot, cheese, and egg in a bowl. Stir until the mixture is uniform and well combined.

line-tray-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken-.title: Line baking tray with parchment
line-tray-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken-.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper to prevent sticking.

form-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.title: Form tortillas on tray
form-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.description: Spoon the carrot mixture onto the prepared tray and shape it into two round, thin tortillas. Flatten them evenly.

bake-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.title: Bake the tortillas
bake-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.description: Place the tray in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) and bake for 20-25 minutes, until the tortillas are golden and firm. They should be slightly crispy on the edges.

cool-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.title: Cool the tortillas
cool-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.description: Remove the tortillas from the parchment paper and let them cool slightly on a wire rack. They should be cool enough to handle.

spread-cream-cheese-carrot-tortillas-wit.title: Spread cream cheese
spread-cream-cheese-carrot-tortillas-wit.description: Spread a generous layer of cream cheese over half of each tortilla, leaving the other half uncovered.

add-arugula-carrot-tortillas-with-chicke.title: Add arugula
add-arugula-carrot-tortillas-with-chicke.description: Distribute fresh arugula leaves evenly over the cream cheese layer.

slice-cucumber-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.title: Slice cucumber
slice-cucumber-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.description: Cut the cucumber into thin slices and arrange them in a single layer over the arugula.

prepare-avocado-carrot-tortillas-with-ch.title: Prepare avocado
prepare-avocado-carrot-tortillas-with-ch.description: Remove the pit and skin from the avocado. Slice the flesh into thin pieces and lay them over the cucumber.

slice-chicken-carrot-tortillas-with-chic.title: Slice chicken breast
