slice-chicken-carrot-tortillas-with-chic.description: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces or thin strips and scatter them over the avocado.

assemble-tortilla-carrot-tortillas-with-.title: Assemble the tortilla
assemble-tortilla-carrot-tortillas-with-.description: Fold the uncovered half of the tortilla over the filling and press gently to seal. Serve immediately.

grate-cheese-carrot-carrot-tortillas-wit.title: Grate cheese and carrot
grate-cheese-carrot-carrot-tortillas-wit.description: Finely grate the cheese and the carrot using a box grater. Set aside.

mix-batter-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken.title: Mix batter
mix-batter-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken.description: In a bowl, combine the grated cheese and carrot. Crack the egg into the bowl and mix everything together until well combined.

shape-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-ch.title: Shape tortillas
shape-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-ch.description: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spoon the carrot mixture onto the paper and form round tortillas about 0.5 cm thick.

bake-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.title: Bake tortillas
bake-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-chi.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the tortillas for 25–30 minutes, until golden and set. The exact time depends on your oven.

remove-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-c.title: Remove tortillas
remove-tortillas-carrot-tortillas-with-c.description: Carefully peel the baked tortillas off the parchment paper and transfer them to a plate.

spread-cream-cheese-carrot-tortillas-wit.title: Spread cream cheese
spread-cream-cheese-carrot-tortillas-wit.description: Spread an even layer of cream cheese over each tortilla.

add-herbs-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken.title: Add fresh herbs
add-herbs-carrot-tortillas-with-chicken.description: Place fresh parsley (or your favorite herbs) on top of the cream cheese.

slice-cucumber-avocado-carrot-tortillas-.title: Slice cucumber and avocado
slice-cucumber-avocado-carrot-tortillas-.description: Cut the cucumber into half‑rings and slice the avocado into thin strips.

arrange-veggies-carrot-tortillas-with-ch.title: Arrange vegetables
arrange-veggies-carrot-tortillas-with-ch.description: Arrange the cucumber and avocado strips over the herbs on the tortillas.

chop-chicken-carrot-tortillas-with-chick.title: Chop smoked chicken
chop-chicken-carrot-tortillas-with-chick.description: Finely chop the smoked chicken thigh.

top-with-chicken-carrot-tortillas-with-c.title: Top with chicken
top-with-chicken-carrot-tortillas-with-c.description: Sprinkle the chopped chicken over the vegetables as the top layer.

season-cauliflower-cauliflower-toasts.title: Season the cauliflower
season-cauliflower-cauliflower-toasts.description: Arrange the cauliflower florets on a baking sheet lined with parchment. Sprinkle with salt, red pepper (or chili), and black pepper. Drizzle with olive oil.

bake-cauliflower-cauliflower-toasts.title: Bake the cauliflower
bake-cauliflower-cauliflower-toasts.description: Bake the cauliflower in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, turning the florets twice during baking, until tender and lightly browned.

cool-cauliflower-cauliflower-toasts.title: Cool and break the cauliflower
cool-cauliflower-cauliflower-toasts.description: Remove the cauliflower from the oven and let it cool slightly. Then break the florets into smaller pieces.

mix-filling-cauliflower-toasts.title: Prepare the filling
mix-filling-cauliflower-toasts.description: Grate two-thirds of the Parmesan cheese. Slice the prosciutto into thin strips. In a bowl, combine the cooled cauliflower, grated Parmesan, prosciutto, and mascarpone. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, and mix well.

toast-bread-cauliflower-toasts.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-cauliflower-toasts.description: Toast the bread slices in a dry skillet or toaster until golden brown on both sides.

bake-toasts-cauliflower-toasts.title: Bake the toasts
bake-toasts-cauliflower-toasts.description: Spread the filling thickly on each toast. Sprinkle with paprika. Return to the oven and bake for 3-4 minutes at 200°C, until the toasts are golden and heated through.

prepare-garnish-cauliflower-toasts.title: Prepare the garnish
prepare-garnish-cauliflower-toasts.description: Grate the remaining Parmesan into fine crumbs. Finely chop the chives. Sprinkle over the baked toasts before serving.

mix-batter-charlotte-omelet.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-charlotte-omelet.description: Combine yogurt and eggs in a bowl. Add flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder. Beat with a mixer until smooth.

prepare-apples-charlotte-omelet.title: Prepare the apples
prepare-apples-charlotte-omelet.description: Peel the apples, remove the core, and slice them thinly.

heat-and-pour-batter-charlotte-omelet.title: Heat the pan and pour the batter
heat-and-pour-batter-charlotte-omelet.description: Grease a frying pan with vegetable oil and heat it well. Pour the egg mixture into the pan.

cook-on-low-heat-charlotte-omelet.title: Cook on low heat
cook-on-low-heat-charlotte-omelet.description: Arrange the apple slices on top of the egg mixture. Cover the pan with a lid and cook over low heat until almost done.

flip-and-fry-charlotte-omelet.title: Flip and fry the omelet
flip-and-fry-charlotte-omelet.description: Carefully flip the omelet and cook for another 1–2 minutes on the other side. Be careful not to overcook.

combine-wet-ingredients-cheese-belgian-w.title: Combine milk, eggs, and salt
combine-wet-ingredients-cheese-belgian-w.description: In a bowl, combine the milk and eggs. Add salt and beat until smooth.

add-dry-ingredients-cheese-belgian-waffl.title: Add baking powder, coriander, and flour
add-dry-ingredients-cheese-belgian-waffl.description: Sprinkle baking powder and ground coriander into the egg-milk mixture. Gradually add the flour, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Mix until a thick batter forms.

add-oil-and-beat-cheese-belgian-waffles.title: Add oil and beat
add-oil-and-beat-cheese-belgian-waffles.description: Pour in the refined sunflower oil. Beat the batter on low speed for 30 seconds until smooth and well combined.

add-grated-cheese-cheese-belgian-waffles.title: Grate cheese and fold into batter
add-grated-cheese-cheese-belgian-waffles.description: Grate the hard cheese on a fine grater. Add the grated cheese to the batter and mix thoroughly. The batter should be thick enough to hold a groove when you drag a spoon through it. Adjust consistency by adding more cheese or flour if needed.

cook-waffles-cheese-belgian-waffles.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-cheese-belgian-waffles.description: Preheat your waffle iron and lightly grease it with vegetable oil. Spoon a small amount of batter onto the center of the plate, close the lid, and cook for 4-5 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

combine-dry-ingredients-cheese-buns-parm.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-ingredients-cheese-buns-parm.description: In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, softened butter, sugar, and salt. Mix them together.

reserve-flour-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Reserve flour for dusting
reserve-flour-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Set aside 2 tablespoons of the flour mixture to use later for dusting the work surface.

rub-into-crumbs-cheese-buns-parmesan-oni.title: Rub mixture into crumbs
rub-into-crumbs-cheese-buns-parmesan-oni.description: Use your hands to rub the mixture until it forms fine crumbs. This helps distribute the butter evenly.

chop-green-onion-cheese-buns-parmesan-on.title: Chop green onion
chop-green-onion-cheese-buns-parmesan-on.description: Finely chop the green onion. Set aside.

grate-cheeses-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Grate cheeses
grate-cheeses-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Coarsely grate the parmesan and maasdam cheeses. Use the large holes of a box grater.

add-onion-and-cheese-cheese-buns-parmesa.title: Add onion and cheese to crumbs
add-onion-and-cheese-cheese-buns-parmesa.description: Add the chopped green onion, all of the maasdam, and half of the parmesan to the crumb mixture.

mix-mixture-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Mix well
mix-mixture-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Stir everything together until the onion and cheese are evenly distributed throughout the crumbs.

add-milk-and-water-cheese-buns-parmesan-.title: Add milk and water
add-milk-and-water-cheese-buns-parmesan-.description: Pour the milk and 125 ml of water into the dry ingredients. Start mixing with a spoon.

knead-dough-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Continue kneading the dough, first with a spoon and then with your hands, until it is soft and no longer sticks to your hands. The dough should be smooth and elastic.

dust-surface-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Dust work surface
dust-surface-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Sprinkle the reserved flour onto your work surface to prevent sticking.

place-dough-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Place dough on surface
place-dough-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Transfer the kneaded dough onto the floured surface.

divide-dough-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Divide dough into portions
divide-dough-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Use a culinary ring or a wide-mouthed glass to divide the dough into 5 equal parts. Each piece will become a bun.

preheat-oven-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) so it is ready for baking.

place-buns-on-sheet-cheese-buns-parmesan.title: Place buns on baking sheet
place-buns-on-sheet-cheese-buns-parmesan.description: Arrange the dough portions on a baking sheet, leaving some space between them.

grease-sheet-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Grease the baking sheet if needed
grease-sheet-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: If desired, lightly brush the baking sheet with olive oil to prevent sticking.

sprinkle-parmesan-cheese-buns-parmesan-o.title: Sprinkle with remaining parmesan
sprinkle-parmesan-cheese-buns-parmesan-o.description: Sprinkle the remaining parmesan cheese over the tops of the buns.

bake-buns-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Bake the buns
bake-buns-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, until the buns are golden and cooked through.

cool-buns-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.title: Cool the buns
cool-buns-cheese-buns-parmesan-onion.description: Remove the buns from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 10–15 minutes before serving.

combine-wet-cheese-pies.title: Combine the wet ingredients
combine-wet-cheese-pies.description: In a large bowl, combine warm milk, water, egg, 3 tablespoons of vegetable oil, sour cream, and sugar. Stir until homogeneous.

add-dry-cheese-pies.title: Add the dry ingredients
add-dry-cheese-pies.description: Add about half of the sifted flour (300 g), along with the salt and yeast. Mix until no lumps remain.

knead-dough-cheese-pies.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-cheese-pies.description: Start kneading the dough on a lightly floured surface, gradually adding the remaining flour. Knead for at least 10 minutes until the dough is smooth, elastic, and no longer sticky.

rise-dough-cheese-pies.title: Let the dough rise
rise-dough-cheese-pies.description: Shape the dough into a ball, place it in a bowl greased with the remaining oil, cover with a towel or plastic wrap, and set in a warm place for 1 to 1.5 hours until doubled in volume.

punch-dough-cheese-pies.title: Punch down the dough
punch-dough-cheese-pies.description: Punch down the risen dough and turn it out onto a work surface. Divide it into 12 equal pieces.

grate-cheese-cheese-pies.title: Grate the cheese
grate-cheese-cheese-pies.description: If not already done, grate the cheese on a coarse grater.

shape-pies-cheese-pies.title: Shape the pies
shape-pies-cheese-pies.description: Roll each piece of dough into a round disc about 3–4 mm thick. Place some grated cheese in the center. Pinch the edges firmly to seal, then gently flatten with your palm to distribute the cheese. Repeat for all pieces.

make-syrup-cheese-pies.title: Prepare the sugar syrup
make-syrup-cheese-pies.description: Mix hot water with sugar to make a syrup.

dip-pies-cheese-pies.title: Coat the pies with syrup and sesame
dip-pies-cheese-pies.description: Dip each pie in the syrup, then roll in sesame seeds to coat. Place seam-side down on a baking tray. Using a sharp knife, make 2–3 shallow diagonal cuts on top of each pie.

proof-pies-cheese-pies.title: Proof the pies
proof-pies-cheese-pies.description: Place the pies in a warm spot and let them proof for 15–20 minutes.

bake-pies-cheese-pies.title: Bake the pies
bake-pies-cheese-pies.description: Bake the pies in the preheated oven for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown.

slice-filling-cheese-roll.title: Slice the filling ingredients
slice-filling-cheese-roll.description: Slice the cooked sausage, pepperoni, and cherry tomatoes into rounds. Slice the onion into half-rings and tear the lettuce into small pieces with your hands.

arrange-cheese-cheese-roll.title: Arrange the cheese base
arrange-cheese-cheese-roll.description: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice the cheese into thin slices and arrange them on the baking sheet in a slightly overlapping rectangle.

bake-cheese-cheese-roll.title: Bake the cheese base
bake-cheese-cheese-roll.description: Place the baking sheet on the middle rack of an oven preheated to 180°C (350°F) and bake for 6–7 minutes, until the cheese becomes golden.

blot-cheese-cheese-roll.title: Blot the cheese
blot-cheese-cheese-roll.description: Remove the baking sheet from the oven and blot the cheese with a paper towel to absorb any released moisture and fat.

layer-meats-cheese-roll.title: Layer the meats and mayonnaise
layer-meats-cheese-roll.description: While the cheese is still warm, place the cooked sausage and pepperoni on top, then spread mayonnaise over them.

add-vegetables-cheese-roll.title: Add the remaining filling
add-vegetables-cheese-roll.description: Arrange the onion, lettuce, and cherry tomatoes over the mayonnaise. Drizzle with Dijon mustard and season with black pepper.

roll-and-cut-cheese-roll.title: Roll and cut the roll
roll-and-cut-cheese-roll.description: Carefully roll the cheese with the filling into a tight roll. Slice into portions and serve.

mix-dry-ingredients-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-cheeseburger-pizza.description: In a bowl, combine half of the flour with sugar, salt, and yeast. Pour in warm water and 2 tablespoons of olive oil, then stir until well mixed.

knead-dough-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Gradually add the remaining flour and knead by hand until you have a smooth, soft, and non-sticky dough. This should take about 10 minutes.

rest-dough-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Let the dough rest
rest-dough-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and leave it in a warm place for 30 minutes to rise and relax.

prepare-vegetables-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Prepare the toppings
prepare-vegetables-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Grate the mozzarella coarsely. Slice the onion into rings, and cut the tomato and pickles into thin rounds.

heat-oil-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Heat the oil
heat-oil-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Pour 2 tablespoons of olive oil into a frying pan and place over medium heat until shimmering.

fry-beef-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Fry the beef
fry-beef-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Add the ground beef to the hot pan and cook, breaking up any lumps with a spatula, until the meat is browned and cooked through. This should take about 8 minutes.

season-beef-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Season the beef
season-beef-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Sprinkle the beef with salt, pepper, oregano, and mustard. Stir to combine, then remove the pan from the heat.

shape-dough-and-rest-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Shape and rest the dough
shape-dough-and-rest-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Punch down the risen dough, shape it into a ball, and dust lightly with millet flour. Let it rest for another 20 minutes at room temperature.

roll-dough-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Roll out the dough
roll-dough-cheeseburger-pizza.description: On a floured surface, roll the dough into a round disc about 30 cm in diameter. Transfer it to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

brush-oil-ketchup-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Brush oil and spread ketchup
brush-oil-ketchup-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Brush the surface of the dough with the remaining olive oil, then spread ketchup evenly over the oil.

add-processed-cheese-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Add processed cheese
add-processed-cheese-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Tear the processed cheese slices into small pieces and scatter them over the ketchup layer.

add-beef-and-onion-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Add beef and onions
add-beef-and-onion-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Spread the cooked beef evenly over the cheese, then arrange the onion rings on top of the meat.

top-with-mozzarella-veggies-cheeseburger.title: Top with mozzarella and vegetables
top-with-mozzarella-veggies-cheeseburger.description: Sprinkle the grated mozzarella over the pizza, then place the cucumber rounds and tomato slices on top.

preheat-oven-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Set your oven to 200°C (400°F) and allow it to fully preheat. This takes about 10 minutes.

bake-pizza-cheeseburger-pizza.title: Bake the pizza
bake-pizza-cheeseburger-pizza.description: Place the pizza in the preheated oven and bake for 8–9 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the crust is golden. Serve hot.

mix-spices-chicken-breast-buzhenina.title: Mix spices
mix-spices-chicken-breast-buzhenina.description: Combine all dry spices in a small bowl and stir together.

add-oil-chicken-breast-buzhenina.title: Add olive oil
add-oil-chicken-breast-buzhenina.description: Pour in the olive oil and mix until a paste forms.

coat-chicken-chicken-breast-buzhenina.title: Coat the chicken
coat-chicken-chicken-breast-buzhenina.description: Generously rub the spice paste all over the chicken fillet.

wrap-and-bake-chicken-breast-buzhenina.title: Wrap and bake
wrap-and-bake-chicken-breast-buzhenina.description: Wrap the chicken tightly in foil, place in a baking dish, and bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 30 minutes.

cool-chicken-chicken-breast-buzhenina.title: Cool the chicken
cool-chicken-chicken-breast-buzhenina.description: Remove the baked chicken from the oven, unwrap, and let it cool completely.

refrigerate-chicken-chicken-breast-buzhe.title: Refrigerate
refrigerate-chicken-chicken-breast-buzhe.description: Once cooled, wrap the chicken in fresh foil and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

prepare-chicken-chicken-cutlets-cheese-b.title: Slice and pound the chicken
prepare-chicken-chicken-cutlets-cheese-b.description: Slice the chicken fillet into slabs no more than 2 cm thick. Gently pound each slab with a kitchen mallet to even thickness.

season-chicken-chicken-cutlets-cheese-ba.title: Season the chicken
season-chicken-chicken-cutlets-cheese-ba.description: Add salt and your favorite spices. Rub the seasoning thoroughly into both sides of the meat.

make-batter-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batte.title: Make the cheese batter
make-batter-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batte.description: Whisk the eggs. Add sour cream, grated cheese, and a little flour. Mix everything until smooth.

dip-cutlets-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batte.title: Dip the cutlets
dip-cutlets-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batte.description: Coat each pounded chicken cutlet in the prepared cheese batter, ensuring it is fully covered.

fry-cutlets-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batte.title: Fry the cutlets
fry-cutlets-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batte.description: Heat vegetable oil in a well-heated frying pan. Fry the cutlets for about 3–4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through.

serve-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batter.title: Serve
serve-chicken-cutlets-cheese-batter.description: The juicy cheese-battered cutlets are ready. Serve with fresh herbs and enjoy!

grate-potatoes-chicken-draniki.title: Grate the potatoes
grate-potatoes-chicken-draniki.description: Peel and grate the potatoes using a coarse grater. Set aside.

chop-chicken-onion-chicken-draniki.title: Chop chicken and onion
chop-chicken-onion-chicken-draniki.description: Finely chop the chicken breast into small pieces. Dice the onion into small cubes.

combine-ingredients-chicken-draniki.title: Combine base ingredients
combine-ingredients-chicken-draniki.description: In a mixing bowl, combine the grated potatoes, chopped chicken, and diced onion. Crack an egg into the bowl. Add salt and black pepper to taste. Mix until well combined.

add-mayo-flour-chicken-draniki.title: Add mayonnaise and flour
add-mayo-flour-chicken-draniki.description: Add mayonnaise for moisture and flour to bind the mixture. Stir thoroughly until the batter is homogeneous and holds together.

fry-pancakes-chicken-draniki.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-chicken-draniki.description: Heat a frying pan with vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the pan, flattening into small pancakes. Fry until golden brown on the bottom, then flip and cook until the other side is golden. Transfer to paper towels to absorb excess oil.

cut-chicken-in-air-fryer.title: Cut the chicken into pieces
cut-chicken-in-air-fryer.description: Cut the chicken into pieces: legs, wings, thighs. Pierce the pieces with a knife.

season-marinade-chicken-in-air-fryer.title: Season and marinate the chicken
season-marinade-chicken-in-air-fryer.description: Add poultry seasoning and mix. Then add ketchup, salt, and mix again. Leave to marinate for 2 hours.

wrap-chicken-in-foil-air-fryer.title: Wrap the chicken in foil
wrap-chicken-in-foil-air-fryer.description: Place the chicken on a thick sheet of foil. Top with sliced onion. Close the foil tightly around the chicken.

air-fry-covered-chicken-in-air-fryer.title: Air fry covered
air-fry-covered-chicken-in-air-fryer.description: Place the foil packet in the air fryer. Set to chicken mode at 180°C. Cook for 15 minutes.

air-fry-partially-covered-chicken-in-air.title: Air fry partially covered
air-fry-partially-covered-chicken-in-air.description: Open the foil slightly to release steam. Continue air frying for 10 minutes.

air-fry-uncovered-chicken-in-air-fryer.title: Air fry uncovered
air-fry-uncovered-chicken-in-air-fryer.description: Open the foil completely. Remove any foil pieces that might touch the heating element. Stir the chicken. Set the air fryer to 160°C and cook for 10-15 minutes until most of the liquid evaporates.

prepare-marinade-chicken-in-caramel-sauc.title: Prepare the marinade
prepare-marinade-chicken-in-caramel-sauc.description: In a bowl, combine honey, soy sauce, and white wine vinegar. Whisk together. Add brown sugar, black pepper, and chicken spices. Whisk until smooth.

marinate-chicken-chicken-in-caramel-sauc.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-chicken-in-caramel-sauc.description: Brush the chicken all over with the marinade, including the cavity. Let it marinate at room temperature for at least 1 hour.

preheat-and-prepare-baking-dish-chicken-.title: Preheat oven and prepare dish
preheat-and-prepare-baking-dish-chicken-.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease a baking dish with vegetable oil. Place the chicken breast-side up. Pour the remaining marinade over the chicken, reserving 2–3 tablespoons for basting.

bake-chicken-chicken-in-caramel-sauce.title: Bake the chicken
bake-chicken-chicken-in-caramel-sauce.description: Place the dish in the oven and bake for 1.5 hours. Every 15–20 minutes, baste the chicken with the accumulated juices and reserved marinade. Turn the chicken over 3–4 times. During the last basting, remove any foil from the wings and legs so they brown.

rest-and-serve-chicken-in-caramel-sauce.title: Rest and serve
rest-and-serve-chicken-in-caramel-sauce.description: Remove the chicken from the oven, pour the pan juices over it. Let it cool slightly, then carefully transfer to a serving platter.

press-garlic-chicken-in-mayonnaise-with-.title: Press the garlic
press-garlic-chicken-in-mayonnaise-with-.description: Press the garlic cloves through a garlic press or grate them on a fine grater. Place the garlic in a deep bowl.

add-mayonnaise-chicken-in-mayonnaise-wit.title: Add mayonnaise
add-mayonnaise-chicken-in-mayonnaise-wit.description: Add the mayonnaise to the bowl with the garlic.

add-lemon-juice-chicken-in-mayonnaise-wi.title: Add lemon juice
add-lemon-juice-chicken-in-mayonnaise-wi.description: Pour the lemon juice into the bowl.

add-zest-and-spices-chicken-in-mayonnais.title: Add zest, spices, salt, and pepper
add-zest-and-spices-chicken-in-mayonnais.description: Add the lemon zest, chicken spices, salt, and black pepper to the bowl. Stir everything together.

coat-and-marinate-chicken-chicken-in-may.title: Coat and marinate the chicken
coat-and-marinate-chicken-chicken-in-may.description: Place the whole chicken in a deep dish. Generously coat it all over with the mayonnaise-garlic mixture. Cover the dish with a lid or plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate.

bake-chicken-chicken-in-mayonnaise-with-.title: Bake the chicken
bake-chicken-chicken-in-mayonnaise-with-.description: Grease a baking dish with vegetable oil. Place the marinated chicken in the dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour, or until the chicken is cooked through and golden brown.

cut-chicken-chicken-julienne.title: Cut the chicken
cut-chicken-chicken-julienne.description: Take the pre-boiled chicken breast and cut it into small, bite-sized pieces. Set aside.

chop-onion-mushrooms-chicken-julienne.title: Chop onion and mushrooms
chop-onion-mushrooms-chicken-julienne.description: Peel and finely chop the onion. Clean the mushrooms and slice them thinly.

saute-onion-chicken-julienne.title: Sauté the onion
saute-onion-chicken-julienne.description: Melt a knob of butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.

add-mushrooms-chicken-julienne.title: Add mushrooms
add-mushrooms-chicken-julienne.description: Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan with the onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms have softened and released their moisture, about 5 minutes.

add-chicken-chicken-julienne.title: Add chicken
add-chicken-chicken-julienne.description: Add the cut chicken pieces to the pan. Stir well to combine with the onion and mushrooms, then remove from heat.

melt-butter-chicken-julienne.title: Melt butter for sauce
melt-butter-chicken-julienne.description: In a separate small pan, melt a generous piece of butter over low heat.

fry-flour-chicken-julienne.title: Fry the flour
fry-flour-chicken-julienne.description: Add the flour to the melted butter and stir continuously. Cook until the mixture turns a light golden color, about 3 minutes. Be careful not to burn it.

simmer-sauce-chicken-julienne.title: Simmer the sauce
simmer-sauce-chicken-julienne.description: Slowly pour in the milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Add your chosen spices (salt, pepper, nutmeg). Continue to simmer over low heat, stirring gently, until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.

assemble-filling-chicken-julienne.title: Distribute the filling
assemble-filling-chicken-julienne.description: Divide the chicken and mushroom mixture evenly among individual ovenproof molds or a single baking dish.

pour-sauce-chicken-julienne.title: Pour the sauce
pour-sauce-chicken-julienne.description: Spoon the prepared white sauce over the filling in each mold, covering it completely.

sprinkle-cheese-chicken-julienne.title: Sprinkle with cheese
sprinkle-cheese-chicken-julienne.description: Grate the hard cheese and generously sprinkle it over the sauced filling.

bake-chicken-julienne.title: Bake the julienne
bake-chicken-julienne.description: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Place the filled molds on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden brown. Serve hot.

fry-onion-chicken-mushroom-julienne-tart.title: Fry the onion
fry-onion-chicken-mushroom-julienne-tart.description: Chop the onion into small pieces. Fry in vegetable oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.

add-chicken-chicken-mushroom-julienne-ta.title: Add chicken
add-chicken-chicken-mushroom-julienne-ta.description: Add finely chopped chicken breast to the pan. Continue frying for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

cook-mushrooms-chicken-mushroom-julienne.title: Cook mushrooms
cook-mushrooms-chicken-mushroom-julienne.description: Add diced mushrooms, stir, and cook for 8–10 minutes until tender.

add-flour-herbs-chicken-mushroom-julienn.title: Add flour and herbs
add-flour-herbs-chicken-mushroom-julienn.description: Sprinkle flour and herbes de Provence over the mixture. Stir and fry for 2 minutes.

simmer-cream-chicken-mushroom-julienne-t.title: Simmer with cream
simmer-cream-chicken-mushroom-julienne-t.description: Pour in the cream, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Turn off the heat.

season-filling-chicken-mushroom-julienne.title: Season the filling
season-filling-chicken-mushroom-julienne.description: Add salt and pepper to taste, and stir well.

fill-tartlets-chicken-mushroom-julienne-.title: Fill the tartlets
fill-tartlets-chicken-mushroom-julienne-.description: Spoon the chicken and mushroom filling into the tartlet shells.

top-with-cheese-chicken-mushroom-julienn.title: Top with cheese
top-with-cheese-chicken-mushroom-julienn.description: Sprinkle grated hard cheese evenly over the filling in each tartlet.

bake-julienne-chicken-mushroom-julienne-.title: Bake the tartlets
bake-julienne-chicken-mushroom-julienne-.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the tartlets for 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden.

cut-chicken-chicken-roll-for-sandwiches.title: Cut the chicken into strips
cut-chicken-chicken-roll-for-sandwiches.description: Slice the chicken fillet into long strips about 2-3 cm wide. This will help the roll form easily.

mix-chicken-with-spices-chicken-roll-for.title: Mix chicken with spices
mix-chicken-with-spices-chicken-roll-for.description: Place the chicken strips in a bowl. Add salt, black pepper, dried garlic, paprika, Italian herbs, and gelatin. Mix thoroughly until all strips are evenly coated.

arrange-chicken-on-sleeve-chicken-roll-f.title: Arrange chicken on baking sleeve
arrange-chicken-on-sleeve-chicken-roll-f.description: Lay out a baking sleeve on your work surface. Place the chicken strips on it, slightly overlapping, to form a sausage-like shape.

roll-and-wrap-chicken-roll-for-sandwiche.title: Roll and wrap the chicken roll
roll-and-wrap-chicken-roll-for-sandwiche.description: Roll the baking sleeve tightly around the chicken to form a compact cylinder. Then wrap it in aluminum foil, twisting the ends to seal.

place-roll-in-dish-chicken-roll-for-sand.title: Place roll in baking dish with water
place-roll-in-dish-chicken-roll-for-sand.description: Put the wrapped roll into a baking dish. Pour cold water into the dish until it reaches halfway up the roll. This ensures even cooking.

bake-chicken-roll-for-sandwiches.title: Bake the chicken roll
bake-chicken-roll-for-sandwiches.description: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Bake the roll for 60–80 minutes, until fully cooked through. The internal temperature should reach 74°C (165°F).

cool-chicken-roll-for-sandwiches.title: Cool the chicken roll completely
cool-chicken-roll-for-sandwiches.description: Remove the roll from the oven and let it cool completely at room temperature. This allows the gelatin to set and the roll to hold its shape when sliced.

cut-chicken-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.title: Cut the chicken
cut-chicken-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.description: Divide the chicken carcass into small pieces, preferably of equal size.

chop-onion-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.title: Chop the onion
chop-onion-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.description: Cut the onion into half rings or thick strips.

combine-chicken-onion-chicken-shashlik-v.title: Combine chicken and onion
combine-chicken-onion-chicken-shashlik-v.description: Place the chicken pieces and chopped onion in a deep bowl and mix.

season-chicken-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.title: Season with salt and pepper
season-chicken-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.description: Sprinkle with salt and black pepper to taste. Thoroughly mix so the chicken is evenly coated with spices.

add-vinegar-and-marinate-chicken-shashli.title: Add vinegar and marinate
add-vinegar-and-marinate-chicken-shashli.description: Pour in the vinegar and mix well with your hands. Refrigerate the meat to marinate for 1.5-2 hours.

mix-marinated-chicken-chicken-shashlik-v.title: Mix the marinated chicken
mix-marinated-chicken-chicken-shashlik-v.description: Remove the shashlik from the refrigerator and thoroughly mix again.

skewer-chicken-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.title: Skewer the chicken
skewer-chicken-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.description: Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers.

bake-shashlik-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.title: Bake the shashlik
bake-shashlik-chicken-shashlik-vinegar.description: Place the skewers in the oven and bake for 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally for even cooking.

remove-meat-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Remove meat from bones
remove-meat-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Remove the chicken meat from the bones. You can leave some small bones. Cut off the fat and set it aside; you'll need it later.

season-meat-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Season the meat
season-meat-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Salt and pepper the meat, add turmeric, and mix well.

place-spices-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Place spices in jar
place-spices-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Place the bay leaf and peppercorns at the bottom of the jar.

pack-meat-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Pack meat into jar
pack-meat-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Pack the meat tightly into the jar so that it reaches the neck.

slow-cook-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Slow cook in oven
slow-cook-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Cover the jar with foil and poke a few holes with a fork. Place the jar in a baking dish and put it in a cold oven. Turn the oven on to 200°C. Watch for the contents to start boiling, then reduce the temperature to 110°C and let it simmer for 3 hours.

render-fat-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Render chicken fat and pour over stew
render-fat-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Place the reserved chicken fat in a dry skillet and render over medium heat. When the stewing time is up, pour the rendered fat into the jar.

seal-jar-chicken-stew-in-oven.title: Seal and cool the jar
seal-jar-chicken-stew-in-oven.description: Screw the lid on the jar. Invert it, wrap in a towel, and let it cool completely. Once cool, store in a dark, cool place.

whisk-eggs-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Whisk eggs with salt
whisk-eggs-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: Crack the eggs into a deep bowl, add salt, and whisk them with a fork until combined.

add-flour-and-soda-chicken-stuffed-panca.title: Add flour and baking soda
add-flour-and-soda-chicken-stuffed-panca.description: Gradually sift the flour and baking soda into the egg mixture while stirring continuously.

warm-milk-and-add-chicken-stuffed-pancak.title: Warm milk and add to batter
warm-milk-and-add-chicken-stuffed-pancak.description: Heat the milk until it's warm (not boiling), then pour it into the bowl with the batter and mix well.

mix-oil-and-rest-batter-chicken-stuffed-.title: Add oil and rest the batter
mix-oil-and-rest-batter-chicken-stuffed-.description: Add vegetable oil to the batter and stir until smooth. Let the batter rest for 5-10 minutes; it should have the consistency of thin sour cream.

fry-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: Heat a non-stick frying pan. Ladle in the batter and cook each pancake on both sides until golden. Brush them with melted butter and stack on a plate.

remove-chicken-skin-chicken-stuffed-panc.title: Remove chicken skin carefully
remove-chicken-skin-chicken-stuffed-panc.description: Place the whole chicken breast-side up on a cutting board. Carefully peel off the skin, keeping it intact. Leave the legs and wings attached to the skin.

season-chicken-skin-chicken-stuffed-panc.title: Season the chicken skin
season-chicken-skin-chicken-stuffed-panc.description: Rub the removed skin generously with salt and pepper. Also season the legs and wings.

debone-and-grind-chicken-chicken-stuffed.title: Debone and grind the chicken
debone-and-grind-chicken-chicken-stuffed.description: Separate all the meat from the bones. Discard the bones (you can use them for soup later). Pass the meat through a meat grinder.

chop-onion-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Chop the onion finely
chop-onion-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: Peel the onion and cut it into small dice.

shred-carrots-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Shred the carrots
shred-carrots-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: Peel the carrots and cut them into small thin slices or shred them on a grater.

dice-mushrooms-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Dice the mushrooms
dice-mushrooms-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: Clean the mushrooms and cut them into small cubes.

saute-vegetables-chicken-stuffed-pancake.title: Sauté the vegetables
saute-vegetables-chicken-stuffed-pancake.description: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan. Fry the onion until golden, then add the carrots and mushrooms. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

grate-cheese-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Grate the cheese
grate-cheese-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: Grate the hard cheese on a coarse or medium grater.

mix-filling-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-chicken-stuffed-pancakes.description: In a large bowl, combine the sautéed vegetables, ground chicken, and grated cheese. Add 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix everything thoroughly.

fill-and-roll-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-p.title: Fill and roll the pancakes
fill-and-roll-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-p.description: Place a portion of the filling onto each pancake and roll it up tightly into a log. Repeat with all pancakes.

stuff-chicken-skin-chicken-stuffed-panca.title: Stuff the chicken skin with pancake rolls
stuff-chicken-skin-chicken-stuffed-panca.description: Place the pancake rolls inside the chicken skin. Secure the open end with toothpicks to keep everything in place.

bake-stuffed-chicken-chicken-stuffed-pan.title: Bake the stuffed chicken
bake-stuffed-chicken-chicken-stuffed-pan.description: Line a baking dish with parchment paper. Place the stuffed chicken on it, brush the top with the remaining mayonnaise, and bake in a preheated oven for 1 hour.

remove-skin-chicken-stuffed-with-pancake.title: Remove chicken skin
remove-skin-chicken-stuffed-with-pancake.description: Carefully run a knife between the skin and meat around the cavity, helping with the knife to peel off the skin in one piece, leaving only the wings and drumsticks attached.

prepare-marinade-chicken-stuffed-with-pa.title: Prepare marinade and marinate skin
prepare-marinade-chicken-stuffed-with-pa.description: Press the garlic through a press. Mix it with mayonnaise and mustard. Place the chicken skin with wings and legs into the marinade, coat all sides, and set aside until needed.

prep-filling-chicken-stuffed-with-pancak.title: Prepare filling ingredients
prep-filling-chicken-stuffed-with-pancak.description: Cut all bones from the chicken meat and dice the meat into small pieces. Slice mushrooms into thin strips and finely chop the onion.

saute-onion-mushrooms-chicken-stuffed-wi.title: Sauté onion and mushrooms
saute-onion-mushrooms-chicken-stuffed-wi.description: Heat a frying pan with 1 tbsp of sunflower oil. Add the onion and fry until pale golden. Add the mushrooms and fry together for about 10-12 minutes. Remove the onion and mushrooms from the pan.

cook-chicken-chicken-stuffed-with-pancak.title: Cook chicken and combine
cook-chicken-chicken-stuffed-with-pancak.description: Add another 1 tsp of oil to the pan. Add the chicken pieces and fry for about 4-5 minutes, stirring regularly. Season with ⅔ tsp of salt, dried dill, and pepper. Return the onion and mushroom mixture to the pan, stir, and remove from heat.

make-pancake-batter-chicken-stuffed-with.title: Make pancake batter
make-pancake-batter-chicken-stuffed-with.description: Pour milk into a deep bowl, crack in the eggs. Add sugar and remaining salt. While whisking, gradually sift in the flour and mix until you have a thin pancake batter.

heat-pan-pour-batter-chicken-stuffed-wit.title: Heat pan and pour batter
heat-pan-pour-batter-chicken-stuffed-wit.description: Heat a second frying pan over high heat and grease it with sunflower oil. Pour in 3-4 tbsp of batter and tilt the pan to spread the batter evenly.

cook-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-with-panca.title: Cook pancakes
cook-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-with-panca.description: Fry the pancake for 1-2 minutes, then flip and cook the other side for another minute. Repeat with the remaining batter to make all pancakes.

fill-fold-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-with-.title: Fill and fold pancakes
fill-fold-pancakes-chicken-stuffed-with-.description: Spread the chicken, onion, and mushroom filling evenly over each pancake, then fold them into envelopes.

stuff-bake-chicken-chicken-stuffed-with-.title: Stuff and bake chicken
stuff-bake-chicken-chicken-stuffed-with-.description: Remove the chicken skin from the marinade. Carefully place the filled pancakes inside the skin. Sew up any openings with kitchen twine. Transfer the chicken to a baking tray, seam-side down, and bake for 35-40 minutes.

wash-and-season-chicken-chicken-vegetabl.title: Wash and season chicken
wash-and-season-chicken-chicken-vegetabl.description: Wash the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper, then set aside to marinate.

peel-and-dice-onion-chicken-vegetables-b.title: Peel and dice onion
peel-and-dice-onion-chicken-vegetables-b.description: Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes.

cut-carrot-and-pepper-chicken-vegetables.title: Cut carrot and bell pepper
cut-carrot-and-pepper-chicken-vegetables.description: Peel the carrot and remove seeds from the bell pepper. Wash them and cut into thin strips.

saute-vegetables-chicken-vegetables-bean.title: Sauté vegetables
saute-vegetables-chicken-vegetables-bean.description: Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, and bell pepper. Sauté for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.

remove-vegetables-chicken-vegetables-bea.title: Remove vegetables
remove-vegetables-chicken-vegetables-bea.description: Transfer the sautéed vegetables to a plate and set aside.

sear-chicken-chicken-vegetables-beans.title: Sear chicken
sear-chicken-chicken-vegetables-beans.description: In the same pan over high heat, sear the chicken on both sides until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

return-vegetables-chicken-vegetables-bea.title: Return vegetables
return-vegetables-chicken-vegetables-bea.description: Place the sautéed vegetables back into the pan with the chicken.

add-beans-chicken-vegetables-beans.title: Add beans
add-beans-chicken-vegetables-beans.description: Open the can of white beans and add them along with the liquid to the pan.

peel-and-dice-potatoes-chicken-vegetable.title: Peel and dice potatoes
peel-and-dice-potatoes-chicken-vegetable.description: Peel the potatoes, wash them, and cut into small cubes.

add-potatoes-chicken-vegetables-beans.title: Add potatoes
add-potatoes-chicken-vegetables-beans.description: Add the diced potatoes to the pan with the chicken, vegetables, and beans.

season-and-add-garlic-chicken-vegetables.title: Season and add garlic
season-and-add-garlic-chicken-vegetables.description: Season with salt and pepper. Crush a clove of garlic through a press and add it to the pan. Pour in a cup of boiling water.

simmer-stew-chicken-vegetables-beans.title: Simmer the stew
simmer-stew-chicken-vegetables-beans.description: Cover the pan with a lid and let it simmer over low heat for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender.

cut-and-fry-chicken-chicken-with-accent.title: Cut and fry the chicken
cut-and-fry-chicken-chicken-with-accent.description: Cut the chicken into small pieces. Pat them dry with paper towels. Heat oil in a skillet over high heat and fry the chicken until golden brown on all sides.

chop-and-mix-herbs-chicken-with-accent.title: Chop and mix herbs
chop-and-mix-herbs-chicken-with-accent.description: Chop the cilantro, dill, and green onion. Slice the onion into half rings. Press the garlic through a press. Combine all the herbs, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and vinegar. Stir thoroughly.

press-herbs-chicken-with-accent.title: Press the herbs to release juice
press-herbs-chicken-with-accent.description: Transfer the herb mixture to a bowl and press it with a pestle to release as much juice as possible.

marinate-chicken-chicken-with-accent.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-chicken-with-accent.description: Add the fried chicken to the bowl with herbs. Pour in the pan juices. Mix well and let it stand for 20-30 minutes so the chicken absorbs the flavors.

cut-chicken-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.title: Cut the chicken into pieces
cut-chicken-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.description: Cut the whole chicken at the joints into serving pieces.

slice-eggplant-chicken-with-potatoes-tom.title: Slice the eggplants into rounds
slice-eggplant-chicken-with-potatoes-tom.description: Slice the eggplants into rounds about 1 cm thick.

slice-onion-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.title: Slice the onion into thin half-rings
slice-onion-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.description: Peel and slice the onion into thin half-rings.

dice-tomatoes-chicken-with-potatoes-toma.title: Dice the tomatoes
dice-tomatoes-chicken-with-potatoes-toma.description: Dice the tomatoes into small cubes.

chop-herbs-chicken-with-potatoes-tomatoe.title: Chop the fresh herbs
chop-herbs-chicken-with-potatoes-tomatoe.description: Finely chop the parsley, dill, basil and cilantro.

cut-potatoes-chicken-with-potatoes-tomat.title: Cut the potatoes into wedges
cut-potatoes-chicken-with-potatoes-tomat.description: Peel and cut the potatoes into small wedges.

place-chicken-chicken-with-potatoes-toma.title: Place the chicken in the pot
place-chicken-chicken-with-potatoes-toma.description: Put the chicken pieces on the bottom of a large pot.

season-chicken-chicken-with-potatoes-tom.title: Season the chicken
season-chicken-chicken-with-potatoes-tom.description: Sprinkle the chicken with salt and black pepper.

layer-vegetables-chicken-with-potatoes-t.title: Layer the vegetables
layer-vegetables-chicken-with-potatoes-t.description: Arrange the onion, potatoes, eggplant and tomatoes in layers on top of the chicken.

layer-herbs-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.title: Add the herb layer
layer-herbs-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.description: Spread the chopped herbs and tarragon over the vegetables.

add-water-chicken-with-potatoes-tomatoes.title: Add water
add-water-chicken-with-potatoes-tomatoes.description: Pour enough water into the pot to just cover the ingredients.

cover-and-heat-chicken-with-potatoes-tom.title: Cover and bring to a boil
cover-and-heat-chicken-with-potatoes-tom.description: Cover the pot with a lid and place it over medium heat. Bring the liquid to a boil.

reduce-heat-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.title: Reduce heat to low
reduce-heat-chicken-with-potatoes-tomato.description: Once the liquid is boiling, reduce the heat to the lowest setting.

simmer-chicken-with-potatoes-tomatoes-eg.title: Simmer until tender
simmer-chicken-with-potatoes-tomatoes-eg.description: Let the stew simmer gently for 1 hour, until the chicken is fully cooked and the vegetables are soft. Do not lift the lid unnecessarily.

cut-and-season-chicken-chicken-with-prun.title: Cut and season the chicken
cut-and-season-chicken-chicken-with-prun.description: Cut the chicken into serving pieces and place in a bowl. Sprinkle with salt and spices, then toss well to coat evenly.

marinate-chicken-chicken-with-prunes-in-.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-chicken-with-prunes-in-.description: Let the chicken marinate at room temperature for 2–3 hours, or refrigerate for longer.

fry-chicken-chicken-with-prunes-in-cream.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-chicken-with-prunes-in-cream.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a deep skillet over high heat. Fry the chicken pieces for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown, then transfer to a plate.

chop-onion-and-grate-carrot-chicken-with.title: Chop onion and grate carrot
chop-onion-and-grate-carrot-chicken-with.description: Finely chop the onion. Peel and grate the carrot on a medium grater.

heat-oil-for-vegetables-chicken-with-pru.title: Heat oil for the vegetables
heat-oil-for-vegetables-chicken-with-pru.description: Add another tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet and heat over medium heat.

saute-vegetables-chicken-with-prunes-in-.title: Sauté the vegetables
saute-vegetables-chicken-with-prunes-in-.description: Add the onion and carrot to the hot oil. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until softened.

add-chicken-and-water-chicken-with-prune.title: Add chicken and water
add-chicken-and-water-chicken-with-prune.description: Return the fried chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables. Pour in the water and bring to a simmer.

braise-chicken-with-vegetables-chicken-w.title: Braise the chicken with vegetables
braise-chicken-with-vegetables-chicken-w.description: Cover the skillet with a lid and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender.

add-sour-cream-and-prunes-chicken-with-p.title: Add sour cream and prunes
add-sour-cream-and-prunes-chicken-with-p.description: Add the sour cream and prunes to the skillet and stir well to combine with the sauce.

braise-with-cream-chicken-with-prunes-in.title: Finish braising with cream
braise-with-cream-chicken-with-prunes-in.description: Cover and continue cooking over low heat for 20–30 minutes, until the sauce thickens slightly and the flavors meld.

cut-chicken-chicken-with-vegetables-and-.title: Cut the chicken into large pieces
cut-chicken-chicken-with-vegetables-and-.description: Cut the chicken into large pieces, approximately 2-3 inches.

cut-carrot-for-marinade-chicken-with-veg.title: Cut half the carrot into strips
cut-carrot-for-marinade-chicken-with-veg.description: Cut the carrot into thick strips or small sticks for the marinade.

combine-marinade-chicken-with-vegetables.title: Combine the marinade ingredients
combine-marinade-chicken-with-vegetables.description: Place the chicken pieces, carrot, garlic clove, parsley bunch, thyme sprig, bay leaf, and allspice in a bowl. Pour in the wine.

marinate-chicken-chicken-with-vegetables.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-chicken-with-vegetables.description: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 8 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

cut-vegetables-and-bacon-chicken-with-ve.title: Prepare the vegetables and bacon
cut-vegetables-and-bacon-chicken-with-ve.description: Cut the remaining carrot into rounds, slice the mushrooms, and dice the bacon.

fry-bacon-chicken-with-vegetables-and-mu.title: Fry the bacon
fry-bacon-chicken-with-vegetables-and-mu.description: Place a dry frying pan over heat and fry the bacon for about 5 minutes until crispy. Transfer to a dish.

fry-mushrooms-chicken-with-vegetables-an.title: Fry the mushrooms
fry-mushrooms-chicken-with-vegetables-an.description: Add 2 tablespoons of oil to the pan and fry the mushrooms for 5-6 minutes. Transfer to the dish with bacon.

fry-carrots-chicken-with-vegetables-and-.title: Fry the carrots
fry-carrots-chicken-with-vegetables-and-.description: Add another 2 tablespoons of oil and fry the carrot rounds for 5 minutes. Transfer to the dish with bacon and mushrooms.

coat-chicken-with-flour-chicken-with-veg.title: Coat the chicken with flour
coat-chicken-with-flour-chicken-with-veg.description: Remove the chicken from the marinade, pat dry, and dredge each piece in flour, shaking off excess.

fry-chicken-until-golden-chicken-with-ve.title: Fry the chicken until golden
fry-chicken-until-golden-chicken-with-ve.description: Fry the floured chicken pieces in the remaining oil until golden brown on all sides, about 10 minutes.

combine-and-heat-chicken-with-vegetables.title: Combine and heat the ingredients
combine-and-heat-chicken-with-vegetables.description: Add the cooked bacon, mushrooms, and carrots to the pan with the chicken. Season with salt and pepper, and heat over low heat for a few minutes to blend flavors.

add-marinade-and-boil-chicken-with-veget.title: Add the marinade and bring to a boil
add-marinade-and-boil-chicken-with-veget.description: Strain the reserved marinade and pour half of it into the pan. Bring to a boil.

simmer-chicken-chicken-with-vegetables-a.title: Simmer the chicken
simmer-chicken-chicken-with-vegetables-a.description: Cover the pan with a lid and let the chicken simmer on low heat for 1 hour, until tender and well-flavored.

mix-batter-chickpea-frittata.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-chickpea-frittata.description: In a bowl, combine chickpea flour, turmeric, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Pour in water, stir well, and let the mixture sit for 15–20 minutes.

chop-vegetables-chickpea-frittata.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-chickpea-frittata.description: Cut the tomato into semicircular slices about 4–5 mm thick. Separate parsley leaves from stems and chop them coarsely.

saute-vegetables-chickpea-frittata.title: Sauté the vegetables
saute-vegetables-chickpea-frittata.description: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the green beans, stirring, for about 2–3 minutes. Add the tomato slices and cook together, stirring occasionally, for another 2–3 minutes until the vegetables are partially tender.

cook-frittata-chickpea-frittata.title: Cook the frittata
cook-frittata-chickpea-frittata.description: Pour the chickpea batter into the skillet over the vegetables. Sprinkle the chopped parsley evenly on top. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the surface becomes matte. Flip the frittata and cook for another 2–3 minutes.

marinate-chicken-chkmeruli.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-chkmeruli.description: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and khmeli-suneli. Mix well and let marinate for 15 minutes.

grate-garlic-chkmeruli.title: Grate the garlic
grate-garlic-chkmeruli.description: Grate the garlic cloves on a fine grater.

mix-sauce-chkmeruli.title: Mix the sauce
mix-sauce-chkmeruli.description: In a bowl, combine the chopped cilantro, grated garlic, extra khmeli-suneli, and light cream. Stir until well blended.

fry-chicken-first-side-chkmeruli.title: Fry the chicken first side
fry-chicken-first-side-chkmeruli.description: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over high heat. Place the chicken in the pan and fry until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

fry-chicken-second-side-chkmeruli.title: Flip and fry the other side
fry-chicken-second-side-chkmeruli.description: Turn the chicken over and continue frying for another 10 minutes until deeply golden.

simmer-with-sauce-first-chkmeruli.title: Simmer with sauce (first round)
simmer-with-sauce-first-chkmeruli.description: Pour the prepared sauce over the chicken, cover the pan, and reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 9 to 12 minutes.

simmer-with-sauce-second-chkmeruli.title: Flip and simmer again
simmer-with-sauce-second-chkmeruli.description: Flip the chicken to ensure it absorbs the sauce evenly, then cover and simmer for another 10 minutes.

mix-dry-ingredients-chocolate-belgian-wa.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-chocolate-belgian-wa.description: In a bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, and cocoa powder. Stir thoroughly so the dry ingredients are evenly distributed.

melt-butter-and-mix-with-milk-chocolate-.title: Melt butter and mix with milk
melt-butter-and-mix-with-milk-chocolate-.description: Melt the butter in the microwave in 10–15 second bursts. Pour the melted butter into the milk and stir to combine.

combine-wet-and-dry-chocolate-belgian-wa.title: Combine wet and dry mixtures
combine-wet-and-dry-chocolate-belgian-wa.description: Add the dry flour mixture to the milk-butter mixture. Crack in the egg and whisk until you have a smooth batter.

preheat-oven-chocolate-belgian-waffles.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-chocolate-belgian-waffles.description: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). This ensures the waffle batter starts baking immediately.

grease-forms-chocolate-belgian-waffles.title: Grease the baking forms
grease-forms-chocolate-belgian-waffles.description: Lightly grease your waffle forms or baking molds with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.

bake-waffles-chocolate-belgian-waffles.title: Bake the waffles
bake-waffles-chocolate-belgian-waffles.description: Pour the batter into the prepared forms and place them in the oven. Bake for 15 minutes until the waffles are firm and slightly golden.

crumble-yeast-chocolate-brioche.title: Crumble the yeast
crumble-yeast-chocolate-brioche.description: Crumble fresh yeast into a deep bowl. Add milk, eggs, sour cream, and powdered sugar. Mix with a whisk or mixer until smooth.

add-flour-knead-chocolate-brioche.title: Knead the dough
add-flour-knead-chocolate-brioche.description: Add about two-thirds of the flour and start mixing with a spoon, then with your hands. After 2–3 minutes, add salt and gradually add the remaining flour. Transfer the dough to the work surface and knead for 15–20 minutes, stretching it away from you, folding back, and turning. The dough should be elastic and not sticky.

add-chocolate-chocolate-brioche.title: Fold in chocolate
add-chocolate-chocolate-brioche.description: Add 80 g of chocolate pieces to the dough and knead briefly to distribute them evenly.

first-rise-chocolate-brioche.title: Let the dough rise
first-rise-chocolate-brioche.description: Shape the dough into a ball, place it in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp towel, and leave in a warm place for 1.5 to 3 hours, until doubled in volume.

punch-and-shape-chocolate-brioche.title: Punch down and shape
punch-and-shape-chocolate-brioche.description: Punch down the risen dough. Divide it into 12 equal pieces, shape each into a ball, and place them tightly in a greased baking pan.

second-rise-chocolate-brioche.title: Second proof
second-rise-chocolate-brioche.description: Sprinkle the remaining chocolate pieces over the dough balls, gently pressing them in. Cover with a towel and let rise for 1 to 1.5 hours.

bake-chocolate-brioche.title: Bake the brioche
bake-chocolate-brioche.description: Bake the brioche for 25–30 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm or at room temperature.

melt-chocolate-chocolate-casserole.title: Melt the chocolate
melt-chocolate-chocolate-casserole.description: Break the chocolate into pieces and place in a heatproof bowl. Add the cream and set the bowl over a pot of hot, but not boiling water. Make sure the bottom does not touch the water. Stir until melted and smooth, then remove from the pot.

blend-tvorog-mixture-chocolate-casserole.title: Blend tvorog and eggs
blend-tvorog-mixture-chocolate-casserole.description: In a separate bowl, combine the tvorog and eggs. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Pour in the melted chocolate and mix again.

add-semolina-and-rest-chocolate-casserol.title: Add semolina and let rest
add-semolina-and-rest-chocolate-casserol.description: Add the sugar and semolina to the tvorog mixture. Stir well and let sit for 10 minutes so the semolina swells and the mixture thickens.

line-dish-and-transfer-chocolate-cassero.title: Line the baking dish
line-dish-and-transfer-chocolate-cassero.description: Line the bottom and sides of a baking dish with parchment paper. Transfer the tvorog mixture into the dish and spread evenly with a spoon.

bake-casserole-chocolate-casserole.title: Bake the casserole
bake-casserole-chocolate-casserole.description: Place the dish in an oven preheated to 180°C and bake for 45 minutes.

combine-and-blend-chocolate-cheese.title: Combine and blend the ingredients
combine-and-blend-chocolate-cheese.description: Place the tvorog, cocoa powder, sweetener, and baking soda into a blender. Pour in the milk. Blend until the mixture is smooth and homogeneous.

cook-in-double-boiler-chocolate-cheese.title: Cook the mixture in a double boiler
cook-in-double-boiler-chocolate-cheese.description: Transfer the blended mixture to a heatproof bowl. Place it over a pot of simmering water to create a double boiler. Stir continuously until all lumps dissolve, about 10–15 minutes.

cool-mixture-chocolate-cheese.title: Cool the mixture
cool-mixture-chocolate-cheese.description: Remove the bowl from the double boiler and let the mixture cool to room temperature.

refrigerate-chocolate-cheese.title: Refrigerate until thickened
refrigerate-chocolate-cheese.description: Place the cooled mixture in the refrigerator for several hours, or until it thickens to a spreadable consistency.

bloom-gelatin-chocolate-mango-mousse.title: Bloom the gelatin
bloom-gelatin-chocolate-mango-mousse.description: Pour 25 ml of water over the gelatin and let it sit at room temperature until the granules absorb the liquid and swell.

cook-mango-chocolate-mango-mousse.title: Cook the mango
cook-mango-chocolate-mango-mousse.description: Dice the mango into cubes, add the sugar, and place over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.

blend-and-pour-mango-chocolate-mango-mou.title: Blend and pour the mango purée
blend-and-pour-mango-chocolate-mango-mou.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat, add half of the bloomed gelatin, and blend with an immersion blender until smooth and homogeneous. Pour the purée into serving glasses or ramekins.

refrigerate-mango-layer-chocolate-mango-.title: Chill the mango layer
refrigerate-mango-layer-chocolate-mango-.description: Place the glasses in the refrigerator and let them set for 1 hour.

heat-cream-with-gelatin-and-melt-chocola.title: Heat cream with gelatin and melt chocolate
heat-cream-with-gelatin-and-melt-chocola.description: In a clean saucepan, combine 50 ml of heavy cream with the remaining gelatin. Place over low heat and warm for 4–5 minutes, without letting it boil. Add the finely chopped dark chocolate and cook for another minute until the chocolate is fully melted.

blend-chocolate-mixture-chocolate-mango-.title: Blend the chocolate mixture
blend-chocolate-mixture-chocolate-mango-.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat and blend the mixture with an immersion blender until perfectly smooth. Let it cool slightly.

cool-chocolate-mixture-chocolate-mango-m.title: Cool the chocolate mixture
cool-chocolate-mixture-chocolate-mango-m.description: Set the chocolate mixture aside to cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes.

whip-cream-chocolate-mango-mousse.title: Whip the remaining cream
whip-cream-chocolate-mango-mousse.description: Pour the remaining heavy cream into a bowl and whip with a mixer until soft peaks form.

fold-cream-into-chocolate-chocolate-mang.title: Fold cream into chocolate
fold-cream-into-chocolate-chocolate-mang.description: Gently fold the whipped cream into the cooled chocolate mixture using a spatula, until just combined and no streaks remain.

assemble-mousse-chocolate-mango-mousse.title: Assemble the mousse
assemble-mousse-chocolate-mango-mousse.description: Remove the chilled glasses from the refrigerator and spoon the chocolate mousse over the mango layer.

refrigerate-final-chocolate-mango-mousse.title: Refrigerate until set
refrigerate-final-chocolate-mango-mousse.description: Return the glasses to the refrigerator and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

prepare-banana-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Prepare the banana
prepare-banana-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Peel the banana and cut it in half crosswise. Using a fork, mash one half into a smooth puree. Set aside.

boil-liquid-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Boil water and milk
boil-liquid-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Pour water and milk into a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat.

cook-oats-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Cook the oats
cook-oats-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Once the liquid boils, stir in the rolled oats. Reduce the heat to low and cook according to the package directions, stirring occasionally. About 5 minutes before the oatmeal is done, proceed to the next step.

add-banana-cocoa-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Add banana puree and cocoa
add-banana-cocoa-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Add the mashed banana and cocoa powder to the oatmeal. Stir thoroughly until the cocoa is fully dissolved and the mixture is a uniform chocolate color.

finish-cooking-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Finish cooking the oatmeal
finish-cooking-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Continue cooking the oatmeal on low heat until it reaches your desired consistency, about 5 more minutes. Stir gently from time to time.

fry-banana-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Fry the banana slices
fry-banana-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Slice the remaining banana half lengthwise. Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Place the banana slices cut-side down and fry for 1–2 minutes until golden caramelized. Flip and warm for another 30 seconds.

serve-chocolate-oatmeal.title: Serve the oatmeal
serve-chocolate-oatmeal.description: Transfer the chocolate oatmeal to a bowl. Top with the fried banana slices, whole cashews, and fresh mint leaves.

combine-dry-ingredients-chocolate-semoli.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-ingredients-chocolate-semoli.description: In a saucepan, mix the semolina and cocoa powder together.

pour-milk-chocolate-semolina-porridge.title: Pour in milk
pour-milk-chocolate-semolina-porridge.description: Add the cold milk to the dry mixture and stir briefly.

soak-semolina-chocolate-semolina-porridg.title: Soak the semolina
soak-semolina-chocolate-semolina-porridg.description: Leave the mixture to sit for 2–3 minutes so the semolina can swell.

chop-chocolate-chocolate-semolina-porrid.title: Chop the chocolate
chop-chocolate-chocolate-semolina-porrid.description: Finely chop the dark chocolate or grate it on a coarse grater.

heat-mixture-chocolate-semolina-porridge.title: Heat the mixture
heat-mixture-chocolate-semolina-porridge.description: Place the saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly with a whisk until the mixture comes to a boil.

simmer-porridge-chocolate-semolina-porri.title: Simmer until thickened
simmer-porridge-chocolate-semolina-porri.description: Reduce the heat to low and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the porridge thickens.

add-butter-and-chocolate-chocolate-semol.title: Add butter and chocolate
add-butter-and-chocolate-chocolate-semol.description: Remove the saucepan from heat. Add the butter and chopped chocolate. Stir until completely melted and smooth.

rest-porridge-chocolate-semolina-porridg.title: Rest the porridge
rest-porridge-chocolate-semolina-porridg.description: Cover the saucepan with a lid and let the porridge stand for 5 minutes before serving.

separate-whip-whites-chocolate-souffle.title: Separate eggs and whip whites
separate-whip-whites-chocolate-souffle.description: Separate the eggs, placing the whites in a large bowl and the yolks in a separate bowl. Beat the whites on low speed until foamy, then gradually increase speed and add the sugar in a thin stream. Continue beating until stiff, glossy peaks form.

mix-paste-yolks-chocolate-souffle.title: Mix chocolate paste with yolks
mix-paste-yolks-chocolate-souffle.description: In a small bowl, combine the chocolate-hazelnut spread and the egg yolks. Stir until smooth and fully combined.

fold-one-third-whites-chocolate-souffle.title: Fold in one third of the whites
fold-one-third-whites-chocolate-souffle.description: Add one third of the beaten egg whites to the chocolate mixture. Gently fold with a spatula until just combined, taking care not to deflate the whites.

fold-remaining-whites-chocolate-souffle.title: Fold in remaining whites
fold-remaining-whites-chocolate-souffle.description: Add the remaining egg whites to the batter. Continue folding gently with a spatula until the mixture is homogeneous and no streaks remain.

butter-dust-molds-chocolate-souffle.title: Butter and dust the molds
butter-dust-molds-chocolate-souffle.description: Grease the soufflé dishes with butter. Lightly dust the insides with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess. Fill each mold about two-thirds full with the batter. Wipe the edges clean with a napkin.

bake-chocolate-souffle.title: Bake the soufflé
bake-chocolate-souffle.description: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Place the filled molds in the oven and bake for 20 minutes until risen and firm on top. Serve immediately.

zest-and-juice-oranges-citrus-marinated-.title: Zest and juice the oranges
zest-and-juice-oranges-citrus-marinated-.description: Grate the zest from one orange, taking only the colored part. Squeeze the juice from that orange and two more. Slice the remaining two oranges, skin on, into wedges.

halve-lemon-and-chop-garlic-citrus-marin.title: Prepare the lemon and garlic
halve-lemon-and-chop-garlic-citrus-marin.description: Cut the lemon in half. Squeeze the juice from one half and slice the other half into wedges. Finely chop the garlic cloves or press them through a garlic press.

mix-marinade-citrus-marinated-chicken.title: Mix the marinade
mix-marinade-citrus-marinated-chicken.description: In a bowl, combine the orange juice, lemon juice, orange zest, chopped garlic, honey, soy sauce, and dried oregano. Stir until well mixed.

prepare-chicken-in-dish-citrus-marinated.title: Prepare the chicken in the baking dish
prepare-chicken-in-dish-citrus-marinated.description: Grease a baking dish with oil. Butcher the whole chicken into pieces and place them skin side up in the dish. Pour the marinade evenly over the chicken, then top with the orange and lemon wedges.

refrigerate-marinate-citrus-marinated-ch.title: Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator
refrigerate-marinate-citrus-marinated-ch.description: Cover the dish with plastic wrap or a lid and refrigerate for 2–4 hours, or overnight. For best results, occasionally baste the chicken with the marinade during this time.

rest-chicken-and-preheat-oven-citrus-mar.title: Rest the chicken and preheat the oven
rest-chicken-and-preheat-oven-citrus-mar.description: Remove the dish from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to let the chicken come to room temperature. Meanwhile, preheat your oven to 210°C (410°F).

bake-first-stage-citrus-marinated-chicke.title: Bake at high temperature
bake-first-stage-citrus-marinated-chicke.description: Remove the plastic wrap, season the chicken with salt and pepper, then bake at 210°C for 20 minutes.

bake-second-stage-citrus-marinated-chick.title: Finish baking at lower temperature
bake-second-stage-citrus-marinated-chick.description: Reduce the oven temperature to 190°C (375°F) and continue baking for 30–40 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is golden brown and crispy. Baste occasionally with the pan juices.

melt-butter-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and melt it in short bursts of 10–15 seconds until fully melted.

heat-milk-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Heat the milk
heat-milk-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Warm the milk in a small saucepan over medium heat until it is hot but not boiling. Remove from heat immediately.

combine-butter-and-milk-classic-belgian-.title: Combine butter and milk
combine-butter-and-milk-classic-belgian-.description: Pour the warm milk into the melted butter and stir to combine.

beat-eggs-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Crack the eggs into a separate bowl and whisk them until the yolks and whites are fully blended.

add-eggs-to-mixture-classic-belgian-waff.title: Add eggs to the mixture
add-eggs-to-mixture-classic-belgian-waff.description: While stirring the butter-milk mixture actively, slowly pour in the beaten eggs until incorporated.

add-flour-gradually-classic-belgian-waff.title: Add flour gradually
add-flour-gradually-classic-belgian-waff.description: Sift the flour into the mixture in small portions, stirring thoroughly after each addition to avoid lumps.

place-batter-on-low-heat-classic-belgian.title: Place batter on low heat
place-batter-on-low-heat-classic-belgian.description: Set the saucepan with the batter over the lowest possible heat on the stove.

add-sparkling-water-salt-sugar-classic-b.title: Add sparkling water, salt, and sugar
add-sparkling-water-salt-sugar-classic-b.description: Pour in the sparkling water, then add the salt and sugar. Stir everything together until evenly mixed, then remove the pan from the heat.

remove-from-heat-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Remove from heat
remove-from-heat-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Take the saucepan off the stove.

add-yeast-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Add yeast
add-yeast-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Sprinkle the dry yeast over the warm batter and stir thoroughly to distribute it evenly.

let-dough-rise-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Let dough rise
let-dough-rise-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Cover the bowl with a clean cloth and leave it in a warm, draft‑free place for 40 minutes, until the batter has doubled in volume and becomes bubbly.

preheat-waffle-iron-classic-belgian-waff.title: Preheat the waffle iron
preheat-waffle-iron-classic-belgian-waff.description: Turn on your waffle iron and let it heat up until it reaches the desired temperature (usually indicated by a light). This takes about 5 minutes.

grease-waffle-iron-classic-belgian-waffl.title: Grease the waffle iron
grease-waffle-iron-classic-belgian-waffl.description: Lightly brush the waffle plates with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.

pour-batter-and-cook-classic-belgian-waf.title: Cook the waffles
pour-batter-and-cook-classic-belgian-waf.description: Ladle a small amount of batter onto the hot waffle iron, close the lid, and cook until the waffle is golden brown and crisp. Repeat with the remaining batter.

trim-edges-classic-belgian-waffles.title: Trim the edges
trim-edges-classic-belgian-waffles.description: Once each waffle is cooked, remove it carefully and use a knife to cut off any uneven or crisp edges for a neat appearance.

heat-caramel-coconut-rice-porridge-with-.title: Heat the caramel mixture
heat-caramel-coconut-rice-porridge-with-.description: Combine the sugar, honey, salt, and water in a heavy-bottomed saucepan. Place over medium-low heat and stir until the mixture comes to a boil.

boil-caramel-coconut-rice-porridge-with-.title: Boil the caramel
boil-caramel-coconut-rice-porridge-with-.description: Once the mixture boils and starts to foam, reduce the heat to low. Cook, without stirring, for 30 minutes until it turns a bright amber color.

grease-tray-coconut-rice-porridge-with-b.title: Grease the baking tray
grease-tray-coconut-rice-porridge-with-b.description: Grease a baking tray lined with parchment paper with 5 g of butter.

add-nuts-to-caramel-coconut-rice-porridg.title: Add nuts to caramel
add-nuts-to-caramel-coconut-rice-porridg.description: Add the nuts, seeds, and remaining 15 g of butter to the caramel. Stir to combine, then pour onto the prepared baking tray and spread evenly. Allow to cool, then refrigerate for 1 hour.

cut-brittle-coconut-rice-porridge-with-b.title: Cut the brittle
cut-brittle-coconut-rice-porridge-with-b.description: Cut the cooled brittle into squares or break it into pieces arbitrarily.

boil-rice-water-coconut-rice-porridge-wi.title: Boil water and cook rice
boil-rice-water-coconut-rice-porridge-wi.description: In a saucepan, bring 100 ml of water to a boil over medium heat. Add the rice and cook until the water is fully absorbed.

cook-rice-porridge-coconut-rice-porridge.title: Cook the rice porridge
cook-rice-porridge-coconut-rice-porridge.description: Pour in the coconut milk, add salt and sugar. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the porridge reaches the desired consistency.

rest-rice-porridge-coconut-rice-porridge.title: Rest the porridge
rest-rice-porridge-coconut-rice-porridge.description: Cover the saucepan with a lid, remove from heat, and let it rest for 20 minutes.

mix-kefir-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Mix kefir with dry ingredients and let rest
mix-kefir-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Pour kefir into a bowl, add salt, sugar, and baking soda. Stir and leave for 5 minutes until bubbles appear. Then pour in vegetable oil and mix again.

add-flour-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Add flour and form the dough
add-flour-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Add half of the flour to the kefir mixture and stir. Gradually add the remaining flour, gathering the dough into a ball.

knead-dough-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Transfer the dough to a floured work surface. Knead until it stops sticking to your hands, adding more flour as needed.

rest-dough-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Let the dough rest
rest-dough-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Cover the dough with a towel and leave it to rest for 25–30 minutes.

prep-filling-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Prepare the filling ingredients
prep-filling-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Pat the cod dry with paper towels and cut into small cubes. Halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the olives into rounds, and finely grate the cheese.

shape-dough-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Shape the dough into boats
shape-dough-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Divide the dough into portions. Roll one portion into an oval and transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet. Fold the edges inward to form boat shapes with pointed ends.

assemble-boats-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Assemble the boats with filling
assemble-boats-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Spread cream cheese in the center of the boats. Top with cod, tomatoes, and olives. Lightly salt and sprinkle with grated cheese.

brush-and-bake-cod-and-olive-boats.title: Brush and bake the boats
brush-and-bake-cod-and-olive-boats.description: Brush the dough edges with egg yolk. Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.

cut-fish-vegetables-cod-envelopes.title: Cut fish and vegetables
cut-fish-vegetables-cod-envelopes.description: Cut the cod fillet into 6 pieces about 7–8 cm long. Slice the onion into thin rings and cut the tomato into rounds 2–3 mm thick.

cut-lavash-cod-envelopes.title: Cut the lavash
cut-lavash-cod-envelopes.description: Cut the lavash sheets into 6 strips, making each strip about 3–4 cm wider than the cod pieces.

layer-onion-cod-cod-envelopes.title: Layer onion and cod on lavash
layer-onion-cod-cod-envelopes.description: Place onion rings on each lavash strip. Put a cod piece on top and season evenly with salt and black pepper.

make-sauce-cod-envelopes.title: Make the sauce
make-sauce-cod-envelopes.description: In a bowl, combine the sour cream and mayonnaise and mix well.
