fill-envelopes-cod-envelopes.title: Fill and fold the envelopes
fill-envelopes-cod-envelopes.description: Brush each cod piece with 1 tablespoon of the sauce, then top with tomato slices. Fold the lavash strips over the filling to form envelopes.

prepare-dish-cod-envelopes.title: Prepare the baking dish
prepare-dish-cod-envelopes.description: Grease a baking dish with 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil. Place the envelopes tightly in the dish, brush them with the remaining oil, and pour the remaining sauce over the top.

bake-envelopes-cod-envelopes.title: Bake the envelopes
bake-envelopes-cod-envelopes.description: Bake the cod envelopes in the preheated oven at 180°C for 25–30 minutes until the fish is cooked through and the lavash is golden.

drain-oil-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Drain the oil
drain-oil-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Open the can of cod liver and drain the oil into a small bowl. Set the oil aside.

place-cod-liver-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Place cod liver in blender
place-cod-liver-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Transfer the cod liver from the can into the blender jar.

add-spices-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Add spices
add-spices-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Add the dried dill, salt, and ground black pepper to the blender.

add-oil-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Add some drained oil
add-oil-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Pour 1–2 teaspoons of the reserved oil into the blender.

blend-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Blend until creamy
blend-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Blend on medium speed for 2–3 minutes until the mixture is smooth and creamy.

transfer-sauce-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Transfer sauce
transfer-sauce-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Spoon the sauce into a serving bowl or sauce boat.

refrigerate-cod-liver-cream-sauce.title: Chill before serving
refrigerate-cod-liver-cream-sauce.description: Place the sauce in the refrigerator for 5–10 minutes to let it firm up slightly. Serve with toast or crackers.

brew-espresso-coffee-oatmeal.title: Brew espresso
brew-espresso-coffee-oatmeal.description: Make a shot of espresso using your preferred method, using water and ground coffee.

strain-espresso-coffee-oatmeal.title: Strain the espresso
strain-espresso-coffee-oatmeal.description: Pour the brewed espresso through a fine sieve to remove any undissolved coffee grounds.

bring-to-boil-coffee-oatmeal.title: Bring the oatmeal to a boil
bring-to-boil-coffee-oatmeal.description: In a small saucepan, combine the coconut milk, strained espresso, rolled oats, and a pinch of salt. Stir constantly over high heat until the mixture comes to a boil.

simmer-oatmeal-coffee-oatmeal.title: Simmer the oatmeal
simmer-oatmeal-coffee-oatmeal.description: Reduce the heat to medium and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until the oatmeal is tender and has reached your desired consistency. Refer to the package instructions for exact timing.

serve-oatmeal-coffee-oatmeal.title: Serve and top
serve-oatmeal-coffee-oatmeal.description: Divide the hot oatmeal into bowls. Add pieces of milk chocolate to each serving and sprinkle with coconut flakes.

heat-milk-coffee-pancakes.title: Heat the milk
heat-milk-coffee-pancakes.description: Pour the milk into a microwave-safe bowl and heat for 1 minute until warm but not hot.

combine-dry-ingredients-coffee-pancakes.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-ingredients-coffee-pancakes.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, instant coffee, sugar, and baking powder.

mix-wet-and-dry-coffee-pancakes.title: Add wet ingredients
mix-wet-and-dry-coffee-pancakes.description: Crack the egg into the dry mixture, add the vegetable oil and warm milk. Whisk until smooth. The batter should be thick and pourable, like heavy cream.

rest-batter-coffee-pancakes.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-coffee-pancakes.description: Let the batter stand for 5 minutes to allow the gluten to relax.

cook-pancakes-coffee-pancakes.title: Cook the pancakes
cook-pancakes-coffee-pancakes.description: Heat a dry non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour about a third of a ladle of batter into the center and let it spread into a circle 8-10 cm in diameter. Cook for 1-1.5 minutes per side until golden brown.

whip-cream-coffee-pancakes.title: Whip the cream
whip-cream-coffee-pancakes.description: In a chilled bowl, whip the cold heavy cream with powdered sugar until soft peaks form.

prepare-vegetables-congee-with-carrots.title: Prepare vegetables
prepare-vegetables-congee-with-carrots.description: Grate the carrot on the large side of a grater. Slice the ginger root into thin rounds, about 1–2 mm thick.

heat-coconut-mixture-congee-with-carrots.title: Heat coconut milk with vegetables and spices
heat-coconut-mixture-congee-with-carrots.description: Pour the coconut milk into a pot. Add the grated carrot, raisins, cardamom, cloves, and cinnamon. Stir well. Place the pot over medium heat, cover, and heat for 2 minutes.

cook-spices-add-rice-congee-with-carrots.title: Cook spices and add rice
cook-spices-add-rice-congee-with-carrots.description: Remove the lid and cook the mixture, stirring constantly, for 1 minute until the spices become fragrant and the coconut milk takes on an orange color from the carrot. Add the rice and stir thoroughly.

bring-to-boil-congee-with-carrots.title: Add water and bring to a boil
bring-to-boil-congee-with-carrots.description: Pour water into the pot. Add the star anise and ginger slices. Stir, then bring the mixture to a boil.

simmer-congee-congee-with-carrots.title: Simmer the congee
simmer-congee-congee-with-carrots.description: Reduce the heat to low. Partially cover the pot and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the congee reaches your desired thickness.

remove-aromatics-congee-with-carrots.title: Remove aromatics and serve
remove-aromatics-congee-with-carrots.description: Remove the pot from the heat. Take out the ginger slices and star anise. Serve the congee warm.

soak-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserole.title: Soak the cornmeal
soak-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserole.description: Pour 200 ml of water over the cornmeal and leave it for 4 hours. This softens the grain for faster cooking.

drain-and-add-water-cornmeal-casserole.title: Drain and add remaining water
drain-and-add-water-cornmeal-casserole.description: Drain the soaked cornmeal, then add the remaining 100 ml of water. Place the pot on the stove.

boil-and-cook-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserol.title: Boil and cook the cornmeal
boil-and-cook-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserol.description: Bring the water to a boil, then cook the cornmeal for 15 minutes over medium heat. Stir occasionally.

add-milk-and-cook-cornmeal-casserole.title: Add milk and cook until tender
add-milk-and-cook-cornmeal-casserole.description: Pour in the milk and continue cooking the porridge until it reaches the desired consistency. Stir gently to prevent lumps.

remove-and-cool-cornmeal-casserole.title: Remove from heat and cool
remove-and-cool-cornmeal-casserole.description: Take the pot off the stove and let the cornmeal porridge cool down slightly.

grate-apple-and-carrot-cornmeal-casserol.title: Grate the apple and carrot
grate-apple-and-carrot-cornmeal-casserol.description: Peel and grate the apple and carrot on a coarse grater.

combine-filling-cornmeal-casserole.title: Combine the filling
combine-filling-cornmeal-casserole.description: In a bowl, mix the grated apple and carrot. Sprinkle with sugar and stir.

whisk-egg-cornmeal-casserole.title: Whisk the egg
whisk-egg-cornmeal-casserole.description: Beat the egg in a clean bowl until frothy.

mix-egg-with-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserole.title: Mix egg into the cornmeal
mix-egg-with-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserole.description: Pour half of the beaten egg into the cooled cornmeal porridge. Add salt and vanilla. Mix well.

grease-dish-cornmeal-casserole.title: Grease the baking dish
grease-dish-cornmeal-casserole.description: Grease a baking dish with butter to prevent sticking.

spread-half-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserole.title: Spread half the cornmeal mixture
spread-half-cornmeal-cornmeal-casserole.description: Spoon half of the cornmeal porridge into the dish and spread it evenly.

add-filling-cornmeal-casserole.title: Add the apple-carrot filling
add-filling-cornmeal-casserole.description: Distribute the fruit and vegetable filling evenly over the cornmeal layer.

top-with-remaining-cornmeal-cornmeal-cas.title: Top with remaining cornmeal
top-with-remaining-cornmeal-cornmeal-cas.description: Cover the filling with the rest of the cornmeal porridge and drizzle the remaining beaten egg on top.

bake-cornmeal-casserole.title: Bake the casserole
bake-cornmeal-casserole.description: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Bake the casserole for 15–20 minutes until the top is golden brown.

mix-curd-layer-cottage-cheese-casserole-.title: Mix the curd layer ingredients
mix-curd-layer-cottage-cheese-casserole-.description: Combine the cottage cheese with eggs, semolina, sugar, and salt. Beat with a mixer until the sugar dissolves.

grease-pan-cottage-cheese-casserole-with.title: Grease and flour the baking dish
grease-pan-cottage-cheese-casserole-with.description: Grease the baking dish with butter and dust with flour using the French shirt technique to prevent sticking.

pour-curd-mixture-cottage-cheese-cassero.title: Pour the curd mixture into the dish
pour-curd-mixture-cottage-cheese-cassero.description: Transfer the curd mixture to the prepared dish and spread evenly with a spatula.

make-crumble-cottage-cheese-casserole-wi.title: Make the muesli crumble
make-crumble-cottage-cheese-casserole-wi.description: Place the muesli and sugar in a blender and pulse a few times. Add the flour and soft butter, then mix by hand, rubbing the butter into the flour with your fingers until crumbly.

sprinkle-crumble-cottage-cheese-casserol.title: Sprinkle the crumble on top
sprinkle-crumble-cottage-cheese-casserol.description: Evenly sprinkle the crumble mixture over the curd layer.

bake-cottage-cheese-casserole-with-muesl.title: Bake the casserole
bake-cottage-cheese-casserole-with-muesl.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Place the dish on the middle rack and bake for 40 minutes until golden brown.

mash-cottage-cheese-cottage-cheese-flatb.title: Mash the cottage cheese
mash-cottage-cheese-cottage-cheese-flatb.description: In a bowl, mash the cottage cheese with a fork until smooth. Crack the egg into the bowl and add the flour, salt, pepper, and dried garlic. Stir to combine.

add-grated-cheese-cottage-cheese-flatbre.title: Add grated cheese
add-grated-cheese-cottage-cheese-flatbre.description: Grate the hard cheese on a fine grater. Add it to the cottage cheese mixture and stir well until you have a homogeneous dough.

shape-flatbreads-cottage-cheese-flatbrea.title: Shape the flatbreads
shape-flatbreads-cottage-cheese-flatbrea.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Using a spoon, drop portions of the dough onto the tray and spread them into thin rounds.

bake-flatbreads-cottage-cheese-flatbread.title: Bake the flatbreads
bake-flatbreads-cottage-cheese-flatbread.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the flatbreads for 20–25 minutes, until they are golden brown. Set a timer to track the baking time.

assemble-flatbreads-cottage-cheese-flatb.title: Assemble the flatbreads
assemble-flatbreads-cottage-cheese-flatb.description: Carefully remove the baked flatbreads from the parchment. Spread cream cheese over each flatbread, then place arugula on top. Slice the tomato into thin rounds and lay them over the arugula, followed by the ham.

fold-and-serve-cottage-cheese-flatbreads.title: Fold and serve
fold-and-serve-cottage-cheese-flatbreads.description: Fold each flatbread in half so the filling is enclosed. Serve immediately for breakfast.

mash-tvorog-and-add-egg-cottage-cheese-p.title: Mash tvorog and add egg
mash-tvorog-and-add-egg-cottage-cheese-p.description: Mash the tvorog with a fork until smooth. Then crack the egg into the bowl and mix briefly.

mix-dry-and-combine-cottage-cheese-panca.title: Mix dry ingredients and combine
mix-dry-and-combine-cottage-cheese-panca.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the rice flour, salt, and baking powder. Pour the dry mixture into the tvorog and egg mixture and stir until well combined.

heat-oil-and-pour-batter-cottage-cheese-.title: Heat oil and pour batter
heat-oil-and-pour-batter-cottage-cheese-.description: Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add the vegetable oil. Once hot, pour the batter into the pan and spread it evenly over the entire surface.

fry-pancake-cottage-cheese-pancake-with-.title: Fry the pancake
fry-pancake-cottage-cheese-pancake-with-.description: Cook the pancake until the bottom is golden brown, about 3 minutes. Flip carefully and cook the other side until golden brown. Transfer to a plate.

spread-yogurt-and-cut-mango-cottage-chee.title: Spread yogurt and prepare mango
spread-yogurt-and-cut-mango-cottage-chee.description: Spread a thick layer of Greek yogurt over the pancake. Cut the mango into small pieces and arrange them on one half of the pancake.

fold-pancake-cottage-cheese-pancake-with.title: Fold the pancake
fold-pancake-cottage-cheese-pancake-with.description: Fold the other half of the pancake over the filling, like a sandwich. Serve immediately.

combine-wet-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Combine cottage cheese and egg
combine-wet-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Place the cottage cheese in a bowl and add half an egg (or the scaled amount). Mix thoroughly until smooth and homogeneous.

add-dry-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Add dry ingredients
add-dry-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Sprinkle the salt and rice flour into the cottage cheese mixture. Knead until a soft, thick dough forms.

preheat-waffle-iron-cottage-cheese-waffl.title: Preheat the waffle iron
preheat-waffle-iron-cottage-cheese-waffl.description: Turn on your waffle iron and let it heat up until it's ready, about 5 minutes.

cook-waffles-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Place the dough onto the lower plate of the waffle iron and spread it evenly. Close the lid and cook for 2–3 minutes until golden brown. Transfer the waffle to a serving plate.

blend-cottage-cheese-cottage-cheese-waff.title: Blend the cottage cheese
blend-cottage-cheese-cottage-cheese-waff.description: Blend the cottage cheese with an immersion blender or food processor until completely smooth.

add-oil-and-vanilla-cottage-cheese-waffl.title: Add oil and vanilla
add-oil-and-vanilla-cottage-cheese-waffl.description: Add the vegetable oil and vanilla essence to the blended cottage cheese and stir to combine.

pour-milk-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Pour in the milk
pour-milk-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Pour the milk into the cottage cheese mixture and whisk until uniform.

separate-eggs-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Separate the eggs
separate-eggs-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Crack the eggs and carefully separate the yolks from the whites. Place the whites in a clean, grease‑free bowl.

add-yolks-and-mix-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Add yolks and mix
add-yolks-and-mix-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Add the egg yolks to the cottage cheese mixture and stir until well incorporated.

mix-dry-ingredients-cottage-cheese-waffl.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-cottage-cheese-waffl.description: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, cornstarch, and salt.

combine-wet-dry-mixtures-cottage-cheese-.title: Combine wet and dry mixtures
combine-wet-dry-mixtures-cottage-cheese-.description: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring gently to avoid lumps. Mix until just combined.

whip-egg-whites-cottage-cheese-waffles.title: Whip egg whites to soft peaks
whip-egg-whites-cottage-cheese-waffles.description: Using a mixer or whisk, beat the egg whites until soft peaks form. They should hold their shape but droop slightly when lifted.

fold-egg-whites-into-batter-cottage-chee.title: Fold egg whites into batter
fold-egg-whites-into-batter-cottage-chee.description: Gently fold the whipped egg whites into the batter in small additions, using a spatula and lifting from the bottom to keep the mixture airy. Continue until no streaks remain.

chop-fish-cream-cheese-fish-spread.title: Chop the fish
chop-fish-cream-cheese-fish-spread.description: Cut the lightly salted red fish into small cubes. Remove any bones beforehand.

mix-cheese-base-cream-cheese-fish-spread.title: Mix the cheese base
mix-cheese-base-cream-cheese-fish-spread.description: In a separate bowl, combine the cream cheese, sour cream, and lemon juice. Stir until smooth.

let-cheese-base-stand-cream-cheese-fish-.title: Let the cheese base stand
let-cheese-base-stand-cream-cheese-fish-.description: Add dried dill to the cheese mixture and let it stand for 13 minutes so the dill infuses its flavor.

combine-and-transfer-cream-cheese-fish-s.title: Combine and store
combine-and-transfer-cream-cheese-fish-s.description: Add the chopped fish to the cheese mixture, season with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Mix well and transfer to a jar or container with a tight lid.

fry-bacon-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.title: Fry the bacon
fry-bacon-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.description: Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Finely chop the bacon and fry until crispy, about 5 minutes. Transfer the bacon to a paper towel to drain.

saute-spinach-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toa.title: Sauté the spinach
saute-spinach-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toa.description: In the same pan, add the spinach and sauté over medium heat until wilted, about 1–2 minutes. No additional oil is needed as there is residual bacon fat.

mix-filling-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.description: In a bowl, combine the fried bacon, sautéed spinach, and cream cheese. Stir until evenly mixed.

assemble-toasts-cream-cheese-quail-egg-t.title: Assemble the toasts
assemble-toasts-cream-cheese-quail-egg-t.description: Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the bread slices. Make a small well in the center of each slice. Place the toasts on a baking tray.

add-egg-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.title: Add the quail eggs
add-egg-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.description: Carefully crack a quail egg into each well. Be gentle to keep the yolk intact.

bake-toasts-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.title: Bake the toasts
bake-toasts-cream-cheese-quail-egg-toast.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Place the baking tray in the oven and bake for 10–15 minutes, until the egg white is set but the yolk remains runny. Watch carefully to avoid overcooking.

boil-egg-croissant-sandwich-with-tuna.title: Boil the egg
boil-egg-croissant-sandwich-with-tuna.description: Place the egg in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to medium heat and cook for 4 minutes for a soft-boiled egg.

cool-peel-egg-croissant-sandwich-with-tu.title: Cool and peel the egg
cool-peel-egg-croissant-sandwich-with-tu.description: Transfer the boiled egg to cold water to stop cooking. Once cool, peel the shell.

prepare-croissants-croissant-sandwich-wi.title: Prepare the croissants
prepare-croissants-croissant-sandwich-wi.description: Cut the croissants lengthwise in half. Spread cream cheese evenly on the cut sides.

prep-ingredients-croissant-sandwich-with.title: Prepare the remaining ingredients
prep-ingredients-croissant-sandwich-with.description: Grate the Parmesan cheese. Slice the cucumber and the boiled egg into rounds about 2-3 mm thick. Place the tuna in a bowl and flake it with a fork.

assemble-sandwich-croissant-sandwich-wit.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwich-croissant-sandwich-wit.description: On the bottom halves of the croissants, layer arugula, cucumber slices, egg slices, flaked tuna, and grated Parmesan. Cover with the top halves and press gently.

prepare-croissant-croissant-with-egg-and.title: Prepare the croissant
prepare-croissant-croissant-with-egg-and.description: Cut off the top of the croissant. Sprinkle with cheese and place two slices of bacon inside.

add-egg-yolk-croissant-with-egg-and-baco.title: Add the egg yolk
add-egg-yolk-croissant-with-egg-and-baco.description: Break an egg and separate the white. Place only the yolk in the center of the croissant.

sprinkle-spices-croissant-with-egg-and-b.title: Sprinkle with spices
sprinkle-spices-croissant-with-egg-and-b.description: Season with your favorite spices. The recipe suggests tomato and garlic seasoning.

bake-croissant-with-egg-and-bacon.title: Bake the croissant
bake-croissant-with-egg-and-bacon.description: Top with additional cheese and bake in the oven at 180°C for about 7 minutes.

garnish-croissant-with-egg-and-bacon.title: Garnish and serve
garnish-croissant-with-egg-and-bacon.description: Remove from the oven, sprinkle with chopped green onions, and enjoy immediately.

slice-croissants-croissants-with-marshma.title: Slice the croissants
slice-croissants-croissants-with-marshma.description: Carefully slice each croissant lengthwise without cutting all the way through, creating a pocket.

stuff-croissants-croissants-with-marshma.title: Fill with chocolate and marshmallows
stuff-croissants-croissants-with-marshma.description: Place pieces of dark chocolate and mini marshmallows inside the pocket of each croissant. Don't be afraid to add plenty — the marshmallows will melt and become gooey.

oven-bake-croissants-croissants-with-mar.title: Bake the croissants
oven-bake-croissants-croissants-with-mar.description: Place the filled croissants on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated oven at 190°C (375°F) for 8-10 minutes, until the filling begins to melt.

melt-chocolate-croissants-with-marshmall.title: Melt the remaining chocolate
melt-chocolate-croissants-with-marshmall.description: While the croissants are baking, melt the remaining dark chocolate in short bursts in the microwave or over a water bath. This will be used for decoration.

drizzle-croissants-croissants-with-marsh.title: Drizzle and top with marshmallows
drizzle-croissants-croissants-with-marsh.description: Remove the baked croissants from the oven and let them cool slightly. Using a brush or spoon, drizzle the melted chocolate over the croissants and add extra marshmallows on top.

preheat-oven-croque-monsieur-casserole.title: Preheat oven to 150°C
preheat-oven-croque-monsieur-casserole.description: Set your oven to 150°C (300°F) so it's ready when you need it.

prep-ingredients-croque-monsieur-cassero.title: Grate cheese and cut meat and bread
prep-ingredients-croque-monsieur-cassero.description: Grate the hard cheese. Cut the carbonade into 3-4 pieces. Cut the bread into 2.5 cm cubes.

toast-bread-croque-monsieur-casserole.title: Toast the bread cubes
toast-bread-croque-monsieur-casserole.description: Spread the bread cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 150°C for 10-15 minutes until dry and lightly golden.

transfer-bread-croque-monsieur-casserole.title: Transfer bread to a bowl
transfer-bread-croque-monsieur-casserole.description: Remove the toasted bread from the baking sheet and place it in a large bowl.

make-egg-mixture-and-soak-croque-monsieu.title: Make egg mixture and soak bread
make-egg-mixture-and-soak-croque-monsieu.description: In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, cream, mustard, salt, and pepper. Pour this mixture over the toasted bread and let it soak for 10 minutes.

prepare-dish-croque-monsieur-casserole.title: Increase oven and grease dish
prepare-dish-croque-monsieur-casserole.description: Raise the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F). Grease a baking dish with 20g of butter.

layer-casserole-croque-monsieur-casserol.title: Layer the casserole
layer-casserole-croque-monsieur-casserol.description: Spread half the soaked bread in the dish. Top with half the grated cheese and half the carbonade. Repeat with remaining bread, then the rest of the carbonade, and most of the remaining cheese.

bake-casserole-first-croque-monsieur-cas.title: Bake the casserole
bake-casserole-first-croque-monsieur-cas.description: Bake at 180°C for 30-40 minutes until the cheese is melted and the casserole is set.

make-roux-croque-monsieur-casserole.title: Make the roux
make-roux-croque-monsieur-casserole.description: In a saucepan, melt 80g of butter over medium heat. Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for about 2 minutes until the mixture turns golden and smells nutty.

finish-bechamel-croque-monsieur-casserol.title: Finish the bechamel sauce
finish-bechamel-croque-monsieur-casserol.description: Gradually whisk in the warm milk. Cook, stirring, until the sauce comes to a boil and thickens. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from heat.

final-bake-croque-monsieur-casserole.title: Top with sauce and finish baking
final-bake-croque-monsieur-casserole.description: Increase oven to 210-220°C (410-430°F). Pour the bechamel sauce over the casserole, sprinkle with remaining cheese, and bake for 2-3 minutes until golden and bubbly.

prepare-ingredients-crostini-mushrooms-c.title: Prepare the ingredients
prepare-ingredients-crostini-mushrooms-c.description: Slice the mushrooms into 2-3 mm thick pieces. Dice the onion into 3-4 mm cubes. Cut the baguette into 7-8 mm thick slices at an angle. Finely grate the Parmesan cheese.

saute-mushrooms-crostini-mushrooms-chees.title: Sauté the mushrooms
saute-mushrooms-crostini-mushrooms-chees.description: Heat 1.5 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring, for 3-4 minutes until the liquid evaporates and they are golden brown.

add-onion-crostini-mushrooms-cheese.title: Add the onion
add-onion-crostini-mushrooms-cheese.description: Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook together for another 2-3 minutes until the onion is golden. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Stir and remove from heat.

toast-bread-crostini-mushrooms-cheese.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-crostini-mushrooms-cheese.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Arrange the baguette slices on a baking sheet. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and toast for about 5 minutes until golden.

assemble-and-grill-crostini-mushrooms-ch.title: Assemble and grill
assemble-and-grill-crostini-mushrooms-ch.description: Top the toasted bread slices with the sautéed mushrooms and onion. Sprinkle evenly with grated Parmesan and a little more black pepper. Set the oven to grill mode and heat the crostini for 2-3 minutes until the cheese melts.

cut-bread-cuban-sandwiches.title: Cut the bread
cut-bread-cuban-sandwiches.description: Cut the ciabatta loaf crosswise into 4 equal pieces, then take one piece and cut it in half lengthwise.

slice-fillings-cuban-sandwiches.title: Slice the fillings
slice-fillings-cuban-sandwiches.description: Slice the ham, pork, cheese, and pickles into long strips about 3–4 mm thick.

spread-mustard-cuban-sandwiches.title: Spread the mustard
spread-mustard-cuban-sandwiches.description: Evenly spread the mustard sauce on the cut sides of the bread halves.

layer-fillings-cuban-sandwiches.title: Layer the fillings
layer-fillings-cuban-sandwiches.description: Place slices of ham, pork, cheese, and pickles on the bottom half of the bread, then close with the top half.

heat-grill-pan-cuban-sandwiches.title: Heat the grill pan
heat-grill-pan-cuban-sandwiches.description: Lightly oil a grill pan and heat it over medium heat.

cook-first-side-cuban-sandwiches.title: Cook the first side
cook-first-side-cuban-sandwiches.description: Place the assembled sandwich on the hot pan, press it down with a heavy skillet to flatten to one-third of its original thickness, and cook for 1–2 minutes until golden brown.

flip-cook-second-side-cuban-sandwiches.title: Flip and cook the second side
flip-cook-second-side-cuban-sandwiches.description: Flip the sandwich, press again with the heavy skillet, and cook for another 1–2 minutes until the cheese is melted and the bread is golden.

transfer-to-plate-cuban-sandwiches.title: Transfer to plate
transfer-to-plate-cuban-sandwiches.description: Move the cooked sandwich to a plate and serve immediately.

separate-eggs-curd-casserole-marshmallow.title: Separate the eggs and chill the whites
separate-eggs-curd-casserole-marshmallow.description: Carefully separate the egg whites from the yolks. Place the whites in the refrigerator to chill — cold whites whip better.

whisk-yolks-milk-curd-casserole-marshmal.title: Whisk the yolks with milk
whisk-yolks-milk-curd-casserole-marshmal.description: In a small bowl, lightly whisk the egg yolks together with the milk until smooth and combined.

blend-curd-curd-casserole-marshmallow.title: Blend the curd into the yolk mixture
blend-curd-curd-casserole-marshmallow.description: Add the cottage cheese (tvorog) to the yolk mixture and use an immersion blender to blend until completely smooth.

chop-pear-marshmallow-curd-casserole-mar.title: Chop pear and marshmallow and fold in
chop-pear-marshmallow-curd-casserole-mar.description: Cut the pear and marshmallow into small cubes. Gently fold them into the curd mixture, taking care not to break up the marshmallow pieces.

grease-dish-curd-casserole-marshmallow.title: Grease the baking dish and transfer the mixture
grease-dish-curd-casserole-marshmallow.description: Grease a baking dish with vegetable oil. Transfer the curd mixture into the dish and smooth the surface.

preheat-oven-curd-casserole-marshmallow.title: Preheat the oven to 170°C
preheat-oven-curd-casserole-marshmallow.description: Preheat your oven to 170°C (340°F) so it is ready for baking.

whip-egg-whites-curd-casserole-marshmall.title: Whip the egg whites with sugar
whip-egg-whites-curd-casserole-marshmall.description: Take the chilled egg whites from the refrigerator, add the powdered sugar, and whip with a mixer until stiff peaks form.

spread-whites-curd-casserole-marshmallow.title: Spread the whipped whites over the casserole
spread-whites-curd-casserole-marshmallow.description: Gently spread the whipped egg whites evenly over the curd mixture in the dish, smoothing the top.

bake-curd-casserole-marshmallow.title: Bake for 40 minutes
bake-curd-casserole-marshmallow.description: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake at 170°C for 40 minutes, until the top is golden and the casserole is set.

soak-gelatin-curd-dessert-cookies-banana.title: Soak the gelatin
soak-gelatin-curd-dessert-cookies-banana.description: Pour gelatin into a small saucepan, add milk, and let it sit for 30 minutes to bloom.

heat-gelatin-curd-dessert-cookies-banana.title: Heat the gelatin mixture
heat-gelatin-curd-dessert-cookies-banana.description: Place the saucepan over the lowest heat. Stir continuously until the gelatin is completely dissolved. Do not let it boil.

add-cocoa-vanillin-curd-dessert-cookies-.title: Add cocoa and vanilla
add-cocoa-vanillin-curd-dessert-cookies-.description: Add cocoa powder and vanillin to the warm gelatin mixture. Whisk until smooth and uniformly chocolate-colored.

blend-curd-mix-curd-dessert-cookies-bana.title: Blend the curd mixture
blend-curd-mix-curd-dessert-cookies-bana.description: Place the soft curd in a deep bowl. Pour in the chocolate-milk mixture and blend with an immersion blender until you have a smooth, homogeneous cream.

grate-chocolate-curd-dessert-cookies-ban.title: Grate the chocolate
grate-chocolate-curd-dessert-cookies-ban.description: Grate the milk chocolate on a coarse grater or chop finely with a knife. Add most of the chocolate shavings to the curd cream and mix. Reserve a small handful for decoration.

slice-banana-for-filling-curd-dessert-co.title: Slice the first banana
slice-banana-for-filling-curd-dessert-co.description: Peel one banana and cut it into thin rounds. These will go inside the dessert.

assemble-layers-curd-dessert-cookies-ban.title: Assemble the layers
assemble-layers-curd-dessert-cookies-ban.description: Crush the cookies and spread half of the crumbs on the bottom of serving dishes. Arrange half of the banana slices on top. Pour in half of the curd cream and spread evenly. Repeat with the remaining cookies, banana slices, and curd cream.

chill-dessert-curd-dessert-cookies-banan.title: Chill the dessert
chill-dessert-curd-dessert-cookies-banan.description: Place the filled dishes in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or overnight, to allow the dessert to set completely.

decorate-with-banana-curd-dessert-cookie.title: Decorate with the second banana
decorate-with-banana-curd-dessert-cookie.description: Take the dessert out of the fridge. Peel the second banana, slice it into rounds, and cut each round in half or into quarters. Arrange the pieces on top of the dessert as decoration.

beat-eggs-curd-waffles-berries-honey.title: Beat eggs with sugar
beat-eggs-curd-waffles-berries-honey.description: In a bowl, beat the eggs with sugar until the mixture becomes fluffy and light. This should take about 2 minutes.

add-tvorog-curd-waffles-berries-honey.title: Add tvorog
add-tvorog-curd-waffles-berries-honey.description: Add the tvorog to the beaten eggs and mix well until combined.

melt-butter-curd-waffles-berries-honey.title: Melt butter
melt-butter-curd-waffles-berries-honey.description: Melt the butter in the microwave using short bursts. Let it cool slightly.

add-butter-curd-waffles-berries-honey.title: Add melted butter
add-butter-curd-waffles-berries-honey.description: Pour the cooled melted butter into the tvorog mixture and stir again.

mix-dry-ingredients-curd-waffles-berries.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-curd-waffles-berries.description: In a separate bowl, mix the rice flour, baking powder, and salt.

incorporate-dry-into-wet-curd-waffles-be.title: Incorporate dry ingredients
incorporate-dry-into-wet-curd-waffles-be.description: Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture, stirring gently until no lumps remain and the batter is smooth.

cook-waffles-curd-waffles-berries-honey.title: Cook waffles
cook-waffles-curd-waffles-berries-honey.description: Preheat your waffle iron. Lightly grease it with vegetable oil and pour in the batter. Cook for 6–7 minutes until golden and crisp.

grate-carrot-curd-waffles-with-carrot.title: Grate the carrot
grate-carrot-curd-waffles-with-carrot.description: Finely grate the carrot into a mixing bowl.

mix-batter-curd-waffles-with-carrot.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-curd-waffles-with-carrot.description: Add the egg, soft curd cheese, flour, salt, and sugar to the grated carrot. Mix well until smooth and uniform.

preheat-and-grease-waffle-iron-curd-waff.title: Preheat and grease the waffle iron
preheat-and-grease-waffle-iron-curd-waff.description: Heat your waffle iron and brush its cooking surfaces with vegetable oil.

cook-waffles-curd-waffles-with-carrot.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-curd-waffles-with-carrot.description: Place a heaping tablespoon of batter onto each waffle section. Close the lid and cook for 3–4 minutes per batch, until golden and cooked through. Repeat with remaining batter.

preheat-oven-danish-with-nectarines.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-danish-with-nectarines.description: Set your oven to preheat to 200°C. This ensures it reaches the right temperature for baking the danishes.

slice-nectarines-danish-with-nectarines.title: Slice the nectarines
slice-nectarines-danish-with-nectarines.description: Cut the nectarines into thin slices. Place them in a bowl.

mix-nectarines-danish-with-nectarines.title: Mix nectarines with flour and cinnamon
mix-nectarines-danish-with-nectarines.description: Add 1 tbsp flour and cinnamon to the sliced nectarines. Gently toss to coat evenly.

separate-egg-danish-with-nectarines.title: Separate the egg
separate-egg-danish-with-nectarines.description: Crack one egg and separate the yolk from the white. Keep the yolk for the filling.

combine-filling-danish-with-nectarines.title: Combine filling ingredients
combine-filling-danish-with-nectarines.description: In a clean bowl, mix the egg yolk, cream cheese, sugar, a pinch of salt, and lemon juice.

beat-filling-danish-with-nectarines.title: Beat the filling
beat-filling-danish-with-nectarines.description: Using a mixer on medium speed, beat the mixture for 2–3 minutes until it becomes smooth and fluffy.

dust-counter-danish-with-nectarines.title: Dust the counter with flour
dust-counter-danish-with-nectarines.description: Lightly dust your work surface with about 1 tbsp of flour to prevent sticking.

roll-pastry-danish-with-nectarines.title: Roll out the puff pastry
roll-pastry-danish-with-nectarines.description: Place the puff pastry on the floured surface. Roll it gently to a thickness of 4–5 mm, smoothing out any creases.

cut-pastry-danish-with-nectarines.title: Cut the pastry into rectangles
cut-pastry-danish-with-nectarines.description: Slice the rolled pastry into 6 equal rectangles.

place-on-tray-danish-with-nectarines.title: Place rectangles on a baking tray
place-on-tray-danish-with-nectarines.description: Arrange the pastry rectangles on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.

make-slits-danish-with-nectarines.title: Make slits along the edges
make-slits-danish-with-nectarines.description: With a knife, cut small slits about 5–6 mm long along the edges of each rectangle, spacing them evenly.

spread-filling-danish-with-nectarines.title: Spread the filling
spread-filling-danish-with-nectarines.description: Using a spoon, spread the cream cheese mixture over the center of each rectangle, leaving the slit edges bare.

arrange-nectarines-danish-with-nectarine.title: Arrange nectarine slices
arrange-nectarines-danish-with-nectarine.description: Place the sliced nectarines on top of the cream cheese filling.

prepare-egg-wash-danish-with-nectarines.title: Prepare the egg wash
prepare-egg-wash-danish-with-nectarines.description: Crack the remaining egg into a clean bowl and add 1 tbsp of milk. Whisk until combined.

brush-egg-wash-danish-with-nectarines.title: Brush the edges with egg wash
brush-egg-wash-danish-with-nectarines.description: Using a pastry brush, coat the exposed edges of each rectangle with the egg wash. This helps achieve a golden colour.

sprinkle-almonds-danish-with-nectarines.title: Sprinkle with almond flakes
sprinkle-almonds-danish-with-nectarines.description: Evenly distribute almond flakes over the tops of the danishes.

bake-danish-with-nectarines.title: Bake the danishes
bake-danish-with-nectarines.description: Place the tray in the preheated oven. Bake at 200°C for 15–20 minutes, until golden and puffed.

make-glaze-danish-with-nectarines.title: Make the glaze
make-glaze-danish-with-nectarines.description: In a small bowl, combine powdered sugar, 1 tbsp of milk, and a pinch of salt. Stir until smooth and lump-free.

drizzle-glaze-danish-with-nectarines.title: Drizzle glaze over baked danishes
drizzle-glaze-danish-with-nectarines.description: Once the danishes are out of the oven and slightly cool, drizzle the prepared glaze over them for a sweet finish.

separate-and-mix-yolks-diet-pudding.title: Separate yolks and mix with butter and sugar
separate-and-mix-yolks-diet-pudding.description: Separate the egg yolks from the whites. In a bowl, rub the yolks with the butter and sugar until smooth and well combined.

add-flour-cardamom-diet-pudding.title: Add flour and cardamom
add-flour-cardamom-diet-pudding.description: Add the flour and ground cardamom to the yolk mixture. Stir thoroughly until the dry ingredients are fully incorporated.

add-sour-milk-diet-pudding.title: Add sour milk
add-sour-milk-diet-pudding.description: Pour in the sour milk or yogurt. Mix well again until a smooth batter forms.

whip-egg-whites-diet-pudding.title: Whip egg whites with salt
whip-egg-whites-diet-pudding.description: In a separate, clean bowl, whip the egg whites with the salt using a mixer. Beat until stiff peaks form and the mixture is fluffy.

fold-whites-into-batter-diet-pudding.title: Fold whites into batter
fold-whites-into-batter-diet-pudding.description: Gently fold the whipped egg whites into the yolk batter using a spatula. Be careful not to deflate the whites; combine until just uniform.

grease-molds-diet-pudding.title: Grease baking molds
grease-molds-diet-pudding.description: Lightly grease the baking molds with vegetable oil. This will help the puddings release easily after baking.

pour-batter-into-molds-diet-pudding.title: Pour batter into molds
pour-batter-into-molds-diet-pudding.description: Divide the batter evenly among the greased molds. Smooth the tops if needed.

bake-diet-pudding.title: Bake the puddings
bake-diet-pudding.description: Place the filled molds in a preheated oven. Bake for 30 minutes until the puddings are golden brown and set in the center. A toothpick inserted should come out clean.

mix-marinade-doner-kebab.title: Mix the marinade
mix-marinade-doner-kebab.description: Combine 1 tablespoon of oil with the spices: black pepper, cumin, cardamom, turmeric, dried garlic, paprika, and salt. Stir well.

rub-chicken-doner-kebab.title: Rub the chicken with marinade
rub-chicken-doner-kebab.description: Coat the chicken fillets thoroughly with the spice mixture on all sides.

let-chicken-marinate-doner-kebab.title: Let the chicken marinate
let-chicken-marinate-doner-kebab.description: Allow the chicken to marinate for at least 1 hour, or longer for deeper flavor.

make-sauce-doner-kebab.title: Make the sauce
make-sauce-doner-kebab.description: Press the garlic cloves into the mayonnaise, add black pepper, salt, and coriander. Mix well.

heat-oil-in-pan-doner-kebab.title: Heat oil in a pan
heat-oil-in-pan-doner-kebab.description: Place a frying pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil. Heat until shimmering.

fry-chicken-first-side-doner-kebab.title: Fry chicken first side
fry-chicken-first-side-doner-kebab.description: Place the marinated chicken in the hot pan and cook for 3 minutes until golden brown. Do not move the chicken.

flip-and-fry-second-side-doner-kebab.title: Flip and fry second side
flip-and-fry-second-side-doner-kebab.description: Flip the chicken and cook for another 3 minutes until the other side is browned and the chicken is cooked through.

chop-vegetables-and-slice-chicken-doner-.title: Chop vegetables and slice chicken
chop-vegetables-and-slice-chicken-doner-.description: Cut the cucumbers into strips, slice the tomatoes into rounds, and slice the onion into half rings. Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.

assemble-wrap-doner-kebab.title: Assemble the wrap
assemble-wrap-doner-kebab.description: Lay the lavash flat. Arrange the chopped vegetables and sliced chicken on top, then drizzle with the prepared sauce.

roll-wrap-doner-kebab.title: Roll the wrap
roll-wrap-doner-kebab.description: Fold the lavash over the filling, tucking in the sides to form a tight roll or envelope shape.

fry-wrap-doner-kebab.title: Fry the wrap
fry-wrap-doner-kebab.description: Place the rolled wrap seam-side down in the pan and fry over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and crispy all over. Serve immediately.

prep-vegetables-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fr.title: Prepare the vegetables, cheese, and ham
prep-vegetables-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fr.description: Dice the bell pepper into 5–6 mm cubes. Finely chop the green onion. Grate the cheese on the large holes of a grater. Cut the ham into strips about 3–4 mm thick.

whisk-eggs-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.title: Whisk the eggs with spices
whisk-eggs-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the salt, black pepper, and chili flakes. Whisk everything together well with a whisk.

mix-filling-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.description: Add the chopped green onion, bell pepper, ham, and grated cheese to the egg mixture. Stir everything together thoroughly with a spatula.

make-indentations-egg-cheese-toasts-air-.title: Make indentations in the bread
make-indentations-egg-cheese-toasts-air-.description: Use the bottom of a glass to press small wells into each slice of bread.

fill-bread-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.title: Fill the bread indentations
fill-bread-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.description: Spoon the egg-cheese mixture into the indentations, distributing it evenly.

bake-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.title: Bake in the air fryer
bake-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fryer.description: Place the filled bread slices on parchment paper in the air fryer basket. Set the air fryer to 180°C and bake for 10 minutes.

cool-and-serve-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fry.title: Cool and serve
cool-and-serve-egg-cheese-toasts-air-fry.description: Let the egg toasts cool slightly, then transfer them to a serving plate.

prepare-batter-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Prepare the batter
prepare-batter-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and add the milk. Sprinkle in the salt and pepper. Whisk until smooth and uniform.

fry-crepes-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Fry the egg crepes
fry-crepes-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Pour a thin layer of the egg mixture into the pan, swirling to cover the bottom. Cook until lightly golden on both sides. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter to make about 7 crepes.

prepare-filling-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Prepare the minced filling
prepare-filling-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: Grate the onion on a coarse grater. Add it to the ground chicken along with the salt, dried basil, mince seasoning, and chopped fresh parsley. Mix thoroughly until all the spices are evenly distributed.

prepare-sauce-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Prepare the sour cream sauce
prepare-sauce-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: In a bowl, combine the sour cream with salt and pepper. Press the garlic cloves through a press into the bowl. Finely chop the dill and add it. Stir until smooth.

divide-and-spread-mince-egg-crepes-with-.title: Divide and spread the mince
divide-and-spread-mince-egg-crepes-with-.description: Divide the prepared mince mixture and the sour cream sauce among the egg crepes. Spread the mince evenly over each crepe.

spread-cream-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Spread the cream layer
spread-cream-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: Spread a thin layer of the sour cream sauce over the mince on each crepe.

grate-cheese-and-sprinkle-egg-crepes-wit.title: Grate and sprinkle the cheese
grate-cheese-and-sprinkle-egg-crepes-wit.description: Grate the hard cheese and sprinkle it evenly over the filling on each crepe.

roll-crepes-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Roll the crepes into rolls
roll-crepes-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: Fold the right and left edges of each crepe inward to keep the filling inside, then tightly roll the crepe into a log. Repeat for all crepes.

bake-crepes-egg-crepes-with-mince.title: Bake the rolls
bake-crepes-egg-crepes-with-mince.description: Line a baking dish with parchment paper and place the rolled crepes in it. Brush them with a little extra sour cream. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35–40 minutes until golden and heated through.

boil-egg-egg-fritters.title: Boil the egg
boil-egg-egg-fritters.description: Boil one egg in water until hard-boiled, about 10 minutes. Then cool it under cold water, peel, and finely chop.

mash-tvorog-egg-fritters.title: Mash the tvorog
mash-tvorog-egg-fritters.description: In a bowl, mash the tvorog (cottage cheese) with a fork. Add the chopped boiled egg and mix.

grate-cheese-egg-fritters.title: Grate cheese and add flour
grate-cheese-egg-fritters.description: Grate the hard cheese on a fine grater. Add it to the bowl along with the flour.

mix-batter-egg-fritters.title: Prepare the batter
mix-batter-egg-fritters.description: Finely chop the green onion and add it to the mixture. Crack the remaining raw egg into the bowl, add salt, and mix everything thoroughly until well combined.

fry-fritters-egg-fritters.title: Fry the fritters
fry-fritters-egg-fritters.description: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Shape the mixture into small patties and fry them on both sides until golden brown and cooked through.

season-chicken-egg-pancakes-with-chicken.title: Season the chicken
season-chicken-egg-pancakes-with-chicken.description: Rub the chicken thighs with salt and spices on all sides.

bake-chicken-egg-pancakes-with-chicken.title: Bake the chicken
bake-chicken-egg-pancakes-with-chicken.description: Place the seasoned chicken in a parchment-lined baking dish and bake at 180°C until fully cooked, about 30 minutes.

whisk-egg-mixture-egg-pancakes-with-chic.title: Whisk the egg mixture
whisk-egg-mixture-egg-pancakes-with-chic.description: In a bowl, beat 1 egg with 1 tablespoon of milk and a pinch of salt until smooth.

cook-pancake-egg-pancakes-with-chicken.title: Cook the egg pancake
cook-pancake-egg-pancakes-with-chicken.description: Pour the egg mixture into a hot oiled frying pan, spread it thinly, and fry on both sides until golden. Transfer to a plate.

saute-mushrooms-egg-pancakes-with-chicke.title: Sauté the mushrooms
saute-mushrooms-egg-pancakes-with-chicke.description: Finely chop the mushrooms. Heat oil in a clean pan and sauté the mushrooms, stirring occasionally, until all liquid evaporates and they turn golden brown.

prepare-chicken-filling-egg-pancakes-wit.title: Prepare the chicken filling
prepare-chicken-filling-egg-pancakes-wit.description: Remove the baked chicken from the bones, cut it into small cubes, and mix with the sautéed mushrooms.

assemble-pancakes-egg-pancakes-with-chic.title: Assemble the pancakes
assemble-pancakes-egg-pancakes-with-chic.description: Place the chicken-mushroom filling in the center of the egg pancake. Fold the top and bottom edges over the filling, then fold the sides to form an envelope.

boil-eggs-egg-sandwich.title: Boil the eggs
boil-eggs-egg-sandwich.description: Place the eggs in a pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil for exactly 10 minutes.

cool-and-peel-eggs-egg-sandwich.title: Cool and peel the eggs
cool-and-peel-eggs-egg-sandwich.description: Transfer the boiled eggs to a bowl of cold water to cool. Once cool enough to handle, peel the eggs.

separate-yolks-and-whites-egg-sandwich.title: Separate yolks and whites
separate-yolks-and-whites-egg-sandwich.description: Cut each egg in half. Separate the yolks and whites into two separate bowls.

mash-yolks-with-mayo-egg-sandwich.title: Mash yolks with mayonnaise
mash-yolks-with-mayo-egg-sandwich.description: Add mayonnaise, salt, and pepper to the yolks. Mash with a fork until smooth and creamy.

chop-whites-and-mix-egg-sandwich.title: Chop whites and mix
chop-whites-and-mix-egg-sandwich.description: Chop the egg whites into small pieces. Add them to the yolk mixture and stir well to combine.

assemble-sandwiches-egg-sandwich.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-egg-sandwich.description: Spread the egg filling onto two slices of bread. Top with the remaining slices and press gently. Repeat for the second sandwich.

prep-vegetables-eggplant-toast-breakfast.title: Peel and grate the eggplant
prep-vegetables-eggplant-toast-breakfast.description: Peel the eggplant and grate it on a fine grater. Dice the tomato into small cubes. Grate the cheese on a fine grater.

fry-eggplant-eggplant-toast-breakfast.title: Fry the grated eggplant
fry-eggplant-eggplant-toast-breakfast.description: Heat a frying pan with vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the grated eggplant and fry, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes until softened.

add-tomato-eggplant-toast-breakfast.title: Add the tomato
add-tomato-eggplant-toast-breakfast.description: Add the diced tomato to the pan. Season with salt and stir.

melt-cheese-eggplant-toast-breakfast.title: Melt the cheese with garlic
melt-cheese-eggplant-toast-breakfast.description: Add the grated cheese to the pan and stir until fully melted. Sprinkle with dried garlic and mix well. Remove from heat.

toast-bread-eggplant-toast-breakfast.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-eggplant-toast-breakfast.description: Toast the slice of bread in a toaster or in a dry frying pan until golden brown.

assemble-toast-eggplant-toast-breakfast.title: Assemble the toast
assemble-toast-eggplant-toast-breakfast.description: Place the cooked vegetable and cheese mixture on top of the toasted bread.

prepare-marinade-festive-chicken-with-ma.title: Prepare the marinade
prepare-marinade-festive-chicken-with-ma.description: Squeeze the juice from half of one mandarin. Mix it with soy sauce and honey. Press the garlic through a press and add it along with salt and ground black pepper. Stir thoroughly.

coat-chicken-festive-chicken-with-mandar.title: Coat the chicken with marinade
coat-chicken-festive-chicken-with-mandar.description: Place the chicken in a large bowl and coat it with the marinade on all sides, inside and out.

refrigerate-chicken-festive-chicken-with.title: Refrigerate the chicken
refrigerate-chicken-festive-chicken-with.description: Transfer the chicken to the refrigerator and let it marinate for 2 hours.

slice-mandarins-festive-chicken-with-man.title: Slice the mandarins
slice-mandarins-festive-chicken-with-man.description: Cut the remaining mandarins into thin rounds.

assemble-chicken-bag-festive-chicken-wit.title: Assemble the chicken in a baking bag
assemble-chicken-bag-festive-chicken-wit.description: Place the sliced mandarins in a roasting bag. Place the marinated chicken on top and seal the bag with kitchen twine or cotton string.

cut-vegetables-festive-chicken-with-mand.title: Cut the vegetables
cut-vegetables-festive-chicken-with-mand.description: Cut the potatoes into wedges. Halve the mushrooms.

assemble-vegetable-bag-festive-chicken-w.title: Assemble the vegetable bag
assemble-vegetable-bag-festive-chicken-w.description: Place the potatoes and mushrooms in a second roasting bag. Season with salt and pepper, then seal the bag.

bake-everything-festive-chicken-with-man.title: Bake the chicken and potatoes
bake-everything-festive-chicken-with-man.description: Place both roasting bags in the preheated oven. Bake for 60 minutes until the chicken is golden and the potatoes are tender. Serve hot.

prepare-marinade-festive-chicken.title: Prepare the marinade
prepare-marinade-festive-chicken.description: Press the garlic cloves. In a bowl, combine the pressed garlic, sour cream, mustard, chili ketchup, ground coriander, and salt. Mix well.

chop-vegetables-and-mix-festive-chicken.title: Chop vegetables and mix with half the marinade
chop-vegetables-and-mix-festive-chicken.description: Chop the onion and bell pepper into medium-sized pieces. Place them in a bowl, add half of the prepared marinade, and stir to combine.

stuff-chicken-festive-chicken.title: Stuff the chicken
stuff-chicken-festive-chicken.description: Fill the cavity of the chicken with the vegetable mixture. Secure the skin with toothpicks or skewers. Tie the legs together to keep the stuffing inside.

coat-and-refrigerate-festive-chicken.title: Coat the chicken and refrigerate
coat-and-refrigerate-festive-chicken.description: Brush the chicken all over with the remaining marinade. Place it in a roasting bag, tie the bag, and refrigerate for 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld.

bake-in-bag-festive-chicken.title: Bake the chicken in the bag
bake-in-bag-festive-chicken.description: Transfer the roasting bag with the chicken to a baking dish. Make 3-4 small slits in the top of the bag to allow steam to escape. Bake for 1 hour at 150°C.

increase-heat-bake-festive-chicken.title: Increase heat and bake uncovered
increase-heat-bake-festive-chicken.description: Carefully cut open the roasting bag. Increase the oven temperature to 200°C (400°F). Continue baking for another 20 minutes until the skin is golden and crispy.

mash-egg-tvorog-filo-rugelach.title: Mash cottage cheese with egg
mash-egg-tvorog-filo-rugelach.description: Mash the tvorog with a fork until smooth. Crack the egg into the tvorog and mix until combined.

chop-spinach-mix-filo-rugelach.title: Chop spinach and mix with filling
chop-spinach-mix-filo-rugelach.description: Finely chop the spinach and add it to the tvorog-egg mixture. Stir thoroughly until evenly distributed.

melt-butter-filo-rugelach.title: Melt butter in microwave
melt-butter-filo-rugelach.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and melt it in 10-second bursts, stirring between each burst to prevent burning and ensure even melting.

lay-brush-filo-filo-rugelach.title: Lay out filo and brush with butter
lay-brush-filo-filo-rugelach.description: Place one sheet of filo dough on a clean work surface. Using a pastry brush, coat the entire sheet evenly with melted butter.

shape-filo-fan-filo-rugelach.title: Shape filo into a fan
shape-filo-fan-filo-rugelach.description: Gather the buttered filo into a loose accordion pleat, then fold it in half. Join the ends to form a fan-like shape and overlap the joined sides slightly.

add-filling-filo-rugelach.title: Add filling to filo fan
add-filling-filo-rugelach.description: Divide the tvorog mixture into as many portions as you have filo sheets. Spoon one portion onto the wide part of the filo fan.

roll-rugelach-filo-rugelach.title: Roll and seal rugelach
roll-rugelach-filo-rugelach.description: Starting from the wide end, roll the filo into a rugelach shape. Twist the ends slightly to secure the roll so it doesn’t unwind.

preheat-oven-filo-rugelach.title: Preheat oven to 180°C
preheat-oven-filo-rugelach.description: Set your oven to 180°C (350°F) and allow it to fully preheat before baking.

assemble-tray-filo-rugelach.title: Arrange rugelach on baking tray
assemble-tray-filo-rugelach.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Place the rugelach on the tray, leaving some space between them. Brush the tops with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

bake-filo-rugelach.title: Bake until golden
bake-filo-rugelach.description: Transfer the tray to the preheated oven and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until the rugelach are golden brown and crisp.

grind-flax-seeds-flaxseed-porridge.title: Grind the flax seeds
grind-flax-seeds-flaxseed-porridge.description: Use a coffee grinder to grind the flax seeds until they become a coarse powder.

cut-prunes-flaxseed-porridge.title: Cut the prunes
cut-prunes-flaxseed-porridge.description: Cut the prunes into small pieces about 4–5 mm thick.

pour-coconut-milk-flaxseed-porridge.title: Pour the coconut milk
pour-coconut-milk-flaxseed-porridge.description: Pour the coconut milk into a small saucepan.

heat-coconut-milk-flaxseed-porridge.title: Warm the coconut milk
heat-coconut-milk-flaxseed-porridge.description: Heat the coconut milk over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it is warm to the touch. Remove from heat immediately.

add-ground-flax-and-prunes-flaxseed-porr.title: Add ground flax and prunes
add-ground-flax-and-prunes-flaxseed-porr.description: Add the ground flax seeds and the chopped prunes to the warm coconut milk.

add-spices-flaxseed-porridge.title: Add the spices
add-spices-flaxseed-porridge.description: Add the ground cinnamon and ground ginger to the mixture.

mix-and-transfer-flaxseed-porridge.title: Mix and serve
mix-and-transfer-flaxseed-porridge.description: Stir everything thoroughly, then transfer the porridge to a serving bowl.

melt-butter-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and melt it in the microwave.

heat-cream-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.title: Heat the cream with vanilla sugar
heat-cream-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.description: Pour the cream into a small saucepan, add the vanilla sugar, and stir. Place over medium heat and warm through, but do not let it boil.

cool-cream-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.title: Let the cream cool slightly
cool-cream-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat and allow the cream to cool for about 2 minutes, so it is warm but not hot.

mix-wet-ingredients-freeze-dried-fruit-p.title: Mix the wet ingredients
mix-wet-ingredients-freeze-dried-fruit-p.description: Crack the egg into a deep bowl. Pour in the warm cream and melted butter, then add the sugar. Whisk until smooth and well combined.

mix-dry-ingredients-freeze-dried-fruit-p.title: Mix the dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-freeze-dried-fruit-p.description: In a separate clean bowl, combine the flour, salt, and baking powder. Stir together.

combine-batter-freeze-dried-fruit-pancak.title: Combine and add fruit
combine-batter-freeze-dried-fruit-pancak.description: Pour the dry mixture into the wet ingredients. Mix until a thick, slightly runny batter forms. Fold in the freeze-dried strawberries until evenly distributed.

fry-pancakes-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-freeze-dried-fruit-pancakes.description: Heat a dry non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Drop spoonfuls of batter (about 2 tablespoons per pancake) to form rounds. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the surface bubbles and sets. Flip and cook the other side for 1–2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter.

whisk-eggs-french-toast-with-milk.title: Whisk eggs with salt and sugar
whisk-eggs-french-toast-with-milk.description: Break the eggs into a bowl. Add salt and sugar. Whisk with a whisk until well combined.

add-milk-french-toast-with-milk.title: Add milk and whisk
add-milk-french-toast-with-milk.description: Pour in the milk. Continue whisking until the mixture is smooth and homogeneous.

add-vanilla-cinnamon-french-toast-with-m.title: Add vanilla and cinnamon
add-vanilla-cinnamon-french-toast-with-m.description: Add vanilla and cinnamon to the mixture. Stir well to combine.

heat-oil-french-toast-with-milk.title: Heat oil in a pan
heat-oil-french-toast-with-milk.description: Pour vegetable oil into a frying pan and heat it over medium heat until hot.

dip-and-fry-bread-french-toast-with-milk.title: Dip and fry the bread slices
dip-and-fry-bread-french-toast-with-milk.description: Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, coating both sides, and immediately place it in the hot pan. Fry over medium heat for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.

beat-eggs-fried-adyghe-cheese-with-eggs.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-fried-adyghe-cheese-with-eggs.description: Break an egg into a bowl, add Adyghe salt, and beat lightly with a mixer on low speed until combined.

heat-pan-and-melt-butter-fried-adyghe-ch.title: Heat the pan and melt butter
heat-pan-and-melt-butter-fried-adyghe-ch.description: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add the butter and wait until it melts completely.

fry-cheese-fried-adyghe-cheese-with-eggs.title: Fry the cheese
fry-cheese-fried-adyghe-cheese-with-eggs.description: Cut the Adyghe cheese into medium-sized pieces. Place them in the melted butter and fry until golden brown on all sides.

add-eggs-and-cook-fried-adyghe-cheese-wi.title: Add the eggs and cook
add-eggs-and-cook-fried-adyghe-cheese-wi.description: Pour the egg mixture over the cheese in the pan. Cover with a lid, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 5-6 minutes until the eggs are set.

fry-chicken-fried-eggs-with-chicken.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-fried-eggs-with-chicken.description: Cut the chicken breast into small cubes. Heat oil in a frying pan over high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.

make-wells-and-add-eggs-fried-eggs-with-.title: Make wells and add eggs
make-wells-and-add-eggs-fried-eggs-with-.description: Make small wells in the chicken pieces. Crack the eggs into the wells. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat to low and cover the pan.

fry-eggs-fried-eggs-with-chicken.title: Fry the eggs
fry-eggs-fried-eggs-with-chicken.description: Cook the eggs for 2-3 minutes on low heat, covered. Watch the yolks carefully to avoid overcooking. They should remain runny if desired.

prepare-vegetables-frittata-mozzarella-a.title: Prepare the vegetables
prepare-vegetables-frittata-mozzarella-a.description: Cut the broccoli into 1.5–2 cm florets. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Dice the bell pepper into 7–8 mm cubes.

grate-cheese-frittata-mozzarella-air-fry.title: Grate the hard cheese
grate-cheese-frittata-mozzarella-air-fry.description: Coarsely grate the hard cheese and set aside.

crack-eggs-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.title: Crack the eggs into the air fryer container
crack-eggs-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.description: Carefully crack the eggs onto a piece of parchment paper in the air fryer container, being careful not to break the yolks. Season with salt and black pepper.

assemble-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.title: Assemble the frittata
assemble-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.description: Arrange the broccoli florets, cherry tomato halves, and diced bell pepper on the egg whites. Distribute the mini mozzarella balls in the gaps. Sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over everything.

cook-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.title: Cook the frittata in the air fryer
cook-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.description: Set the air fryer to 180°C in the 'Vegetables' mode and the timer to 20 minutes. Place the container inside and wait until the frittata is fully cooked.

serve-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.title: Serve the frittata
serve-frittata-mozzarella-air-fryer.description: Transfer the frittata to a serving plate and cut it into portions.

peel-oranges-fruit-ginger-smoothie.title: Peel the oranges
peel-oranges-fruit-ginger-smoothie.description: Peel the oranges, separate them into segments, remove any seeds and white pith. Place the citrus flesh into the blender jar.

peel-bananas-fruit-ginger-smoothie.title: Peel and slice the bananas
peel-bananas-fruit-ginger-smoothie.description: Peel the bananas, cut them into thick rounds, and add them to the blender with the oranges.

blend-ingredients-fruit-ginger-smoothie.title: Blend with ginger and honey
blend-ingredients-fruit-ginger-smoothie.description: Slice the ginger into thin pieces. Add it to the blender along with the honey. Blend everything until smooth and creamy.

dilute-and-serve-fruit-ginger-smoothie.title: Dilute and serve
dilute-and-serve-fruit-ginger-smoothie.description: Add water to the blended mixture, adjusting to your preferred consistency. Pour into glasses and serve immediately, garnishing with mint if desired.

beat-butter-sugar-greek-bagels.title: Beat butter and sugar
beat-butter-sugar-greek-bagels.description: Place the softened butter and sugar in a deep bowl. Beat with a mixer on medium speed until the mixture turns white and fluffy, about 4–5 minutes.

add-egg-and-dry-greek-bagels.title: Add egg, baking powder, and soda
add-egg-and-dry-greek-bagels.description: While beating, add the egg, then sift in the baking powder and baking soda. Continue beating until fully incorporated.

knead-dough-greek-bagels.title: Knead the dough with flour and orange juice
knead-dough-greek-bagels.description: Add 200 g of flour and beat briefly. Pour in the orange juice, then add the remaining flour. Knead the dough by hand until smooth and homogeneous.

shape-dough-into-balls-and-roll-greek-ba.title: Shape dough into balls and roll into strips
shape-dough-into-balls-and-roll-greek-ba.description: Roll the dough into walnut-sized balls. Dust your work surface with flour. Using both palms, roll each ball into a long rope about 15 cm long and 1 cm thick.

preheat-oven-greek-bagels.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-greek-bagels.description: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). This should be done while you shape the rings.

form-rings-greek-bagels.title: Form the rings
form-rings-greek-bagels.description: Bring the ends of each rope together to form a ring and pinch firmly to seal. Repeat with all the dough pieces.

brush-and-sprinkle-greek-bagels.title: Brush with egg and sprinkle toppings
brush-and-sprinkle-greek-bagels.description: Arrange the rings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush each ring with beaten egg, then sprinkle with sugar and sesame seeds.

bake-greek-bagels.title: Bake the bagels
bake-greek-bagels.description: Bake the bagels in the preheated oven at 190°C for 15 minutes, until golden brown.

cool-on-rack-greek-bagels.title: Cool on a wire rack
cool-on-rack-greek-bagels.description: After baking, transfer the bagels to a wire rack and let them cool completely.

chop-vegetables-greek-strapatsada.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-greek-strapatsada.description: Finely chop the shallot, garlic, and tomatoes. Mince the parsley.

beat-eggs-greek-strapatsada.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-greek-strapatsada.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until smooth and homogeneous.

saute-shallot-garlic-greek-strapatsada.title: Sauté the aromatics
saute-shallot-garlic-greek-strapatsada.description: Heat olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped shallot and garlic and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes until softened.

cook-tomatoes-greek-strapatsada.title: Cook the tomatoes
cook-tomatoes-greek-strapatsada.description: Add the chopped tomatoes to the skillet, stir to combine, and let them cook in their own juice for 5 minutes until the liquid reduces slightly and the tomatoes soften.

add-eggs-greek-strapatsada.title: Add the eggs and seasoning
add-eggs-greek-strapatsada.description: Pour the beaten eggs into the skillet. Add most of the parsley, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.

finish-eggs-greek-strapatsada.title: Scramble the eggs
finish-eggs-greek-strapatsada.description: Let the eggs set for 20–30 seconds, then stir. Continue cooking, stirring gently, for another 2–3 minutes until the eggs are fully cooked. Remove from heat.

chop-hazelnuts-greek-yogurt-hazelnuts-ra.title: Chop the hazelnuts
chop-hazelnuts-greek-yogurt-hazelnuts-ra.description: Coarsely chop the hazelnuts into small crumbs using a knife or a food processor.

combine-ingredients-greek-yogurt-hazelnu.title: Combine yogurt, bran, and raisins
combine-ingredients-greek-yogurt-hazelnu.description: In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, bran, and raisins until well combined.

sprinkle-toppings-greek-yogurt-hazelnuts.title: Sprinkle with nuts and cinnamon
sprinkle-toppings-greek-yogurt-hazelnuts.description: Top the yogurt mixture with the chopped hazelnuts and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

let-stand-greek-yogurt-hazelnuts-raisins.title: Let the mixture rest
let-stand-greek-yogurt-hazelnuts-raisins.description: Allow the yogurt mixture to sit for 5–10 minutes so the bran and raisins soften.

preheat-oven-green-frittata.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-green-frittata.description: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). This ensures the frittata bakes evenly once you transfer the skillet.

slice-spinach-green-frittata.title: Slice the spinach
slice-spinach-green-frittata.description: Cut the spinach leaves into strips about 6-7 mm wide. This will help them wilt quickly.

chop-herbs-and-green-onion-green-frittat.title: Chop herbs and green onion
chop-herbs-and-green-onion-green-frittat.description: Separate the leaves from the stems of parsley, dill, and basil. Finely chop them together with the green onion.

dice-red-onion-green-frittata.title: Dice the red onion
dice-red-onion-green-frittata.description: Cut the red onion into small cubes about 3-4 mm in size. This ensures they cook evenly.

mince-garlic-green-frittata.title: Mince the garlic
mince-garlic-green-frittata.description: Finely chop the garlic clove. You can use a knife or a garlic press.

mix-egg-mixture-green-frittata.title: Mix the egg mixture
mix-egg-mixture-green-frittata.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the chopped herbs, milk, salt, and black pepper. Whisk everything together until well combined.

saute-onion-and-garlic-green-frittata.title: Sauté the onion and garlic
saute-onion-and-garlic-green-frittata.description: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the diced red onion and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes until golden. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.

cook-frittata-on-stove-green-frittata.title: Cook the frittata on the stove
cook-frittata-on-stove-green-frittata.description: Reduce the heat to low. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet with the cooked onions and garlic. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges and bottom are set but the top is still slightly runny.

bake-frittata-green-frittata.title: Bake the frittata
bake-frittata-green-frittata.description: Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven. Bake for 4-5 minutes until the top is golden brown and the frittata is fully set.

melt-butter-and-fry-spinach-green-oven-o.title: Melt butter and fry spinach
melt-butter-and-fry-spinach-green-oven-o.description: Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for 3 minutes until wilted.

chop-spinach-green-oven-omelette.title: Chop the spinach
chop-spinach-green-oven-omelette.description: Transfer the cooked spinach to a plate and chop it finely with a knife.

cut-bread-green-oven-omelette.title: Cut the bread into cubes
cut-bread-green-oven-omelette.description: Remove crusts from the bread slices and cut the soft part into small cubes of about 2x2 cm.

grate-cheese-and-garlic-green-oven-omele.title: Grate cheese and garlic
grate-cheese-and-garlic-green-oven-omele.description: Finely grate the hard cheese and garlic clove.

whisk-eggs-green-oven-omelette.title: Whisk eggs with cream and spices
whisk-eggs-green-oven-omelette.description: In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, cream, salt, pepper, and paprika until smooth.

combine-mixture-green-oven-omelette.title: Add spinach, garlic, and cheese to eggs
combine-mixture-green-oven-omelette.description: Add the chopped spinach, grated garlic, and cheese to the egg mixture. Stir well to combine.

pour-over-bread-and-mix-green-oven-omele.title: Pour egg mixture over bread
pour-over-bread-and-mix-green-oven-omele.description: Pour the egg mixture over the bread cubes and mix gently to ensure all pieces are coated.

soak-bread-green-oven-omelette.title: Let the bread soak
soak-bread-green-oven-omelette.description: Let the bread soak in the egg mixture for 15 minutes so it absorbs the liquid.

grease-baking-dish-green-oven-omelette.title: Grease the baking dish
grease-baking-dish-green-oven-omelette.description: Use the remaining butter to grease a baking dish.

transfer-to-dish-green-oven-omelette.title: Transfer soaked bread to dish
transfer-to-dish-green-oven-omelette.description: Transfer the soaked bread and any remaining mixture into the greased baking dish.

bake-green-oven-omelette.title: Bake in preheated oven
bake-green-oven-omelette.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the omelette for 15 minutes until golden and set.

slice-leek-green-shakshuka.title: Slice the leek
slice-leek-green-shakshuka.description: Slice the white part of the leek into half rings.

chop-green-onion-and-dill-green-shakshuk.title: Chop green onion and dill
chop-green-onion-and-dill-green-shakshuk.description: Finely chop the green onion and dill.

press-garlic-green-shakshuka.title: Press the garlic
press-garlic-green-shakshuka.description: Press the garlic cloves through a garlic press.

crumble-feta-green-shakshuka.title: Crumble the feta
crumble-feta-green-shakshuka.description: Crumble the feta cheese with a fork.

saute-leek-green-shakshuka.title: Sauté the leek
saute-leek-green-shakshuka.description: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add the sliced leek, salt, and sauté, stirring, for 5–7 minutes until soft and translucent. Stir in the khmeli-suneli.

saute-garlic-green-shakshuka.title: Sauté the garlic
saute-garlic-green-shakshuka.description: Add the pressed garlic and sauté, stirring, for about 1 minute until fragrant.

cook-greens-green-shakshuka.title: Cook the greens
cook-greens-green-shakshuka.description: Reduce the heat. Add the chopped green onion and spinach. Cook, stirring gently, for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts.

add-sour-cream-and-feta-green-shakshuka.title: Add sour cream and feta
add-sour-cream-and-feta-green-shakshuka.description: Add the sour cream, half of the feta, and half of the dill. Stir well and heat for 1 minute. Level the surface and make 4 indentations with a spoon.

cook-eggs-green-shakshuka.title: Cook the eggs
cook-eggs-green-shakshuka.description: Carefully crack one egg into each indentation. Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and cook for 5–7 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny.

finish-and-serve-green-shakshuka.title: Finish and serve
finish-and-serve-green-shakshuka.description: Remove the skillet from heat. Season the eggs with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with the remaining dill and feta.

mix-marinade-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.title: Mix the marinade
mix-marinade-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.description: In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, mustard, and salt. Stir until well mixed. Add pepper if desired.

coat-and-marinate-chicken-grilled-chicke.title: Coat and marinate the chicken
coat-and-marinate-chicken-grilled-chicke.description: Brush the marinade all over the chicken, including the inside. Place the chicken in a resealable bag, pour in any remaining marinade, seal, and refrigerate for about 12 hours. Occasionally turn the bag to redistribute the marinade.

place-chicken-in-air-fryer-grilled-chick.title: Place chicken in air fryer
place-chicken-in-air-fryer-grilled-chick.description: Remove the chicken from the bag and place it in the air fryer basket or a baking dish suitable for the oven.

bake-chicken-1-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.title: Bake the first side
bake-chicken-1-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.description: Preheat the air fryer or oven to 160°C (320°F). Bake the chicken for 15 minutes.

turn-chicken-1-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.title: Turn the chicken and brush
turn-chicken-1-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.description: Carefully turn the chicken over. Brush with some of the remaining marinade from the bag.

turn-chicken-2-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.title: Turn and brush again
turn-chicken-2-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.description: Turn the chicken over once more and brush with marinade.

turn-chicken-3-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.title: Turn and brush one last time
turn-chicken-3-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.description: Turn the chicken over and brush with any remaining marinade.

bake-chicken-4-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.title: Bake the final side
bake-chicken-4-grilled-chicken-air-fryer.description: Bake for a final 15 minutes until the chicken is golden and cooked through. Internal temperature should reach 74°C (165°F) in the thickest part.

peel-and-dice-apples-healthy-chocolate-d.title: Peel and dice apples
peel-and-dice-apples-healthy-chocolate-d.description: Peel the apples, remove the cores, and cut the flesh into small cubes.

cook-apples-with-water-healthy-chocolate.title: Cook apples with water
cook-apples-with-water-healthy-chocolate.description: Place the apple cubes in a preheated dry frying pan, add the water, and simmer over medium heat, stirring, until the apples are soft.

transfer-apples-to-blender-healthy-choco.title: Transfer apples to blender
transfer-apples-to-blender-healthy-choco.description: Transfer the cooked apples to a blender bowl, then add the sugar and cocoa powder.

blend-with-tvorog-and-yogurt-healthy-cho.title: Blend with tvorog and yogurt
blend-with-tvorog-and-yogurt-healthy-cho.description: Add the tvorog and Greek yogurt to the blender. Blend until the mixture is smooth and homogeneous.

melt-chocolate-in-microwave-healthy-choc.title: Melt chocolate in microwave
