melt-chocolate-in-microwave-healthy-choc.description: Break the dark chocolate into small pieces. Melt it in the microwave in 10-second bursts, stirring between each burst, until fully melted and smooth.

combine-chocolate-and-blend-healthy-choc.title: Combine chocolate and blend
combine-chocolate-and-blend-healthy-choc.description: Pour the melted chocolate into the apple-tvorog mixture, add a pinch of salt, and blend again until everything is well combined.

portion-and-chill-healthy-chocolate-dess.title: Portion and chill
portion-and-chill-healthy-chocolate-dess.description: Divide the mixture into serving glasses or bowls. Refrigerate for 2–3 hours until set and chilled.

sprinkle-with-cocoa-healthy-chocolate-de.title: Sprinkle with cocoa
sprinkle-with-cocoa-healthy-chocolate-de.description: Once the dessert is fully chilled, sprinkle a generous layer of cocoa powder on top before serving.

cut-bread-window-hearty-breakfast-toasts.title: Cut a window from the bread
cut-bread-window-hearty-breakfast-toasts.description: Using a small knife, cut a square or round hole in the center of each bread slice, leaving a 1 cm border around the edges. Set the cut-out pieces aside to use as lids later.

dice-ham-veggies-hearty-breakfast-toasts.title: Dice the ham and vegetables
dice-ham-veggies-hearty-breakfast-toasts.description: Finely dice the ham, red onion, and bell pepper into small cubes. Aim for uniform pieces so they cook evenly.

slice-cheese-hearty-breakfast-toasts.title: Slice the cheese
slice-cheese-hearty-breakfast-toasts.description: Cut the gouda cheese into thin slices. You'll need enough to cover the top of each toast.

heat-oil-hearty-breakfast-toasts.title: Heat the oil
heat-oil-hearty-breakfast-toasts.description: Add the sunflower oil to a frying pan and place it over low heat. Let the oil warm up for about a minute before adding the bread.

fry-bread-hearty-breakfast-toasts.title: Fry the bread on one side
fry-bread-hearty-breakfast-toasts.description: Place the bread slices with the hole in the pan. Fry them for 2 minutes on one side over low heat until lightly golden. Keep the heat low to prevent burning.

add-egg-and-toppings-hearty-breakfast-to.title: Add the egg and toppings
add-egg-and-toppings-hearty-breakfast-to.description: Carefully crack an egg into the hole of each bread slice. Sprinkle the diced ham, onion, and bell pepper evenly over the egg. The toppings should sit on top of the egg yolk and white.

add-cheese-and-lid-hearty-breakfast-toas.title: Add cheese and cover with bread lid
add-cheese-and-lid-hearty-breakfast-toas.description: Place the sliced gouda cheese over the egg and toppings. Then take the reserved bread cut-outs and place them on top, pressing down gently to seal the toast.

cook-toasts-hearty-breakfast-toasts.title: Cook the toasts until egg is set
cook-toasts-hearty-breakfast-toasts.description: Continue cooking the toasts over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until the egg white is fully set and the cheese is melted. Then carefully flip each toast and cook for 1 more minute on the other side. Serve immediately.

preheat-oven-herb-butter-chicken-roll-sa.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-herb-butter-chicken-roll-sa.description: Set your oven to preheat to 180°C. This will take about 10 minutes.

mix-herb-butter-herb-butter-chicken-roll.title: Make the herb butter
mix-herb-butter-herb-butter-chicken-roll.description: In a bowl, combine soft butter with pressed garlic and finely chopped dill. Mix until smooth and well combined.

cut-and-spread-ciabatta-herb-butter-chic.title: Cut and spread the ciabatta
cut-and-spread-ciabatta-herb-butter-chic.description: Slice the ciabatta in half lengthwise. Spread the herb butter evenly on the cut sides of both halves.

bake-ciabatta-herb-butter-chicken-roll-s.title: Bake the ciabatta
bake-ciabatta-herb-butter-chicken-roll-s.description: Place the ciabatta halves on a baking tray, buttered side up. Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are golden and crispy.

cool-ciabatta-herb-butter-chicken-roll-s.title: Cool the ciabatta slightly
cool-ciabatta-herb-butter-chicken-roll-s.description: Remove the baked ciabatta from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes so it's easier to handle.

prepare-avocado-and-tomato-herb-butter-c.title: Prepare the avocado and tomato
prepare-avocado-and-tomato-herb-butter-c.description: Peel and pit the avocado, then slice it into 3–4 mm thick pieces. Slice the tomato into rounds of the same thickness.

assemble-bottom-layer-herb-butter-chicke.title: Assemble the bottom layer
assemble-bottom-layer-herb-butter-chicke.description: On the bottom half of the ciabatta, place the lettuce leaves. Top with the tomato slices, then arrange the avocado slices on top.

add-chicken-roll-and-top-herb-butter-chi.title: Add chicken roll and top
add-chicken-roll-and-top-herb-butter-chi.description: Place slices of chicken roll over the avocado. Cover with the top half of the ciabatta and press down gently.

cut-fat-homemade-chicken-slow-cooker.title: Cut fat from chicken belly
cut-fat-homemade-chicken-slow-cooker.description: Cut pieces of fat from the belly of the chicken.

fry-fat-homemade-chicken-slow-cooker.title: Fry chicken fat
fry-fat-homemade-chicken-slow-cooker.description: Set the multicooker to fry mode, place the fat pieces on the bottom, and fry for 3–4 minutes.

chop-vegetables-and-chicken-homemade-chi.title: Chop vegetables and chicken
chop-vegetables-and-chicken-homemade-chi.description: Slice the onion into feathers, grate the carrot on a medium grater, and cut the chicken meat into medium slices.

remove-cracklings-and-add-chicken-homema.title: Remove cracklings and add chicken
remove-cracklings-and-add-chicken-homema.description: Take the cracklings out of the multicooker and set them aside. Place the chicken slices into the bowl.

add-vegetables-and-season-homemade-chick.title: Add vegetables and season
add-vegetables-and-season-homemade-chick.description: Add the onion and carrot to the chicken. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

stew-chicken-homemade-chicken-slow-cooke.title: Stew chicken
stew-chicken-homemade-chicken-slow-cooke.description: Cover the multicooker with the lid and set to stew mode for 1 hour. Halfway through (after 30 minutes), turn the chicken pieces to ensure even cooking.

cut-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chicken.title: Cut the Chicken
cut-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chicken.description: Cut the chicken into serving pieces and place them in a bowl.

squeeze-lemon-homestyle-grilled-chicken.title: Squeeze Lemon Juice
squeeze-lemon-homestyle-grilled-chicken.description: Squeeze the juice from half a lemon into a small bowl.

grate-ginger-homestyle-grilled-chicken.title: Grate Ginger
grate-ginger-homestyle-grilled-chicken.description: Grate the ginger on a fine grater.

combine-marinade-homestyle-grilled-chick.title: Combine Marinade
combine-marinade-homestyle-grilled-chick.description: In a bowl, combine the lemon juice, soy sauce, grated ginger, Italian herbs, black pepper, and balsamic vinegar. Stir well.

marinate-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chick.title: Marinate the Chicken
marinate-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chick.description: Pour the marinade over the chicken pieces and mix thoroughly to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 hours.

place-chicken-on-rack-homestyle-grilled-.title: Place Chicken on Rack
place-chicken-on-rack-homestyle-grilled-.description: Place the marinated chicken pieces on a wire rack set over a baking tray to catch drips.

bake-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chicken.title: Bake the Chicken
bake-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chicken.description: Put the rack with chicken in the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.

grill-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chicken.title: Grill the Chicken
grill-chicken-homestyle-grilled-chicken.description: Switch the oven to grill mode and continue baking for another 15 minutes until the skin is crispy and golden.

rub-chicken-homestyle-stewed-chicken.title: Rub the chicken with salt and seasoning
rub-chicken-homestyle-stewed-chicken.description: Take the whole chicken and rub it thoroughly on all sides with salt and chicken seasoning. Make sure it's evenly coated.

sear-chicken-homestyle-stewed-chicken.title: Sear the chicken
sear-chicken-homestyle-stewed-chicken.description: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat. Place the whole chicken in the skillet and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side until a golden brown crust forms. This seals in the juices.

transfer-and-bring-to-boil-homestyle-ste.title: Transfer and bring to a boil
transfer-and-bring-to-boil-homestyle-ste.description: Transfer the seared chicken to a pot. Pour hot water over it and place the pot over medium heat. Bring the liquid to a boil.

simmer-chicken-homestyle-stewed-chicken.title: Simmer the chicken
simmer-chicken-homestyle-stewed-chicken.description: Reduce the heat to low. Cover the pot and let the chicken simmer for 1 hour. Every 15 minutes, turn the chicken to ensure even cooking.

preheat-oven-hot-cheese-toasts.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-hot-cheese-toasts.description: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the toast slices on it.

dice-vegetables-hot-cheese-toasts.title: Dice the vegetables
dice-vegetables-hot-cheese-toasts.description: Finely dice the tomato, red onion, and pickled jalapeño. Press the garlic clove through a press. Set aside.

mix-filling-hot-cheese-toasts.title: Mix the cheese filling
mix-filling-hot-cheese-toasts.description: In a bowl, combine the grated hard cheese and cream cheese. Add the diced vegetables and pressed garlic. Season with salt and black pepper, then mix until homogeneous.

top-toasts-hot-cheese-toasts.title: Top the toasts
top-toasts-hot-cheese-toasts.description: Spoon 2-3 tablespoons of the cheese mixture onto each toast slice. Spread evenly over the surface.

bake-toasts-hot-cheese-toasts.title: Bake the toasts
bake-toasts-hot-cheese-toasts.description: Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven. Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the bread edges are golden and the cheese is melted and bubbly.

fry-sausages-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.title: Fry the sausages
fry-sausages-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.description: Make shallow cuts on the sausages and fry them in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown, about 5 minutes.

chop-vegetables-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.title: Chop the onion and pickles
chop-vegetables-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.description: Finely dice the red onion and cornichons (pickled cucumbers).

mix-sauce-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.title: Mix the sauce
mix-sauce-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.description: Combine the chopped onion and pickles in a bowl. Add mayonnaise and barbecue sauce, then stir well.

melt-butter-add-corn-hot-dog-with-cheese.title: Melt butter and add corn
melt-butter-add-corn-hot-dog-with-cheese.description: In a skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the corn kernels and stir. Grate the Gouda cheese and add it to the pan.

melt-cheese-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.title: Melt the processed cheese
melt-cheese-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.description: Add the processed cheese to the pan. Stir continuously until the cheese is completely melted and combined with the corn.

add-cream-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.title: Add cream and mix
add-cream-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.description: Pour in the light cream in a thin stream while stirring. Mix until the sauce is smooth and homogeneous.

prepare-buns-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.title: Prepare the buns
prepare-buns-hot-dog-with-cheese-corn.description: Slice the hot dog buns lengthwise without cutting all the way through. Spread the onion-pickle-mayo sauce inside each bun.

assemble-hot-dogs-hot-dog-with-cheese-co.title: Assemble the hot dogs
assemble-hot-dogs-hot-dog-with-cheese-co.description: Place a cooked sausage into each bun on top of the sauce. Spoon the corn-cheese mixture over the sausage. Sprinkle with ground paprika.

roll-dough-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-an.title: Roll out the dough
roll-dough-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-an.description: Dust your work surface with flour, place the puff pastry, and roll it into two sheets about 2–3 mm thick. Cut out circles slightly larger than your tartlet molds so you can form raised edges.

line-molds-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-an.title: Line the molds
line-molds-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-an.description: Grease the tartlet molds evenly with vegetable oil. Place a dough circle into each mold, pressing it against the sides to form edges. Cover with a clean cloth and leave in a warm place for 30 minutes to rise.

proof-dough-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-a.title: Proof the dough
proof-dough-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-a.description: Let the lined molds rest at room temperature, covered with a towel, for 30 minutes. This allows the dough to puff slightly before baking.

grate-and-chop-hot-tartlets-with-sausage.title: Grate and chop filling ingredients
grate-and-chop-hot-tartlets-with-sausage.description: Coarsely grate the cheese. Dice the bell pepper and sausages into 4–5 mm cubes. Finely chop the green onions.

combine-filling-hot-tartlets-with-sausag.title: Combine the filling
combine-filling-hot-tartlets-with-sausag.description: In a mixing bowl, combine the grated cheese, diced pepper and sausages, and chopped green onions. Add the canned corn and stir everything together.

preheat-oven-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-.description: Set your oven to 180°C (350°F) so it is hot by the time you are ready to bake.

make-custard-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-.title: Make the egg‑cream custard
make-custard-hot-tartlets-with-sausages-.description: Crack the eggs into a clean bowl and whisk lightly. Pour in the heavy cream, add the Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper. Whisk until well combined.

fill-tartlets-hot-tartlets-with-sausages.title: Fill the tartlet shells
fill-tartlets-hot-tartlets-with-sausages.description: Divide the filling mixture evenly among the proofed tartlet shells. Pour about 2 tablespoons of the egg‑cream custard into each shell, over the filling.

bake-tartlets-hot-tartlets-with-sausages.title: Bake the tartlets
bake-tartlets-hot-tartlets-with-sausages.description: Place the filled tartlets in the preheated oven and bake at 180°C for 25–30 minutes, until the tops are golden and the custard is set. Let them cool slightly before serving.

boil-eggs-hot-toasts-with-egg-salad.title: Boil the eggs
boil-eggs-hot-toasts-with-egg-salad.description: Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Cook for exactly 10 minutes from the moment the water starts boiling. Transfer the eggs to ice water to cool, then peel and dice them finely.

chop-parsley-and-mix-egg-salad-hot-toast.title: Make the egg salad
chop-parsley-and-mix-egg-salad-hot-toast.description: Finely chop the parsley and add it to the diced eggs. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Add mayonnaise and stir until well combined.

fry-bread-and-assemble-hot-toasts-with-e.title: Toast the bread and assemble
fry-bread-and-assemble-hot-toasts-with-e.description: Toast the bread slices in a dry frying pan over medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Transfer the slices to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spread the egg salad evenly over each slice.

bake-toasts-hot-toasts-with-egg-salad.title: Bake the toasts
bake-toasts-hot-toasts-with-egg-salad.description: Place a slice of cheese on top of each toast, pressing lightly. Bake in the preheated oven for 7–10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden. Serve immediately.

separate-eggs-japanese-pancakes.title: Separate the eggs
separate-eggs-japanese-pancakes.description: Crack the eggs and carefully separate the whites from the yolks. Keep 2 yolks for later (you can discard the third yolk or save for another use) and place all 3 whites in a large bowl.

beat-egg-whites-japanese-pancakes.title: Beat the egg whites
beat-egg-whites-japanese-pancakes.description: Add a pinch of salt to the egg whites and beat until soft peaks form. Gradually add the sugar while continuing to beat until stiff, glossy peaks form. This should take about 5 minutes.

mix-yolk-mixture-japanese-pancakes.title: Mix the yolk mixture
mix-yolk-mixture-japanese-pancakes.description: In a separate bowl, combine the 2 reserved egg yolks with the milk and olive oil. Whisk until smooth and well combined. You don't need to achieve a frothy texture.

mix-dry-wet-japanese-pancakes.title: Combine dry and wet ingredients
mix-dry-wet-japanese-pancakes.description: In a small bowl, mix the flour and baking powder together. Gradually add the dry mixture to the yolk mixture, stirring constantly until no lumps remain and the batter is smooth.

fold-egg-whites-japanese-pancakes.title: Fold in the beaten egg whites
fold-egg-whites-japanese-pancakes.description: Gently add the beaten egg whites to the batter, one spoonful at a time. Use a spatula to fold them in with upward motions from the bottom until just incorporated. Be careful not to deflate the whites.

make-parchment-rings-japanese-pancakes.title: Make parchment rings
make-parchment-rings-japanese-pancakes.description: Cut parchment paper into strips about 26 cm long and 5 cm wide. Roll each strip into a ring about 8 cm in diameter, overlapping the ends by about 1 cm, and secure with a toothpick.

cook-first-side-japanese-pancakes.title: Cook the first side
cook-first-side-japanese-pancakes.description: Place the parchment rings in a dry, well-heated frying pan. Fill each ring about three-quarters full with batter. Cover the pan with a lid and cook over medium heat for 4–5 minutes, until the batter rises to the top of the rings.

cook-second-side-japanese-pancakes.title: Flip and cook the second side
cook-second-side-japanese-pancakes.description: Carefully flip the pancakes (still inside the rings) using a spatula. Cook for another 4 minutes without the lid until the other side is golden brown. Remove the rings before serving.

boil-rice-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.title: Boil the rice
boil-rice-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.description: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the rice and cook until tender. Drain the rice in a sieve and set aside.

boil-broth-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.title: Boil the dashi broth
boil-broth-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.description: Pour the dashi broth into a pot and bring to a boil over medium heat.

add-rice-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.title: Add the cooked rice
add-rice-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.description: Add the drained rice to the boiling broth.

add-seasonings-japanese-rice-porridge-eg.title: Add the seasonings
add-seasonings-japanese-rice-porridge-eg.description: Stir in the mirin, sake, and light soy sauce.

simmer-porridge-japanese-rice-porridge-e.title: Simmer the porridge
simmer-porridge-japanese-rice-porridge-e.description: Reduce the heat to low and cover the pot, leaving a small gap. Simmer until the porridge reaches your desired consistency.

whisk-eggs-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.title: Whisk the eggs
whisk-eggs-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.description: In a small bowl, whisk the eggs until uniform.

add-eggs-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.title: Add the eggs
add-eggs-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.description: Pour the whisked eggs into the porridge without stirring. Cook for 20-30 seconds over low heat.

stir-porridge-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.title: Stir and serve
stir-porridge-japanese-rice-porridge-egg.description: Stir the porridge gently to distribute the eggs evenly. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

beat-eggs-japanese-steamed-omelette.title: Beat eggs and mix with broth
beat-eggs-japanese-steamed-omelette.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add salt, and lightly beat with a fork. Pour in the chicken broth and mix again.

strain-and-pour-japanese-steamed-omelett.title: Strain the mixture and pour into molds
strain-and-pour-japanese-steamed-omelett.description: Strain the egg mixture through a fine sieve into a measuring cup. Pour into a ceramic or glass mold, filling it to about two-thirds full. If the mixture is too much, divide between two molds.

steam-japanese-steamed-omelette.title: Steam the omelette
steam-japanese-steamed-omelette.description: Place the mold in a steamer, cover with plastic wrap, and steam for 12–14 minutes until set but still jiggly in the center.

crack-eggs-kefir-omelette.title: Crack eggs and whisk with kefir
crack-eggs-kefir-omelette.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add salt, pepper, and kefir. Whisk until smooth and uniform.

add-flour-kefir-omelette.title: Add flour to the mixture
add-flour-kefir-omelette.description: Sift the flour into the egg mixture and stir thoroughly until no lumps remain.

chop-parsley-kefir-omelette.title: Chop parsley and add to batter
chop-parsley-kefir-omelette.description: Finely chop the parsley leaves and add them to the batter. Mix well to distribute.

grate-cheese-kefir-omelette.title: Grate the cheese
grate-cheese-kefir-omelette.description: Grate the hard cheese on a fine or medium grater into a separate plate. Set aside.

heat-oil-kefir-omelette.title: Heat oil in a pan
heat-oil-kefir-omelette.description: Place a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the vegetable oil and let it heat up.

pour-mixture-kefir-omelette.title: Pour the omelette mixture into the pan
pour-mixture-kefir-omelette.description: Pour the prepared egg mixture into the hot skillet, spreading it evenly.

top-with-cheese-kefir-omelette.title: Top with grated cheese
top-with-cheese-kefir-omelette.description: Sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over the top of the omelette.

cook-covered-kefir-omelette.title: Cover and cook on low heat
cook-covered-kefir-omelette.description: Cover the skillet with a lid. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until the omelette is fully set. Use a timer.

dice-cucumber-avocado-keto-dinner-with-a.title: Dice cucumber and avocado
dice-cucumber-avocado-keto-dinner-with-a.description: Cut the cucumber and avocado into small cubes. Place them in a bowl.

add-arugula-keto-dinner-with-avocado.title: Add arugula
add-arugula-keto-dinner-with-avocado.description: Add the arugula to the bowl with the cucumber and avocado.

dress-with-olive-oil-keto-dinner-with-av.title: Dress with olive oil
dress-with-olive-oil-keto-dinner-with-av.description: Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and toss gently.

boil-chicken-keto-dinner-with-avocado.title: Boil the chicken
boil-chicken-keto-dinner-with-avocado.description: Place the chicken breast in a small pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook until fully cooked through, about 20 minutes.

place-chicken-on-plate-keto-dinner-with-.title: Place chicken on plate
place-chicken-on-plate-keto-dinner-with-.description: Take the cooked chicken out of the water and place it on a serving plate.

top-with-butter-keto-dinner-with-avocado.title: Top with butter
top-with-butter-keto-dinner-with-avocado.description: Place the slices of butter on top of the hot chicken so it melts slightly.

mix-dough-and-rise-khachapuri-with-pumpk.title: Mix dough and let rise
mix-dough-and-rise-khachapuri-with-pumpk.description: Combine flour, yeast, salt, and warm water. Mix until a dough forms. Cover with a towel and let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.

saute-onion-khachapuri-with-pumpkin.title: Sauté onion
saute-onion-khachapuri-with-pumpkin.description: Finely chop the onion and fry in a pan over medium heat until soft and translucent.

prepare-pumpkin-filling-khachapuri-with-.title: Prepare pumpkin filling
prepare-pumpkin-filling-khachapuri-with-.description: Grate the pumpkin using a coarse grater. Mix with the sautéed onion and chopped dill. Season with salt to taste.

assemble-khachapuri-with-pumpkin.title: Assemble khachapuri
assemble-khachapuri-with-pumpkin.description: Roll out the dough into a thin circle, about 0.3 cm thick. Place the filling in the center. Gather the edges of the dough over the filling and pinch tightly to seal.

prepare-for-baking-khachapuri-with-pumpk.title: Prepare for baking
prepare-for-baking-khachapuri-with-pumpk.description: Transfer the assembled khachapuri seam-side down onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush the surface with milk and make a small hole in the center to allow steam to escape.

bake-khachapuri-with-pumpkin.title: Bake khachapuri
bake-khachapuri-with-pumpkin.description: Place the khachapuri in the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes until golden brown.

mix-eggs-salt-kindergarten-omelette.title: Mix eggs with salt
mix-eggs-salt-kindergarten-omelette.description: Crack the eggs into a deep bowl. Add salt and stir gently with a fork or whisk, without beating to a foam.

add-milk-kindergarten-omelette.title: Add milk and mix
add-milk-kindergarten-omelette.description: Pour the milk into the egg mixture and stir gently until combined. Avoid vigorous beating.

grease-dish-kindergarten-omelette.title: Grease the baking dish
grease-dish-kindergarten-omelette.description: Choose a heatproof dish with high sides. Use about 15g of the butter to generously grease the dish.

pour-mixture-kindergarten-omelette.title: Pour mixture into dish
pour-mixture-kindergarten-omelette.description: Carefully pour the egg-milk mixture into the greased dish. The height of the omelette will depend on the size of the dish.

preheat-oven-kindergarten-omelette.title: Preheat oven to 200°C
preheat-oven-kindergarten-omelette.description: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Make sure the oven is fully heated before baking.

bake-omelette-kindergarten-omelette.title: Bake the omelette
bake-omelette-kindergarten-omelette.description: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 15–20 minutes until set and golden. Do not open the oven during baking.

rest-omelette-kindergarten-omelette.title: Let the omelette rest in the oven
rest-omelette-kindergarten-omelette.description: Turn off the oven and leave the dish inside for 5–7 minutes. This helps the omelette stay fluffy.

finish-omelette-kindergarten-omelette.title: Brush with butter and cut
finish-omelette-kindergarten-omelette.description: Remove the omelette from the oven. Brush the top with the remaining 5g of butter. Let it cool slightly, then cut into squares to serve.

grate-mix-filling-lavash-rolls-air-fryer.title: Grate ham and cheese and mix with mayonnaise
grate-mix-filling-lavash-rolls-air-fryer.description: Coarsely grate the ham and hard cheese. Combine them in a bowl, add mayonnaise, and mix well.

assemble-rolls-lavash-rolls-air-fryer.title: Assemble the rolls
assemble-rolls-lavash-rolls-air-fryer.description: Spread the filling evenly over the entire surface of the lavash, leaving a 1-2 cm border on the far edge. Roll the lavash tightly into a log. Cut the roll into 8 pieces. Place them in the air fryer basket lined with parchment. Brush the tops with egg yolk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

preheat-bake-rolls-lavash-rolls-air-frye.title: Bake the rolls in the air fryer
preheat-bake-rolls-lavash-rolls-air-frye.description: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C. Bake the rolls for 8-10 minutes until golden and heated through.

boil-water-lazy-greek-yogurt-tiramisu.title: Boil water
boil-water-lazy-greek-yogurt-tiramisu.description: Bring water to a boil in a small pot or kettle.

dissolve-coffee-lazy-greek-yogurt-tirami.title: Dissolve instant coffee
dissolve-coffee-lazy-greek-yogurt-tirami.description: Pour the boiling water over the instant coffee and stir until completely dissolved.

break-and-dip-biscuits-lazy-greek-yogurt.title: Break and dip biscuits
break-and-dip-biscuits-lazy-greek-yogurt.description: Break the savoiardi biscuits into 3–4 cm pieces and quickly dip each piece into the coffee, then set aside.

mix-coffee-into-yogurt-lazy-greek-yogurt.title: Mix coffee into yogurt
mix-coffee-into-yogurt-lazy-greek-yogurt.description: Pour the remaining coffee into the Greek yogurt and stir until smooth and uniform.

divide-yogurt-mixture-lazy-greek-yogurt-.title: Divide into glasses
divide-yogurt-mixture-lazy-greek-yogurt-.description: Divide the yogurt mixture evenly between two serving glasses.

insert-biscuits-into-yogurt-lazy-greek-y.title: Insert biscuits into yogurt
insert-biscuits-into-yogurt-lazy-greek-y.description: Gently press the coffee-dipped biscuit pieces into the yogurt. They may stick out slightly; that is fine.

refrigerate-lazy-greek-yogurt-tiramisu.title: Refrigerate
refrigerate-lazy-greek-yogurt-tiramisu.description: Place the glasses in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight, to allow the biscuits to soften and the dessert to set.

chop-onion-and-mushrooms-lazy-pie-with-e.title: Chop onion and mushrooms
chop-onion-and-mushrooms-lazy-pie-with-e.description: Finely chop the onion and slice the mushrooms into thin pieces.

heat-oil-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushroom.title: Heat oil
heat-oil-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushroom.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat.

fry-onion-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushroo.title: Fry onion
fry-onion-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushroo.description: Add the chopped onion and sauté until soft and translucent.

add-mushrooms-and-cook-lazy-pie-with-egg.title: Add mushrooms and cook
add-mushrooms-and-cook-lazy-pie-with-egg.description: Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until the excess moisture evaporates. Stir occasionally.

transfer-filling-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-.title: Transfer filling
transfer-filling-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-.description: Transfer the cooked onion and mushrooms to a plate.

whisk-eggs-cream-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-.title: Whisk eggs and cream
whisk-eggs-cream-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-.description: In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, cream, salt, and pepper until well combined.

cook-omelet-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushr.title: Cook omelet
cook-omelet-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushr.description: Pour the egg mixture into the hot skillet and cook covered over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until set. Be careful not to overcook.

combine-filling-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-m.title: Combine filling
combine-filling-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-m.description: Transfer the cooked omelet to the plate with mushrooms and mix everything together thoroughly.

mix-wet-dough-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mus.title: Mix wet dough ingredients
mix-wet-dough-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mus.description: In a clean bowl, combine the eggs, mayonnaise, sour cream, and vodka. Whisk until smooth.

add-dry-to-dough-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-.title: Add dry ingredients
add-dry-to-dough-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-.description: Sift in the flour and baking powder, then stir until the batter is smooth and lump-free. The dough should be runny but slightly thick, like pancake batter.

grease-pan-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushro.title: Grease baking dish
grease-pan-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushro.description: Grease a baking dish with the remaining vegetable oil.

pour-dough-and-top-lazy-pie-with-eggs-an.title: Assemble the pie
pour-dough-and-top-lazy-pie-with-eggs-an.description: Pour the batter into the prepared dish. Evenly distribute the mushroom-omelet filling on top and sprinkle with grated cheese.

bake-pie-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushroom.title: Bake the pie
bake-pie-lazy-pie-with-eggs-and-mushroom.description: Place the dish in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown and set.

activate-yeast-lemon-bread.title: Activate the yeast
activate-yeast-lemon-bread.description: Dissolve the dry yeast, 2 tablespoons of flour, and 1 teaspoon of sugar in warm water. Let it stand in a warm place for 15 minutes until the yeast activates.

add-wet-ingredients-lemon-bread.title: Add wet ingredients
add-wet-ingredients-lemon-bread.description: Add sour cream and butter to the sponge. Crack in 1 egg, then add salt, 50 g sugar, and vanilla extract. Mix well.

mix-dough-lemon-bread.title: Mix the dough
mix-dough-lemon-bread.description: Add the flour and mix with a mixer until smooth. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let rise for 1.5 hours.

let-dough-rise-lemon-bread.title: Let the dough rise
let-dough-rise-lemon-bread.description: Allow the dough to rise in a warm place for 1.5 hours until doubled in size.

prepare-filling-lemon-bread.title: Prepare the filling
prepare-filling-lemon-bread.description: In a separate bowl, combine sour cream with the remaining sugar and 2 tablespoons of flour. Stir in the lemon juice and mix well.

roll-dough-lemon-bread.title: Roll out the dough
roll-dough-lemon-bread.description: Lay a sheet of parchment paper dusted with 3 tablespoons of flour. Roll the dough into a rectangle about 25 by 35 cm.

spread-lemon-honey-lemon-bread.title: Spread lemon honey
spread-lemon-honey-lemon-bread.description: Visually divide the dough into three parts. Spread the central third with grated lemon mixed with honey.

spread-cream-cut-strips-lemon-bread.title: Spread cream and cut strips
spread-cream-cut-strips-lemon-bread.description: Evenly spread the lemon cream over the sour cream mixture. Cut the free dough sections into 1 cm wide strips, perpendicular to the filling, ensuring an equal number on each side.

braid-dough-lemon-bread.title: Braid the dough
braid-dough-lemon-bread.description: Weave the strips into a braid over the filling. Transfer the braid with parchment to a baking sheet, cover with a towel, and let rise for 50 minutes.

let-shaped-dough-rise-lemon-bread.title: Let the shaped dough rise
let-shaped-dough-rise-lemon-bread.description: Allow the braided bread to rest and rise for 50 minutes in a warm place.

preheat-oven-lemon-bread.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-lemon-bread.description: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F) in preparation for baking.

brush-egg-sprinkle-lemon-bread.title: Brush with egg and sprinkle
brush-egg-sprinkle-lemon-bread.description: Brush the risen dough with the remaining beaten egg and sprinkle with decorative sprinkles.

bake-bread-lemon-bread.title: Bake the bread
bake-bread-lemon-bread.description: Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until golden brown. Allow to cool before slicing.

prepare-lemons-lemon-souffle.title: Prepare the lemons
prepare-lemons-lemon-souffle.description: Finely grate the zest of the lemons. Cut one lemon in half, remove any seeds, and squeeze out 2 tablespoons of juice.

separate-and-beat-yolks-lemon-souffle.title: Separate eggs and beat yolks
separate-and-beat-yolks-lemon-souffle.description: Separate the egg whites from the yolks into two bowls. Add half of the sugar to the yolks and beat with a mixer until the mixture becomes pale and thick.

add-dry-and-milk-lemon-souffle.title: Add dry ingredients and milk
add-dry-and-milk-lemon-souffle.description: Sift in the flour and cornstarch, then pour in the milk and lemon juice. Mix on low speed until smooth and no lumps remain.

beat-egg-whites-lemon-souffle.title: Beat the egg whites
beat-egg-whites-lemon-souffle.description: Start beating the egg whites at low speed, gradually increasing to high. When the whites become frothy and increase in volume, add the remaining sugar. Continue beating until stiff peaks form — the mixture should hold its shape and not fall when you turn the bowl upside down.

fold-egg-whites-lemon-souffle.title: Fold the egg whites into the batter
fold-egg-whites-lemon-souffle.description: Gently transfer the beaten egg whites to the yolk mixture. Fold them in using a spatula, moving in one direction and lifting the batter from the bottom to the center, until just combined.

butter-and-fill-molds-lemon-souffle.title: Butter and fill the molds
butter-and-fill-molds-lemon-souffle.description: Grease individual ramekins or molds with butter. Fill them with the airy soufflé mixture.

bake-souffle-lemon-souffle.title: Bake the soufflé
bake-souffle-lemon-souffle.description: Preheat the oven to 150°C. Bake the soufflés for 30 minutes until they are puffed and golden brown on top. Serve immediately.

soak-lentils-lentil-bread.title: Soak the lentils
soak-lentils-lentil-bread.description: Place the lentils in a bowl, cover with water, and let soak for 3 hours. Then drain the water.

drain-lentils-lentil-bread.title: Drain the lentils
drain-lentils-lentil-bread.description: Drain the soaked lentils in a colander and rinse briefly.

blend-dough-lentil-bread.title: Blend the dough
blend-dough-lentil-bread.description: Add the drained lentils to a blender along with eggs, yogurt, flour, salt, Italian herbs, baking powder, and olive oil. Blend until smooth and uniform.

prepare-form-lentil-bread.title: Prepare the baking form
prepare-form-lentil-bread.description: Line a baking loaf pan with parchment paper. Pour the lentil dough into the pan and sprinkle the seed mix evenly on top.

bake-lentil-bread.title: Bake the bread
bake-lentil-bread.description: Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until golden and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

soak-lentils-lentil-pancakes.title: Soak the lentils
soak-lentils-lentil-pancakes.description: Rinse the red lentils and place them in a bowl. Cover with water and let them soak at room temperature for 3 hours. Drain the water afterward.

drain-blender-lentil-pancakes.title: Prepare the blender
drain-blender-lentil-pancakes.description: Drain the soaked lentils and transfer them to the blender jar. Measure the remaining water (150 ml) and add it to the blender with the lentils.

blend-lentils-lentil-pancakes.title: Blend until smooth
blend-lentils-lentil-pancakes.description: Blend the lentils and water for 3–4 minutes until you get a smooth, frothy puree similar to foam.

add-seasoning-lentil-pancakes.title: Add spices and mix
add-seasoning-lentil-pancakes.description: Add the salt, black pepper, paprika, and Italian herbs to the lentil puree. Stir well to combine.

heat-pan-lentil-pancakes.title: Heat the pan with oil
heat-pan-lentil-pancakes.description: Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with sunflower oil using a brush or paper towel.

fry-pancakes-lentil-pancakes.title: Cook the pancakes
fry-pancakes-lentil-pancakes.description: Pour a small ladle of the lentil batter onto the hot pan and spread it thinly. Cook for 1–2 minutes on one side until set, then flip and cook for about 1 minute on the other side until golden. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter.

prepare-fish-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-ek.title: Prepare the mackerel
prepare-fish-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-ek.description: Remove the head and tail from the fish. Remove the thin membrane from the body. Cut open the belly along the length, remove the innards and large bones. You should get two large fillets. Rinse them and pat dry with paper towels.

prepare-marinade-mackerel-in-lavash-bali.title: Prepare the marinade
prepare-marinade-mackerel-in-lavash-bali.description: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, and mustard. Set aside half of the marinade for later.

marinate-fish-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-e.title: Marinate the fish
marinate-fish-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-e.description: Brush the mackerel fillets with half of the marinade. Season with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme. Let the fish marinate for 10 minutes.

preheat-grill-pan-mackerel-in-lavash-bal.title: Preheat the grill pan
preheat-grill-pan-mackerel-in-lavash-bal.description: Place a grill pan over medium heat and let it get hot.

grill-fish-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-ekme.title: Grill the mackerel fillets
grill-fish-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-ekme.description: Place the marinated fillets on the hot grill pan. Cook for 3 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through.

assemble-wraps-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-.title: Assemble the wraps
assemble-wraps-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-.description: Slice the red onion into half-rings and the tomatoes into rounds. Cut the lavash sheet in half. Brush each half with the reserved marinade. Layer the tomatoes, then the onions, and finally one grilled fish fillet on each lavash half.

grill-wraps-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-ekm.title: Grill the wraps
grill-wraps-mackerel-in-lavash-balik-ekm.description: Fold the edges of the lavash inward and roll it up tightly. Place the wraps seam-side down on the grill pan. Cook over medium heat for 1–2 minutes on each side, until the lavash is lightly golden and crisp.

make-yogurt-sauce-mackerel-in-lavash-bal.title: Make the yogurt sauce
make-yogurt-sauce-mackerel-in-lavash-bal.description: Press the garlic clove through a press. Mix it with yogurt, salt, and black pepper. Serve the sauce alongside the wraps.

beat-eggs-sugar-mango-dessert.title: Beat eggs with sugar
beat-eggs-sugar-mango-dessert.description: In a bowl, beat the eggs with sugar until the mixture is fluffy and homogeneous. This should take a couple of minutes.

add-flour-mango-dessert.title: Add flour gradually
add-flour-mango-dessert.description: Gradually sift in the flour while continuing to beat the egg mixture. Ensure no dry lumps remain and the batter is runny.

bake-biscuit-mango-dessert.title: Bake the biscuit
bake-biscuit-mango-dessert.description: Pour the batter into a parchment-lined baking pan. Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for 25 minutes, or until golden and springy to the touch.

cool-biscuit-mango-dessert.title: Cool the biscuit
cool-biscuit-mango-dessert.description: Remove the biscuit from the oven and transfer it onto a wire rack along with the parchment paper. Let it cool completely.

whip-cream-sugar-mango-dessert.title: Whip cream with powdered sugar
whip-cream-sugar-mango-dessert.description: In a clean bowl, pour the heavy cream and add the powdered sugar. Whip until soft peaks form and the mixture is fluffy.

add-cream-cheese-mango-dessert.title: Add cream cheese
add-cream-cheese-mango-dessert.description: Add the cream cheese to the whipped cream and gently fold until combined. Be careful not to deflate the cream.

blend-mango-lemon-mango-dessert.title: Blend mango with lemon juice
blend-mango-lemon-mango-dessert.description: Place the mango pieces in a blender, drizzle with lemon juice, and blend until smooth puree.

assemble-dessert-mango-dessert.title: Assemble the dessert
assemble-dessert-mango-dessert.description: Cut the cooled biscuit into small cubes or break into pieces. In serving glasses, layer whipped cream, biscuit cubes, and mango puree. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Garnish with mint leaves if desired.

crack-beat-eggs-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Crack and beat eggs
crack-beat-eggs-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat with a whisk for 2-3 minutes until light foam appears on the surface.

add-mayonnaise-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Add mayonnaise
add-mayonnaise-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Add the mayonnaise to the beaten eggs and mix well with a whisk until fluffy.

add-sugar-salt-beat-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Add sugar and salt
add-sugar-salt-beat-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: While continuing to mix, add the sugar and salt. Beat for another 2-3 minutes until the crystals are fully dissolved.

add-water-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Add warm water
add-water-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Pour warm water into the egg mixture and stir.

add-flour-mix-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Add flour and mix
add-flour-mix-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Sift in the flour and whisk until the batter is smooth and free of lumps.

add-oil-mix-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Add oil and mix
add-oil-mix-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Pour in the sunflower oil and stir once more to combine.

heat-pan-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with a little oil.

cook-pancakes-mayonnaise-pancakes.title: Cook pancakes
cook-pancakes-mayonnaise-pancakes.description: Pour about half a ladle of batter into the pan and spread it into a thin, even layer. Cook for 30-40 seconds on each side until golden. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the pan as needed. Stack the pancakes and cover with a lid to keep warm.

grind-flakes-millet-oat-waffles.title: Grind the flakes
grind-flakes-millet-oat-waffles.description: Grind the wheat and oat flakes in a coffee grinder or blender until they become a fine powder.

combine-dry-millet-oat-waffles.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-millet-oat-waffles.description: In a large bowl, mix the ground flakes with whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon. Whisk to combine.

mash-banana-mix-wet-millet-oat-waffles.title: Mash banana and mix wet ingredients
mash-banana-mix-wet-millet-oat-waffles.description: Mash the banana into a puree. Add milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract. Whisk again until smooth.

combine-wet-dry-millet-oat-waffles.title: Combine wet and dry mixtures
combine-wet-dry-millet-oat-waffles.description: Pour the wet mixture into the bowl with the dry ingredients. Stir with a whisk or silicone spatula until just combined. The batter should be like liquid sour cream. If too thick, add 1 tablespoon of water and mix again.

rest-batter-millet-oat-waffles.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-millet-oat-waffles.description: Let the batter rest for 10 minutes. This allows the grains to hydrate and the batter to thicken slightly.

preheat-oven-millet-oat-waffles.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-millet-oat-waffles.description: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) while the batter rests.

pour-batter-into-forms-millet-oat-waffle.title: Pour batter into waffle forms
pour-batter-into-forms-millet-oat-waffle.description: Divide the batter into greased waffle baking forms or a waffle iron. Spread evenly.

bake-waffles-millet-oat-waffles.title: Bake the waffles
bake-waffles-millet-oat-waffles.description: Bake the waffles in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. The exact time depends on your oven and forms.

grate-carrot-millet-porridge-carrot-cake.title: Grate the carrot
grate-carrot-millet-porridge-carrot-cake.description: Grate the carrot on the large holes of a box grater. Set aside.

prep-apple-millet-porridge-carrot-cake.title: Prepare the apple
prep-apple-millet-porridge-carrot-cake.description: Core the apple, peel it, and cut the flesh into small cubes. Set aside.

combine-ingredients-millet-porridge-carr.title: Combine ingredients in a pot
combine-ingredients-millet-porridge-carr.description: Place the millet in a small heavy-bottomed saucepan. Add the grated carrot, milk, sugar, and ground spices (cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves). Stir to combine.

bring-to-boil-millet-porridge-carrot-cak.title: Bring the mixture to a boil
bring-to-boil-millet-porridge-carrot-cak.description: Set the saucepan over medium heat. Bring the mixture to a boil, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

simmer-10-min-millet-porridge-carrot-cak.title: Simmer for 10 minutes
simmer-10-min-millet-porridge-carrot-cak.description: Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and let it simmer gently for 10 minutes.

add-apple-millet-porridge-carrot-cake.title: Add the diced apple
add-apple-millet-porridge-carrot-cake.description: Uncover the pot and add the diced apple. Stir it into the porridge.

cook-until-absorbed-millet-porridge-carr.title: Cook until milk is absorbed
cook-until-absorbed-millet-porridge-carr.description: Continue cooking over low heat, uncovered, until all the milk has been absorbed by the millet. This will take about 15–20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

rest-porridge-millet-porridge-carrot-cak.title: Let the porridge rest
rest-porridge-millet-porridge-carrot-cak.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat. Cover it again and let the porridge stand for 10 minutes. This allows the flavors to meld together.

blend-batter-mini-breakfast-cake.title: Blend the batter
blend-batter-mini-breakfast-cake.description: Combine kefir, egg, oats, and a pinch of salt in a blender. Blend until smooth and homogeneous.

heat-pan-mini-breakfast-cake.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-mini-breakfast-cake.description: Place a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Lightly grease with oil if needed. Let it heat thoroughly.

cook-first-side-mini-breakfast-cake.title: Cook the first side
cook-first-side-mini-breakfast-cake.description: Pour the oat batter into the hot pan. Cover with a lid and cook over low heat for 3–4 minutes until the bottom is golden and set.

cook-second-side-mini-breakfast-cake.title: Flip and cook the second side
cook-second-side-mini-breakfast-cake.description: Carefully flip the pancake. Cook for another 3–4 minutes over low heat, uncovered or covered, until golden brown on both sides.

cut-pancake-mini-breakfast-cake.title: Cut the pancake into pieces
cut-pancake-mini-breakfast-cake.description: Transfer the cooked pancake to a cutting board. Cut it into 4 equal wedge-shaped pieces.

assemble-cake-mini-breakfast-cake.title: Assemble the cake
assemble-cake-mini-breakfast-cake.description: Spread one pancake piece with sweetened soft tvorog. Top with banana slices and chopped walnuts. Place another piece on top and repeat. Continue layering until all pieces are used, finishing with a top layer.

mix-egg-and-milk-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Mix egg and milk
mix-egg-and-milk-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: In a separate bowl, whisk the whole egg with the milk using a fork.

knead-dough-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: Add the sifted mixture of rice flour, cornmeal, and baking powder. Add the sweetener. Knead into a soft, homogeneous dough. Gather it into a ball, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 20 minutes.

chill-dough-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Chill the dough
chill-dough-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: Place the wrapped dough in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.

prepare-filling-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Prepare the filling
prepare-filling-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: Mash the cottage cheese in a bowl with a fork. Add the egg white, vanilla, and sweetener. Mix well.

roll-and-cut-dough-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Roll and cut the dough
roll-and-cut-dough-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: Take the dough out of the refrigerator. Roll it out to a thickness of 2-3 mm on a surface lightly dusted with rice flour. Use a glass to cut out circles.

assemble-and-brush-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Assemble and brush the sochniki
assemble-and-brush-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: Place 1-2 teaspoons of filling on one half of each circle and fold the other half over. Place the pastries on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with beaten egg yolk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

bake-sochniki-mini-healthy-sochniki.title: Bake the sochniki
bake-sochniki-mini-healthy-sochniki.description: Bake for 15-20 minutes until lightly golden.

strip-chop-dill-mini-turkey-cheese-sandw.title: Strip and chop the dill
strip-chop-dill-mini-turkey-cheese-sandw.description: Remove the dill leaves from the stems and chop them finely.

mix-herb-oil-mini-turkey-cheese-sandwich.title: Mix herb oil
mix-herb-oil-mini-turkey-cheese-sandwich.description: Combine the chopped dill with salt and olive oil in a small bowl. Stir well to create a flavored oil mixture.

spread-oil-mixture-mini-turkey-cheese-sa.title: Spread oil mixture on crispbread
spread-oil-mixture-mini-turkey-cheese-sa.description: Brush or spread the herb oil mixture evenly over the surface of the crispbread.

place-cheese-mini-turkey-cheese-sandwich.title: Place cheese slice
place-cheese-mini-turkey-cheese-sandwich.description: Lay a thin slice of cheese on top of the oiled crispbread.

layer-toppings-mini-turkey-cheese-sandwi.title: Layer the toppings
layer-toppings-mini-turkey-cheese-sandwi.description: Place a lettuce leaf on the cheese, then add slices of boiled turkey and tomato on top.

prep-ingredients-mozzarella-and-ham-tria.title: Trim crusts and slice cheese and ham
prep-ingredients-mozzarella-and-ham-tria.description: Cut the crusts off the bread slices. Slice the mozzarella and ham into 3-4 mm thick slices.

assemble-sandwiches-mozzarella-and-ham-t.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-mozzarella-and-ham-t.description: Place half of the mozzarella slices on 4 bread slices. Evenly distribute the ham slices on top. Cover with the remaining mozzarella, then top with the remaining 4 bread slices.

prepare-coating-mozzarella-and-ham-trian.title: Prepare the coating station
prepare-coating-mozzarella-and-ham-trian.description: In a bowl, crack the eggs, add salt and pepper, and whisk until combined. Pour the milk into a separate bowl. Place the flour in another bowl.

coat-sandwiches-mozzarella-and-ham-trian.title: Coat the sandwiches
coat-sandwiches-mozzarella-and-ham-trian.description: One by one, dip each assembled sandwich completely in milk, then coat in flour, and finally dip in the egg mixture, ensuring even coverage.

heat-oil-mozzarella-and-ham-triangles.title: Heat the oil
heat-oil-mozzarella-and-ham-triangles.description: Pour the vegetable oil into a frying pan and heat it over medium heat until hot.

fry-sandwiches-mozzarella-and-ham-triang.title: Fry the sandwiches
fry-sandwiches-mozzarella-and-ham-triang.description: Place the coated sandwiches in the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted.

chop-vegetables-mushroom-cream-cheese-en.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-mushroom-cream-cheese-en.description: Cut the onion into small cubes, about 3–4 mm. Chop the mushrooms into slightly larger cubes.

fry-onion-mushroom-cream-cheese-envelope.title: Fry the onion
fry-onion-mushroom-cream-cheese-envelope.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the onion, stirring occasionally, for 2–3 minutes until golden brown.

fry-mushrooms-mushroom-cream-cheese-enve.title: Fry the mushrooms
fry-mushrooms-mushroom-cream-cheese-enve.description: Add the chopped mushrooms to the pan with the onion. Cook together, stirring, for 3–4 minutes until the liquid evaporates and the mushrooms are lightly browned. Season with salt and pepper, stir, and remove from heat.

assemble-envelopes-mushroom-cream-cheese.title: Assemble the envelopes
assemble-envelopes-mushroom-cream-cheese.description: Cut each lavash into 3 long strips. Spread cream cheese evenly over each strip. Place about 2 teaspoons of the mushroom filling in the center of each strip, then fold into triangular envelopes.

beat-eggs-mushroom-cream-cheese-envelope.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-mushroom-cream-cheese-envelope.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them with a fork until smooth.

fry-envelopes-mushroom-cream-cheese-enve.title: Fry the envelopes
fry-envelopes-mushroom-cream-cheese-enve.description: Add another tablespoon of oil to the pan and heat over medium heat. Dip each assembled envelope into the beaten egg, then fry for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown.

press-garlic-new-year-chicken.title: Press the garlic
press-garlic-new-year-chicken.description: Press the garlic clove through a garlic press or mince it finely with a knife.

mix-marinade-new-year-chicken.title: Mix the marinade
mix-marinade-new-year-chicken.description: In a bowl, combine the vegetable oil, pressed garlic, salt, black pepper, and Dijon mustard. Stir until well blended.

marinate-chicken-new-year-chicken.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-new-year-chicken.description: Brush the marinade all over the chicken, covering every side. Let it rest at room temperature for 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.

preheat-oven-new-year-chicken.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-new-year-chicken.description: Preheat your oven to 220°C (430°F). This ensures the chicken starts cooking immediately when placed inside.

transfer-chicken-new-year-chicken.title: Transfer to baking dish
transfer-chicken-new-year-chicken.description: Place the marinated chicken into a baking dish suitable for oven use.

bake-high-new-year-chicken.title: Bake at high temperature
bake-high-new-year-chicken.description: Put the dish in the oven and bake at 220°C for 20 minutes. This high heat will give the skin a nice golden color.

bake-low-new-year-chicken.title: Reduce heat and continue baking
bake-low-new-year-chicken.description: Lower the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and bake for another 45 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.

serve-chicken-new-year-chicken.title: Serve the chicken
serve-chicken-new-year-chicken.description: Arrange lettuce leaves on a plate, slice the orange into thin rounds, and place the baked chicken on top. Garnish with the orange slices if desired.

grind-oats-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.title: Grind the oats
grind-oats-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.description: Place 150 g of oats into a mixer bowl and grind until fine. Transfer to a separate bowl.

combine-dry-ingredients-oat-bars-strawbe.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-ingredients-oat-bars-strawbe.description: In a bowl, mix the ground oats with whole wheat flour, sugar, and salt.

cut-butter-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.title: Cut the butter
cut-butter-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.description: Cut the cold butter into small cubes.

rub-butter-into-dry-ingredients-oat-bars.title: Rub butter into dry mix
rub-butter-into-dry-ingredients-oat-bars.description: Add the butter cubes to the dry ingredients and use your fingers to rub them in until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

add-vanilla-and-remaining-oats-oat-bars-.title: Add vanilla and remaining oats
add-vanilla-and-remaining-oats-oat-bars-.description: Pour in the vanilla extract and add the remaining oats. Stir everything together thoroughly.

press-half-crumb-into-dish-oat-bars-stra.title: Press half the crumb into dish
press-half-crumb-into-dish-oat-bars-stra.description: Transfer half of the oat mixture into a baking dish. Press it down firmly with your hands or a glass to form a compact, even base.

spread-jam-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.title: Spread the jam
spread-jam-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.description: Spread the strawberry jam evenly over the pressed base using a spoon.

top-with-remaining-crumb-oat-bars-strawb.title: Top with remaining crumb
top-with-remaining-crumb-oat-bars-strawb.description: Sprinkle the remaining oat mixture over the jam layer and gently press it down to compact.

bake-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.title: Bake
bake-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.description: Place the dish in an oven preheated to 180°C and bake for 50 minutes until golden brown.

cool-in-pan-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.title: Cool in pan
cool-in-pan-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.description: Let the baked bars cool completely in the pan on a wire rack.

remove-and-cut-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.title: Remove and cut
remove-and-cut-oat-bars-strawberry-jam.description: Carefully remove the cooled bars from the pan and cut into squares.

grind-oats-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.title: Grind the oats
grind-oats-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.description: Place the oat flakes into a blender and grind for 2–3 minutes until you get a fine flour.

beat-eggs-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.title: Beat the eggs with sugar and salt
beat-eggs-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add sugar, salt, and baking powder. Beat with a mixer on medium speed until fluffy and homogeneous.

mix-batter-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.title: Add milk, oat flour, and cinnamon
mix-batter-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.description: While mixing on low speed, pour in the milk, then add the ground oats and cinnamon. Mix until smooth. Finally add the sunflower oil and stir briefly.

heat-pan-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.title: Heat the frying pan with oil
heat-pan-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.description: Heat a frying pan with sunflower oil over medium heat. Pour the batter by tablespoonfuls to form round pancakes about 7–9 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick.

fry-pancakes-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-oat-pancakes-with-cinnamon.description: Reduce the heat to low. Fry the pancakes for 1–2 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface, then flip and fry for another 1–2 minutes until golden brown. Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.

soak-oats-oatmeal-broccoli-fritters.title: Soak the oats
soak-oats-oatmeal-broccoli-fritters.description: Place the rolled oats in a small bowl and pour boiling water over them until they are covered by about 1 cm. Let them soak for 30–40 minutes until softened and cooled.

thaw-and-boil-broccoli-oatmeal-broccoli-.title: Thaw and boil the broccoli
thaw-and-boil-broccoli-oatmeal-broccoli-.description: Pour hot water over the broccoli and let it sit for 3 minutes to thaw. Then transfer to a small pot, add water and salt, and boil for 5 minutes.

drain-chop-blend-oatmeal-broccoli-fritte.title: Drain, chop and blend
drain-chop-blend-oatmeal-broccoli-fritte.description: Drain the broccoli in a colander and let it cool. Peel and roughly chop the onion. Transfer the broccoli and onion to a blender and pulse until finely chopped into a vegetable crumb.

combine-and-mix-oatmeal-broccoli-fritter.title: Combine and mix
combine-and-mix-oatmeal-broccoli-fritter.description: Add the soaked oats to the broccoli-onion mixture, crack in the egg, crumble the brynza cheese with your hands, and season with salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly.

fry-fritters-oatmeal-broccoli-fritters.title: Fry the fritters
fry-fritters-oatmeal-broccoli-fritters.description: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the pan, shaping them into small fritters. Fry for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.

grind-oats-oatmeal-waffles.title: Grind the oats
grind-oats-oatmeal-waffles.description: Place the oatmeal flakes in a blender and grind them into flour, or leave some small pieces for texture, as you prefer.

mix-dry-ingredients-oatmeal-waffles.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-oatmeal-waffles.description: Transfer the ground oats to a bowl. Add baking powder and salt, then stir to combine.

add-wet-ingredients-oatmeal-waffles.title: Add wet ingredients
add-wet-ingredients-oatmeal-waffles.description: Pour in 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil, the milk, and the honey. Mix everything thoroughly.

separate-eggs-add-yolks-oatmeal-waffles.title: Separate eggs and add yolks
separate-eggs-add-yolks-oatmeal-waffles.description: Separate the egg yolks from the whites. Add the yolks to the batter and mix well.

whip-egg-whites-oatmeal-waffles.title: Whip the egg whites
whip-egg-whites-oatmeal-waffles.description: In a separate clean, dry bowl, whip the egg whites with a mixer until stiff peaks form.

fold-egg-whites-oatmeal-waffles.title: Fold in the egg whites
fold-egg-whites-oatmeal-waffles.description: Gradually add the whipped egg whites to the batter in small portions, gently folding with a motion from bottom to top until combined.

preheat-waffle-iron-oatmeal-waffles.title: Preheat the waffle iron
preheat-waffle-iron-oatmeal-waffles.description: Preheat your electric waffle iron and lightly grease the surface with the remaining oil.

cook-waffles-oatmeal-waffles.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-oatmeal-waffles.description: Spoon some batter onto the preheated waffle iron, close the lid, and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

cut-pear-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.title: Cut the pear
cut-pear-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.description: Cut the pear in half lengthwise and remove the core.

season-pear-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.title: Season the pear
season-pear-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.description: Place the pear halves cut-side up in a parchment-lined baking dish. Drizzle with lemon juice and honey, sprinkle with cinnamon, and top each half with a small piece of butter.

bake-pear-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.title: Bake the pear
bake-pear-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.description: Bake the pear for 20 minutes, basting occasionally with the accumulated juices.

cook-oatmeal-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.title: Cook the oatmeal
cook-oatmeal-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.description: In a saucepan, combine the oats, almond milk, water, and vanilla essence. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes, until the oatmeal is thick and creamy.

assemble-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.title: Assemble and serve
assemble-oatmeal-with-baked-pear.description: Transfer the oatmeal to a serving bowl and arrange the baked pear halves on top.

add-oats-and-milk-oatmeal-with-cashew-bu.title: Add oats and milk to pot
add-oats-and-milk-oatmeal-with-cashew-bu.description: Pour the oat flakes into a saucepan and add the nut milk. No heat yet.

bring-to-boil-oatmeal-with-cashew-butter.title: Bring to a boil
bring-to-boil-oatmeal-with-cashew-butter.description: Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the mixture to a boil.

simmer-oats-oatmeal-with-cashew-butter-a.title: Simmer the oats
simmer-oats-oatmeal-with-cashew-butter-a.description: Reduce the heat to low and cook the oatmeal for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.

peel-and-grate-apple-oatmeal-with-cashew.title: Peel and grate the apple
peel-and-grate-apple-oatmeal-with-cashew.description: While the oats cook, peel the apple and finely grate the flesh.

add-remaining-ingredients-oatmeal-with-c.title: Add apple, raisins, cinnamon, and cashew butter
add-remaining-ingredients-oatmeal-with-c.description: Add the grated apple, raisins, ground cinnamon, and cashew butter to the pot. Stir to combine.

heat-mixture-oatmeal-with-cashew-butter-.title: Heat the mixture
heat-mixture-oatmeal-with-cashew-butter-.description: Continue cooking over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring gently, until everything is warmed through and well blended.

cook-oats-oatmeal-with-ginger-pear-and-h.title: Cook the oatmeal
cook-oats-oatmeal-with-ginger-pear-and-h.description: Place the oats into a small saucepan, add a pinch of salt, and pour in the water. Set over medium heat and cook for about 10 minutes, until the oats have absorbed the liquid.

caramelize-pear-oatmeal-with-ginger-pear.title: Caramelize the pear
caramelize-pear-oatmeal-with-ginger-pear.description: Slice the pear into thin wedges. Fry the slices in a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat for 3–5 minutes, until they are lightly caramelized.

add-ginger-and-serve-oatmeal-with-ginger.title: Add ginger and serve
add-ginger-and-serve-oatmeal-with-ginger.description: Stir the ground ginger into the cooked oatmeal. Transfer to a bowl, top with the caramelized pear slices, pumpkin seeds, and drizzle with honey.

prep-vegetables-okonomiyaki.title: Grate and shred the vegetables
prep-vegetables-okonomiyaki.description: Finely grate the potato and carrot into a bowl. Shred the cabbage, bell pepper, and pickled ginger, and add them to the same bowl.

make-batter-okonomiyaki.title: Mix the batter
make-batter-okonomiyaki.description: Crack the eggs into the bowl with the vegetables, add soy sauce, and mix well. Gradually add the flour while stirring continuously until a thick batter forms.

cook-first-side-first-patty-okonomiyaki.title: Cook the first patty, first side
cook-first-side-first-patty-okonomiyaki.description: Grease a frying pan with sunflower oil and heat over medium heat. Form half of the batter into a flat, round patty about 1 cm thick and 12–15 cm in diameter. Place it in the pan, cover with a lid, and cook for 12–15 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy.

cook-second-side-first-patty-okonomiyaki.title: Flip and cook the first patty, second side
cook-second-side-first-patty-okonomiyaki.description: Flip the patty carefully, cover again, and cook for another 10–12 minutes. Transfer the cooked patty to a plate.

cook-first-side-second-patty-okonomiyaki.title: Cook the second patty, first side
cook-first-side-second-patty-okonomiyaki.description: Using the remaining batter, form another patty of the same size. Place it in the hot pan, cover, and cook for 12–15 minutes on the first side.

cook-second-side-second-patty-okonomiyak.title: Flip and cook the second patty, second side
cook-second-side-second-patty-okonomiyak.description: Flip the second patty, cover, and cook for 10–12 minutes. Remove to the plate and serve.

beat-eggs-omelette-with-potatoes-and-che.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-omelette-with-potatoes-and-che.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add salt and black pepper. Whisk until smooth and homogeneous.

grate-cheese-omelette-with-potatoes-and-.title: Grate and mix cheese
grate-cheese-omelette-with-potatoes-and-.description: Finely grate the Gouda cheese. Stir it into the beaten egg mixture until well combined.

chop-vegetables-omelette-with-potatoes-a.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-omelette-with-potatoes-a.description: Cut the potatoes into thin, almost translucent slices. Dice the onion into small cubes. Finely chop the green onion stalks.

fry-onion-omelette-with-potatoes-and-che.title: Fry the onion
fry-onion-omelette-with-potatoes-and-che.description: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and sauté, stirring, until golden brown, about 1 minute.

fry-potatoes-omelette-with-potatoes-and-.title: Fry the potatoes
fry-potatoes-omelette-with-potatoes-and-.description: Add the potato slices to the pan with the onion. Continue frying for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are golden and tender.

combine-mixture-omelette-with-potatoes-a.title: Combine vegetables with egg mixture
combine-mixture-omelette-with-potatoes-a.description: Drain excess oil from the pan. Transfer the fried vegetables to the bowl with the egg and cheese mixture. Add the chopped green onion and stir well to combine.

cook-omelette-covered-omelette-with-pota.title: Cook the omelette covered
cook-omelette-covered-omelette-with-pota.description: Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the pan over medium heat. Pour in the egg‑vegetable mixture and spread it evenly. Cover the pan and cook until the omelette is set, 3–4 minutes.

flip-and-cook-other-side-omelette-with-p.title: Flip and finish cooking
flip-and-cook-other-side-omelette-with-p.description: Remove the lid. Place a large plate over the pan and carefully flip the omelette onto the plate. Slide the omelette back into the pan with the cooked side up. Fry until the other side is golden brown, about 3 minutes.

preheat-oven-orange-juice-muffins.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-orange-juice-muffins.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. While it heats, prepare the muffin tin.

line-muffin-tin-orange-juice-muffins.title: Line the muffin tin
line-muffin-tin-orange-juice-muffins.description: Place paper liners in the wells of a muffin tin.

squeeze-orange-orange-juice-muffins.title: Squeeze orange and grate zest
squeeze-orange-orange-juice-muffins.description: Squeeze the juice from the orange and grate the zest. Set aside.

mix-wet-ingredients-orange-juice-muffins.title: Mix wet ingredients
mix-wet-ingredients-orange-juice-muffins.description: In a bowl, crack the egg. Add the orange juice, vegetable oil, and yogurt. Beat with a mixer on medium speed until smooth.

combine-dry-and-wet-orange-juice-muffins.title: Combine dry and wet ingredients
combine-dry-and-wet-orange-juice-muffins.description: In a separate bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, cornstarch, and vanilla. Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture, stirring until no lumps remain.

fill-forms-orange-juice-muffins.title: Fill the forms
fill-forms-orange-juice-muffins.description: Divide the batter evenly among the paper liners.

bake-muffins-orange-juice-muffins.title: Bake the muffins
bake-muffins-orange-juice-muffins.description: Bake the muffins for 20 minutes at 180°C, until a toothpick comes out clean.

cool-and-transfer-orange-juice-muffins.title: Cool and transfer
cool-and-transfer-orange-juice-muffins.description: Let the muffins cool slightly in the pan, then transfer to a serving plate.

cream-butter-and-condensed-milk-orange-j.title: Cream butter and condensed milk
cream-butter-and-condensed-milk-orange-j.description: In a clean bowl, beat the softened butter on medium speed for 2-3 minutes until creamy. Add the condensed milk and beat again until well combined.

add-cream-cheese-and-zest-orange-juice-m.title: Add cream cheese and zest
add-cream-cheese-and-zest-orange-juice-m.description: Add the cream cheese and beat on low speed until incorporated. Fold in the orange zest gently with a spatula.

pipe-cream-orange-juice-muffins.title: Pipe cream onto muffins
pipe-cream-orange-juice-muffins.description: Transfer the cream to a piping bag and pipe onto the cooled muffins.

mix-filling-orange-sochniki.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-orange-sochniki.description: In a bowl, combine tvorog, sugar, sour cream, orange zest, and one egg yolk. Stir until smooth and homogeneous.

cream-butter-and-sugar-orange-sochniki.title: Cream butter and powdered sugar
cream-butter-and-sugar-orange-sochniki.description: In another bowl, rub the softened butter with the powdered sugar until light and fluffy.

add-egg-orange-sochniki.title: Add the egg
add-egg-orange-sochniki.description: Add the whole egg to the butter mixture and mix well.

add-dry-ingredients-orange-sochniki.title: Add dry ingredients
add-dry-ingredients-orange-sochniki.description: Sift together the flour and baking powder, then add to the butter mixture along with a pinch of salt. Mix briefly.

knead-dough-orange-sochniki.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-orange-sochniki.description: Knead the mixture until a smooth, uniform dough forms. Do not overwork it.

divide-dough-orange-sochniki.title: Divide the dough
divide-dough-orange-sochniki.description: Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.

roll-fill-and-shape-pastries-orange-soch.title: Roll, fill, and shape the pastries
roll-fill-and-shape-pastries-orange-soch.description: On a lightly floured surface, roll each dough ball into a circle about 3–4 mm thick. Place one-eighth of the filling on one half of the circle, then fold the other half over to form a half‑moon. Press the edges to seal. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Transfer the shaped pastries to a parchment‑lined baking tray.

make-egg-wash-and-brush-orange-sochniki.title: Make egg wash and brush the pastries
make-egg-wash-and-brush-orange-sochniki.description: Whisk the remaining egg yolk with the water. Using a pastry brush, lightly coat the tops of the pastries with the egg wash.

bake-sochniki-orange-sochniki.title: Bake the sochniki
bake-sochniki-orange-sochniki.description: Bake the pastries in the preheated oven for 20–25 minutes until golden brown. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

sauté-garlic-add-chicken-orzo-pasta-chic.title: Sauté garlic and add chicken
sauté-garlic-add-chicken-orzo-pasta-chic.description: Heat sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, then add the chicken pieces.

fry-chicken-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sa.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sa.description: Cook the chicken until golden brown and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Adjust heat as needed to avoid burning.

transfer-chicken-orzo-pasta-chicken-crea.title: Transfer the chicken to a plate
transfer-chicken-orzo-pasta-chicken-crea.description: Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and set it aside on a plate.

add-pasta-water-orzo-pasta-chicken-cream.title: Add pasta and water
add-pasta-water-orzo-pasta-chicken-cream.description: Place the orzo pasta into the same pan and pour in about 65 ml of water. Stir to combine.

return-chicken-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy.title: Return the chicken to the pan
return-chicken-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy.description: Add the cooked chicken back into the pan with the pasta and water.

add-cream-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sauc.title: Pour in the cream
add-cream-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sauc.description: Add the light cream to the pan and stir to incorporate.

add-spices-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sau.title: Add spices
add-spices-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sau.description: Season with your choice of spices to taste, such as salt, pepper, or Italian herbs.

add-cheese-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sau.title: Sprinkle cheese
add-cheese-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-sau.description: Grate or sprinkle the cheese over the mixture.

simmer-sauce-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-s.title: Simmer until thickened
simmer-sauce-orzo-pasta-chicken-creamy-s.description: Lower the heat and let the sauce simmer gently until it thickens and the pasta is tender, about 22 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.

combine-dry-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.description: In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, lemon zest, and orange zest. Stir well to combine.

add-wet-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.title: Add wet ingredients
add-wet-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.description: Pour oat milk into the dry mixture. Add nut paste and maple syrup. Stir until everything is evenly combined and smooth.

chop-nuts-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.title: Chop nuts
chop-nuts-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.description: Using a knife or rolling pin, coarsely chop the pistachios and walnuts. Set aside.

assemble-layers-overnight-oatmeal-pistac.title: Assemble layers
assemble-layers-overnight-oatmeal-pistac.description: Divide half of the oatmeal mixture into jars. Sprinkle half of the chopped nuts over the mixture. Top with the remaining oatmeal mixture and then with the rest of the nuts.

refrigerate-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.title: Refrigerate overnight
refrigerate-overnight-oatmeal-pistachios.description: Seal the jars and place them in the refrigerator. Let them chill for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight, until the oats are soft and the flavors meld.

boil-chicken-paella-with-chicken.title: Boil the chicken
boil-chicken-paella-with-chicken.description: Place the chicken in a pot, cover with salted water, and bring to a boil. Simmer until fully cooked, about 30 minutes, to create a flavorful broth.

remove-boiled-chicken-paella-with-chicke.title: Remove the chicken
remove-boiled-chicken-paella-with-chicke.description: Take the cooked chicken out of the broth and set aside. If needed, remove the meat from the bones and discard bones.

fry-chicken-paella-with-chicken.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-paella-with-chicken.description: In a large frying pan over medium-high heat, heat a little olive oil. Fry the boiled chicken pieces until golden brown on all sides.

remove-fried-chicken-paella-with-chicken.title: Remove the fried chicken
remove-fried-chicken-paella-with-chicken.description: Transfer the golden chicken pieces to a separate bowl and set aside.

saute-vegetables-paella-with-chicken.title: Sauté the vegetables
saute-vegetables-paella-with-chicken.description: In the same pan, add a bit more oil if needed. Sauté the diced tomatoes, bell pepper, chopped garlic, onion, and paprika for 4-5 minutes until softened. Season with salt and pepper.

add-rice-paella-with-chicken.title: Add the rice
add-rice-paella-with-chicken.description: Stir the rice into the vegetable mixture. Cook over medium heat for 3-5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice grains are lightly toasted.

add-broth-and-simmer-paella-with-chicken.title: Add broth and simmer
add-broth-and-simmer-paella-with-chicken.description: Return the chicken to the pan. Pour in the chicken broth until the rice is just covered. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 10-15 minutes, until the rice is almost tender.

add-wine-and-simmer-paella-with-chicken.title: Add wine and simmer until evaporated
