add-wine-and-simmer-paella-with-chicken.description: Pour the white wine over the rice and continue to simmer until the liquid is fully absorbed and the rice is cooked through.

add-peas-paella-with-chicken.title: Add peas and serve
add-peas-paella-with-chicken.description: Fold in the green peas, heat for a minute, then remove from heat. Serve the paella warm, garnished with lemon wedges, parsley, or dill if desired.

fry-seafood-paella-with-seafood-and-chic.title: Fry the seafood
fry-seafood-paella-with-seafood-and-chic.description: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet. Add the frozen seafood mixture and fry until the excess liquid evaporates, about 5 minutes.

add-wine-simmer-seafood-paella-with-seaf.title: Add white wine and simmer
add-wine-simmer-seafood-paella-with-seaf.description: Pour the white wine over the seafood. Simmer until the wine has completely evaporated.

fry-chicken-paella-with-seafood-and-chic.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-paella-with-seafood-and-chic.description: In a separate skillet, heat oil and fry the chicken fillet until golden brown. Season with salt.

transfer-chicken-paella-with-seafood-and.title: Transfer the chicken
transfer-chicken-paella-with-seafood-and.description: Remove the chicken from the skillet and set it aside on a plate.

fry-onion-garlic-paella-with-seafood-and.title: Fry onion and garlic
fry-onion-garlic-paella-with-seafood-and.description: In the same skillet, fry the chopped onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

fry-vegetables-paella-with-seafood-and-c.title: Fry the vegetables
fry-vegetables-paella-with-seafood-and-c.description: Add the diced bell pepper and tomatoes to the skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 7–10 minutes until softened.

add-rice-paella-with-seafood-and-chicken.title: Add rice and fry
add-rice-paella-with-seafood-and-chicken.description: Add the round-grain rice to the vegetables. Stir well and continue frying for 2–3 minutes to coat the rice with oil.

add-proteins-paella-with-seafood-and-chi.title: Add the chicken and seafood
add-proteins-paella-with-seafood-and-chi.description: Return the cooked chicken and seafood to the skillet, distributing them evenly among the rice.

add-water-season-paella-with-seafood-and.title: Add water and season
add-water-season-paella-with-seafood-and.description: Pour the water into the skillet. Season with salt, black pepper, and saffron. Stir gently to combine.

simmer-paella-with-seafood-and-chicken.title: Simmer until rice is tender
simmer-paella-with-seafood-and-chicken.description: Reduce the heat to medium and simmer the paella uncovered for 15–20 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed. Do not stir during cooking.

melt-butter-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.description: Melt the butter for the dough in a microwave or bain-marie. If using microwave, heat in 15-20 second bursts, stirring after each, until fully melted.

mix-dry-wet-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.title: Mix dry and wet ingredients
mix-dry-wet-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.description: In a bowl, combine sifted wheat and buckwheat flour with a pinch of salt. Make a well in the center, crack in the eggs and pour in slightly warm milk. Whisk until smooth.

add-beer-pancake-boats-caramelized-pear.title: Add beer and adjust consistency
add-beer-pancake-boats-caramelized-pear.description: Pour in the light beer and whisk the batter. Adjust the consistency with a little extra liquid if needed — it should be like thin sour cream.

add-butter-dough-pancake-boats-carameliz.title: Add melted butter
add-butter-dough-pancake-boats-carameliz.description: Add the cooled melted butter to the batter and stir until incorporated.

rest-batter-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.description: Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and let the batter rest at room temperature for 1 hour. This allows the flours to hydrate and the gluten to relax.

peel-dice-pears-pancake-boats-caramelize.title: Peel and dice pears
peel-dice-pears-pancake-boats-caramelize.description: Peel the pears, remove the cores, and cut the flesh into small cubes about 1-1.5 cm in size.

saute-pears-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.title: Sauté pears in butter
saute-pears-pancake-boats-caramelized-pe.description: In a saucepan, melt the remaining butter over medium heat. Add the diced pears and sauté for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

caramelize-pears-pancake-boats-carameliz.title: Caramelize pears with sugar and cinnamon
caramelize-pears-pancake-boats-carameliz.description: Sprinkle the cane sugar and ground cinnamon over the pears. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring, until the sugar dissolves and a caramel forms.

add-lemon-zest-pancake-boats-caramelized.title: Add lemon juice and zest
add-lemon-zest-pancake-boats-caramelized.description: Pour in the lemon juice, add the lemon zest, stir once, and remove the pan from the heat.

cool-filling-pancake-boats-caramelized-p.title: Cool the filling completely
cool-filling-pancake-boats-caramelized-p.description: Let the pear filling cool entirely to room temperature before using. This prevents the pancakes from getting soggy.

fry-pancakes-pancake-boats-caramelized-p.title: Fry thin pancakes
fry-pancakes-pancake-boats-caramelized-p.description: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease with vegetable oil. Pour a thin layer of batter and cook small pancakes about 10-12 cm in diameter until golden on both sides.

fill-pancakes-pancake-boats-caramelized-.title: Fill pancakes with pear mixture
fill-pancakes-pancake-boats-caramelized-.description: Place 1.5-2 tablespoons of cooled pear filling on half of each pancake. Fold the other half over to form a half-moon shape.

skewer-pancakes-pancake-boats-caramelize.title: Skewer to create boat shape
skewer-pancakes-pancake-boats-caramelize.description: Insert a skewer about 0.5 cm from the curved edge of the folded pancake, threading it in an accordion pattern to secure and lift the edge, creating a boat shape. Repeat with the remaining pancakes.

whisk-egg-sugar-salt-milk-pancake-casser.title: Whisk egg with sugar, salt, and milk
whisk-egg-sugar-salt-milk-pancake-casser.description: In a bowl, beat the egg with the sugar and salt until smooth. Add the milk and mix well.

mix-dry-wet-pancake-casserole.title: Mix dry ingredients into batter
mix-dry-wet-pancake-casserole.description: Combine the flour with the baking powder. Gradually add the dry mixture to the egg-milk mixture, stirring vigorously to break up any lumps.

add-berries-batter-pancake-casserole.title: Fold in berries
add-berries-batter-pancake-casserole.description: Add the berries to the batter and fold gently until evenly distributed.

fry-pancakes-pancake-casserole.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-pancake-casserole.description: Heat a frying pan with oil over medium heat. Fry the pancakes until golden brown on both sides, about 1-2 minutes per side. Make small pancakes, about 13-15 cm in diameter. You should get about 4 pancakes per serving.

assemble-pancakes-pan-pancake-casserole.title: Arrange pancakes in baking dish
assemble-pancakes-pan-pancake-casserole.description: Line a baking dish with parchment or grease with oil. Cut each pancake in half to form semicircles. Arrange them tightly in the dish, cut side down, with the rounded edges facing up.

mix-custard-pancake-casserole.title: Prepare the custard
mix-custard-pancake-casserole.description: In a clean bowl, combine the cream, remaining eggs, brown sugar, vanilla extract, salt, and cinnamon. Whisk with a mixer until smooth.

pour-custard-and-chill-pancake-casserole.title: Pour custard and refrigerate
pour-custard-and-chill-pancake-casserole.description: Pour the custard mixture over the arranged pancakes. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

bake-casserole-pancake-casserole.title: Bake the casserole
bake-casserole-pancake-casserole.description: Remove the dish from the fridge, take off the plastic wrap, and place in the preheated oven. Bake for 45 minutes until the top is golden and the custard is set.

cool-casserole-pancake-casserole.title: Let cool
cool-casserole-pancake-casserole.description: Remove from the oven and let the casserole cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

heat-milk-and-beat-eggs-pancake-cheburek.title: Heat the milk and beat the eggs
heat-milk-and-beat-eggs-pancake-cheburek.description: Pour the milk into a microwave-safe bowl and heat for 1-2 minutes until warm but not hot. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with a fork until smooth.

mix-dry-ingredients-pancake-chebureki.title: Mix the dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-pancake-chebureki.description: In a large bowl, combine the sifted flour, yeast, sugar, and salt. Stir to combine.

add-wet-and-mix-batter-pancake-chebureki.title: Add wet ingredients and mix the batter
add-wet-and-mix-batter-pancake-chebureki.description: Pour the warm milk and beaten eggs into the dry mixture. Mix until a smooth, thin pancake batter forms.

add-oil-and-mix-pancake-chebureki.title: Add oil and mix again
add-oil-and-mix-pancake-chebureki.description: Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the batter and mix well.

let-dough-rise-pancake-chebureki.title: Let the dough rise
let-dough-rise-pancake-chebureki.description: Cover the bowl with a clean kitchen towel and leave it in a warm place for 1 hour until the batter becomes bubbly and slightly thickened.

chop-vegetables-pancake-chebureki.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-pancake-chebureki.description: Shred the cabbage into 4-5 mm strips. Coarsely grate the carrot. Dice the onion into 3-4 mm cubes.

saute-onion-pancake-chebureki.title: Sauté the onion
saute-onion-pancake-chebureki.description: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until golden.

cook-cabbage-and-carrots-pancake-chebure.title: Cook the cabbage and carrots
cook-cabbage-and-carrots-pancake-chebure.description: Add the grated carrot and shredded cabbage to the skillet. Sprinkle with 2 g of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-6 minutes until the vegetables are soft.

add-mince-and-cook-pancake-chebureki.title: Add the minced meat and cook
add-mince-and-cook-pancake-chebureki.description: Add the ground beef to the skillet. Season with black pepper and the remaining salt. Cook, breaking up any clumps, for 7-8 minutes until the meat is fully cooked. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

cool-filling-pancake-chebureki.title: Cool the filling
cool-filling-pancake-chebureki.description: Take the skillet off the heat and let the filling cool down a bit before assembling the chebureki.

grease-and-heat-pan-pancake-chebureki.title: Grease and heat the pancake pan
grease-and-heat-pan-pancake-chebureki.description: Brush a thin layer of vegetable oil onto a flat pancake pan and heat it over medium heat.

pour-and-cook-pancake-base-pancake-chebu.title: Pour and cook the pancake base
pour-and-cook-pancake-base-pancake-chebu.description: Fill a ladle halfway with the risen batter and pour it into the pan. Swirl to spread evenly. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the surface sets.

add-filling-and-fold-pancake-chebureki.title: Add the filling and fold
add-filling-and-fold-pancake-chebureki.description: Visually divide the pancake in half. Place 2-3 tablespoons of meat filling on one half and spread slightly. Fold the other half over to form a half-moon shape.

fry-first-side-pancake-chebureki.title: Fry the first side
fry-first-side-pancake-chebureki.description: Fry the cheburek for 1-2 minutes until the bottom is golden brown, then flip.

fry-second-side-pancake-chebureki.title: Fry the second side
fry-second-side-pancake-chebureki.description: Fry the other side for another 1-2 minutes until golden and crispy. Transfer to a plate.

repeat-for-remaining-chebureki-pancake-c.title: Repeat for all chebureki
repeat-for-remaining-chebureki-pancake-c.description: Repeat the cooking process with the remaining batter and filling to make all the chebureki. Serve hot.

whisk-eggs-sugar-salt-pancakes-with-appl.title: Whisk eggs with salt and sugar
whisk-eggs-sugar-salt-pancakes-with-appl.description: Break the eggs into a deep bowl, add salt and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Whisk with a hand whisk until light foam and sugar dissolve.

heat-milk-pancakes-with-apples-and-nuts.title: Heat the milk
heat-milk-pancakes-with-apples-and-nuts.description: Heat the milk to 40°C, which is just above body temperature. Do not boil.

combine-milk-eggs-pancakes-with-apples-a.title: Add milk to eggs
combine-milk-eggs-pancakes-with-apples-a.description: Pour the warm milk into the egg mixture and whisk again until combined.

sift-flour-soda-pancakes-with-apples-and.title: Sift dry ingredients into batter
sift-flour-soda-pancakes-with-apples-and.description: Sift the flour and baking soda through a sieve into the liquid ingredients. Mix until smooth and no lumps remain.

add-oil-batter-pancakes-with-apples-and-.title: Add oil to the batter
add-oil-batter-pancakes-with-apples-and-.description: Pour the vegetable oil into the batter and mix well until incorporated.

rest-batter-pancakes-with-apples-and-nut.title: Let the batter rest
rest-batter-pancakes-with-apples-and-nut.description: Set the batter aside for 20 minutes. This allows the gluten to swell so the pancakes won't tear when flipped.

peel-chop-apples-pancakes-with-apples-an.title: Peel and dice apples
peel-chop-apples-pancakes-with-apples-an.description: Peel the apples, remove the core, and cut them into small cubes.

melt-sugar-caramel-pancakes-with-apples-.title: Melt sugar into caramel
melt-sugar-caramel-pancakes-with-apples-.description: Pour the remaining sugar into a dry small saucepan with a thick bottom. Heat over medium heat until the sugar melts and turns into a golden caramel.

make-apple-caramel-pancakes-with-apples-.title: Cook apples in caramel sauce
make-apple-caramel-pancakes-with-apples-.description: Add the heavy cream and butter to the caramel and stir. Then add the diced apples and cook for 5 minutes, stirring gently, until the apples are coated and softened.

add-walnuts-pancakes-with-apples-and-nut.title: Add chopped walnuts
add-walnuts-pancakes-with-apples-and-nut.description: Chop the walnuts and add them to the apple caramel. Stir to combine.

cook-pancakes-pancakes-with-apples-and-n.title: Cook all pancakes
cook-pancakes-pancakes-with-apples-and-n.description: Heat a pancake pan over medium heat, grease it with vegetable oil if needed. Pour in a ladleful of batter and cook each pancake until golden on both sides. Stack the cooked pancakes on a plate.

fill-roll-pancakes-pancakes-with-apples-.title: Fill and roll pancakes
fill-roll-pancakes-pancakes-with-apples-.description: Place a portion of the apple-nut filling onto each pancake and roll it into a tube. Repeat for all pancakes.

transfer-chocolate-paste-pancakes-with-c.title: Transfer chocolate paste to a piping bag
transfer-chocolate-paste-pancakes-with-c.description: Place the chocolate paste into a piping bag. Cut off the tip to make a small opening.

melt-butter-pancakes-with-chocolate-spre.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-pancakes-with-chocolate-spre.description: Melt the butter in a microwave in short bursts of 10-15 seconds until fully melted.

add-sugar-and-egg-pancakes-with-chocolat.title: Add vanilla sugar and egg
add-sugar-and-egg-pancakes-with-chocolat.description: Add the vanilla sugar and the egg to the melted butter. Mix until well combined.

add-milk-pancakes-with-chocolate-spread.title: Add milk
add-milk-pancakes-with-chocolate-spread.description: Pour in the milk and stir until the mixture is smooth and homogeneous.

make-batter-pancakes-with-chocolate-spre.title: Make the pancake batter
make-batter-pancakes-with-chocolate-spre.description: Combine the flour and baking powder, then sift them into the wet mixture. Mix until you get a thick but flowing batter that easily drips off the ladle.

heat-pan-pancakes-with-chocolate-spread.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-pancakes-with-chocolate-spread.description: Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and let it warm up.

fill-and-fry-pancakes-pancakes-with-choc.title: Fill and fry the pancakes
fill-and-fry-pancakes-pancakes-with-choc.description: Pour a ladle of batter into the center of the pan. Quickly pipe a small amount of chocolate paste onto the batter. Cover the paste with a thin layer of batter. Fry on low heat with the lid on for 3-4 minutes per side. Repeat with the remaining batter.

mix-eggs-and-milk-pancakes-with-cottage-.title: Mix eggs and milk
mix-eggs-and-milk-pancakes-with-cottage-.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add half of the milk and whisk until combined.

add-dry-ingredients-pancakes-with-cottag.title: Add dry ingredients
add-dry-ingredients-pancakes-with-cottag.description: Sift in the flour, then add salt and sugar. Mix until smooth and no lumps remain.

add-remaining-milk-water-pancakes-with-c.title: Add remaining milk and water
add-remaining-milk-water-pancakes-with-c.description: Pour in the rest of the milk and the water. Stir until the batter is homogeneous.

add-oil-pancakes-with-cottage-cheese-and.title: Add oil
add-oil-pancakes-with-cottage-cheese-and.description: Add the vegetable oil and mix well. The batter is now ready.

rest-batter-pancakes-with-cottage-cheese.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-pancakes-with-cottage-cheese.description: Cover the bowl and let the batter rest for 30 minutes. This allows the gluten to relax for tender pancakes.

cook-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-chee.title: Cook pancakes
cook-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-chee.description: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a little oil. Pour a ladleful of batter, swirl to cover the surface, and cook for 30–40 seconds per side until golden. Repeat with remaining batter.

stack-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-che.title: Stack cooked pancakes
stack-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-che.description: Stack the cooked pancakes on a plate and cover with a clean kitchen towel to keep them warm and moist.

make-filling-pancakes-with-cottage-chees.title: Make the filling
make-filling-pancakes-with-cottage-chees.description: In a deep bowl, whip the heavy cream with powdered sugar until stiff peaks form. Reserve one-third of the whipped cream for serving. Add the cottage cheese to the remaining cream and mix until smooth.

assemble-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-.title: Assemble the pancakes
assemble-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-.description: Line small bowls or a muffin tin with plastic wrap, letting the edges hang over. Place a pancake in each lined bowl. Spoon some cottage cheese filling in the center, make a small indent, and add berries or jam. Cover with more filling, then fold the pancake edges toward the center. Gather the plastic wrap and twist to seal tightly. Repeat for all pancakes.

refrigerate-pancakes-pancakes-with-cotta.title: Chill the pancakes
refrigerate-pancakes-pancakes-with-cotta.description: Place the wrapped pancake bundles in the refrigerator and chill for at least 3 hours, or until firm.

serve-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-che.title: Serve
serve-pancakes-pancakes-with-cottage-che.description: Unwrap the chilled pancakes. Place a dollop of the reserved whipped cream on a plate, then set a pancake bundle on top. Serve immediately.

combine-mango-sugar-cornstarch-pancakes-.title: Combine mango, sugar, and cornstarch
combine-mango-sugar-cornstarch-pancakes-.description: Place the mango cubes, sugar, and cornstarch in a saucepan. Shake the pan to mix the ingredients together.

cook-mango-medium-heat-pancakes-with-man.title: Cook mango mixture over medium heat
cook-mango-medium-heat-pancakes-with-man.description: Set the saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, for 4–5 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.

cook-mango-low-heat-pancakes-with-mango-.title: Simmer mango confit over low heat
cook-mango-low-heat-pancakes-with-mango-.description: Reduce the heat to low and continue cooking for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mango cubes are soft but still hold their shape. Remove from heat and let cool.

combine-cream-cheese-cream-pancakes-with.title: Combine cream cheese and cream
combine-cream-cheese-cream-pancakes-with.description: In a clean bowl, place the cream cheese and pour in the light cream.

beat-cream-cheese-mixture-pancakes-with-.title: Beat cream cheese mixture
beat-cream-cheese-mixture-pancakes-with-.description: Using a mixer on medium speed, beat the cream cheese and cream for 2–3 minutes until smooth and creamy.

arrange-pancakes-on-plate-pancakes-with-.title: Arrange pancakes on a plate
arrange-pancakes-on-plate-pancakes-with-.description: Place a portion of the pancakes in a single layer on a flat microwave-safe plate.

defrost-pancakes-microwave-pancakes-with.title: Defrost pancakes in microwave
defrost-pancakes-microwave-pancakes-with.description: Heat the pancakes in the microwave on the defrost setting for 2–3 minutes to thaw them.

brush-pancakes-with-butter-pancakes-with.title: Brush pancakes with butter
brush-pancakes-with-butter-pancakes-with.description: Brush each pancake with a small amount of butter.

heat-pancakes-microwave-pancakes-with-ma.title: Heat pancakes in microwave
heat-pancakes-microwave-pancakes-with-ma.description: Return the plate to the microwave and heat on the standard setting for 2 minutes until warmed through.

assemble-pancakes-with-filling-pancakes-.title: Assemble pancakes with filling
assemble-pancakes-with-filling-pancakes-.description: Spread the whipped cream cheese and mango confit over each pancake, then fold them into triangles.

warm-honey-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Warm honey in microwave
warm-honey-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Heat the honey in the microwave in short 10-second bursts, stirring in between. Do not let it boil; just melt it. Then set aside to cool.

cool-honey-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Let honey cool
cool-honey-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Allow the warmed honey to cool down completely before using.

strain-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Strain the tvorog
strain-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Press the tvorog through a fine sieve to make it smooth and creamy.

mix-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Mix tvorog with sugar and sour cream
mix-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Combine the strained tvorog with 2 tablespoons of sugar and the sour cream. Stir until homogeneous.

divide-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Divide mixture into bowls
divide-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Spoon the tvorog mixture into individual serving bowls or ramekins.

refrigerate-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-hone.title: Chill the tvorog mixture
refrigerate-tvorog-persimmon-tvorog-hone.description: Place the bowls in the refrigerator to chill for at least 5 minutes.

cut-persimmon-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Cut persimmon into wedges
cut-persimmon-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Slice the persimmon into small wedges and remove any seeds.

melt-sugar-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Melt sugar in pan
melt-sugar-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Sprinkle the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar into a non‑stick frying pan and set over low heat. Wait until the sugar melts into a golden liquid, without stirring too much.

caramelize-persimmon-persimmon-tvorog-ho.title: Caramelize persimmon wedges
caramelize-persimmon-persimmon-tvorog-ho.description: Add the persimmon wedges to the melted sugar. Fry over low heat, turning occasionally, until they are lightly caramelized. Transfer to a plate and let cool.

cool-persimmon-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Cool caramelized persimmon
cool-persimmon-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Allow the persimmon wedges to cool completely so they firm up.

assemble-dessert-persimmon-tvorog-honey.title: Assemble the dessert
assemble-dessert-persimmon-tvorog-honey.description: Place the caramelized persimmon on top of the chilled tvorog mixture and drizzle with the cooled honey.

melt-butter-phyllo-strawberry-pastries.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-phyllo-strawberry-pastries.description: Melt the butter in the microwave in short 10-second bursts, stirring in between, until completely melted.

assemble-phyllo-blanks-phyllo-strawberry.title: Assemble phyllo blanks
assemble-phyllo-blanks-phyllo-strawberry.description: Lay one sheet of phyllo dough, brush it with melted butter, then place a second sheet on top. Gather the edges toward the center to form a round, crumpled blank. Repeat for the remaining sheets to make three blanks.

make-cream-filling-phyllo-strawberry-pas.title: Make the cream filling
make-cream-filling-phyllo-strawberry-pas.description: In a bowl, combine cream cheese, sugar, and one egg yolk. Mix until smooth and homogeneous.

fill-and-brush-edges-phyllo-strawberry-p.title: Fill and brush edges
fill-and-brush-edges-phyllo-strawberry-p.description: Place a spoonful of the cream filling in the center of each phyllo blank. Brush the exposed dough edges with the remaining egg yolk.

sprinkle-almonds-and-bake-phyllo-strawbe.title: Sprinkle almonds and bake
sprinkle-almonds-and-bake-phyllo-strawbe.description: Sprinkle the edges of the pastries with almond flakes. Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden and crispy.

top-with-strawberries-phyllo-strawberry-.title: Top with strawberries
top-with-strawberries-phyllo-strawberry-.description: Remove the pastries from the oven. Cut the strawberries into quarters and arrange them on top of the cream filling.

melt-chocolate-and-drizzle-phyllo-strawb.title: Melt chocolate and drizzle
melt-chocolate-and-drizzle-phyllo-strawb.description: Break the white chocolate into pieces and melt it in the microwave in 10–15 second bursts. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the pastries.

sift-dry-ingredients-pickle-brine-pancak.title: Sift dry ingredients
sift-dry-ingredients-pickle-brine-pancak.description: Sift the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, and black pepper into a bowl. Mix well.

beat-eggs-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-che.title: Beat eggs
beat-eggs-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-che.description: Beat the eggs with a whisk or mixer until smooth and frothy.

add-brine-butter-to-eggs-pickle-brine-pa.title: Add brine and butter to eggs
add-brine-butter-to-eggs-pickle-brine-pa.description: Add half of the pickle brine (125 ml) and melted butter to the beaten eggs. Mix until combined.

add-dry-to-wet-pickle-brine-pancakes-wit.title: Add dry ingredients to wet mixture
add-dry-to-wet-pickle-brine-pancakes-wit.description: Gradually add the dry ingredient mixture to the egg mixture, stirring until smooth.

add-remaining-brine-pickle-brine-pancake.title: Add remaining brine
add-remaining-brine-pickle-brine-pancake.description: Pour in the remaining 125 ml of pickle brine and mix until the batter is smooth and thin.

heat-pan-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-chee.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-chee.description: Place a non-stick frying pan over high heat, then reduce to medium. Lightly oil the pan with a brush and remove excess oil with a paper towel.

fry-pancakes-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-.title: Fry pancakes
fry-pancakes-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-.description: Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan and swirl to spread. Cook until the edges are golden brown, then flip and cook the other side. Repeat with remaining batter.

butter-pancakes-pickle-brine-pancakes-wi.title: Butter the pancakes
butter-pancakes-pickle-brine-pancakes-wi.description: Brush each cooked pancake with melted butter.

mix-filling-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-c.title: Mix the cheese filling
mix-filling-pickle-brine-pancakes-with-c.description: In a bowl, combine mozzarella, cream cheese, minced garlic, chopped parsley, and a pinch of salt. Mix until smooth.

fill-pancakes-pickle-brine-pancakes-with.title: Fill and fold pancakes
fill-pancakes-pickle-brine-pancakes-with.description: Place about 50–60 g of filling in the center of each pancake. Fold the sides over to form an envelope shape.

cut-pineapple-rings-pineapple-lassi.title: Cut the pineapple into rings
cut-pineapple-rings-pineapple-lassi.description: Cut the pineapple into 5 rings, each about 1–1.3 cm thick.

heat-pan-with-oils-pineapple-lassi.title: Heat the pan and melt the oils
heat-pan-with-oils-pineapple-lassi.description: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add the butter and coconut oil and let them melt.

cook-first-batch-pineapple-lassi.title: Cook the first batch of rings
cook-first-batch-pineapple-lassi.description: Place 2–3 pineapple rings in the pan, sprinkle with half the sugar and salt. Cook for 4–5 minutes per side until caramelized and deep golden.

cook-second-batch-pineapple-lassi.title: Cook the remaining rings
cook-second-batch-pineapple-lassi.description: Transfer the first batch to a plate. Add the remaining rings to the pan, sprinkle with the rest of the sugar and salt, and cook for 4–5 minutes per side until caramelized.

add-ingredients-to-blender-pineapple-las.title: Add ingredients to the blender
add-ingredients-to-blender-pineapple-las.description: Place 4 cooked pineapple rings into the blender. Add the yogurt, coconut milk, cardamom, and cinnamon.

blend-lassi-pineapple-lassi.title: Blend until smooth
blend-lassi-pineapple-lassi.description: Blend on high speed for 2–3 minutes until the mixture is thick and homogeneous.

serve-lassi-pineapple-lassi.title: Pour into glasses and garnish
serve-lassi-pineapple-lassi.description: Pour the lassi into glasses. Cut the remaining grilled pineapple ring in half, place a half on top of each glass, and garnish with fresh mint if desired.

prepare-batter-pineapple-pancakes.title: Prepare the batter
prepare-batter-pineapple-pancakes.description: In a bowl, mix the protein pancake mix with water (or milk) according to package instructions. Add 2 tablespoons of agave syrup and pineapple juice, then stir until smooth.

rest-batter-pineapple-pancakes.title: Let the batter rest
rest-batter-pineapple-pancakes.description: Allow the batter to rest for 10 minutes. This helps the flavors meld and the texture improve.

cut-pineapple-pineapple-pancakes.title: Cut the pineapple into rings
cut-pineapple-pineapple-pancakes.description: Slice the pineapple into rings about 1 cm thick. Remove the core from each ring.

caramelize-pineapple-pineapple-pancakes.title: Caramelize the pineapple rings
caramelize-pineapple-pineapple-pancakes.description: Pour the remaining agave syrup into a hot frying pan. Add the pineapple rings and cook for 2 minutes on each side until they are golden and caramelized.

assemble-pancakes-pineapple-pancakes.title: Assemble the pancakes
assemble-pancakes-pineapple-pancakes.description: Place a cocktail cherry in the center of each caramelized pineapple ring. Carefully pour the batter over each ring, filling it completely.

fry-pancakes-pineapple-pancakes.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-pineapple-pancakes.description: Cook the pancakes over medium heat for about 3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface. Flip them and cook for another 2-3 minutes until the other side is golden brown. Serve hot.

boil-beets-pink-pancakes.title: Boil the beet
boil-beets-pink-pancakes.description: Place the beet in cold water and bring to a boil. Simmer over low heat for 35–40 minutes until tender. Test with a skewer, then cool and peel.

grate-and-squeeze-beets-pink-pancakes.title: Grate and squeeze the beet juice
grate-and-squeeze-beets-pink-pancakes.description: Grate the peeled beet on the fine side of a grater. Press the grated beet through a sieve to extract the juice. Discard the pulp.

sift-flour-and-separate-eggs-pink-pancak.title: Sift flour and separate eggs
sift-flour-and-separate-eggs-pink-pancak.description: Sift the flour into a bowl. Separate the eggs, adding the yolks to the flour. Mix the yolks into the flour.

melt-butter-and-combine-wet-ingredients-.title: Melt butter and combine wet ingredients
melt-butter-and-combine-wet-ingredients-.description: Melt the butter in the microwave or on the stove. Add it to the flour-yolk mixture. While stirring, gradually pour in the milk and the beet juice.

whip-whites-and-fold-into-batter-pink-pa.title: Whip egg whites and fold into batter
whip-whites-and-fold-into-batter-pink-pa.description: In a separate deep bowl, whip the egg whites with a mixer until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whipped whites into the batter, mixing thoroughly to eliminate lumps.

add-salt-and-sugar-pink-pancakes.title: Add salt and sugar
add-salt-and-sugar-pink-pancakes.description: Season the batter with salt and sugar to taste. Stir until dissolved.

cook-pancakes-pink-pancakes.title: Cook the pancakes
cook-pancakes-pink-pancakes.description: Heat a pancake pan over medium heat and grease it lightly with oil. Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan, tilting to spread evenly. Cook for 2 minutes on one side, then flip and cook for 1 minute on the other side. Repeat with remaining batter.

boil-eggs-pink-salmon-and-egg-sandwiches.title: Boil the eggs
boil-eggs-pink-salmon-and-egg-sandwiches.description: Place the eggs in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 minutes from the moment of boiling.

cool-and-mash-eggs-pink-salmon-and-egg-s.title: Cool, peel and mash the eggs
cool-and-mash-eggs-pink-salmon-and-egg-s.description: Transfer the boiled eggs to ice water to cool. Then peel them and mash with a fork.

dice-cucumber-and-flake-fish-pink-salmon.title: Dice cucumber and flake fish
dice-cucumber-and-flake-fish-pink-salmon.description: Cut the cucumber into small cubes. Remove the canned salmon from the can and flake it with a fork.

mix-filling-pink-salmon-and-egg-sandwich.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-pink-salmon-and-egg-sandwich.description: Combine the flaked salmon, mashed eggs, and diced cucumber in a bowl. Add sour cream and grainy mustard. Stir well until smooth.

toast-bread-pink-salmon-and-egg-sandwich.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-pink-salmon-and-egg-sandwich.description: Toast the slices of bread in a dry frying pan or toaster until golden brown on both sides.

assemble-sandwiches-pink-salmon-and-egg-.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-pink-salmon-and-egg-.description: Spread the fish mixture onto two slices of toast. Top with lettuce leaves and cover with the remaining two slices of bread.

blanch-almonds-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Blanch the almonds
blanch-almonds-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Pour boiling water over the almonds and let them sit for 1-2 minutes. Then drain the water and peel off the skins.

peel-almonds-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Peel the almonds
peel-almonds-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Remove the skins from the almonds after blanching. Discard the skins.

dry-almonds-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Dry the almonds
dry-almonds-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Place the peeled almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat. Toast them for 1-2 minutes, stirring frequently, until they are dry and lightly golden.

preheat-oven-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Set your oven to preheat to 190°C (375°F). This will ensure it's hot enough when the batter is ready.

prepare-lemon-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Prepare the lemon
prepare-lemon-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Finely grate the zest from the lemon, then cut the lemon in half and squeeze out the juice. Set both aside.

grind-nuts-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Grind the nuts
grind-nuts-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Place the dried almonds and 100 g of pistachios (original recipe; adjust for portion) into a blender. Process on high speed for 3-4 minutes until the mixture becomes a fine crumb.

cream-butter-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Cream butter and sugar
cream-butter-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: In a large bowl, combine the softened butter and sugar. Add half of the lemon zest. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed for 2-3 minutes until light and fluffy.

add-eggs-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Add the eggs
add-eggs-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: While continuing to beat, add the eggs one at a time. Mix well after each addition until the mixture is smooth and fully combined.

add-dry-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Add the dry ingredients
add-dry-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Add the ground nut mixture, flour, and the seeds scraped from the vanilla pod. Mix on the lowest speed until just combined, being careful not to overmix.

transfer-to-pan-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Transfer to the pan
transfer-to-pan-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Scoop the batter into a greased loaf pan or cake mold. Spread it evenly with a spatula.

bake-cake-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Bake the cake
bake-cake-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake at 190°C for 40-50 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. The top should be golden brown.

make-syrup-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Make the lemon syrup
make-syrup-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: In a small saucepan, combine the lemon juice and sugar. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 3-4 minutes until the sugar has completely dissolved.

finish-syrup-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Finish the syrup
finish-syrup-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Add the remaining lemon zest to the saucepan, stir, then remove from heat. Set aside.

cool-cake-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Cool the cake
cool-cake-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Let the cake cool in the pan for about 10 minutes. Then carefully remove it from the pan and transfer to a wire rack or serving plate.

glaze-cake-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Glaze the cake
glaze-cake-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: While the cake is still warm, pour the lemon syrup evenly over the top. Allow it to soak in.

chop-pistachios-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Chop the pistachios
chop-pistachios-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Roughly chop the remaining pistachios (50 g original; adjust for portion) into coarse pieces.

sprinkle-pistachios-pistachio-lemon-cake.title: Sprinkle with pistachios
sprinkle-pistachios-pistachio-lemon-cake.description: Distribute the chopped pistachios evenly over the syrup-glazed cake. Press lightly so they stick.

heat-water-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Heat the water
heat-water-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Pour water into a microwave-safe bowl and heat it for 1–1.5 minutes until warm. Take 3 tablespoons of the warm water into a small bowl.

activate-yeast-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Activate the yeast
activate-yeast-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Add the compressed yeast to the 3 tablespoons of warm water. Stir and let it stand for 10–15 minutes until the yeast activates and becomes frothy.

mix-dry-ingredients-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Mix the dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: In a large bowl, combine the flour and 0.5 teaspoon of salt. Stir to mix, then make a well in the center.

knead-dough-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Pour the activated yeast and remaining warm water into the well. Gradually mix into a dough. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and knead for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Form into a ball.

first-rise-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Let the dough rise
first-rise-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Grease a deep bowl with remaining olive oil, place the dough ball inside, cover with a towel or plastic wrap, and leave in a warm place for about 1 hour until doubled in size.

shape-dough-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Shape the pizza base
shape-dough-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Punch down the risen dough, then flatten it into a round disc about 1 cm thick. Place on a baking sheet, brush with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.

bake-base-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Bake the pizza base
bake-base-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Bake the base for 12–15 minutes until golden and cooked through. Remove and let cool.

slice-onion-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Slice the red onion
slice-onion-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Cut the red onion into thin feather-like slices.

saute-onion-first-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Sauté the onion until soft
saute-onion-first-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Heat a mixture of olive oil and vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and sauté for 7–9 minutes until soft.

caramelize-onion-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Caramelize the onion
caramelize-onion-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Pour in balsamic vinegar, add salt and sugar. Continue cooking over medium heat for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onion is caramelized and dark.

prep-toppings-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Prepare the toppings
prep-toppings-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Cut the cherry tomatoes in half. Finely chop the green onion, dill, and pickles.

assemble-pizza-base-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Assemble the pizza base
assemble-pizza-base-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Transfer the cooled pizza base to a board. Spread an even layer of ricotta over the base. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and dill. Arrange the tomato halves, chopped pickles, and caramelized onion on top.

add-fish-and-oil-pizza-salmon-cherry.title: Top with fish and oil
add-fish-and-oil-pizza-salmon-cherry.description: Lay slices of trout fillet over the pizza. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil. Serve immediately.

activate-yeast-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Activate the yeast
activate-yeast-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Warm 35 ml of milk in a microwave-safe bowl for about 1 minute until lukewarm. Stir in 1 g of yeast, 8 g of sugar, and 20 g of flour. Mix well and let sit for 5–10 minutes until frothy.

mix-dough-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Mix the dough
mix-dough-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Crack the egg into the yeast mixture, add the remaining 14 g of sugar, water, and softened butter. Stir thoroughly until combined.

knead-dough-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Add salt and the remaining 40 g of flour little by little while mixing. Knead into a smooth, soft dough.

first-rise-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Let the dough rise
first-rise-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Cover the dough with a clean towel and leave it in a warm place for 1–1.5 hours, or until it has doubled in volume.

heat-poppy-seeds-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Heat the poppy seeds
heat-poppy-seeds-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Place 2 g of poppy seeds in a small heatproof bowl or saucepan, add 5 ml of milk, stir, and heat over low heat for 2–3 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and let cool.

punch-down-dough-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Punch down the dough
punch-down-dough-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Punch the risen dough down to release air, then let it rest in a warm place for 15 minutes.

make-filling-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Make the filling
make-filling-poppy-accordion-bread.description: In a clean bowl, combine the second egg, 28 g of cream cheese, 14 g of sugar, and orange zest. Whisk until smooth. Fold in the cooled poppy seeds and mix well.

roll-and-fill-dough-poppy-accordion-brea.title: Roll and fill the dough
roll-and-fill-dough-poppy-accordion-brea.description: Dust your work surface with a little flour. Roll the dough into a 40x30 cm rectangle. Spread the poppy-cream cheese filling evenly over the surface, leaving a small border.

cut-and-arrange-dough-poppy-accordion-br.title: Cut and arrange the dough
cut-and-arrange-dough-poppy-accordion-br.description: Cut the filled dough into equal squares. Stand the squares vertically in a baking pan, packing them tightly from one short side to the other.

second-rise-and-preheat-poppy-accordion-.title: Let the bread rise and preheat the oven
second-rise-and-preheat-poppy-accordion-.description: Cover the pan with a towel and let the dough rise for 40 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat your oven to 180°C.

bake-bread-poppy-accordion-bread.title: Bake the bread
bake-bread-poppy-accordion-bread.description: Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 35–40 minutes, until golden brown. If the bread browns too quickly, cover it loosely with foil.

slice-and-arrange-potatoes-potato-tacos.title: Slice and arrange potatoes
slice-and-arrange-potatoes-potato-tacos.description: Slice the potatoes into thin rounds. Pat them dry with a paper towel, then arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet in a single layer, slightly overlapping, to form two rectangular sheets.

preheat-oven-potato-tacos.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-potato-tacos.description: Set your oven to 200°C (400°F) and let it preheat completely.

grate-cheese-and-sprinkle-potato-tacos.title: Grate cheese and sprinkle over potatoes
grate-cheese-and-sprinkle-potato-tacos.description: Coarsely grate the hard cheese and distribute it evenly over the potato slices.

bake-potatoes-potato-tacos.title: Bake the potato base
bake-potatoes-potato-tacos.description: Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the cheese is melted and golden.

salt-cucumbers-and-rest-potato-tacos.title: Salt cucumbers and let rest
salt-cucumbers-and-rest-potato-tacos.description: Grate the cucumber coarsely, sprinkle with salt, and let it sit for 5 minutes to draw out excess moisture.

squeeze-cucumber-potato-tacos.title: Squeeze cucumber dry
squeeze-cucumber-potato-tacos.description: After resting, squeeze the grated cucumber firmly to remove as much liquid as possible.

make-yogurt-sauce-potato-tacos.title: Make the yogurt sauce
make-yogurt-sauce-potato-tacos.description: Press the garlic through a press and chop the dill. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt. Mix well.

assemble-base-potato-tacos.title: Assemble the base
assemble-base-potato-tacos.description: Spread a thick layer of the yogurt sauce over one half of each baked potato sheet. Top the saucy half with arugula.

add-toppings-potato-tacos.title: Add toppings
add-toppings-potato-tacos.description: Slice the tomato into rounds and arrange over the arugula. Halve the avocado, remove the pit and skin, slice the flesh, and place on the tomatoes. Cut the salmon into strips and lay them on top.

mix-eggs-milk-pp-khachapuri.title: Mix eggs and milk
mix-eggs-milk-pp-khachapuri.description: In a bowl, combine the eggs and milk and whisk until smooth. Do not overbeat.

mash-tvorog-pp-khachapuri.title: Mash tvorog
mash-tvorog-pp-khachapuri.description: Mash the tvorog with a fork and add to the egg-milk mixture. Mix well, breaking up any large curds.

add-flour-seasoning-pp-khachapuri.title: Add flour and seasonings
add-flour-seasoning-pp-khachapuri.description: Add the rice flour, salt, and pepper. Mix thoroughly.

add-cheese-herbs-pp-khachapuri.title: Add cheese and herbs
add-cheese-herbs-pp-khachapuri.description: Grate the suluguni on a fine grater and add to the batter. Chop fresh herbs and add as well.

cook-first-side-pp-khachapuri.title: Cook the first side
cook-first-side-pp-khachapuri.description: Brush the skillet with oil and pour in the batter. Spread evenly with a spatula. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5–6 minutes until golden brown.

flip-and-cook-second-side-pp-khachapuri.title: Flip and cook the other side
flip-and-cook-second-side-pp-khachapuri.description: Carefully flip the flatbread and cook covered for another 5–6 minutes.

chop-ingredients-pp-shawarma-with-chicke.title: Chop the ingredients
chop-ingredients-pp-shawarma-with-chicke.description: Finely chop the cooked chicken breast and tomato. Grate the carrot, chop the fresh herbs, shred the Chinese cabbage, and knead it with your hands to soften.

mix-yogurt-sauce-pp-shawarma-with-chicke.title: Mix the yogurt sauce
mix-yogurt-sauce-pp-shawarma-with-chicke.description: Add the chopped herbs to the yogurt. Sprinkle in a little salt and stir to combine.

spread-yogurt-pp-shawarma-with-chicken.title: Spread the yogurt on the lavash
spread-yogurt-pp-shawarma-with-chicken.description: Spread the yogurt mixture evenly over the lavash bread.

fill-lavash-pp-shawarma-with-chicken.title: Fill the lavash
fill-lavash-pp-shawarma-with-chicken.description: Place the chopped chicken and vegetables on top of the yogurt-coated lavash.

roll-and-cut-pp-shawarma-with-chicken.title: Roll and cut the shawarma
roll-and-cut-pp-shawarma-with-chicken.description: Roll the lavash tightly into a log, then cut it diagonally into two pieces.

grate-carrot-processed-cheese-carrot-toa.title: Grate the carrots
grate-carrot-processed-cheese-carrot-toa.description: Finely grate the carrots using a box grater or food processor. Set aside.

chop-dill-processed-cheese-carrot-toasts.title: Chop the dill
chop-dill-processed-cheese-carrot-toasts.description: Rinse the dill and chop it finely.

mix-filling-processed-cheese-carrot-toas.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-processed-cheese-carrot-toas.description: In a bowl, combine the grated carrots, chopped dill, processed cheese, mayonnaise, salt, and black pepper. Stir until well combined.

spread-filling-processed-cheese-carrot-t.title: Spread the filling on bread
spread-filling-processed-cheese-carrot-t.description: Divide the filling evenly among the bread slices and spread it over the surface.

bake-sandwiches-processed-cheese-carrot-.title: Bake the sandwiches
bake-sandwiches-processed-cheese-carrot-.description: Place the prepared sandwiches on a baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven at 190°C for 10 minutes, keeping an eye on the edges to prevent burning.

add-chia-protein-cocoa-protein-chocolate.title: Add dry ingredients
add-chia-protein-cocoa-protein-chocolate.description: Place the chia seeds, protein powder, and cocoa powder into the blender jar.

pit-dates-protein-chocolate-pudding.title: Pit the dates
pit-dates-protein-chocolate-pudding.description: If your dates have pits, remove them.

add-dates-to-blender-protein-chocolate-p.title: Add dates
add-dates-to-blender-protein-chocolate-p.description: Place the pitted dates into the blender with the dry ingredients.

blend-mixture-protein-chocolate-pudding.title: Blend with coconut milk
blend-mixture-protein-chocolate-pudding.description: Add the coconut milk to the blender and process until the mixture is completely smooth.

transfer-to-dish-protein-chocolate-puddi.title: Transfer to dish
transfer-to-dish-protein-chocolate-puddi.description: Spoon the blended mixture into a serving bowl or ramekin.

refrigerate-pudding-protein-chocolate-pu.title: Refrigerate
refrigerate-pudding-protein-chocolate-pu.description: Place the dish in the refrigerator for 1 hour to allow the pudding to set and thicken.

chop-kiwi-banana-protein-shake.title: Chop kiwi and banana
chop-kiwi-banana-protein-shake.description: Roughly chop the kiwi and banana into small pieces for easy blending.

blend-fruits-protein-shake.title: Blend fruits
blend-fruits-protein-shake.description: Place the blueberries and chopped fruits into a blender bowl. Blend until smooth.

blend-protein-shake-again-protein-shake.title: Blend again with protein
blend-protein-shake-again-protein-shake.description: Add water, flaxseed oil, chia seeds, cinnamon, and protein powder. Blend once more until everything is well combined.

preheat-oven-puff-pastry-pizza-with-saus.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-puff-pastry-pizza-with-saus.description: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). This ensures the oven is hot enough for baking the pizza.

slice-onion-and-grate-cheese-puff-pastry.title: Slice onion and grate cheese
slice-onion-and-grate-cheese-puff-pastry.description: Slice the onion into thin half rings. Grate the mozzarella cheese coarsely using a box grater.

slice-vegetables-and-sausages-puff-pastr.title: Slice vegetables and sausages
slice-vegetables-and-sausages-puff-pastr.description: Cut the pickles, tomato, and sausages into round slices about 2–3 mm thick. Slice the mushrooms into similar thin slices.

roll-dough-and-form-crust-puff-pastry-pi.title: Roll out dough and form crust
roll-dough-and-form-crust-puff-pastry-pi.description: Roll the puff pastry sheet into a rectangle about 3–4 mm thick. Transfer it to a baking sheet. Fold the edges inward to create a raised crust.

spread-ketchup-and-add-toppings-puff-pas.title: Spread ketchup and add first toppings
spread-ketchup-and-add-toppings-puff-pas.description: Evenly spread ketchup over the dough base. Arrange the sliced onion on top, then lay the mushroom slices over the onion. Season with salt, black pepper, and Italian herbs.

add-tomato-and-pickles-puff-pastry-pizza.title: Add tomato and pickles
add-tomato-and-pickles-puff-pastry-pizza.description: Distribute the sliced tomato and pickles evenly over the pizza.

add-sausages-and-cheese-puff-pastry-pizz.title: Add sausages and cheese
add-sausages-and-cheese-puff-pastry-pizz.description: Place the sausage slices on the pizza, then sprinkle the grated mozzarella cheese evenly over everything.

bake-pizza-puff-pastry-pizza-with-sausag.title: Bake the pizza
bake-pizza-puff-pastry-pizza-with-sausag.description: Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, until the crust is golden and cheese is melted and bubbly.

place-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Add millet and water to pot
place-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: Put the millet in a saucepan and pour in 1 cup of water. This is the first step to cook the millet.

boil-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Bring to a boil
boil-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the water to a boil.

drain-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Drain and rinse millet
drain-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: Pour the millet into a sieve, rinse under cold running water, and return to the saucepan.

reboil-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Add water and reboil
reboil-millet-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: Pour the remaining 0.5 cup of water into the saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently.

dice-pumpkin-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Dice the pumpkin
dice-pumpkin-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: Cut the pumpkin into 1 cm cubes for even cooking.

cook-pumpkin-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Add pumpkin and cook
cook-pumpkin-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: Add the diced pumpkin to the millet, stir, cover, and cook for 10 minutes over medium heat.

simmer-coconut-pumpkin-millet-porridge.title: Finish with coconut milk and simmer
simmer-coconut-pumpkin-millet-porridge.description: When the pumpkin is soft and the millet is cooked, pour in the coconut milk. Add salt, coconut oil, and honey. Stir well, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

mix-honey-butter-pumpkin-pancakes-with-c.title: Mix honey butter
mix-honey-butter-pumpkin-pancakes-with-c.description: In a bowl, combine softened butter, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Whisk until smooth and set aside at room temperature until serving.

mix-dry-ingredients-pumpkin-pancakes-wit.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-pumpkin-pancakes-wit.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, cane sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon.

melt-butter-and-mix-wet-pumpkin-pancakes.title: Melt butter and mix wet ingredients
melt-butter-and-mix-wet-pumpkin-pancakes.description: Melt 40 g of butter. In a large bowl, combine the melted butter with eggs, kefir, pumpkin puree, and vanilla extract.

whisk-batter-pumpkin-pancakes-with-cinna.title: Whisk batter
whisk-batter-pumpkin-pancakes-with-cinna.description: Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and whisk until smooth.

rest-batter-pumpkin-pancakes-with-cinnam.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-pumpkin-pancakes-with-cinnam.description: Let the batter rest for 10–15 minutes. This allows the pancakes to become fluffier.

make-cinnamon-swirl-pumpkin-pancakes-wit.title: Make cinnamon swirl mixture
make-cinnamon-swirl-pumpkin-pancakes-wit.description: In a small bowl, combine 80 g softened butter, 3 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon, and 2 tbsp of the prepared batter. Mix until smooth, then transfer to a piping bag or a zip‑top bag with a corner snipped off.

heat-pan-pumpkin-pancakes-with-cinnamon.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-pumpkin-pancakes-with-cinnamon.description: Place a frying pan over medium heat. Lightly grease the surface with butter or vegetable oil.

cook-pancake-first-side-pumpkin-pancakes.title: Cook first side with swirl
cook-pancake-first-side-pumpkin-pancakes.description: Pour about half a ladle of batter onto the hot pan. After 1 minute, pipe a spiral of the cinnamon mixture onto the batter. Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface.

flip-and-cook-second-side-pumpkin-pancak.title: Flip and cook second side
flip-and-cook-second-side-pumpkin-pancak.description: Carefully flip the pancake and cook for another 1–3 minutes until golden brown. Repeat the cooking steps for the remaining batter.

boil-eggs-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.title: Boil the eggs
boil-eggs-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.description: Place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 8–10 minutes, then cool, peel, and halve each egg.

grind-bran-and-flax-quiche-with-cabbage-.title: Grind bran and flax seeds
grind-bran-and-flax-quiche-with-cabbage-.description: Use a blender or coffee grinder to process the rye bran and flax seeds into a fine crumb. Transfer to a deep bowl.

mix-dry-ingredients-quiche-with-cabbage-.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-quiche-with-cabbage-.description: Add sifted wheat flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt to the ground bran and flax. Stir to combine.

mix-wet-ingredients-quiche-with-cabbage-.title: Mix wet ingredients
mix-wet-ingredients-quiche-with-cabbage-.description: In a separate bowl, whisk together the sunflower oil, yogurt, and boiling water.

combine-and-knead-dough-quiche-with-cabb.title: Combine and knead the dough
combine-and-knead-dough-quiche-with-cabb.description: Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients. Knead until you have a smooth, non-sticky dough.

rest-dough-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.title: Rest the dough
rest-dough-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.description: Cover the dough with a towel or plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.

prep-vegetables-quiche-with-cabbage-and-.title: Prepare vegetables and cheese
prep-vegetables-quiche-with-cabbage-and-.description: Shred the cabbage, finely chop the dill, and coarsely grate the hard cheese.

saute-cabbage-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eg.title: Sauté the cabbage
saute-cabbage-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eg.description: Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the cabbage and cook for about 10 minutes until soft. Remove from heat and let cool.

mix-filling-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.description: Combine the cooked cabbage with dill, grated cheese, salt, and pepper. Stir well.

roll-dough-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.title: Roll out the dough
roll-dough-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.description: Roll the rested dough into a circle about 5 mm thick. Transfer it to a tart pan, pressing it into the bottom and up the sides. Prick the base with a fork.

blind-bake-crust-quiche-with-cabbage-and.title: Blind bake the crust
blind-bake-crust-quiche-with-cabbage-and.description: Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake the crust for 10 minutes.

assemble-quiche-quiche-with-cabbage-and-.title: Assemble the quiche
assemble-quiche-quiche-with-cabbage-and-.description: Remove the partially baked crust from the oven. Spread the cabbage filling evenly over the crust, then arrange the halved boiled eggs on top, cut side up.

make-custard-quiche-with-cabbage-and-egg.title: Make the custard
make-custard-quiche-with-cabbage-and-egg.description: In a bowl, whisk together one raw egg, the yogurt, and sour cream until smooth. Pour this mixture over the filling.

bake-final-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.title: Bake the quiche
bake-final-quiche-with-cabbage-and-eggs.description: Return the pan to the oven, reduce the temperature to 180°C (350°F), and bake for 20–25 minutes until the custard is set and the top is light golden.

beat-eggs-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Beat eggs with sugar and salt
beat-eggs-raffaello-style-crepes.description: In a bowl, beat the eggs with sugar and salt until the mixture becomes light and fluffy.

add-flour-milk-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Add flour and milk gradually
add-flour-milk-raffaello-style-crepes.description: Slowly sift in the flour while mixing, then pour in the milk in small batches, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.

let-batter-rest-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Add boiling water and oil, then rest the batter
let-batter-rest-raffaello-style-crepes.description: Bring the water to a boil and pour it into the batter. Add the vegetable oil and mix until smooth. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes.

fry-crepes-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Fry the crepes
fry-crepes-raffaello-style-crepes.description: Heat a well-greased frying pan over medium-high heat. Pour a ladleful of batter and swirl to coat. Cook until golden on both sides. Stack the finished crepes on a plate.

make-filling-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Make the filling
make-filling-raffaello-style-crepes.description: In a separate bowl, mix the tvorog with the condensed milk until well combined.

add-coconut-vanilla-raffaello-style-crep.title: Add coconut and vanilla sugar
add-coconut-vanilla-raffaello-style-crep.description: Stir in the coconut flakes and vanilla sugar into the tvorog mixture. Mix thoroughly.

spread-filling-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Spread the filling on each crepe
spread-filling-raffaello-style-crepes.description: Place a generous layer of the filling onto each crepe, spreading evenly.

roll-crepes-raffaello-style-crepes.title: Fold and roll the crepes
roll-crepes-raffaello-style-crepes.description: Fold the two opposite edges of each crepe inward to secure the filling, then roll tightly into a compact log. Arrange the rolled crepes on a serving plate.

mash-raspberries-raspberry-chia-jam.title: Mash the raspberries
mash-raspberries-raspberry-chia-jam.description: Mash the raspberries into a puree using a potato masher or a blender. If using a blender, pulse a few times until smooth.

add-honey-lemon-raspberry-chia-jam.title: Add honey and lemon juice
add-honey-lemon-raspberry-chia-jam.description: Add the honey and lemon juice to the raspberry puree. Stir until well combined.

add-chia-seeds-raspberry-chia-jam.title: Add chia seeds and mix
add-chia-seeds-raspberry-chia-jam.description: Add the chia seeds to the puree mixture. Stir thoroughly to distribute the seeds evenly.

refrigerate-raspberry-chia-jam.title: Refrigerate the jam
refrigerate-raspberry-chia-jam.description: Transfer the mixture to a jar or container. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight, to allow the chia seeds to swell and thicken the jam.

mash-tvorog-rice-paper-snails.title: Mash the tvorog
mash-tvorog-rice-paper-snails.description: Place the tvorog in a bowl and mash it with a fork until smooth.

add-egg-mix-rice-paper-snails.title: Add egg and seasonings
add-egg-mix-rice-paper-snails.description: Crack the egg into the mashed tvorog, add salt and dried basil, then mix thoroughly until combined.

grate-cheese-rice-paper-snails.title: Grate the cheese
grate-cheese-rice-paper-snails.description: Grate the hard cheese on a fine grater.

chop-spinach-onion-rice-paper-snails.title: Chop spinach and green onion
chop-spinach-onion-rice-paper-snails.description: Finely chop the spinach and green onion.

dice-bell-pepper-rice-paper-snails.title: Dice the bell pepper
dice-bell-pepper-rice-paper-snails.description: Cut the red bell pepper into small squares.

combine-filling-rice-paper-snails.title: Combine all filling ingredients
combine-filling-rice-paper-snails.description: Add the grated cheese, chopped spinach, green onion, and diced bell pepper to the tvorog mixture. Stir until evenly distributed.

pour-water-container-rice-paper-snails.title: Prepare water for softening rice paper
pour-water-container-rice-paper-snails.description: Pour water into a wide container or deep plate.

dip-first-sheet-rice-paper-snails.title: Dip first rice paper sheet
dip-first-sheet-rice-paper-snails.description: Immerse one sheet of rice paper in water for 5–10 seconds until it softens, then place it on a cutting board.

dip-second-sheet-overlap-rice-paper-snai.title: Add second sheet and overlap
dip-second-sheet-overlap-rice-paper-snai.description: Dip a second sheet of rice paper and place it slightly overlapping the first sheet to form a larger rectangle.

place-filling-on-sheet-rice-paper-snails.title: Portion the filling
place-filling-on-sheet-rice-paper-snails.description: Place one-fifth of the filling along the edge of the combined rice paper sheet.

roll-tightly-rice-paper-snails.title: Roll tightly
roll-tightly-rice-paper-snails.description: Roll the rice paper over the filling, pressing gently to form a tight log.

shape-snail-and-transfer-rice-paper-snai.title: Shape into snails and transfer to baking sheet
shape-snail-and-transfer-rice-paper-snai.description: Coil the rolled log into a spiral (snail shape), pinch the edge to seal, and place on a parchment-covered baking sheet. Repeat for all remaining rolls.

brush-with-yolk-rice-paper-snails.title: Brush with egg yolk
brush-with-yolk-rice-paper-snails.description: Beat the egg yolk and brush it over the tops of the snails for a golden finish.

bake-rice-paper-snails.title: Bake until crispy
bake-rice-paper-snails.description: Bake the snails in the preheated oven for 20–25 minutes, until the rice paper is golden and crispy.

cut-pears-rice-porridge-almond-milk-spic.title: Cut the pears
cut-pears-rice-porridge-almond-milk-spic.description: Cut the pear flesh into long slices. Choose firm pears so they don't turn into mush during caramelization.

saute-pears-rice-porridge-almond-milk-sp.title: Melt butter and add pears
saute-pears-rice-porridge-almond-milk-sp.description: Melt the butter in a heated frying pan. Add the pear slices, then sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.

fry-pears-rice-porridge-almond-milk-spic.title: Fry the pears
fry-pears-rice-porridge-almond-milk-spic.description: Fry the pears over medium heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they become soft and caramelized.

boil-milk-rice-porridge-almond-milk-spic.title: Boil the almond milk
boil-milk-rice-porridge-almond-milk-spic.description: Pour almond milk into a saucepan, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a boil over medium heat.

cook-rice-flakes-rice-porridge-almond-mi.title: Cook the rice flakes
cook-rice-flakes-rice-porridge-almond-mi.description: Stir in the rice flakes, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the porridge thickens to your liking. Remove from heat.

toast-almonds-rice-porridge-almond-milk-.title: Toast the almonds
toast-almonds-rice-porridge-almond-milk-.description: Toast the almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned. Roughly chop them.

heat-coconut-milk-rice-porridge-bounty.title: Heat the coconut milk with sugar and salt
heat-coconut-milk-rice-porridge-bounty.description: Pour the coconut milk into a saucepan. Add sugar and a pinch of salt. Place the saucepan over medium heat and stir occasionally until the mixture comes to a boil.

cook-rice-flakes-rice-porridge-bounty.title: Cook the rice flakes and coconut
cook-rice-flakes-rice-porridge-bounty.description: Add the rice flakes and coconut flakes to the boiling milk. Stir constantly and cook for 1–2 minutes until the porridge thickens slightly.

let-porridge-rest-rice-porridge-bounty.title: Let the porridge rest
let-porridge-rest-rice-porridge-bounty.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat. Cover with a lid and let it stand for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the porridge to become creamy.

make-chocolate-glaze-rice-porridge-bount.title: Make the chocolate glaze
make-chocolate-glaze-rice-porridge-bount.description: Break the dark chocolate into small pieces and place in a microwave-safe bowl. Add the light cream. Heat in the microwave in 10–15 second bursts, stirring after each burst, until the chocolate is completely melted and the mixture is smooth and glossy.

bring-water-to-boil-rice-pudding-with-ca.title: Bring water to a boil
bring-water-to-boil-rice-pudding-with-ca.description: Fill a large pot with water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a boil over high heat.

add-rice-and-boil-rice-pudding-with-cand.title: Add rice and boil
add-rice-and-boil-rice-pudding-with-cand.description: Add the rice to the boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

drain-rice-rice-pudding-with-candied-fru.title: Drain the rice
drain-rice-rice-pudding-with-candied-fru.description: Pour the rice into a colander and let the water drain completely.

return-rice-add-milk-rice-pudding-with-c.title: Return rice and add milk
return-rice-add-milk-rice-pudding-with-c.description: Return the drained rice to the pot and pour in the milk.

simmer-rice-milk-low-heat-rice-pudding-w.title: Simmer rice with milk
simmer-rice-milk-low-heat-rice-pudding-w.description: Place the pot on the stove and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Allow to cool slightly.

cool-rice-mixture-slightly-rice-pudding-.title: Cool the rice mixture slightly
cool-rice-mixture-slightly-rice-pudding-.description: Let the rice mixture sit for a few minutes until it is warm but not hot.

separate-eggs-rice-pudding-with-candied-.title: Separate eggs
separate-eggs-rice-pudding-with-candied-.description: Crack the eggs and separate the yolks from the whites. Place whites in a clean bowl and yolks in another.

whisk-yolks-sugar-vanilla-rice-pudding-w.title: Whisk yolks with sugar and vanilla
whisk-yolks-sugar-vanilla-rice-pudding-w.description: Add sugar and vanilla to the yolks and whisk until smooth and pale.

mix-yolk-mixture-into-rice-rice-pudding-.title: Mix yolk mixture into rice
mix-yolk-mixture-into-rice-rice-pudding-.description: Pour the yolk mixture into the cooled rice and stir gently to combine. Ensure the rice is not hot to prevent the yolks from curdling.

whip-egg-whites-rice-pudding-with-candie.title: Whip egg whites
whip-egg-whites-rice-pudding-with-candie.description: In a clean bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.

cut-butter-into-cubes-rice-pudding-with-.title: Cut butter into cubes
cut-butter-into-cubes-rice-pudding-with-.description: Cut the butter into small cubes.

chop-candied-fruits-rice-pudding-with-ca.title: Chop candied fruits
chop-candied-fruits-rice-pudding-with-ca.description: If the candied fruits are large, chop them into smaller pieces.

add-butter-candied-fruits-rice-pudding-w.title: Add butter and candied fruits
add-butter-candied-fruits-rice-pudding-w.description: Add the butter cubes and chopped candied fruits to the rice mixture and stir to combine.

fold-in-whites-rice-pudding-with-candied.title: Fold in whipped egg whites
fold-in-whites-rice-pudding-with-candied.description: Gently fold the whipped egg whites into the pudding mixture until just combined. Be careful not to deflate the whites.

grease-dish-with-butter-rice-pudding-wit.title: Grease baking dish with butter
grease-dish-with-butter-rice-pudding-wit.description: Grease a baking dish with the remaining butter and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.

fill-dish-with-mixture-rice-pudding-with.title: Fill the dish with pudding mixture
fill-dish-with-mixture-rice-pudding-with.description: Pour the pudding mixture into the prepared baking dish and spread evenly.

bake-pudding-at-180c-rice-pudding-with-c.title: Bake the pudding
bake-pudding-at-180c-rice-pudding-with-c.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the pudding for 35 minutes until set and golden. Let cool before serving.

cool-pudding-rice-pudding-with-candied-f.title: Cool the pudding
cool-pudding-rice-pudding-with-candied-f.description: Allow the pudding to cool completely before serving. Optionally, refrigerate for a firmer texture.

combine-cherries-sugar-rice-pudding-with.title: Combine cherries and sugar
combine-cherries-sugar-rice-pudding-with.description: Place the frozen cherries in a saucepan and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of sugar.

cook-cherry-syrup-rice-pudding-with-cher.title: Cook the cherry syrup
cook-cherry-syrup-rice-pudding-with-cher.description: Set the saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until the cherries release their juice and the sugar dissolves into a thick syrup, about 5-6 minutes.

strain-cherries-rice-pudding-with-cherri.title: Strain the cherries
strain-cherries-rice-pudding-with-cherri.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat. Pour the mixture through a sieve to separate the syrup from the soft cherries. Set both aside.

combine-rice-milk-rice-pudding-with-cher.title: Combine rice and milk
combine-rice-milk-rice-pudding-with-cher.description: Pour the rice into a pot and add the milk. Stir to combine.

simmer-rice-rice-pudding-with-cherries.title: Simmer the rice in milk
simmer-rice-rice-pudding-with-cherries.description: Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and the porridge is thick, about 20-25 minutes.

add-seasonings-rice-pudding-with-cherrie.title: Add cream and seasonings
add-seasonings-rice-pudding-with-cherrie.description: Pour in the light cream, then add the salt, remaining sugar, and vanilla sugar. Stir to combine.

heat-rice-pudding-rice-pudding-with-cher.title: Heat the pudding
heat-rice-pudding-rice-pudding-with-cher.description: Warm the porridge over low heat for 1-2 minutes, stirring gently, until everything is well incorporated and heated through. Remove from heat.

soak-rice-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.title: Soak the rice
soak-rice-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.description: Pour 1 cup of boiling water over the rice and let it sit for 1 hour to soften.

cook-rice-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.title: Cook the rice
cook-rice-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.description: Transfer the rice and its soaking water to a saucepan. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes.

add-milk-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.title: Add milk and bring to a boil
add-milk-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.description: Pour the milk into the saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil.

simmer-pudding-rice-pudding-with-cinnamo.title: Simmer with sugar and vanilla
simmer-pudding-rice-pudding-with-cinnamo.description: Add sugar and vanilla to the pan. Cook on the lowest heat with the lid slightly open, stirring occasionally, for about 30 minutes.

dissolve-starch-rice-pudding-with-cinnam.title: Dissolve the cornstarch
dissolve-starch-rice-pudding-with-cinnam.description: In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in 50 ml of cold water until smooth.

add-starch-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.title: Thicken the pudding
add-starch-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.description: Pour the cornstarch mixture into the milk-rice pudding in a thin stream while stirring continuously. Cook for another 3 minutes, stirring gently.

cool-pudding-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.title: Cool the pudding
cool-pudding-rice-pudding-with-cinnamon.description: Divide the pudding into serving bowls and let it cool completely at room temperature.

sprinkle-and-refrigerate-rice-pudding-wi.title: Sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate
sprinkle-and-refrigerate-rice-pudding-wi.description: Sprinkle ground cinnamon over each pudding, then refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours until fully chilled and set.

mix-dry-ingredients-ricotta-pancakes-ber.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-ricotta-pancakes-ber.description: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.

melt-butter-ricotta-pancakes-berry-butte.title: Melt butter in microwave
melt-butter-ricotta-pancakes-berry-butte.description: Place 10 g of butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Melt it in short 10-second bursts until just melted, then let it cool slightly.

beat-eggs-sugar-ricotta-pancakes-berry-b.title: Beat eggs with sugar
beat-eggs-sugar-ricotta-pancakes-berry-b.description: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with sugar until light and frothy.

add-wet-ingredients-ricotta-pancakes-ber.title: Add wet ingredients to eggs
add-wet-ingredients-ricotta-pancakes-ber.description: Add the vanilla extract, cooled melted butter, milk, and ricotta to the egg mixture. Stir until well combined.

combine-batter-ricotta-pancakes-berry-bu.title: Combine dry and wet mixtures
combine-batter-ricotta-pancakes-berry-bu.description: Pour the dry ingredients into the egg mixture and mix until a thick batter forms. The batter should resemble thick sour cream.

rest-batter-ricotta-pancakes-berry-butte.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-ricotta-pancakes-berry-butte.description: Let the batter rest for 10 minutes. This allows the baking powder to activate and results in fluffier pancakes.

heat-pan-ricotta-pancakes-berry-butter.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-ricotta-pancakes-berry-butter.description: Place a frying pan over medium heat and grease the bottom lightly with a little vegetable oil.

cook-first-side-ricotta-pancakes-berry-b.title: Cook first side of pancakes
cook-first-side-ricotta-pancakes-berry-b.description: Scoop about 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake onto the hot pan. Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface.

flip-cook-second-side-ricotta-pancakes-b.title: Flip and cook second side
flip-cook-second-side-ricotta-pancakes-b.description: Carefully flip the pancakes and cook for another 2 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.

make-berry-butter-ricotta-pancakes-berry.title: Make berry butter
make-berry-butter-ricotta-pancakes-berry.description: In a clean bowl, beat the softened 50 g butter with the blueberry jam until smooth and evenly combined.

melt-butter-mix-cocoa-royal-cheesecake.title: Melt butter and mix with cocoa
melt-butter-mix-cocoa-royal-cheesecake.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and melt it in the microwave or on the stove. Add the cocoa powder and stir until well combined.

mix-and-knead-dough-royal-cheesecake.title: Make the chocolate dough
mix-and-knead-dough-royal-cheesecake.description: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and baking powder. Add the sour cream and the melted butter-cocoa mixture. Knead until a soft, uniform dough forms. Cover with a towel and set aside.

blend-filling-royal-cheesecake.title: Blend the curd filling
blend-filling-royal-cheesecake.description: In a blender, combine the tvorog, eggs, cornstarch, and boiled condensed milk. Blend until smooth and homogeneous.

press-dough-into-dish-royal-cheesecake.title: Divide and press dough into dish
press-dough-into-dish-royal-cheesecake.description: Cut off about one-third of the dough for the topping. Press the remaining dough into a baking dish, forming sides about 3 cm high.

spread-filling-royal-cheesecake.title: Spread the filling
spread-filling-royal-cheesecake.description: Pour the curd filling over the dough base and spread evenly.

grate-dough-topping-royal-cheesecake.title: Grate dough topping
grate-dough-topping-royal-cheesecake.description: Grate the reserved piece of dough over the filling to create a decorative top.

bake-cheesecake-royal-cheesecake.title: Bake the cheesecake
