bake-cheesecake-royal-cheesecake.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the cheesecake for 40–45 minutes, until set and lightly golden. If the top browns too quickly, move the pan to a lower rack or cover with foil.

cool-cheesecake-royal-cheesecake.title: Cool the cheesecake
cool-cheesecake-royal-cheesecake.description: Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool completely in the pan before serving.

season-chicken-royal-shawarma.title: Season the chicken
season-chicken-royal-shawarma.description: Pat the chicken breast dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with salt, khmeli-suneli, black pepper, and paprika. Rub the spices into the meat with your fingers, then drizzle with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil.

fry-chicken-royal-shawarma.title: Fry the chicken
fry-chicken-royal-shawarma.description: Heat a well-oiled skillet over high heat. Place the seasoned chicken in the pan and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Transfer to a plate.

cut-chicken-royal-shawarma.title: Cut the chicken into cubes
cut-chicken-royal-shawarma.description: Let the chicken cool slightly, then cut it into small bite-sized cubes.

make-sauce-royal-shawarma.title: Make the sauce
make-sauce-royal-shawarma.description: In a bowl, mix together sour cream and mayonnaise. Finely grate the hard cheese and add it to the mixture. Press or mince the garlic cloves, chop the fresh herbs, and add them along with the remaining salt and khmeli-suneli. Stir everything thoroughly.

cut-vegetables-royal-shawarma.title: Cut the vegetables
cut-vegetables-royal-shawarma.description: Slice the cucumber into thin strips and dice the tomato into small cubes.

layer-ingredients-royal-shawarma.title: Layer the ingredients on the lavash
layer-ingredients-royal-shawarma.description: Lay the thin lavash flat on your work surface. Place lettuce leaves along one edge, then top with the cubed chicken. Pour the prepared sauce over the chicken, and spread the cucumber strips, tomato cubes, and Korean-style carrots on top.

roll-and-bread-shawarma-royal-shawarma.title: Roll and bread the shawarma
roll-and-bread-shawarma-royal-shawarma.description: Fold the bottom and top edges of the lavash over the filling to prevent spillage. Roll it up tightly into a compact cylinder. Beat the egg in a shallow bowl, and pour breadcrumbs onto a plate. Dip the rolled shawarma in the egg, coating all sides, then roll it in the breadcrumbs to cover evenly.

fry-shawarma-royal-shawarma.title: Fry the shawarma until golden
fry-shawarma-royal-shawarma.description: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place the breaded shawarma in the pan and fry, turning occasionally, until the crust is golden and crispy, about 4 minutes.

beat-egg-sugar-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Beat egg with sugar
beat-egg-sugar-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Break the egg into a bowl, add sugar. Beat with a mixer on medium speed for 2–3 minutes until light and fluffy.

add-ryazhenka-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Add ryazhenka
add-ryazhenka-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Continue beating while pouring in the ryazhenka. Mix until the mixture is smooth and homogeneous.

combine-dry-wet-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Combine dry and wet ingredients
combine-dry-wet-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Sift the flour into a clean bowl. Mix in the salt and baking powder. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth.

rest-dough-first-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Rest dough
rest-dough-first-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Cover the bowl with a clean cloth and let the dough rest in a warm place for 20 minutes.

add-baking-soda-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Add baking soda and rest again
add-baking-soda-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Add the baking soda to the dough, stir well. Cover and let rest in a warm place for another 10 minutes.

heat-pan-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Brush a frying pan with a small amount of oil and heat it over medium heat until hot.

fry-pancakes-ryazhenka-pancakes.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-ryazhenka-pancakes.description: Scoop portions of the batter onto the hot pan, forming round pancakes about 6–7 cm in diameter. Fry for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. Transfer cooked pancakes to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.

mix-dry-ingredients-rye-pancakes-with-sa.title: Mix the dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-rye-pancakes-with-sa.description: In a bowl, combine the rye flour, wheat flour, and baking soda. Stir them together with a whisk or spoon until evenly distributed.

heat-kefir-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.title: Warm the kefir
heat-kefir-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.description: Place the kefir in a microwave-safe bowl and heat it on high for about 30 seconds until it is just warm to the touch. Do not let it boil.

whisk-eggs-sugar-kefir-oil-rye-pancakes-.title: Whisk eggs, sugar, kefir, and oil
whisk-eggs-sugar-kefir-oil-rye-pancakes-.description: In a separate bowl, crack the eggs and add the sugar. Whisk until the sugar is completely dissolved. Then pour in the warmed kefir and the vegetable oil and whisk again until smooth.

add-dry-mixture-gradually-rye-pancakes-w.title: Gradually add the dry mixture
add-dry-mixture-gradually-rye-pancakes-w.description: Slowly sift or sprinkle the dry flour mixture into the wet ingredients while whisking continuously. Make sure there are no lumps. The batter should be thick and smooth, about the consistency of sour cream.

add-hot-water-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.title: Add hot water and mix
add-hot-water-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.description: Pour hot (not boiling) water into the batter and stir quickly. The batter will thin out slightly.

rest-batter-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.description: Let the batter stand at room temperature for 10 minutes. This allows the gluten to relax and the baking soda to activate.

heat-pan-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.title: Heat the pan
heat-pan-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.description: Place a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and let it warm up for about 2 minutes before adding the batter.

fry-pancakes-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.description: Pour about three-quarters of a ladle of batter into the hot pan and tilt to spread it into a thin, even circle. Cook for 1–2 minutes per side until golden brown. Repeat with the remaining batter, stacking the finished pancakes on a plate.

slice-salmon-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.title: Slice the salmon
slice-salmon-rye-pancakes-with-salmon.description: Cut the red fish (salmon) into thin, even slices. Set aside.

assemble-pancakes-rye-pancakes-with-salm.title: Assemble the pancakes
assemble-pancakes-rye-pancakes-with-salm.description: Spread a generous layer of cream cheese over each pancake. Place a few slices of salmon near one edge, then roll the pancake tightly into a log. Serve immediately or cut into pieces.

chop-herbs-and-mix-filling-salmon-in-kat.title: Chop herbs and mix filling
chop-herbs-and-mix-filling-salmon-in-kat.description: Remove the herb leaves from stems and chop finely. Add to cream cheese and mix well.

divide-filling-into-portions-salmon-in-k.title: Divide filling into portions
divide-filling-into-portions-salmon-in-k.description: Divide the cream cheese mixture into 5 equal portions.

lay-salmon-and-add-filling-salmon-in-kat.title: Lay salmon and add filling
lay-salmon-and-add-filling-salmon-in-kat.description: Lay out the salmon slices on a work surface. Place a portion of filling on each slice.

roll-salmon-rolls-salmon-in-kataifi-doug.title: Roll salmon rolls
roll-salmon-rolls-salmon-in-kataifi-doug.description: Roll each salmon slice into a tight roll.

wrap-rolls-with-kataifi-dough-salmon-in-.title: Wrap rolls with kataifi dough
wrap-rolls-with-kataifi-dough-salmon-in-.description: Divide the kataifi dough into 5 parts. Wrap each roll completely with the dough.

place-rolls-on-baking-sheet-salmon-in-ka.title: Place rolls on baking sheet
place-rolls-on-baking-sheet-salmon-in-ka.description: Place the wrapped rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

bake-rolls-salmon-in-kataifi-dough.title: Bake rolls
bake-rolls-salmon-in-kataifi-dough.description: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10–15 minutes, until golden and crispy.

heat-water-sandwich-buns.title: Heat the water
heat-water-sandwich-buns.description: Heat the water until it is warm but not hot.

dissolve-yeast-sandwich-buns.title: Dissolve sugar and yeast
dissolve-yeast-sandwich-buns.description: Dissolve the sugar and dry yeast in the warm water.

leave-sponge-sandwich-buns.title: Let the sponge rest
leave-sponge-sandwich-buns.description: Leave the sponge at room temperature for 15 minutes until the yeast activates.

mix-flour-salt-sandwich-buns.title: Mix flour and salt
mix-flour-salt-sandwich-buns.description: In a separate bowl, mix the flour with salt.

add-flour-to-sponge-sandwich-buns.title: Add flour mixture to sponge
add-flour-to-sponge-sandwich-buns.description: Gradually add the flour mixture to the sponge, stirring to prevent lumps.

melt-butter-sandwich-buns.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-sandwich-buns.description: Melt the butter in the microwave.

knead-dough-sandwich-buns.title: Knead the dough
knead-dough-sandwich-buns.description: Pour the melted butter into the dough and knead thoroughly until smooth.

let-dough-rise-sandwich-buns.title: Let the dough rise
let-dough-rise-sandwich-buns.description: Shape the dough into a ball, place in a greased bowl, cover with a towel, and let rise in a warm place for 40–50 minutes.

line-baking-tray-sandwich-buns.title: Line the baking tray
line-baking-tray-sandwich-buns.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper and grease it with the remaining sunflower oil.

shape-buns-sandwich-buns.title: Shape the buns
shape-buns-sandwich-buns.description: Divide the dough into equal pieces and shape them into balls. Place them on the prepared tray, spaced apart.

brush-buns-sandwich-buns.title: Brush with egg yolk and sesame
brush-buns-sandwich-buns.description: Brush the buns with beaten egg yolk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

proof-buns-sandwich-buns.title: Let the buns proof
proof-buns-sandwich-buns.description: Leave the buns to proof at room temperature for 15 minutes.

bake-buns-sandwich-buns.title: Bake the buns
bake-buns-sandwich-buns.description: Bake the buns in the preheated oven for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.

saute-spinach-sandwich-with-tuna-and-spi.title: Sauté the spinach
saute-spinach-sandwich-with-tuna-and-spi.description: Heat 1 tsp of butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the spinach and sauté for 2-3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and let cool slightly.

prepare-tuna-and-cheese-sandwich-with-tu.title: Prepare the tuna, cheese, and onion
prepare-tuna-and-cheese-sandwich-with-tu.description: In a bowl, mash the tuna with a fork. Grate the semi-hard cheese coarsely. Finely chop the green onion.

mix-filling-sandwich-with-tuna-and-spina.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-sandwich-with-tuna-and-spina.description: Add the sautéed spinach, cream cheese, mustard, yogurt, chopped green onion, salt, and dried garlic to the tuna. Mix until well combined.

assemble-sandwich-sandwich-with-tuna-and.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwich-sandwich-with-tuna-and.description: Place the grated cheese on two slices of bread. Top each with a generous spoonful of the tuna-spinach filling. Cover with the remaining bread slices and press lightly.

fry-sandwich-sandwich-with-tuna-and-spin.title: Fry the sandwiches
fry-sandwich-sandwich-with-tuna-and-spin.description: Heat the remaining butter in the skillet over medium heat. Fry the sandwiches on both sides until golden and crispy, about 2-3 minutes total.

mix-filling-sandwiches-with-canned-salmo.title: Mix the fish filling
mix-filling-sandwiches-with-canned-salmo.description: Place the canned salmon in a bowl and mash it with a fork. Squeeze the lemon juice over it. Add 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise, soy sauce, ginger, and sugar. Mix everything well.

chop-vegetables-sandwiches-with-canned-s.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-sandwiches-with-canned-s.description: Finely chop the celery stalk and green onions. Add them to the fish mixture and stir again.

make-wasabi-spread-sandwiches-with-canne.title: Make the wasabi spread
make-wasabi-spread-sandwiches-with-canne.description: In a clean bowl, mix the remaining mayonnaise with the wasabi until smooth.

toast-bread-sandwiches-with-canned-salmo.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-sandwiches-with-canned-salmo.description: Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Brush the bread slices with vegetable oil. Toast them for 1–2 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove from the pan.

assemble-sandwiches-sandwiches-with-cann.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-sandwiches-with-cann.description: Spread the wasabi mayonnaise on one side of all bread slices. Place a lettuce leaf on 4 slices. Divide the fish mixture evenly among them. Cover with the remaining bread slices, spread side down.

cut-lavash-sausage-lavash-rolls.title: Cut the lavash into strips
cut-lavash-sausage-lavash-rolls.description: Cut the lavash into strips as wide as the sausages. You will need one strip per sausage.

place-sauce-sausage-lavash-rolls.title: Place ketchup and mayonnaise on each strip
place-sauce-sausage-lavash-rolls.description: Place 1 teaspoon of ketchup and 1 teaspoon of mayonnaise in the center of each lavash strip.

spread-sauce-sausage-lavash-rolls.title: Spread the sauce
spread-sauce-sausage-lavash-rolls.description: Using a silicone brush or spoon, spread the ketchup and mayonnaise evenly over the entire surface of the lavash strip.

grate-cheese-sausage-lavash-rolls.title: Grate and sprinkle cheese
grate-cheese-sausage-lavash-rolls.description: Grate the cheese and sprinkle it evenly over the lavash strip, leaving a 1 cm border.

roll-sausage-sausage-lavash-rolls.title: Roll up the sausage in lavash
roll-sausage-sausage-lavash-rolls.description: Place a sausage on the edge of the strip and roll it tightly. Repeat for all sausages.

fry-rolls-sausage-lavash-rolls.title: Fry the lavash rolls
fry-rolls-sausage-lavash-rolls.description: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry the lavash rolls for 1–2 minutes on each side until golden and crispy.

cut-lavash-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.title: Cut the lavash
cut-lavash-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.description: Cut the lavash into 3 strips lengthwise, roughly the same length as the sausages.

grate-mozzarella-sausages-in-lavash-air-.title: Grate the mozzarella
grate-mozzarella-sausages-in-lavash-air-.description: Grate the mozzarella cheese on a coarse grater.

place-filling-sausages-in-lavash-air-fry.title: Place the filling
place-filling-sausages-in-lavash-air-fry.description: Place one sausage on one end of a lavash strip and add a portion of the grated cheese next to it.

roll-lavash-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.title: Roll the lavash
roll-lavash-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.description: Roll the lavash tightly around the sausage and cheese to form a neat roll.

repeat-rolling-sausages-in-lavash-air-fr.title: Repeat with remaining strips
repeat-rolling-sausages-in-lavash-air-fr.description: Repeat the filling and rolling process with the remaining lavash strips and sausages.

mix-egg-coating-sausages-in-lavash-air-f.title: Mix the egg coating
mix-egg-coating-sausages-in-lavash-air-f.description: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and smoked paprika until well combined.

dip-rolls-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.title: Dip the rolls
dip-rolls-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.description: Dip each rolled lavash into the egg mixture, turning to coat all sides.

coat-rolls-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.title: Coat in tempura flakes
coat-rolls-sausages-in-lavash-air-fryer.description: Roll the dipped rolls in tempura flakes until evenly covered.

place-on-rack-sausages-in-lavash-air-fry.title: Place on the air fryer rack
place-on-rack-sausages-in-lavash-air-fry.description: Arrange the coated rolls on the air fryer rack, leaving space between them.

air-fry-rolls-sausages-in-lavash-air-fry.title: Air fry the rolls
air-fry-rolls-sausages-in-lavash-air-fry.description: Set the air fryer to the 'French fries' mode and cook for 10 minutes until golden and crispy.

blanch-vegetables-savory-veggie-muffins.title: Blanch the vegetables
blanch-vegetables-savory-veggie-muffins.description: Bring 1-1.5 liters of water to a boil in a pot. Add half of the salt, then add the frozen vegetable mix. Boil for 2-3 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water.

heat-kefir-savory-veggie-muffins.title: Heat the kefir
heat-kefir-savory-veggie-muffins.description: Pour the kefir into a microwave-safe bowl and heat it for 40-50 seconds until warm.

mix-dough-savory-veggie-muffins.title: Mix the dough
mix-dough-savory-veggie-muffins.description: Add the remaining salt and baking powder to the warm kefir and whisk until frothy. In a separate bowl, mash the cottage cheese with the eggs. Pour in the kefir mixture and stir well. Add the flour and mix until a thick dough forms.

prepare-vegetables-savory-veggie-muffins.title: Prepare and combine the vegetables
prepare-vegetables-savory-veggie-muffins.description: Pat the blanched vegetables dry with paper towels. Cut any large pieces into 1 cm cubes. Add the vegetables, smoked paprika, black pepper, and ground coriander to the dough. Gently mix until evenly combined.

bake-muffins-savory-veggie-muffins.title: Bake the muffins
bake-muffins-savory-veggie-muffins.description: Grease muffin tins with vegetable oil. Divide the dough evenly among the tins. Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

dice-bacon-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Dice the bacon
dice-bacon-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Cut the bacon into small pieces.

fry-bacon-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Fry the bacon
fry-bacon-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Place the bacon in a dry skillet over medium heat and cook for about 5 minutes until crispy and golden. Stir occasionally.

drain-bacon-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Drain the bacon
drain-bacon-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Transfer the cooked bacon to a paper towel-lined plate to remove excess fat.

dice-apple-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Dice the apple
dice-apple-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Cut the apple into small cubes.

mix-dry-ingredients-scones-with-bacon-an.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-scones-with-bacon-an.description: In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, and black pepper.

cut-butter-into-flour-scones-with-bacon-.title: Cut butter into flour
cut-butter-into-flour-scones-with-bacon-.description: Grate the cold butter into the dry mixture and use forks or a pastry cutter to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

mix-wet-and-dry-scones-with-bacon-and-ap.title: Mix wet and dry ingredients
mix-wet-and-dry-scones-with-bacon-and-ap.description: Add the diced apple, bacon, grated cheese, chopped rosemary, and heavy cream to the bowl. Stir a few times until the dough comes together into a ball. Do not overmix.

roll-dough-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Roll out the dough
roll-dough-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of 2 cm (about 3/4 inch).

cut-dough-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Cut out scones
cut-dough-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Use a round cutter to cut out scones from the dough. Gather scraps and re-roll if needed.

place-on-tray-scones-with-bacon-and-appl.title: Place on baking tray
place-on-tray-scones-with-bacon-and-appl.description: Transfer the cut scones to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, spacing them slightly apart.

bake-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.title: Bake the scones
bake-scones-with-bacon-and-apple.description: Bake in the preheated oven at 190°C for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown and risen. Let cool slightly before serving.

prep-ingredients-scrambled-egg-and-bacon.title: Prep ingredients
prep-ingredients-scrambled-egg-and-bacon.description: Slice the shallots into half rings. Dice the bacon into 1 cm cubes. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add salt and pepper, and whisk with a fork until well combined.

prepare-coffee-scrambled-egg-and-bacon-j.title: Prepare coffee
prepare-coffee-scrambled-egg-and-bacon-j.description: Put ground coffee into a cezve and pour in water. Set over medium heat and wait until foam rises. Remove from heat for 20–30 seconds to let the foam subside. Return to heat and bring to the first signs of boiling again, then remove and let cool.

cook-bacon-scrambled-egg-and-bacon-jam-t.title: Cook bacon
cook-bacon-scrambled-egg-and-bacon-jam-t.description: Heat a dry frying pan over high heat, then reduce to medium. Add the bacon cubes and fry, stirring often, for about 10 minutes until the fat renders and the bacon is crispy. Transfer the bacon to a plate.

caramelize-shallots-scrambled-egg-and-ba.title: Caramelize shallots
caramelize-shallots-scrambled-egg-and-ba.description: Add the sliced shallots to the bacon fat in the pan. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 20–25 minutes until the shallots are dark and caramelized.

simmer-bacon-jam-scrambled-egg-and-bacon.title: Simmer bacon jam
simmer-bacon-jam-scrambled-egg-and-bacon.description: Return the cooked bacon to the pan with the shallots. Pour in maple syrup, apple cider vinegar, and the prepared coffee. Add sugar and chili flakes. Stir well. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil, then reduce to low and simmer for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the jam thickens. Remove from heat and let cool until warm.

cook-scrambled-eggs-scrambled-egg-and-ba.title: Cook scrambled eggs
cook-scrambled-eggs-scrambled-egg-and-ba.description: Place 20 g (for the whole recipe, adjust for your serving) of butter in the pan and melt over medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and let it set for 5–7 seconds. Stir continuously from the center to the edges for 3–4 minutes until the eggs are just set but still soft. Remove from heat, let rest for 2–3 seconds, then transfer to a plate. Wipe the pan clean with paper towels.

toast-bread-scrambled-egg-and-bacon-jam-.title: Toast bread
toast-bread-scrambled-egg-and-bacon-jam-.description: Return the cleaned pan to medium heat and melt the remaining butter. Add the bread slices and toast for 1–2 minutes per side until golden brown. Arrange the toast on a serving plate.

roll-pastry-sea-shell-snack.title: Roll out the pastry
roll-pastry-sea-shell-snack.description: Dust your work surface with flour and roll the puff pastry into a 5 mm thick sheet.

cut-pastry-circles-sea-shell-snack.title: Cut out circles
cut-pastry-circles-sea-shell-snack.description: Use a cookie cutter to cut 9 identical circles from the pastry sheet.

fold-pastry-circles-sea-shell-snack.title: Fold the circles
fold-pastry-circles-sea-shell-snack.description: Fold one edge of each circle toward the center to create a small pillow shape.

score-pastry-circles-sea-shell-snack.title: Score the folded edge
score-pastry-circles-sea-shell-snack.description: Use the back of a knife to make crosswise lines on the folded part of each circle.

place-and-brush-pastry-sea-shell-snack.title: Arrange and brush with egg
place-and-brush-pastry-sea-shell-snack.description: Place the pastry shells on a parchment-lined baking sheet and brush them with beaten egg.

bake-pastry-shells-sea-shell-snack.title: Bake the pastry shells
bake-pastry-shells-sea-shell-snack.description: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden. Then remove and let cool completely.

dice-pickles-sea-shell-snack.title: Dice the pickled cucumbers
dice-pickles-sea-shell-snack.description: Finely dice the pickled cucumbers into small cubes.

mix-tuna-filling-sea-shell-snack.title: Mix the tuna filling
mix-tuna-filling-sea-shell-snack.description: Combine the diced pickles with canned tuna, add mayonnaise, salt, and pepper, and mix everything thoroughly.

boil-quail-eggs-sea-shell-snack.title: Boil the quail eggs
boil-quail-eggs-sea-shell-snack.description: Place the quail eggs in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil over medium heat, and cook for 4–5 minutes. Do not overcook.

cool-and-peel-quail-eggs-sea-shell-snack.title: Cool and peel the eggs
cool-and-peel-quail-eggs-sea-shell-snack.description: Transfer the boiled eggs to ice water, let them cool, then peel carefully.

cut-pastry-shells-sea-shell-snack.title: Cut the pastry shells
cut-pastry-shells-sea-shell-snack.description: Slice each baked pastry shell lengthwise, leaving 1–2 cm attached to create an opening.

fill-pastry-shells-sea-shell-snack.title: Fill and top the shells
fill-pastry-shells-sea-shell-snack.description: Spoon the tuna mixture into each shell, spread it evenly, and place a peeled quail egg on top.

chop-vegetables-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Chop the vegetables and bacon
chop-vegetables-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Finely dice the tomatoes and bell pepper. Mince the onion and garlic. Chop the streaky bacon into small pieces.

fry-bacon-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Fry the bacon
fry-bacon-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Heat a frying pan over high heat. Add the bacon and fry for 2-3 minutes until the fat renders and the bacon is crispy. Transfer the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels.

toast-spices-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Toast the spices
toast-spices-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Reduce the heat to medium. Add the paprika and cumin to the pan and stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

saute-onion-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Sauté the onion
saute-onion-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.

saute-garlic-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Sauté the garlic
saute-garlic-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.

saute-bell-pepper-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Sauté the bell pepper
saute-bell-pepper-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Add the diced bell pepper to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.

stew-tomatoes-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Stew the tomatoes
stew-tomatoes-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Add the diced tomatoes to the pan, stir well, cover, and let simmer for 7 minutes until the tomatoes are soft. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

add-bacon-and-eggs-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Add bacon and eggs
add-bacon-and-eggs-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Return the cooked bacon to the pan and stir to combine. Make three indentations in the mixture and crack an egg into each well.

cook-eggs-shakshuka-with-bacon.title: Cook the eggs
cook-eggs-shakshuka-with-bacon.description: Cover the pan, ensure the heat is low, and cook for about 5 minutes until the egg whites are set but the yolks remain runny. Be careful not to overcook the yolks.

chop-onion-garlic-shakshuka-with-tomatoe.title: Chop onion and garlic
chop-onion-garlic-shakshuka-with-tomatoe.description: Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves. This step is preparation for sautéing.

saute-onion-garlic-shakshuka-with-tomato.title: Sauté onion and garlic
saute-onion-garlic-shakshuka-with-tomato.description: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and garlic, season with salt, pepper, and spices, and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.

grate-tomatoes-add-shakshuka-with-tomato.title: Grate tomatoes and add to skillet
grate-tomatoes-add-shakshuka-with-tomato.description: Grate the tomatoes on a coarse grater directly into the skillet with the sautéed vegetables. Stir well to combine.

crack-eggs-shakshuka-with-tomatoes-and-h.title: Crack eggs into the sauce
crack-eggs-shakshuka-with-tomatoes-and-h.description: Carefully crack the eggs into the skillet, placing them directly onto the tomato sauce. Try not to break the yolks.

chop-feta-place-shakshuka-with-tomatoes-.title: Chop feta and arrange over eggs
chop-feta-place-shakshuka-with-tomatoes-.description: Cut the feta cheese into small cubes and scatter them evenly over the eggs.

cover-simmer-shakshuka-with-tomatoes-and.title: Cover and simmer
cover-simmer-shakshuka-with-tomatoes-and.description: Cover the skillet with a lid and reduce the heat to low. Let the shakshuka simmer for 10 minutes, until the eggs are cooked to your liking.

chop-herbs-garnish-shakshuka-with-tomato.title: Chop herbs and garnish
chop-herbs-garnish-shakshuka-with-tomato.description: Finely chop the fresh herbs and lettuce leaves. Sprinkle the mixture over the finished shakshuka before serving.

chop-vegetables-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.description: Finely chop the mushrooms and onion into small pieces.

heat-oil-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribami.title: Heat the oil
heat-oil-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribami.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.

fry-onion-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribam.title: Fry the onion
fry-onion-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribam.description: Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3 minutes until softened.

fry-mushrooms-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gr.title: Fry the mushrooms
fry-mushrooms-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gr.description: Add the mushrooms and cook for 5–7 minutes until golden brown.

season-mushrooms-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i.title: Season the mushrooms
season-mushrooms-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i.description: Season the mushroom mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.

mix-pate-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribami.title: Mix with pâté
mix-pate-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribami.description: Let the mushrooms cool slightly, then add the meat pâté and stir to combine.

cut-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-griba.title: Cut the phyllo dough
cut-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-griba.description: Cut a strip of phyllo dough 15 cm wide and 17 cm long. Keep the remaining dough covered with a damp towel to prevent drying.

cover-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gri.title: Cover remaining phyllo
cover-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gri.description: Cover the unused phyllo with a damp kitchen towel to keep it moist.

separate-sheets-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.title: Separate three sheets
separate-sheets-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.description: Gently separate three sheets of phyllo from the cut strip.

layer-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gri.title: Layer the phyllo
layer-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gri.description: Brush the first sheet with oil, cover with the second sheet, brush again, and place the third sheet on top.

fill-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-grib.title: Fill the phyllo
fill-phyllo-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-grib.description: Place the mushroom-pâté filling in the center of the layered phyllo, leaving 1–2 cm of space around the edges.

roll-sigarilla-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-g.title: Roll the sigarilla
roll-sigarilla-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-g.description: Fold in the edges and roll the phyllo tightly into a cigar shape.

repeat-assembly-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.title: Repeat with remaining dough
repeat-assembly-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.description: Repeat the layering, filling, and rolling process with the remaining phyllo dough and filling.

arrange-sigarillas-sigarilly-s-pashtetom.title: Arrange on baking sheet
arrange-sigarillas-sigarilly-s-pashtetom.description: Place the rolled sigarillas on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.

brush-egg-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribam.title: Brush with egg
brush-egg-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gribam.description: Brush the tops of the sigarillas with beaten egg.

sprinkle-sesame-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.title: Sprinkle sesame seeds
sprinkle-sesame-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.description: Sprinkle sesame seeds over the egg-washed sigarillas.

bake-sigarillas-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.title: Bake the sigarillas
bake-sigarillas-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-.description: Bake in the preheated oven for 20–25 minutes until golden and crispy.

cut-cheese-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-griba.title: Cut the blue cheese
cut-cheese-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-griba.description: Cut the blue cheese into small cubes.

combine-cheese-yogurt-sigarilly-s-pashte.title: Combine cheese, yogurt, and sour cream
combine-cheese-yogurt-sigarilly-s-pashte.description: Place the cheese cubes in a bowl, add Greek yogurt and sour cream.

blend-sauce-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-grib.title: Blend until creamy
blend-sauce-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-grib.description: Blend the mixture with an immersion blender until smooth and creamy.

add-mustard-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-grib.title: Add mustard
add-mustard-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-grib.description: Stir in the whole-grain mustard with a spoon.

whip-cream-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-griba.title: Whip the cream
whip-cream-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-griba.description: In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until it thickens.

combine-cream-sauce-sigarilly-s-pashteto.title: Combine cream with cheese mixture
combine-cream-sauce-sigarilly-s-pashteto.description: Fold the whipped cream into the cheese mixture until well combined.

garnish-sauce-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gr.title: Garnish the sauce
garnish-sauce-sigarilly-s-pashtetom-i-gr.description: Before serving, sprinkle the sauce with chili flakes, paprika, and chopped cilantro.

cut-bananas-smoothie-with-banana-and-cra.title: Cut the bananas
cut-bananas-smoothie-with-banana-and-cra.description: Cut the bananas into large rounds and place them in the blender.

add-cranberries-honey-smoothie-with-bana.title: Add cranberries and honey
add-cranberries-honey-smoothie-with-bana.description: Add the cranberries and honey to the blender.

add-kefir-smoothie-with-banana-and-cranb.title: Pour in the kefir
add-kefir-smoothie-with-banana-and-cranb.description: Pour the kefir into the blender.

blend-smoothie-with-banana-and-cranberry.title: Blend the smoothie
blend-smoothie-with-banana-and-cranberry.description: Blend the ingredients on medium speed for 2–3 minutes until smooth with small cranberry pieces.

serve-smoothie-with-banana-and-cranberry.title: Serve the smoothie
serve-smoothie-with-banana-and-cranberry.description: Pour the smoothie into glasses, add cocktail straws, and serve immediately.

chop-thyme-garlic-snack-butter-with-must.title: Chop thyme and garlic
chop-thyme-garlic-snack-butter-with-must.description: Remove the thyme leaves from the stems and finely chop them. Finely grate the garlic or press it through a garlic press.

heat-honey-mix-butter-snack-butter-with-.title: Heat honey and mix with butter and mustards
heat-honey-mix-butter-snack-butter-with-.description: Warm the honey in the microwave for 10–15 seconds until it is warm but not hot. Add it to the softened butter along with both types of mustard. Stir until well combined and smooth.

add-seasonings-mix-snack-butter-with-mus.title: Add seasonings and mix
add-seasonings-mix-snack-butter-with-mus.description: Add the chopped thyme, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the butter mixture. Stir again until all ingredients are evenly distributed.

store-refrigerate-snack-butter-with-must.title: Store and refrigerate
store-refrigerate-snack-butter-with-must.description: Transfer the flavored butter into a storage jar, close the lid, and place it in the refrigerator for 24 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

butter-bread-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Butter the bread
butter-bread-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: Spread butter on both sides of each bread slice. This ensures even browning and adds flavor.

toast-bread-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: Place the buttered bread slices in a hot frying pan and toast until golden brown on both sides. Transfer to a clean plate.

fry-sausage-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Fry the sausage
fry-sausage-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: In the same pan, fry the sausage slices over medium heat until golden and slightly crispy on both sides.

place-sausage-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Place sausage on toast
place-sausage-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: Arrange the fried sausage slices evenly on top of one of the toasted bread slices.

layer-cheese-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Layer the cheese
layer-cheese-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: Immediately place slices of processed cheese on top of the hot sausage. Press gently and let the residual heat melt the cheese slightly.

add-chips-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Add chips
add-chips-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: Place a layer of potato chips on top of the melted cheese.

cover-sandwich-snoop-dogg-sandwich.title: Cover and press
cover-sandwich-snoop-dogg-sandwich.description: Top with the second toasted bread slice and press lightly to hold the sandwich together. Serve immediately.

boil-egg-sockeye-forshmak.title: Boil the egg
boil-egg-sockeye-forshmak.description: Place the egg in a small saucepan and cover completely with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat and cook for 7-8 minutes. Transfer the egg to cold water, let it cool, then peel it.

soak-bread-sockeye-forshmak.title: Soak the bread
soak-bread-sockeye-forshmak.description: Soak the slice of bread in water for 2 minutes, then squeeze it out with your hands.

blend-ingredients-sockeye-forshmak.title: Blend the ingredients
blend-ingredients-sockeye-forshmak.description: Place the boiled egg, onion, salmon fillet, soaked bread, lemon juice, and olive oil into a blender. Blend until smooth.

mix-semolina-sour-cream-sour-cream-semol.title: Mix semolina with sour cream
mix-semolina-sour-cream-sour-cream-semol.description: In a bowl, combine the semolina and sour cream. Stir well until fully incorporated.

soak-semolina-sour-cream-semolina-cake.title: Let the semolina soak
soak-semolina-sour-cream-semolina-cake.description: Allow the semolina to sit in the sour cream for 15–20 minutes. During this time, the semolina will absorb the liquid and swell.

melt-butter-sour-cream-semolina-cake.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-sour-cream-semolina-cake.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Melt it in the microwave in 2–3 intervals of 20–30 seconds each, until fully melted.

preheat-oven-sour-cream-semolina-cake.title: Preheat the oven
preheat-oven-sour-cream-semolina-cake.description: Set your oven to preheat to 180°C (350°F). This ensures it is ready when you need to bake the cake.

beat-eggs-mixture-sour-cream-semolina-ca.title: Beat eggs with condensed milk and salt
beat-eggs-mixture-sour-cream-semolina-ca.description: Crack the eggs into a deep bowl. Add the condensed milk and salt. Beat with a mixer on medium speed for 2–3 minutes until the mixture is fluffy and homogeneous.

combine-dough-sour-cream-semolina-cake.title: Combine all ingredients into a dough
combine-dough-sour-cream-semolina-cake.description: Add the flour and baking powder to the egg mixture. Then add the melted butter and the soaked semolina. Mix with a mixer until smooth and well combined.

bake-cake-sour-cream-semolina-cake.title: Bake the cake
bake-cake-sour-cream-semolina-cake.description: Pour the batter into a greased or parchment-lined baking pan. Smooth the top. Bake in the preheated oven at 180°C for 40–45 minutes until the top is caramel-brown and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

cool-cake-sour-cream-semolina-cake.title: Cool and serve
cool-cake-sour-cream-semolina-cake.description: Let the cake cool in the pan for a few minutes, then carefully transfer it to a serving plate. Allow it to cool completely before slicing, or serve warm.

slice-vegetables-steamed-omelette-with-c.title: Slice the vegetables
slice-vegetables-steamed-omelette-with-c.description: Slice the shallot and fresh chili into thin half-rings, and cut the garlic into thin slices.

heat-oil-with-spices-steamed-omelette-wi.title: Heat oil and bloom spices
heat-oil-with-spices-steamed-omelette-wi.description: Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the chili flakes, smoked paprika, and cinnamon stick. Fry for 1 minute until fragrant.

cook-aromatics-in-oil-steamed-omelette-w.title: Cook aromatics in oil
cook-aromatics-in-oil-steamed-omelette-w.description: Add the sliced shallot, garlic, and fresh chili to the oil. Reduce heat to low and cook for 10–15 minutes until the vegetables are golden. Stir occasionally.

season-and-strain-oil-steamed-omelette-w.title: Season and strain the chili oil
season-and-strain-oil-steamed-omelette-w.description: Remove the saucepan from heat. Add soy sauce and a pinch of sugar, then stir. Strain the oil through a fine sieve or cheesecloth to remove spices and fried pieces.

heat-broth-steamed-omelette-with-chili-o.title: Heat the broth
heat-broth-steamed-omelette-with-chili-o.description: Heat the chicken broth in a small saucepan until it just begins to boil.

whisk-eggs-steamed-omelette-with-chili-o.title: Whisk the eggs
whisk-eggs-steamed-omelette-with-chili-o.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until homogeneous and smooth.

combine-broth-and-eggs-steamed-omelette-.title: Combine broth with eggs
combine-broth-and-eggs-steamed-omelette-.description: Slowly pour the hot broth into the whisked eggs in a thin stream while stirring continuously to prevent the eggs from curdling.

add-chili-oil-to-mixture-steamed-omelett.title: Add chili oil to the mixture
add-chili-oil-to-mixture-steamed-omelett.description: Add a portion of the prepared chili oil to the egg and broth mixture and stir gently.

strain-egg-mixture-steamed-omelette-with.title: Strain the egg mixture
strain-egg-mixture-steamed-omelette-with.description: Pass the mixture through a fine sieve to ensure a silky smooth texture.

pour-into-molds-steamed-omelette-with-ch.title: Pour into molds
pour-into-molds-steamed-omelette-with-ch.description: Divide the mixture among portion-sized molds, filling them about halfway.

steam-omelette-steamed-omelette-with-chi.title: Steam the omelette
steam-omelette-steamed-omelette-with-chi.description: Place the molds in a steamer or on a rack over a pot of boiling water. Cover and steam over low heat for 12–15 minutes until the custard is set.

cut-chicken-and-onion-stewed-cabbage-wit.title: Cut chicken and onion
cut-chicken-and-onion-stewed-cabbage-wit.description: Cut the chicken into small pieces. Slice the onion into half rings.

fry-chicken-and-onion-stewed-cabbage-wit.title: Fry chicken and onion
fry-chicken-and-onion-stewed-cabbage-wit.description: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and onion and fry, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.

prep-tomato-mushroom-apple-stewed-cabbag.title: Prep tomato, mushrooms, and apple
prep-tomato-mushroom-apple-stewed-cabbag.description: Finely chop the tomatoes and mushrooms. Peel the apple and grate it on a coarse grater.

stew-vegetables-stewed-cabbage-with-chic.title: Stew vegetables
stew-vegetables-stewed-cabbage-with-chic.description: Add the prepared tomato, mushrooms, and apple to the skillet. Reduce heat to low and stew for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.

add-cabbage-and-fry-stewed-cabbage-with-.title: Add cabbage and fry
add-cabbage-and-fry-stewed-cabbage-with-.description: Shred the cabbage and add it to the skillet. Season with salt and black pepper, mix well, and continue frying without a lid over medium heat.

mix-tomato-paste-with-milk-stewed-cabbag.title: Mix tomato paste with milk
mix-tomato-paste-with-milk-stewed-cabbag.description: In a small bowl, dilute the tomato paste with milk and stir until smooth.

simmer-covered-stewed-cabbage-with-chick.title: Simmer covered
simmer-covered-stewed-cabbage-with-chick.description: Pour the tomato-milk mixture into the skillet over the vegetables and chicken. Cover with a lid and simmer on low heat until all ingredients are tender, about 20-25 minutes.

mix-oat-flakes-strawberry-oat-pancake-wi.title: Mix oat flakes into egg whites
mix-oat-flakes-strawberry-oat-pancake-wi.description: Sprinkle the oat flakes over the egg whites and stir gently until combined.

mash-banana-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-.title: Mash half a banana
mash-banana-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-.description: Take half of the banana and mash it with a fork until smooth. Add it to the oat mixture.

add-milk-whisk-strawberry-oat-pancake-wi.title: Add milk and whisk
add-milk-whisk-strawberry-oat-pancake-wi.description: Pour in the milk and whisk with a hand whisk or mixer until the batter is smooth and homogeneous.

add-spices-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-b.title: Add cinnamon and vanilla
add-spices-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-b.description: Add the ground cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well to incorporate the spices evenly.

rest-batter-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-.title: Let batter rest for 10 minutes
rest-batter-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-.description: Allow the batter to sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. This lets the oats absorb the liquid and swell, creating a better texture.

heat-pan-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-ban.title: Heat and oil the pan
heat-pan-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-ban.description: Set a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Lightly grease the pan with vegetable oil.

pour-batter-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-.title: Pour batter into pan
pour-batter-strawberry-oat-pancake-with-.description: Pour all the batter into the hot pan and spread it evenly to form one large pancake.

cook-first-side-strawberry-oat-pancake-w.title: Cook first side for 3–4 minutes
cook-first-side-strawberry-oat-pancake-w.description: Cook the pancake over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the bottom is golden brown. Do not move it while cooking.

flip-pancake-strawberry-oat-pancake-with.title: Flip the pancake
flip-pancake-strawberry-oat-pancake-with.description: Lightly spray or brush the top of the pancake with a little oil. Carefully flip it over with a spatula.

cook-second-side-strawberry-oat-pancake-.title: Cook second side for 1–2 minutes
cook-second-side-strawberry-oat-pancake-.description: Continue cooking the second side for 1 to 2 minutes until it turns golden brown as well.

transfer-to-plate-strawberry-oat-pancake.title: Transfer to a plate
transfer-to-plate-strawberry-oat-pancake.description: Slide the oat pancake onto a serving plate. Serve warm with banana slices, berries, and honey if desired.

beat-eggs-striped-pancakes.title: Beat eggs with sugar
beat-eggs-striped-pancakes.description: In a bowl, beat the eggs and sugar together until the mixture becomes light and fluffy.

add-liquid-ingredients-striped-pancakes.title: Add salt, milk, and boiling water
add-liquid-ingredients-striped-pancakes.description: Add a pinch of salt to the egg mixture, then pour in the milk. Continue beating while gradually adding boiling water.

incorporate-flour-and-oil-striped-pancak.title: Incorporate flour and oil
incorporate-flour-and-oil-striped-pancak.description: Sift the flour into the batter in small portions, stirring constantly until smooth. Pour in the vegetable oil and mix again.

let-batter-rest-striped-pancakes.title: Let batter rest
let-batter-rest-striped-pancakes.description: Cover the bowl with a towel and allow the batter to rest for 7–10 minutes. This allows the gluten to relax and ensures tender pancakes.

prepare-chocolate-batter-striped-pancake.title: Prepare chocolate batter
prepare-chocolate-batter-striped-pancake.description: Pour about two ladles of the plain batter into a separate bowl. Add the cocoa powder and stir until fully combined. Transfer the chocolate batter into a pastry syringe or a squeeze bottle with a narrow tip.

cook-pancake-with-chocolate-spiral-strip.title: Cook pancakes with chocolate spiral
cook-pancake-with-chocolate-spiral-strip.description: Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease with oil. Pour a thin layer of plain batter into the pan, tilting to spread evenly. Immediately draw a spiral of chocolate batter starting from the center. Cook until the bottom is golden, then flip and cook the other side. Repeat with the remaining batter.

prepare-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-veg.title: Prepare the chicken
prepare-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-veg.description: Place the chicken breast side up. Gently separate the skin from the breast with your hands. Cut the breast away from the back using a knife, being careful not to tear the skin. Remove the meat from the carcass, debone it, and cut it into cubes about 1 cm.

marinate-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-ve.title: Marinate the chicken
marinate-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-ve.description: In a bowl, mix mayonnaise, ⅓ teaspoon of salt, and chicken seasoning. Place the chicken carcass in a baking dish and spread the marinade inside and out. Let it marinate while you prepare the filling.

assemble-lavash-roll-stuffed-chicken-wit.title: Assemble the lavash roll
assemble-lavash-roll-stuffed-chicken-wit.description: Spread a sheet of lavash on the table. Arrange the chicken cubes on it and sprinkle with ⅓ teaspoon of salt. Spread the frozen vegetable mix evenly over the chicken. Slice mushrooms thinly and place on top. Cut the cheese into slices and cover the mushrooms. Roll the lavash tightly into a log.

stuff-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-veget.title: Stuff the chicken
stuff-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-veget.description: Cut the lavash log into 3–4 pieces. Stuff these pieces tightly into the cavity of the chicken, under the skin of the breast.

secure-opening-stuffed-chicken-with-vege.title: Secure the opening
secure-opening-stuffed-chicken-with-vege.description: Close the opening in the carcass with the ends of the skin. Fasten with toothpicks or skewers.

bake-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-vegeta.title: Bake the chicken
bake-chicken-stuffed-chicken-with-vegeta.description: Place the chicken in the preheated oven and bake for 40–50 minutes until golden and cooked through.

boil-potatoes-stuffed-chicken-with-veget.title: Boil the potatoes
boil-potatoes-stuffed-chicken-with-veget.description: Cut the potatoes into 3–4 pieces each. Place in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add ⅓ teaspoon of salt, reduce the heat to medium, and cook for 10–15 minutes until half-done. Drain and let cool.

slice-pumpkin-stuffed-chicken-with-veget.title: Slice the pumpkin
slice-pumpkin-stuffed-chicken-with-veget.description: Cut the pumpkin into slices about 1–1.5 cm thick.

add-vegetables-and-bake-stuffed-chicken-.title: Add vegetables and finish baking
add-vegetables-and-bake-stuffed-chicken-.description: Remove the almost-done chicken from the oven. Arrange the boiled potatoes and pumpkin slices around the chicken. Drizzle with vegetable oil. Return to the oven and bake for another 10–15 minutes until the chicken is nicely browned and the vegetables are tender.

bring-water-to-boil-stuffed-eggs-with-to.title: Bring water to a boil
bring-water-to-boil-stuffed-eggs-with-to.description: Place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with water, and set over high heat. Bring to a boil.

boil-eggs-stuffed-eggs-with-tomatoes-and.title: Boil eggs for 10 minutes
boil-eggs-stuffed-eggs-with-tomatoes-and.description: Once the water is boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook the eggs for exactly 10 minutes. Set a timer.

fry-bacon-stuffed-eggs-with-tomatoes-and.title: Fry bacon until crispy
fry-bacon-stuffed-eggs-with-tomatoes-and.description: While the eggs cook, place bacon slices in a dry frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry until crispy, then transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.

cool-and-peel-eggs-stuffed-eggs-with-tom.title: Cool and peel the eggs
cool-and-peel-eggs-stuffed-eggs-with-tom.description: Transfer the boiled eggs to a bowl of ice water. Let them cool for a couple of minutes, then peel off the shells.

prepare-yolk-filling-stuffed-eggs-with-t.title: Prepare the yolk filling
prepare-yolk-filling-stuffed-eggs-with-t.description: Slice each egg in half lengthwise and remove the yolks. Mash the yolks with a fork in a bowl, then stir in mayonnaise, mustard, dried garlic, salt, and black pepper until smooth.

fill-egg-whites-stuffed-eggs-with-tomato.title: Fill the egg whites
fill-egg-whites-stuffed-eggs-with-tomato.description: Spoon the yolk mixture back into the cavities of the egg white halves, filling them evenly.

assemble-stuffed-eggs-stuffed-eggs-with-.title: Assemble the stuffed eggs
assemble-stuffed-eggs-stuffed-eggs-with-.description: Place a lettuce leaf on half of the filled egg halves. Top with a thin slice of tomato and a piece of bacon. Cover with the remaining egg halves and secure each mini sandwich with a toothpick.

prepare-sweet-potato-sweet-potato-chickp.title: Prepare the sweet potato
prepare-sweet-potato-sweet-potato-chickp.description: Cut the sweet potato in half lengthwise. Score the cut sides in several places. Place the halves cut-side up in a baking dish and brush with 0.5 teaspoon of olive oil.

bake-sweet-potato-sweet-potato-chickpea-.title: Bake the sweet potato
bake-sweet-potato-sweet-potato-chickpea-.description: Bake the sweet potato until tender, about 30–40 minutes, depending on your oven. Check with a fork; it should be soft.

make-chickpea-filling-sweet-potato-chick.title: Make the chickpea filling
make-chickpea-filling-sweet-potato-chick.description: Place the canned chickpeas in a bowl and blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Add the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, turmeric, and paprika. Blend again until fully combined and creamy.

fill-sweet-potato-boat-sweet-potato-chic.title: Fill the sweet potato boats
fill-sweet-potato-boat-sweet-potato-chic.description: Transfer the baked sweet potato halves to a plate. Use a spoon to press down the centers, creating a boat shape. Distribute the chickpea mixture evenly into the indentations.

top-with-avocado-sweet-potato-chickpea-b.title: Top with avocado and serve
top-with-avocado-sweet-potato-chickpea-b.description: Peel the avocado and remove the pit. Cut the flesh into half-round slices. Arrange the slices on top of the filled sweet potato boats and serve immediately.

mix-dough-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-.title: Mix the dough
mix-dough-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-.description: Place the tvorog in a bowl. Add semolina and sugar. Mix thoroughly until homogeneous and slightly sticky.

divide-and-flatten-syrniki-with-boiled-c.title: Divide and flatten the dough
divide-and-flatten-syrniki-with-boiled-c.description: Divide the dough into equal portions. Flatten each portion into a patty.

fill-and-shape-syrniki-with-boiled-conde.title: Fill and shape the syrniki
fill-and-shape-syrniki-with-boiled-conde.description: Place a teaspoon of boiled condensed milk in the center of each patty. Seal the edges and form into a disk shape.

coat-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-milk.title: Coat the syrniki in flour
coat-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-milk.description: Pour flour into a clean bowl. Coat each syrnik on all sides.

heat-oil-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-m.title: Heat the oil
heat-oil-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-m.description: Pour sunflower oil into a frying pan and heat over medium heat.

fry-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-milk.title: Fry the syrniki
fry-syrniki-with-boiled-condensed-milk.description: Fry the syrniki for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and firm.

prep-ingredients-syrniki-with-sun-dried-.title: Prepare the herbs, cheese, and tomatoes
prep-ingredients-syrniki-with-sun-dried-.description: Separate the parsley and basil leaves from the stems and finely chop them. Finely grate the hard cheese. Cut the sun-dried tomatoes into small pieces.

mix-tvorog-mixture-syrniki-with-sun-drie.title: Mix the tvorog, sour cream, and egg yolk
mix-tvorog-mixture-syrniki-with-sun-drie.description: In a bowl, combine the tvorog, sour cream, and egg yolk. Mix well, mashing the tvorog until smooth.

combine-dough-syrniki-with-sun-dried-tom.title: Add the vegetables, cheese, and flour
combine-dough-syrniki-with-sun-dried-tom.description: Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, herbs, grated hard cheese, salt, and black pepper to the tvorog mixture. Stir until combined. Gradually add 2-3 tablespoons of rice flour, adjusting the amount until the dough is slightly sticky but firm. Knead gently.

form-syrniki-patties-syrniki-with-sun-dr.title: Shape the syrniki patties
form-syrniki-patties-syrniki-with-sun-dr.description: Pour the remaining rice flour onto a plate. Form the tvorog dough into round patties about 3-3.5 cm in diameter. Coat each patty thoroughly in rice flour.

fry-syrniki-syrniki-with-sun-dried-tomat.title: Fry the syrniki
fry-syrniki-syrniki-with-sun-dried-tomat.description: Pour sunflower oil into a frying pan and heat over medium heat. Place the syrniki in the pan and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown. Flip and fry the other side for another 3-4 minutes. Cover the pan, reduce heat to low, and steam the syrniki for about 2 minutes more.

beat-eggs-tamago-yaki-vegetables.title: Beat the eggs
beat-eggs-tamago-yaki-vegetables.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them with a fork for 1–2 minutes until well combined.

prepare-vegetable-mixture-tamago-yaki-ve.title: Prepare vegetables and mix
prepare-vegetable-mixture-tamago-yaki-ve.description: Finely grate the carrot and chop the green onion. Add them to the beaten eggs and mix well. Season with salt and pepper.

heat-pan-and-pour-first-layer-tamago-yak.title: Heat the pan and pour first layer
heat-pan-and-pour-first-layer-tamago-yak.description: Preheat a crepe pan over medium heat. Lightly grease it with vegetable oil. Pour a thin layer of the egg mixture and tilt the pan to spread it evenly.

roll-first-layer-tamago-yaki-vegetables.title: Roll the first layer
roll-first-layer-tamago-yaki-vegetables.description: When the eggs start to set and are no longer runny on the bottom, use a spatula to lift one edge and roll the omelet into a log, leaving 2–3 cm of the free edge.

cook-remaining-layers-tamago-yaki-vegeta.title: Cook and roll remaining layers
cook-remaining-layers-tamago-yaki-vegeta.description: Grease the exposed part of the pan again. Pour in a portion of the remaining egg mixture, spreading it to connect with the rolled part. Cook for 1–2 minutes, then roll it up. Repeat until all mixture is used.

slice-tamago-yaki-vegetables.title: Slice the tamagoyaki
slice-tamago-yaki-vegetables.description: Carefully transfer the rolled omelet to a cutting board and slice into bite-sized pieces. Serve warm or at room temperature.

grate-vegetables-tamagoyaki.title: Grate carrot and daikon
grate-vegetables-tamagoyaki.description: Finely grate the carrot and daikon using a fine grater.

slice-green-onion-tamagoyaki.title: Slice green onion
slice-green-onion-tamagoyaki.description: Slice the green onion into thin rings.

beat-egg-mixture-tamagoyaki.title: Beat eggs with seasonings
beat-egg-mixture-tamagoyaki.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the black pepper, soy sauce, and mirin. Whisk until lightly frothy.

combine-vegetables-with-eggs-tamagoyaki.title: Combine vegetables with egg mixture
combine-vegetables-with-eggs-tamagoyaki.description: Add the grated vegetables to the egg mixture and stir to combine evenly.

heat-oil-in-pan-tamagoyaki.title: Heat oil in pan
heat-oil-in-pan-tamagoyaki.description: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with vegetable oil.

cook-omelette-layers-tamagoyaki.title: Cook and roll omelette layers
cook-omelette-layers-tamagoyaki.description: Pour a thin layer of the egg mixture into the pan, tilting to spread evenly. When the egg sets, carefully roll it into a log using a spatula. Push the roll to the edge of the pan, brush the empty surface with oil, and pour another thin layer. When set, roll again. Repeat until all the mixture is used.

boil-chicken-tavuk-gogsu.title: Boil the chicken
boil-chicken-tavuk-gogsu.description: Place the chicken breast in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and cook for 20–25 minutes until tender.

shred-chicken-tavuk-gogsu.title: Shred the chicken
shred-chicken-tavuk-gogsu.description: Let the cooked chicken cool, then shred it into very fine fibers using your hands or a fork.

wash-and-soak-chicken-tavuk-gogsu.title: Wash and soak the chicken
wash-and-soak-chicken-tavuk-gogsu.description: Rinse the shredded chicken well, squeeze out excess liquid, then cover with cold water and let it soak for 10 minutes. Repeat this process three times, squeezing the chicken dry after each soak.

whisk-dry-mixture-tavuk-gogsu.title: Whisk dry mixture
whisk-dry-mixture-tavuk-gogsu.description: In a bowl, whisk together the rice flour, cornstarch, and 100 ml of milk until smooth and lump-free.

heat-milk-and-add-mixture-tavuk-gogsu.title: Heat milk and add mixture
heat-milk-and-add-mixture-tavuk-gogsu.description: Pour the remaining milk into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until it begins to boil. Gradually whisk in the flour mixture.

cook-pudding-base-tavuk-gogsu.title: Cook the pudding base
cook-pudding-base-tavuk-gogsu.description: Reduce heat to low and cook the milk mixture for 5–10 minutes, stirring constantly, until it thickens into a smooth pudding.

combine-chicken-with-milk-tavuk-gogsu.title: Combine chicken with hot milk
combine-chicken-with-milk-tavuk-gogsu.description: Take 3–4 tablespoons of the hot milk pudding and mix it with the prepared shredded chicken.

mix-chicken-into-pudding-tavuk-gogsu.title: Mix chicken into pudding
mix-chicken-into-pudding-tavuk-gogsu.description: Transfer the chicken mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining pudding and whisk everything together until fully incorporated.

add-sugar-and-cook-tavuk-gogsu.title: Add sugar and cook
add-sugar-and-cook-tavuk-gogsu.description: Stir in the sugar and continue cooking over low heat for 1 minute, until the sugar is completely dissolved.

add-vanilla-tavuk-gogsu.title: Add vanilla
add-vanilla-tavuk-gogsu.description: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract until evenly distributed.

chill-pudding-tavuk-gogsu.title: Chill the pudding
chill-pudding-tavuk-gogsu.description: Lightly spray a rectangular dish with water, pour the pudding into it, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour until set.

combine-wet-three-cheese-waffles.title: Combine cream cheese, salt, sugar, and egg
combine-wet-three-cheese-waffles.description: Put the cream cheese, salt, and sugar in a bowl. Crack the egg into the bowl and mix until well combined.

grate-cheeses-three-cheese-waffles.title: Grate cheddar and parmesan
grate-cheeses-three-cheese-waffles.description: Finely grate the cheddar and parmesan cheeses.

add-cheeses-three-cheese-waffles.title: Add grated cheeses to the batter
add-cheeses-three-cheese-waffles.description: Add the grated cheddar and parmesan to the batter and mix again.

combine-flour-milk-three-cheese-waffles.title: Add flour, baking powder, and milk
combine-flour-milk-three-cheese-waffles.description: Sprinkle the flour and baking powder over the batter, then gradually pour in the milk while mixing. The batter should be thick but fall from a spoon with some effort.

preheat-waffle-iron-three-cheese-waffles.title: Preheat the waffle iron
preheat-waffle-iron-three-cheese-waffles.description: Preheat your waffle iron. Brush the cooking surface with vegetable oil.

cook-waffles-three-cheese-waffles.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-three-cheese-waffles.description: Cook the waffles for 4–5 minutes each, adjusting based on your waffle iron's settings. Serve hot.

add-gelatin-three-layer-milk-jelly.title: Add gelatin and water
add-gelatin-three-layer-milk-jelly.description: Sprinkle the gelatin powder into a small saucepan. Pour the cool water over it and stir briefly to combine.

bloom-gelatin-three-layer-milk-jelly.title: Let gelatin bloom
bloom-gelatin-three-layer-milk-jelly.description: Let the gelatin sit for 10 to 15 minutes until it has absorbed the water and become spongy. This is called blooming.

heat-gelatin-three-layer-milk-jelly.title: Heat gelatin until dissolved
heat-gelatin-three-layer-milk-jelly.description: Place the saucepan over low heat. Warm the gelatin mixture, stirring gently, for 3 to 4 minutes until it is completely dissolved. Do not let it boil.

prepare-chocolate-mixture-three-layer-mi.title: Prepare chocolate mixture
prepare-chocolate-mixture-three-layer-mi.description: In a bowl, pour 100 ml of milk, add the cocoa powder and 18.75 g of sugar. Stir in half of the dissolved gelatin mixture and whisk until smooth.

pour-chocolate-layer-three-layer-milk-je.title: Pour chocolate layer into dishes
pour-chocolate-layer-three-layer-milk-je.description: Divide the chocolate mixture among your serving dishes. Tilt each dish slightly so the layer sets at an angle.

chill-chocolate-layer-three-layer-milk-j.title: Chill chocolate layer
chill-chocolate-layer-three-layer-milk-j.description: Place the dishes in the refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes, keeping them tilted, until the chocolate layer is set.

prepare-sour-cream-mixture-three-layer-m.title: Prepare sour cream mixture
prepare-sour-cream-mixture-three-layer-m.description: In a clean bowl, combine the sour cream, 75 ml of milk, and the remaining sugar. Add the rest of the gelatin mixture and stir until well blended.

pour-sour-cream-layer-three-layer-milk-j.title: Pour sour cream layer
pour-sour-cream-layer-three-layer-milk-j.description: Gently pour the sour cream mixture over the set chocolate layer. Tilt the dishes in the opposite direction this time.

chill-sour-cream-layer-three-layer-milk-.title: Chill sour cream layer
chill-sour-cream-layer-three-layer-milk-.description: Return the dishes to the refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes, maintaining the tilt, until the sour cream layer is firm.

prepare-cherry-mixture-three-layer-milk-.title: Prepare cherry mixture
prepare-cherry-mixture-three-layer-milk-.description: In another bowl, combine the cherry juice, the remaining milk, and any leftover gelatin mixture. Stir until all crystals have dissolved completely.

pour-cherry-layer-three-layer-milk-jelly.title: Pour cherry layer
pour-cherry-layer-three-layer-milk-jelly.description: Carefully pour the cherry mixture over the two set layers in each dish.

chill-cherry-layer-three-layer-milk-jell.title: Chill until fully set
chill-cherry-layer-three-layer-milk-jell.description: Place the dishes in the refrigerator and let them chill for 2 to 3 hours until the jelly is completely firm.

toast-bread-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-.description: Heat a skillet over medium heat and toast the bread slices on both sides until golden and crispy, about 1–2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

boil-egg-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-sti.title: Boil the egg
boil-egg-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-sti.description: Place the egg in a small pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook for about 10 minutes for a hard-boiled egg. Drain and cool under cold water.

chop-crab-sticks-and-tomatoes-toast-with.title: Chop crab sticks and tomatoes
chop-crab-sticks-and-tomatoes-toast-with.description: Remove crab sticks from packaging and chop into small pieces. Cut cherry tomatoes into quarters.

mash-egg-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-sti.title: Mash the boiled egg
mash-egg-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-sti.description: Peel the boiled egg and mash it with a fork until finely crumbled.

mix-filling-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-.title: Mix the filling
mix-filling-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-.description: In a bowl, combine the chopped crab sticks, quartered tomatoes, and mashed egg. Add cream cheese and stir until well combined.

mash-avocado-toast-with-avocado-and-crab.title: Mash the avocado
mash-avocado-toast-with-avocado-and-crab.description: Transfer the avocado halves to a small bowl and mash with a fork until smooth. Season with salt to taste and mix.

assemble-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-sti.title: Assemble the toasts
assemble-toast-with-avocado-and-crab-sti.description: Spread the mashed avocado onto each toasted bread slice. Top with the crab stick filling. For extra heat, sprinkle with black pepper.

boil-eggs-toasts-with-pate-and-eggs.title: Boil the eggs
boil-eggs-toasts-with-pate-and-eggs.description: Bring water to a boil in a pot. Gently lower the eggs using a spoon to prevent cracking. Boil for 10 minutes, then transfer to ice water to cool.

fry-bread-toasts-with-pate-and-eggs.title: Fry the bread
fry-bread-toasts-with-pate-and-eggs.description: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the bread slices until golden and crispy on both sides.

prepare-egg-mixture-toasts-with-pate-and.title: Prepare the egg mixture
prepare-egg-mixture-toasts-with-pate-and.description: Peel the cooled eggs and dice or grate them finely. Chop the dill and mix it with the eggs. Season with a pinch of salt.

assemble-toasts-with-pate-and-eggs.title: Assemble the toasts
assemble-toasts-with-pate-and-eggs.description: Spread the pate evenly on the toasted bread slices. Top with the egg and dill mixture.

roll-pastry-tomato-galette.title: Roll out the pastry
roll-pastry-tomato-galette.description: Roll out the puff pastry into a thin sheet. Trim uneven edges. Line a baking tray with parchment. Fold the edges to form a small rim. Prick the pastry with a fork in several places to prevent puffing.

freeze-dough-tomato-galette.title: Freeze the dough with weights
freeze-dough-tomato-galette.description: Cover the dough with another sheet of parchment. Pour dry beans or peas onto the paper to act as weights. Place the tray in the freezer for 15 minutes.

prepare-baking-tomatoes-tomato-galette.title: Prepare tomatoes for baking
prepare-baking-tomatoes-tomato-galette.description: Slice the tomatoes intended for baking into 5 mm rounds. Arrange them on a second baking tray. Top with thyme sprigs. Crush garlic cloves with a knife and scatter over the tomatoes. Season with salt, pepper, and drizzle with olive oil.

bake-pastry-tomatoes-tomato-galette.title: Bake the pastry and tomatoes
bake-pastry-tomatoes-tomato-galette.description: Place the tray with the pastry and the tray with the tomatoes in the oven. Bake for 20 minutes.

cool-pastry-tomato-galette.title: Cool the pastry and tomatoes
cool-pastry-tomato-galette.description: Remove both trays from the oven and let them cool completely. Once cool, carefully remove the parchment with beans from the pastry.

blend-ricotta-cream-tomato-galette.title: Blend the ricotta cream
blend-ricotta-cream-tomato-galette.description: In a blender, combine ricotta, sour cream, roasted garlic cloves, basil leaves, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth.

marinate-fresh-tomatoes-tomato-galette.title: Marinate fresh tomatoes
marinate-fresh-tomatoes-tomato-galette.description: Slice the remaining fresh tomatoes into 5 mm rounds. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Place them in a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and let sit for 15 minutes to release juices. Then drain the liquid and pat the tomatoes dry with paper towels.

assemble-galette-tomato-galette.title: Assemble the galette
assemble-galette-tomato-galette.description: Spread the ricotta cream over the cooled pastry base. First arrange the baked tomatoes on top, then the fresh tomatoes. Sprinkle with pepper. Garnish with thinly sliced basil leaves.

dice-tomato-mince-garlic-tomato-oatmeal-.title: Dice tomato and mince garlic
dice-tomato-mince-garlic-tomato-oatmeal-.description: Dice the tomato into 1-1.5 cm cubes. Finely mince the garlic clove.

heat-oil-fry-garlic-tomato-oatmeal-with-.title: Heat oil and fry garlic
heat-oil-fry-garlic-tomato-oatmeal-with-.description: Pour vegetable oil into a pot and heat over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and fry for about 1 minute until golden.

simmer-tomato-rosemary-tomato-oatmeal-wi.title: Simmer tomato and rosemary
simmer-tomato-rosemary-tomato-oatmeal-wi.description: Add the diced tomato and a sprig of rosemary to the pot. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until the vegetables are soft.

add-oats-and-cook-tomato-oatmeal-with-eg.title: Add oats and cook
add-oats-and-cook-tomato-oatmeal-with-eg.description: Stir in the rolled oats and pour in 1 cup of water. Add salt and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are tender.

add-cream-cheese-tomato-oatmeal-with-egg.title: Add cream cheese and finish
add-cream-cheese-tomato-oatmeal-with-egg.description: Add the cream cheese, stir until smooth, then remove the pot from the heat.

crack-egg-tomato-oatmeal-with-egg.title: Crack egg into a bowl
crack-egg-tomato-oatmeal-with-egg.description: Carefully crack the egg into a clean bowl without breaking the yolk.

bring-water-to-simmer-tomato-oatmeal-wit.title: Bring water to a simmer
bring-water-to-simmer-tomato-oatmeal-wit.description: Fill a second pot about two-thirds full with water. Heat over medium heat until the first bubbles appear.

poach-egg-tomato-oatmeal-with-egg.title: Poach the egg
poach-egg-tomato-oatmeal-with-egg.description: Stir the water in a circular motion to create a vortex, then gently pour in the egg. Cook for 3 minutes, then carefully remove with a slotted spoon.

combine-wet-ingredients-tomato-olive-loa.title: Combine wet ingredients
combine-wet-ingredients-tomato-olive-loa.description: Crack the eggs into a deep bowl. Add the Italian herbs, a pinch of salt, and some black pepper, then stir. Pour in the olive oil and milk, and stir again until well combined.

combine-dry-and-wet-tomato-olive-loaf.title: Mix dry ingredients into wet
combine-dry-and-wet-tomato-olive-loaf.description: Add the baking powder to the flour and sift the mixture into the liquid ingredients in several additions. Mix until you have a thick batter that resembles sour cream.

prepare-filling-and-mix-tomato-olive-loa.title: Prepare filling and mix into batter
prepare-filling-and-mix-tomato-olive-loa.description: Slice the olives into rings. Grate the cheese on a coarse grater and set a little aside for garnish. Roughly chop the sun‑dried tomatoes. Add all the filling to the batter and mix thoroughly.

bake-tomato-olive-loaf.title: Bake the loaf
bake-tomato-olive-loaf.description: Transfer the batter into a loaf pan, sprinkle with the reserved cheese, and bake in a preheated oven at 180 °C for 35 minutes.

prepare-trout-trout-mousse.title: Prepare the trout
prepare-trout-trout-mousse.description: Remove the skin from the trout fillet and cut the flesh into arbitrary pieces. Remove any bones you find. Transfer the pieces to a blender bowl.

blend-mousse-trout-mousse.title: Blend the mousse
blend-mousse-trout-mousse.description: Squeeze the juice from half a lemon. Add the lemon juice, cream cheese, and ground black pepper to the fish in the blender. Blend everything until smooth. Taste and adjust with more lemon juice or pepper if desired.

transfer-mousse-trout-mousse.title: Transfer the mousse
transfer-mousse-trout-mousse.description: Transfer the trout mousse to a small container for storage or serving.

poach-trout-trout-rillette-with-olives.title: Poach the trout
poach-trout-trout-rillette-with-olives.description: Place the whole trout fillet in a saucepan and pour in the white wine. Set over medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5–7 minutes until the fish is cooked through.

shred-trout-trout-rillette-with-olives.title: Shred the trout
shred-trout-trout-rillette-with-olives.description: Transfer the poached trout to a plate and remove the skin. Use a fork to break the flesh into small flakes.

chop-olives-trout-rillette-with-olives.title: Chop the olives
chop-olives-trout-rillette-with-olives.description: Roughly chop the olives into rings.

melt-butter-trout-rillette-with-olives.title: Melt the butter
melt-butter-trout-rillette-with-olives.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Melt it in 2–3 intervals of 30–40 seconds each, then let it cool slightly.

saute-zest-trout-rillette-with-olives.title: Sauté the orange zest
saute-zest-trout-rillette-with-olives.description: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the orange zest and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.

combine-ingredients-trout-rillette-with-.title: Combine all ingredients
combine-ingredients-trout-rillette-with-.description: In a large bowl, mix together the shredded trout, chopped olives, and sautéed orange zest. Pour in the melted butter, add salt and pepper, and stir until well combined.

chill-rillette-trout-rillette-with-olive.title: Chill the rillette
chill-rillette-trout-rillette-with-olive.description: Transfer the mixture to a container or small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

prepare-fish-trout-sandwich-spread.title: Prepare the fish
prepare-fish-trout-sandwich-spread.description: Remove the skin from the fish, cut the fillet into arbitrary pieces, and place them in a blender bowl.

blend-ingredients-trout-sandwich-spread.title: Blend the ingredients
blend-ingredients-trout-sandwich-spread.description: Add the horseradish and sour cream to the fish. Blend until smooth.

toast-bread-trout-sandwich-spread.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-trout-sandwich-spread.description: Toast the bread on a dry frying pan or in a toaster until golden.

mix-sauce-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sauce.title: Mix the sauce
mix-sauce-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sauce.description: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, chili sauce, a few drops of Worcestershire sauce, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir until smooth.

prep-vegetables-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sau.title: Prepare the vegetables
prep-vegetables-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sau.description: Peel the outer layer of the celery stalk using a vegetable peeler, then cut it into small cubes. Dice the tomato and shallot finely, and chop the cilantro. Transfer everything into a mixing bowl.

combine-filling-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sau.title: Combine the filling
combine-filling-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sau.description: Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork. Add it to the bowl with the vegetables. Pour in the prepared sauce and mix well.

melt-garlic-butter-tuna-sandwich-garlic-.title: Melt garlic butter
melt-garlic-butter-tuna-sandwich-garlic-.description: Place the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and add the pressed garlic. Microwave on high power for 15 seconds until melted.

cut-and-butter-bread-tuna-sandwich-garli.title: Cut and butter the bread
cut-and-butter-bread-tuna-sandwich-garli.description: Slice the ciabatta in half lengthwise, then cut each half into 2 or 4 pieces. Brush each piece with the garlic butter.

toast-bread-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sauce.title: Toast the bread
toast-bread-tuna-sandwich-garlic-sauce.description: Brown the bread on a skillet or in the oven for about 3 minutes until golden and crisp.

assemble-sandwiches-tuna-sandwich-garlic.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-tuna-sandwich-garlic.description: Spoon the tuna filling onto the bottom halves of the toasted ciabatta and cover with the top halves.

mash-tuna-egg-tuna-spread-sandwich.title: Mash tuna and egg
mash-tuna-egg-tuna-spread-sandwich.description: Place the tuna and half of a hard-boiled egg in a bowl. Mash them together with a fork. Chop the herbs and add to the mixture.

add-oil-lemon-tuna-spread-sandwich.title: Add oil and lemon juice
add-oil-lemon-tuna-spread-sandwich.description: Pour in the olive oil and lemon juice. Add salt and mix thoroughly until well combined.

spread-mixture-on-bread-tuna-spread-sand.title: Spread on bread
spread-mixture-on-bread-tuna-spread-sand.description: Spread the tuna mixture generously onto the whole grain crispbread.

slice-vegetables-top-tuna-spread-sandwic.title: Slice vegetables and top
