slice-vegetables-top-tuna-spread-sandwic.description: Cut the cucumber and tomato into thin slices. Arrange them on top of the tuna spread.

mix-dry-ingredients-turkish-cake.title: Mix dry ingredients
mix-dry-ingredients-turkish-cake.description: In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, orange zest, and raisins. Stir until evenly distributed.

cream-butter-sugar-turkish-cake.title: Cream butter and sugar
cream-butter-sugar-turkish-cake.description: In a separate bowl, beat the softened butter with half of the sugar until light and fluffy.

beat-egg-yolks-turkish-cake.title: Beat egg yolks with sugar
beat-egg-yolks-turkish-cake.description: Separate the eggs. Beat the yolks with the remaining sugar until thick and pale.

combine-wet-and-flour-turkish-cake.title: Combine wet and dry mixtures
combine-wet-and-flour-turkish-cake.description: Add the yogurt and the butter mixture to the beaten yolks. Mix well, then gradually add the flour mixture, stirring until a smooth batter forms.

beat-egg-whites-turkish-cake.title: Beat egg whites to stiff peaks
beat-egg-whites-turkish-cake.description: In a clean bowl, beat the egg whites with lemon juice using a mixer until stiff peaks form.

fold-egg-whites-turkish-cake.title: Fold in egg whites
fold-egg-whites-turkish-cake.description: Gently fold the beaten egg whites into the batter using a spatula until just combined. Be careful not to deflate the mixture.

prepare-pan-and-preheat-turkish-cake.title: Prepare pan and preheat oven
prepare-pan-and-preheat-turkish-cake.description: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease a cake pan with butter and sprinkle sesame seeds evenly over the inside to coat.

bake-cake-turkish-cake.title: Bake the cake
bake-cake-turkish-cake.description: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes, then reduce the temperature to 160°C (325°F) and bake for another 45 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

mix-dough-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Mix the dough
mix-dough-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: In a bowl, combine tvorog, butter, egg, salt, flour, and semolina. Mix thoroughly until a uniform dough forms.

refrigerate-dough-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Refrigerate the dough
refrigerate-dough-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place it in the refrigerator. Let it chill for 30 to 40 minutes to allow the dough to stabilize.

chop-walnuts-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Chop the walnuts
chop-walnuts-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Finely chop the walnuts with a knife or in a food processor.

toast-crumb-mixture-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Toast the crumb mixture
toast-crumb-mixture-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Add the breadcrumbs, chopped walnuts, sugar, and cinnamon. Cook, stirring frequently, for 8 to 10 minutes until the mixture turns golden and aromatic. Remove from heat.

cool-crumb-mixture-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Cool the crumb mixture
cool-crumb-mixture-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Let the toasted crumb mixture cool completely on a plate or in a bowl.

combine-berry-sauce-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Combine the berry sauce ingredients
combine-berry-sauce-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: In a small saucepan, combine the frozen berries, maple syrup, and lemon zest.

cook-berry-sauce-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Cook the berry sauce
cook-berry-sauce-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Place the saucepan over medium heat. Cook for 7 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries soften and the sauce thickens. Remove from heat.

remove-sauce-from-heat-tvorog-kneli-berr.title: Remove sauce from heat
remove-sauce-from-heat-tvorog-kneli-berr.description: Take the saucepan off the stove and set the berry sauce aside.

take-dough-out-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Take the dough out of the fridge
take-dough-out-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Remove the chilled dough from the refrigerator.

bring-water-to-boil-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Bring water to a boil
bring-water-to-boil-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Fill a large pot about two-thirds full with water. Place over high heat and bring to a rolling boil.

reduce-heat-and-add-salt-tvorog-kneli-be.title: Reduce heat and add salt
reduce-heat-and-add-salt-tvorog-kneli-be.description: Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium and add a pinch of salt to the water.

form-kneli-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Form the kneli
form-kneli-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Using a tablespoon, scoop portions of the dough and shape them into elongated dumplings (kneli).

boil-kneli-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Boil the kneli
boil-kneli-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Gently drop the formed kneli into the simmering water. Cook for 10 minutes, until they float and are cooked through.

remove-kneli-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Remove the kneli
remove-kneli-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: Use a slotted spoon to lift the cooked kneli out of the water and transfer them to a plate.

coat-kneli-in-crumb-tvorog-kneli-berries.title: Coat the kneli in crumb mixture
coat-kneli-in-crumb-tvorog-kneli-berries.description: While still warm, roll each kneli in the cooled crumb mixture until evenly coated on all sides.

transfer-to-serving-plate-tvorog-kneli-b.title: Transfer to serving plate
transfer-to-serving-plate-tvorog-kneli-b.description: Arrange the coated kneli on a serving plate. Serve with the berry sauce on the side or drizzled over.

heat-milk-cream-vanilla-rice-porridge.title: Heat milk and cream for custard
heat-milk-cream-vanilla-rice-porridge.description: Combine the cream and milk for the custard in a small saucepan. Place over low heat and warm until steam starts to rise. Remove from heat.

whisk-yolks-vanilla-rice-porridge.title: Whisk egg yolks with sugar and temper
whisk-yolks-vanilla-rice-porridge.description: In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks with 1 tablespoon of sugar until well combined. Gradually add about 100 ml of the hot milk mixture, whisking constantly to temper the yolks.

cook-custard-vanilla-rice-porridge.title: Cook the custard until thickened
cook-custard-vanilla-rice-porridge.description: Pour the egg mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining milk and cream. Place over low heat and cook, stirring gently, until the custard thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.

strain-custard-vanilla-rice-porridge.title: Strain and cover the custard
strain-custard-vanilla-rice-porridge.description: Pass the custard through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface of the custard (contact method) and set aside.

combine-rice-ingredients-vanilla-rice-po.title: Combine rice and remaining ingredients
combine-rice-ingredients-vanilla-rice-po.description: Place the rice in a heavy-bottomed pot. Add the milk, cream, sugar, and vanilla essence. Stir everything together thoroughly.

bring-to-boil-vanilla-rice-porridge.title: Bring the rice mixture to a boil
bring-to-boil-vanilla-rice-porridge.description: Set the pot over medium heat and bring to a boil, stirring constantly to prevent the rice from sticking.

simmer-rice-vanilla-rice-porridge.title: Simmer the rice until creamy
simmer-rice-vanilla-rice-porridge.description: Reduce the heat to the lowest setting and simmer gently for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soft and the mixture is creamy. About 5 minutes before the end of cooking, add a pinch of salt and stir.

hydrate-oats-vegan-oatmeal-pie.title: Hydrate the oats
hydrate-oats-vegan-oatmeal-pie.description: Boil the water and pour it over the rolled oats. Let them sit for 15–20 minutes until they absorb the water.

mix-wet-ingredients-vegan-oatmeal-pie.title: Add wet ingredients
mix-wet-ingredients-vegan-oatmeal-pie.description: Once the oats have absorbed the water, add both sugars, vegetable oil, apple puree, and orange zest. Mix thoroughly.

combine-dry-mixture-vegan-oatmeal-pie.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-dry-mixture-vegan-oatmeal-pie.description: In a separate bowl, combine the flour, salt, and baking soda. Gradually add the dry mixture to the oat mixture, stirring after each addition.

assemble-pie-vegan-oatmeal-pie.title: Assemble the pie
assemble-pie-vegan-oatmeal-pie.description: Grease a baking pan with a little vegetable oil. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Transfer the batter to the pan and spread it evenly. Arrange the berries on top in a single layer.

bake-pie-vegan-oatmeal-pie.title: Bake the pie
bake-pie-vegan-oatmeal-pie.description: Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 60–65 minutes. Check doneness by inserting a wooden skewer into the center; it should come out clean.

chop-and-grate-vegetable-bread.title: Chop herbs and grate cheese
chop-and-grate-vegetable-bread.description: Finely chop the onion, spinach, and parsley. Grate the hard cheese on the large side of a grater.

grate-and-squeeze-zucchini-vegetable-bre.title: Grate and squeeze zucchini and carrot
grate-and-squeeze-zucchini-vegetable-bre.description: Grate the zucchini and carrot coarsely. Wrap them in cheesecloth and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.

combine-ingredients-vegetable-bread.title: Combine dry ingredients
combine-ingredients-vegetable-bread.description: In a deep bowl, mix together the squeezed vegetables, chopped herbs, and grated cheese. Add the salt and stir to distribute.

add-wet-ingredients-vegetable-bread.title: Add oil and eggs
add-wet-ingredients-vegetable-bread.description: Pour in the olive oil and crack the eggs over the vegetable mixture. Stir everything thoroughly until well combined.

mix-and-transfer-dough-vegetable-bread.title: Mix in flour and transfer to pan
mix-and-transfer-dough-vegetable-bread.description: Add the almond flour and mix until a dough forms. Transfer the dough to a loaf pan, using a silicone spatula to press it evenly into the corners.

sprinkle-seeds-vegetable-bread.title: Sprinkle hemp seeds on top
sprinkle-seeds-vegetable-bread.description: Evenly scatter the hemp seeds over the surface of the dough.

bake-bread-vegetable-bread.title: Bake the bread
bake-bread-vegetable-bread.description: Place the loaf pan in an oven preheated to 170°C and bake for 40 minutes. The bread is done when a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.

cool-and-remove-vegetable-bread.title: Cool and unmold
cool-and-remove-vegetable-bread.description: Let the bread cool in the pan for at least 10 minutes, then carefully remove it from the pan. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

chop-vegetables-vegetable-crepes.title: Chop the vegetables
chop-vegetables-vegetable-crepes.description: Dice the zucchini and eggplant into medium cubes. Finely dice the onion and bell pepper.

grate-and-chop-vegetable-crepes.title: Grate and chop
grate-and-chop-vegetable-crepes.description: Coarsely grate the mozzarella. Finely chop the dill and garlic.

coat-vegetables-vegetable-crepes.title: Coat vegetables with flour
coat-vegetables-vegetable-crepes.description: Sprinkle flour over the diced zucchini and eggplant. Toss to coat evenly.

fry-coated-vegetables-vegetable-crepes.title: Fry the coated vegetables
fry-coated-vegetables-vegetable-crepes.description: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the floured zucchini and eggplant and fry until golden brown. Transfer to a plate.

saute-onion-vegetable-crepes.title: Sauté the onion
saute-onion-vegetable-crepes.description: Add the diced onion to the same skillet and cook over medium heat until translucent, stirring occasionally.

fry-bell-pepper-vegetable-crepes.title: Fry the bell pepper
fry-bell-pepper-vegetable-crepes.description: Add the diced bell pepper to the skillet with the onion. Continue cooking until the pepper is soft.

combine-filling-vegetable-crepes.title: Combine the filling
combine-filling-vegetable-crepes.description: Return the fried zucchini and eggplant to the skillet. Add the chopped dill, garlic, half of the grated mozzarella, and salt. Mix well.

whisk-egg-mix-vegetable-crepes.title: Whisk eggs with sugar and salt
whisk-egg-mix-vegetable-crepes.description: In a bowl, whisk the eggs together with the sugar and salt until well combined.

add-milk-and-flour-vegetable-crepes.title: Add milk and flour gradually
add-milk-and-flour-vegetable-crepes.description: Pour half of the milk into the egg mixture. Gradually add the flour while stirring constantly to avoid lumps.

add-remaining-milk-oil-vegetable-crepes.title: Add remaining milk and oil
add-remaining-milk-oil-vegetable-crepes.description: Stir in the remaining milk and the vegetable oil. Mix until the batter is smooth.

rest-batter-vegetable-crepes.title: Rest the batter
rest-batter-vegetable-crepes.description: Let the batter sit for 5 minutes to allow the gluten to relax.

fry-pancakes-vegetable-crepes.title: Fry the pancakes
fry-pancakes-vegetable-crepes.description: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat with a little oil. Pour a ladleful of batter and swirl to coat the pan. Cook until golden on both sides. Repeat with remaining batter.

fill-and-roll-pancakes-vegetable-crepes.title: Fill and roll the pancakes
fill-and-roll-pancakes-vegetable-crepes.description: Place about 2 tablespoons of the vegetable filling on one edge of each pancake. Roll it up like a tight roll or envelope.

make-sauce-vegetable-crepes.title: Make the sauce
make-sauce-vegetable-crepes.description: In a small bowl, combine sour cream and ketchup. Stir in the remaining grated mozzarella. Mix well.

shred-vegetables-vegetable-nests-with-ch.title: Shred the vegetables
shred-vegetables-vegetable-nests-with-ch.description: Shred the zucchini, carrots, and potatoes into thin strips using a Korean carrot grater or a vegetable peeler with serrated blades.

salt-and-squeeze-vegetables-vegetable-ne.title: Salt and squeeze the vegetables
salt-and-squeeze-vegetables-vegetable-ne.description: Transfer the shredded vegetables to a bowl, sprinkle with salt, and mix well. Let them rest for 10 minutes to release moisture. Then thoroughly squeeze out the liquid and transfer to another bowl.

mix-batter-vegetable-nests-with-cheese.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-vegetable-nests-with-cheese.description: Add flour, eggs, salt, and pepper to the squeezed vegetables. Stir until well combined.

form-nests-vegetable-nests-with-cheese.title: Form the nests
form-nests-vegetable-nests-with-cheese.description: Place the vegetable mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, shaping it into small fist-sized nests.

bake-vegetable-nests-with-cheese.title: Bake the nests
bake-vegetable-nests-with-cheese.description: Grate the cheese and fill the indentations in the nests. Optionally, place a cherry tomato in the center. Bake in the oven at 170°C for 30 minutes.

boil-beets-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.title: Boil the beets
boil-beets-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.description: Place the beets in a pot of salted water and bring to a boil. Cook for 45–50 minutes until tender.

cool-peel-grate-beets-vegetable-waffles-.title: Cool, peel, and grate the beets
cool-peel-grate-beets-vegetable-waffles-.description: Let the beets cool slightly, then peel them. Grate the beets on a coarse grater and squeeze out excess moisture.

grate-celery-carrots-vegetable-waffles-b.title: Grate celery root and carrots
grate-celery-carrots-vegetable-waffles-b.description: Peel the celery root and carrots. Grate them coarsely and place each in separate bowls.

chop-onion-grate-cheese-vegetable-waffle.title: Chop onion and grate cheese
chop-onion-grate-cheese-vegetable-waffle.description: Finely chop the onion. Grate the hard cheese on a fine grater. Combine them in a large clean bowl.

mix-batter-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.description: Add the flour, milk, eggs, and salt to the bowl with onion and cheese. Stir until well combined.

divide-batter-vegetable-waffles-breakfas.title: Divide the batter
divide-batter-vegetable-waffles-breakfas.description: Divide the batter into three equal portions.

add-vegetables-to-batter-vegetable-waffl.title: Add grated vegetables to the batter
add-vegetables-to-batter-vegetable-waffl.description: Add one type of grated vegetable to each portion of batter: carrots to one, celery root to another, and beets to the third.

add-herbs-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.title: Add herbs
add-herbs-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.description: To the carrot batter, add chopped mint and thyme. To the beet batter, add chopped dill. To the celery root batter, add chopped parsley. Mix each well.

cook-waffles-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-vegetable-waffles-breakfast.description: Grease the waffle iron with vegetable oil. Spoon 2–3 tablespoons of one batter onto the iron, close, and cook for 3–4 minutes until golden. Repeat with the remaining batter.

whip-egg-yolk-vietnamese-egg-coffee.title: Whip egg yolk with condensed milk
whip-egg-yolk-vietnamese-egg-coffee.description: Separate the egg yolk from the white. Discard or refrigerate the white. Add condensed milk to the yolk and whisk until light and fluffy, about 2–3 minutes.

brew-coffee-vietnamese-egg-coffee.title: Brew the coffee
brew-coffee-vietnamese-egg-coffee.description: Brew a strong coffee using your preferred method — a Turkish cezve, French press, or drip filter. Use boiling water and about 3 teaspoons of ground coffee.

pour-coffee-and-top-vietnamese-egg-coffe.title: Assemble the drink
pour-coffee-and-top-vietnamese-egg-coffe.description: Pour the hot brewed coffee into a cup. Gently spoon the whipped egg yolk mixture on top. Serve immediately.

whisk-eggs-waffles-with-tuna-and-celery.title: Whisk the eggs
whisk-eggs-waffles-with-tuna-and-celery.description: Break the eggs into a bowl, add salt, and whisk with a whisk until smooth.

mix-batter-waffles-with-tuna-and-celery.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-waffles-with-tuna-and-celery.description: Finely grate the cheese into the eggs, add almond flour, and quickly mix into a thick batter.

preheat-waffle-iron-waffles-with-tuna-an.title: Preheat the waffle iron
preheat-waffle-iron-waffles-with-tuna-an.description: Brush the waffle iron plates with vegetable oil and let the appliance heat up.

bake-waffles-batch-waffles-with-tuna-and.title: Bake the first batch of waffles
bake-waffles-batch-waffles-with-tuna-and.description: Pour 2-3 tablespoons of batter into each compartment, close the lid, and bake for 3-4 minutes.

cook-remaining-waffles-waffles-with-tuna.title: Cook the remaining waffles
cook-remaining-waffles-waffles-with-tuna.description: Remove the cooked waffles and repeat the process with the remaining batter until all batter is used.

dice-vegetables-waffles-with-tuna-and-ce.title: Dice the vegetables
dice-vegetables-waffles-with-tuna-and-ce.description: Cut the red onion and celery into small cubes.

mix-tuna-filling-waffles-with-tuna-and-c.title: Mix the tuna filling
mix-tuna-filling-waffles-with-tuna-and-c.description: Place the tuna fillet in a bowl, flake it with a fork, then add the diced vegetables and Greek yogurt. Mix well.

assemble-dish-waffles-with-tuna-and-cele.title: Assemble the dish
assemble-dish-waffles-with-tuna-and-cele.description: Arrange the waffles on a serving plate and top with the tuna mixture. Garnish with cherry tomatoes if desired.

cut-crusts-weird-sandwich.title: Cut the crusts off the bread
cut-crusts-weird-sandwich.description: Use a sharp knife to cut off the crusts from all six slices of bread.

beat-egg-weird-sandwich.title: Beat the egg
beat-egg-weird-sandwich.description: Crack one egg into a bowl and beat it with a fork until the yolk and white are fully combined. Do not whisk to a froth.

dip-bread-weird-sandwich.title: Dip bread slices in egg
dip-bread-weird-sandwich.description: Take two slices of the bread and dip them into the beaten egg on both sides, ensuring they are fully coated. Reserve the remaining egg.

fry-bread-weird-sandwich.title: Fry the dipped bread
fry-bread-weird-sandwich.description: Heat a non-stick pan over high heat and fry the egg-coated bread slices for about 1 minute per side until golden brown. Set aside.

mix-mayo-honey-weird-sandwich.title: Mix mayonnaise and honey
mix-mayo-honey-weird-sandwich.description: In a clean bowl, combine one tablespoon of mayonnaise with one teaspoon of honey and stir until smooth.

spread-mixture-weird-sandwich.title: Spread the mixture on bread
spread-mixture-weird-sandwich.description: Spread the mayonnaise-honey mixture on one side of each of the remaining four bread slices.

assemble-sandwiches-weird-sandwich.title: Assemble the sandwiches
assemble-sandwiches-weird-sandwich.description: Place two of the spread bread slices mayo-side up. Top each with two slices of ham, then place one fried bread slice on top of the ham. Add the remaining ham slices on the fried bread and cover with the remaining spread bread slices, mayo-side down.

mix-egg-milk-weird-sandwich.title: Mix leftover egg with milk
mix-egg-milk-weird-sandwich.description: Add the 50 ml of milk to the leftover beaten egg and whisk until combined.

coat-sandwiches-weird-sandwich.title: Coat the sandwiches
coat-sandwiches-weird-sandwich.description: Butter the top and bottom of each sandwich, then brush the buttered surfaces with the egg-milk mixture.

bake-sandwiches-weird-sandwich.title: Bake the sandwiches
bake-sandwiches-weird-sandwich.description: Place the sandwiches on a parchment-lined baking sheet, sprinkle with sugar, and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 5 minutes until golden and caramelized.

grate-zucchini-zucchini-breads-with-chee.title: Grate the zucchini
grate-zucchini-zucchini-breads-with-chee.description: Grate the zucchini finely. Sprinkle with salt and let sit for 10 minutes to draw out moisture.

squeeze-zucchini-zucchini-breads-with-ch.title: Squeeze out the moisture
squeeze-zucchini-zucchini-breads-with-ch.description: After the zucchini has rested, squeeze it firmly to remove as much liquid as possible. This is important for a crispy texture.

mix-eggs-seasonings-zucchini-breads-with.title: Add eggs and seasonings
mix-eggs-seasonings-zucchini-breads-with.description: Add the eggs, dried dill, and black pepper to the squeezed zucchini. Mix until well combined.

add-flour-mix-zucchini-breads-with-chees.title: Add the flour
add-flour-mix-zucchini-breads-with-chees.description: Gradually add the flour while mixing. The batter should become thick and stretchy. You may need slightly more or less flour.

prepare-baking-sheet-zucchini-breads-wit.title: Prepare the baking sheet
prepare-baking-sheet-zucchini-breads-wit.description: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and brush it with sunflower oil.

spread-batter-zucchini-breads-with-chees.title: Spread the batter
spread-batter-zucchini-breads-with-chees.description: Spread the batter onto the prepared baking sheet in a rectangular shape, no more than 1 cm thick.

bake-base-zucchini-breads-with-cheese.title: Bake the base
bake-base-zucchini-breads-with-cheese.description: Bake the zucchini base for 30 minutes at 220 °C. The edges should become nicely browned and crispy.

top-with-cheese-zucchini-breads-with-che.title: Top with cheese
top-with-cheese-zucchini-breads-with-che.description: Remove the baked base from the oven and sprinkle the grated Parmesan evenly over the top.

bake-with-cheese-zucchini-breads-with-ch.title: Bake with cheese
bake-with-cheese-zucchini-breads-with-ch.description: Reduce the oven temperature to 180 °C (350 °F) and return the sheet to the oven. Bake for another 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden.

grate-zucchini-zucchini-waffles-with-red.title: Grate the zucchini
grate-zucchini-zucchini-waffles-with-red.description: Peel the zucchini and grate it on a coarse grater.

salt-zucchini-zucchini-waffles-with-red-.title: Salt the zucchini
salt-zucchini-zucchini-waffles-with-red-.description: Sprinkle salt over the grated zucchini, mix well.

rest-zucchini-zucchini-waffles-with-red-.title: Let the zucchini rest
rest-zucchini-zucchini-waffles-with-red-.description: Leave the salted zucchini for 15 minutes to release liquid.

beat-sour-cream-egg-zucchini-waffles-wit.title: Beat sour cream and egg
beat-sour-cream-egg-zucchini-waffles-wit.description: In a clean bowl, whisk together the sour cream and egg until smooth.

squeeze-and-add-zucchini-zucchini-waffle.title: Squeeze and add zucchini
squeeze-and-add-zucchini-zucchini-waffle.description: Squeeze the excess liquid from the zucchini, then add the zucchini pulp to the egg mixture.

add-flour-and-mix-zucchini-waffles-with-.title: Add flour and mix dough
add-flour-and-mix-zucchini-waffles-with-.description: Add the rice flour to the mixture and stir until a uniform batter forms.

cook-waffles-zucchini-waffles-with-red-f.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-zucchini-waffles-with-red-f.description: Preheat the waffle iron, distribute the batter evenly, and cook until golden brown.

plate-and-top-with-fish-zucchini-waffles.title: Plate and top with fish
plate-and-top-with-fish-zucchini-waffles.description: Transfer the cooked waffles to a serving plate and arrange slices of salted red fish on top.

grate-and-squeeze-zucchini-zucchini-waff.title: Grate and squeeze zucchini
grate-and-squeeze-zucchini-zucchini-waff.description: Coarsely grate the zucchini. Wrap it in cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out excess moisture thoroughly.

mix-batter-zucchini-waffles-with-sausage.title: Mix the batter
mix-batter-zucchini-waffles-with-sausage.description: In a bowl, combine the squeezed zucchini with eggs and rice flour. Add baking powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined.

cook-waffles-zucchini-waffles-with-sausa.title: Cook the waffles
cook-waffles-zucchini-waffles-with-sausa.description: Preheat your waffle iron. Lightly grease the surface with 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil. Pour the batter and cook for 3-4 minutes until golden and cooked through.

make-salad-zucchini-waffles-with-sausage.title: Make the salad
make-salad-zucchini-waffles-with-sausage.description: Dice the tomatoes and chop the basil. Dress with olive oil and vinegar, add salt to taste, and toss to combine.

fry-sausages-zucchini-waffles-with-sausa.title: Fry the sausages
fry-sausages-zucchini-waffles-with-sausa.description: Slice the sausages into rounds. Heat 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the sausage slices for 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
